descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/abs:
Returns the absolute value of a Variant parameter x (i.e. non-negative
value). Supported types: int, float, Vector2, Vector2i, Vector3,
Vector3i, Vector4, Vector4i.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/absf: Returns the absolute value of float parameter x (i.e. positive value).
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/absi: Returns the absolute value of int parameter x (i.e. positive value).
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/acos:
Returns the arc cosine of x in radians. Use to get the angle of cosine
x. x will be clamped between -1.0 and 1.0 (inclusive), in order to
prevent acos from returning @GDScript.NAN.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/acosh:
Returns the hyperbolic arc (also called inverse) cosine of x, returning
a value in radians. Use it to get the angle from an angle's cosine in
hyperbolic space if x is larger or equal to 1. For values of x lower
than 1, it will return 0, in order to prevent acosh from returning
@GDScript.NAN.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/angle_difference:
Returns the difference between the two angles (in radians), in the range
of [-PI, +PI]. When from and to are opposite, returns -PI if from is
smaller than to, or PI otherwise.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/asin:
Returns the arc sine of x in radians. Use to get the angle of sine x. x
will be clamped between -1.0 and 1.0 (inclusive), in order to prevent
asin from returning @GDScript.NAN.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/asinh:
Returns the hyperbolic arc (also called inverse) sine of x, returning a
value in radians. Use it to get the angle from an angle's sine in
hyperbolic space.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/atan:
Returns the arc tangent of x in radians. Use it to get the angle from an
angle's tangent in trigonometry. The method cannot know in which
quadrant the angle should fall. See atan2 if you have both y and x.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/atan2:
Returns the arc tangent of y/x in radians. Use to get the angle of
tangent y/x. To compute the value, the method takes into account the
sign of both arguments in order to determine the quadrant. Important
note: The Y coordinate comes first, by convention.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/atanh:
Returns the hyperbolic arc (also called inverse) tangent of x, returning
a value in radians. Use it to get the angle from an angle's tangent in
hyperbolic space if x is between -1 and 1 (non-inclusive). In
mathematics, the inverse hyperbolic tangent is only defined for -1 < x <
1 in the real set, so values equal or lower to -1 for x return
negative...
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/bezier_derivative:
Returns the derivative at the given t on a one-dimensional Bézier curve
defined by the given control_1, control_2, and end points.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/bezier_interpolate:
Returns the point at the given t on a one-dimensional Bézier curve
defined by the given control_1, control_2, and end points.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/bytes_to_var:
Decodes a byte array back to a Variant value, without decoding objects.
Note: If you need object deserialization, see bytes_to_var_with_objects.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/bytes_to_var_with_ob:
Decodes a byte array back to a Variant value. Decoding objects is
allowed. Warning: Deserialized object can contain code which gets
executed. Do not use this option if the serialized object comes from
untrusted sources to avoid potential security threats (remote code
execution).
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/ceil:
Rounds x upward (towards positive infinity), returning the smallest
whole number that is not less than x. Supported types: int, float,
Vector2, Vector2i, Vector3, Vector3i, Vector4, Vector4i.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/ceilf:
Rounds x upward (towards positive infinity), returning the smallest
whole number that is not less than x. A type-safe version of ceil,
returning a float.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/ceili:
Rounds x upward (towards positive infinity), returning the smallest
whole number that is not less than x. A type-safe version of ceil,
returning an int.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/clamp:
Clamps the value, returning a Variant not less than min and not more
than max. Any values that can be compared with the less than and greater
than operators will work.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/clampf:
Clamps the value, returning a float not less than min and not more than
max.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/clampi:
Clamps the value, returning an int not less than min and not more than
max.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/cos: Returns the cosine of angle angle_rad in radians.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/cosh: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of x in radians.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/cubic_interpolate:
Cubic interpolates between two values by the factor defined in weight
with pre and post values.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/cubic_interpolate_an:
Cubic interpolates between two rotation values with shortest path by the
factor defined in weight with pre and post values. See also lerp_angle.

Cubic interpolates between two rotation values with shortest path by the
factor defined in weight with pre and post values. See also lerp_angle.
It can perform smoother interpolation than cubic_interpolate by the time
values.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/cubic_interpolate_in:
Cubic interpolates between two values by the factor defined in weight
with pre and post values. It can perform smoother interpolation than
cubic_interpolate by the time values.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/db_to_linear: Converts from decibels to linear energy (audio).
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/deg_to_rad: Converts an angle expressed in degrees to radians.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/ease:
Returns an "eased" value of x based on an easing function defined with
curve. This easing function is based on an exponent. The curve can be
any floating-point number, with specific values leading to the following
behaviors:
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/error_string: Returns a human-readable name for the given Error code.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/exp:
The natural exponential function. It raises the mathematical constant e
to the power of x and returns it. e has an approximate value of 2.71828,
and can be obtained with exp(1). For exponents to other bases use the
method pow.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/floor:
Rounds x downward (towards negative infinity), returning the largest
whole number that is not more than x. Supported types: int, float,
Vector2, Vector2i, Vector3, Vector3i, Vector4, Vector4i.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/floorf:
Rounds x downward (towards negative infinity), returning the largest
whole number that is not more than x. A type-safe version of floor,
returning a float.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/floori:
Rounds x downward (towards negative infinity), returning the largest
whole number that is not more than x. A type-safe version of floor,
returning an int. Note: This function is not the same as int(x), which
rounds towards 0.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/fmod:
Returns the floating-point remainder of x divided by y, keeping the sign
of x.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/fposmod:
Returns the floating-point modulus of x divided by y, wrapping equally
in positive and negative.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/hash: Returns the integer hash of the passed variable.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/instance_from_id:
Returns the Object that corresponds to instance_id. All Objects have a
unique instance ID. See also Object.get_instance_id.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/inverse_lerp:
Returns an interpolation or extrapolation factor considering the range
specified in from and to, and the interpolated value specified in
weight. The returned value will be between 0.0 and 1.0 if weight is
between from and to (inclusive). If weight is located outside this
range, then an extrapolation factor will be returned (return value lower
than 0.0 or...
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/is_equal_approx:
Returns true if a and b are approximately equal to each other. Here,
"approximately equal" means that a and b are within a small internal
epsilon of each other, which scales with the magnitude of the numbers.
Infinity values of the same sign are considered equal.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/is_finite:
Returns whether x is a finite value, i.e. it is not @GDScript.NAN,
positive infinity, or negative infinity. See also is_inf and is_nan.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/is_inf:
Returns true if x is either positive infinity or negative infinity. See
also is_finite and is_nan.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/is_instance_id_valid:
Returns true if the Object that corresponds to id is a valid object
(e.g. has not been deleted from memory). All Objects have a unique
instance ID.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/is_instance_valid:
Returns true if instance is a valid Object (e.g. has not been deleted
from memory).
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/is_nan:
Returns true if x is a NaN ("Not a Number" or invalid) value. This
method is needed as @GDScript.NAN is not equal to itself, which means x
== NAN can't be used to check whether a value is a NaN.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/is_same:
Returns true, for value types, if a and b share the same value. Returns
true, for reference types, if the references of a and b are the same.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/is_zero_approx:
Returns true if x is zero or almost zero. The comparison is done using a
tolerance calculation with a small internal epsilon. This function is
faster than using is_equal_approx with one value as zero.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/lerp:
Linearly interpolates between two values by the factor defined in
weight. To perform interpolation, weight should be between 0.0 and 1.0
(inclusive). However, values outside this range are allowed and can be
used to perform extrapolation. If this is not desired, use clampf to
limit weight. Both from and to must be the same type. Supported types:
int,...
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/lerp_angle:
Linearly interpolates between two angles (in radians) by a weight value
between 0.0 and 1.0. Similar to lerp, but interpolates correctly when
the angles wrap around @GDScript.TAU. To perform eased interpolation
with lerp_angle, combine it with ease or smoothstep.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/lerpf:
Linearly interpolates between two values by the factor defined in
weight. To perform interpolation, weight should be between 0.0 and 1.0
(inclusive). However, values outside this range are allowed and can be
used to perform extrapolation. If this is not desired, use clampf on the
result of this function.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/linear_to_db:
Converts from linear energy to decibels (audio). Since volume is not
normally linear, this can be used to implement volume sliders that
behave as expected. Example: Change the Master bus's volume through a
Slider node, which ranges from 0.0 to 1.0:
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/log:
Returns the natural logarithm of x (base e, with e being approximately
2.71828). This is the amount of time needed to reach a certain level of
continuous growth. Note: This is not the same as the "log" function on
most calculators, which uses a base 10 logarithm. To use base 10
logarithm, use log(x) / log(10).
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/max:
Returns the maximum of the given numeric values. This function can take
any number of arguments.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/maxf: Returns the maximum of two float values.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/maxi: Returns the maximum of two int values.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/min:
Returns the minimum of the given numeric values. This function can take
any number of arguments.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/minf: Returns the minimum of two float values.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/mini: Returns the minimum of two int values.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/move_toward:
Moves from toward to by the delta amount. Will not go past to. Use a
negative delta value to move away.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/nearest_po2:
Returns the smallest integer power of 2 that is greater than or equal to
value.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/pingpong:
Wraps value between 0 and the length. If the limit is reached, the next
value the function returns is decreased to the 0 side or increased to
the length side (like a triangle wave). If length is less than zero, it
becomes positive.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/posmod:
Returns the integer modulus of x divided by y that wraps equally in
positive and negative.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/pow:
Returns the result of base raised to the power of exp. In GDScript, this
is the equivalent of the ** operator.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/print:
Converts one or more arguments of any type to string in the best way
possible and prints them to the console.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/print_rich:
Converts one or more arguments of any type to string in the best way
possible and prints them to the console. The following BBCode tags are
supported: b, i, u, s, indent, code, url, center, right, color, bgcolor,
fgcolor. URL tags only support URLs wrapped by a URL tag, not URLs with
a different title. When printing to standard output, the supported...
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/print_verbose:
If verbose mode is enabled (OS.is_stdout_verbose returning true),
converts one or more arguments of any type to string in the best way
possible and prints them to the console.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/printerr:
Prints one or more arguments to strings in the best way possible to
standard error line.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/printraw:
Prints one or more arguments to strings in the best way possible to the
OS terminal. Unlike print, no newline is automatically added at the end.
Note: The OS terminal is not the same as the editor's Output dock. The
output sent to the OS terminal can be seen when running Godot from a
terminal. On Windows, this requires using the console.exe executable.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/prints:
Prints one or more arguments to the console with a space between each
argument.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/printt:
Prints one or more arguments to the console with a tab between each
argument.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/push_error:
Pushes an error message to Godot's built-in debugger and to the OS
terminal.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/push_warning:
Pushes a warning message to Godot's built-in debugger and to the OS
terminal.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/rad_to_deg: Converts an angle expressed in radians to degrees.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/rand_from_seed:
Given a seed, returns a PackedInt64Array of size 2, where its first
element is the randomized int value, and the second element is the same
as seed. Passing the same seed consistently returns the same array.
Note: "Seed" here refers to the internal state of the pseudo random
number generator, currently implemented as a 64 bit integer.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/randf: Returns a random floating-point value between 0.0 and 1.0 (inclusive).
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/randf_range: Returns a random floating-point value between from and to (inclusive).
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/randfn:
Returns a normally-distributed, pseudo-random floating-point value from
the specified mean and a standard deviation. This is also known as a
Gaussian distribution. Note: This method uses the Box-Muller transform
algorithm.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/randi:
Returns a random unsigned 32-bit integer. Use remainder to obtain a
random value in the interval [0, N - 1] (where N is smaller than 2^32).
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/randi_range:
Returns a random signed 32-bit integer between from and to (inclusive).
If to is lesser than from, they are swapped.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/randomize:
Randomizes the seed (or the internal state) of the random number
generator. The current implementation uses a number based on the
device's time. Note: This function is called automatically when the
project is run. If you need to fix the seed to have consistent,
reproducible results, use seed to initialize the random number
generator.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/remap:
Maps a value from range [istart, istop] to [ostart, ostop]. See also
lerp and inverse_lerp. If value is outside [istart, istop], then the
resulting value will also be outside [ostart, ostop]. If this is not
desired, use clamp on the result of this function.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/rid_allocate_id:
Allocates a unique ID which can be used by the implementation to
construct an RID. This is used mainly from native extensions to
implement servers.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/rid_from_int64:
Creates an RID from a base. This is used mainly from native extensions
to build servers.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/rotate_toward:
Rotates from toward to by the delta amount. Will not go past to. Similar
to move_toward, but interpolates correctly when the angles wrap around
@GDScript.TAU. If delta is negative, this function will rotate away from
to, toward the opposite angle, and will not go past the opposite angle.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/roundf:
Rounds x to the nearest whole number, with halfway cases rounded away
from 0. A type-safe version of round, returning a float.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/roundi:
Rounds x to the nearest whole number, with halfway cases rounded away
from 0. A type-safe version of round, returning an int.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/seed:
Sets the seed for the random number generator to base. Setting the seed
manually can ensure consistent, repeatable results for most random
functions.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/sign:
Returns the same type of Variant as x, with -1 for negative values, 1
for positive values, and 0 for zeros. For nan values it returns 0.
Supported types: int, float, Vector2, Vector2i, Vector3, Vector3i,
Vector4, Vector4i.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/signf:
Returns -1.0 if x is negative, 1.0 if x is positive, and 0.0 if x is
zero. For nan values of x it returns 0.0.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/signi: Returns -1 if x is negative, 1 if x is positive, and 0 if x is zero.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/sin: Returns the sine of angle angle_rad in radians.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/sinh: Returns the hyperbolic sine of x.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/smoothstep:
Returns a smooth cubic Hermite interpolation between 0 and 1. For
positive ranges (when from <= to) the return value is 0 when x <= from,
and 1 when x >= to. If x lies between from and to, the return value
follows an S-shaped curve that smoothly transitions from 0 to 1. For
negative ranges (when from > to) the function is mirrored and returns 1
when x <=...
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/snapped:
Returns the multiple of step that is the closest to x. This can also be
used to round a floating-point number to an arbitrary number of
decimals. The returned value is the same type of Variant as step.
Supported types: int, float, Vector2, Vector2i, Vector3, Vector3i,
Vector4, Vector4i.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/snappedf:
Returns the multiple of step that is the closest to x. This can also be
used to round a floating-point number to an arbitrary number of
decimals. A type-safe version of snapped, returning a float.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/snappedi:
Returns the multiple of step that is the closest to x. A type-safe
version of snapped, returning an int.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/sqrt: Returns the square root of x, where x is a non-negative number.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/step_decimals:
Returns the position of the first non-zero digit, after the decimal
point. Note that the maximum return value is 10, which is a design
decision in the implementation.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/str:
Converts one or more arguments of any Variant type to a String in the
best way possible.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/str_to_var:
Converts a formatted string that was returned by var_to_str to the
original Variant.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/tan: Returns the tangent of angle angle_rad in radians.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/tanh: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of x.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/type_convert:
Converts the given variant to the given type, using the Variant.Type
values. This method is generous with how it handles types, it can
automatically convert between array types, convert numeric Strings to
int, and converting most things to String. If the type conversion cannot
be done, this method will return the default value for that type, for
example...
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/type_string:
Returns a human-readable name of the given type, using the Variant.Type
values.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/typeof:
Returns the internal type of the given variable, using the Variant.Type
values.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/var_to_bytes:
Encodes a Variant value to a byte array, without encoding objects.
Deserialization can be done with bytes_to_var. Note: If you need object
serialization, see var_to_bytes_with_objects. Note: Encoding Callable is
not supported and will result in an empty value, regardless of the data.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/var_to_bytes_with_ob:
Encodes a Variant value to a byte array. Encoding objects is allowed
(and can potentially include executable code). Deserialization can be
done with bytes_to_var_with_objects. Note: Encoding Callable is not
supported and will result in an empty value, regardless of the data.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/var_to_str:
Converts a Variant variable to a formatted String that can then be
parsed using str_to_var.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/weakref:
Returns a WeakRef instance holding a weak reference to obj. Returns an
empty WeakRef instance if obj is null. Prints an error and returns null
if obj is neither Object-derived nor null. A weak reference to an object
is not enough to keep the object alive: when the only remaining
references to a referent are weak references, garbage collection is free
to...
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/wrap:
Wraps the Variant value between min and max. min is inclusive while max
is exclusive. This can be used for creating loop-like behavior or
infinite surfaces. Variant types int and float are supported. If any of
the arguments is float, this function returns a float, otherwise it
returns an int.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/wrapf:
Wraps the float value between min and max. min is inclusive while max is
exclusive. This can be used for creating loop-like behavior or infinite
surfaces.
descriptions.@GlobalScope/method/wrapi:
Wraps the integer value between min and max. min is inclusive while max
is exclusive. This can be used for creating loop-like behavior or
infinite surfaces.
descriptions.AABB/method/abs:
Returns an AABB equivalent to this bounding box, with its width, height,
and depth modified to be non-negative values.
descriptions.AABB/method/encloses:
Returns true if this bounding box completely encloses the with box. The
edges of both boxes are included.
descriptions.AABB/method/expand:
Returns a copy of this bounding box expanded to align the edges with the
given to_point, if necessary.
descriptions.AABB/method/get_center:
Returns the center point of the bounding box. This is the same as
position + (size / 2.0).
descriptions.AABB/method/get_endpoint:
Returns the position of one of the 8 vertices that compose this bounding
box. With an idx of 0 this is the same as position, and an idx of 7 is
the same as end.
descriptions.AABB/method/get_longest_axis:
Returns the longest normalized axis of this bounding box's size, as a
Vector3 (Vector3.RIGHT, Vector3.UP, or Vector3.BACK).
descriptions.AABB/method/get_longest_axis_index:
Returns the index to the longest axis of this bounding box's size (see
Vector3.AXIS_X, Vector3.AXIS_Y, and Vector3.AXIS_Z). For an example, see
get_longest_axis.
descriptions.AABB/method/get_longest_axis_size:
Returns the longest dimension of this bounding box's size. For an
example, see get_longest_axis.
descriptions.AABB/method/get_shortest_axis:
Returns the shortest normalized axis of this bounding box's size, as a
Vector3 (Vector3.RIGHT, Vector3.UP, or Vector3.BACK).
descriptions.AABB/method/get_shortest_axis_index:
Returns the index to the shortest axis of this bounding box's size (see
Vector3.AXIS_X, Vector3.AXIS_Y, and Vector3.AXIS_Z). For an example, see
get_shortest_axis.
descriptions.AABB/method/get_shortest_axis_size:
Returns the shortest dimension of this bounding box's size. For an
example, see get_shortest_axis.
descriptions.AABB/method/get_support:
Returns the vertex's position of this bounding box that's the farthest
in the given direction. This point is commonly known as the support
point in collision detection algorithms.
descriptions.AABB/method/get_volume:
Returns the bounding box's volume. This is equivalent to size.x * size.y
* size.z. See also has_volume.
descriptions.AABB/method/grow:
Returns a copy of this bounding box extended on all sides by the given
amount by. A negative amount shrinks the box instead.
descriptions.AABB/method/has_point:
Returns true if the bounding box contains the given point. By
convention, points exactly on the right, top, and front sides are not
included. Note: This method is not reliable for AABB with a negative
size. Use abs first to get a valid bounding box.
descriptions.AABB/method/has_surface:
Returns true if this bounding box has a surface or a length, that is, at
least one component of size is greater than 0. Otherwise, returns false.
descriptions.AABB/method/has_volume:
Returns true if this bounding box's width, height, and depth are all
positive. See also get_volume.
descriptions.AABB/method/intersection:
Returns the intersection between this bounding box and with. If the
boxes do not intersect, returns an empty AABB. If the boxes intersect at
the edge, returns a flat AABB with no volume (see has_surface and
has_volume).
descriptions.AABB/method/intersects:
Returns true if this bounding box overlaps with the box with. The edges
of both boxes are always excluded.
descriptions.AABB/method/intersects_plane: Returns true if this bounding box is on both sides of the given plane.
descriptions.AABB/method/intersects_ray:
Returns the first point where this bounding box and the given ray
intersect, as a Vector3. If no intersection occurs, returns null. The
ray begin at from, faces dir and extends towards infinity.
descriptions.AABB/method/intersects_segment:
Returns the first point where this bounding box and the given segment
intersect, as a Vector3. If no intersection occurs, returns null. The
segment begins at from and ends at to.
descriptions.AABB/method/is_equal_approx:
Returns true if this bounding box and aabb are approximately equal, by
calling Vector3.is_equal_approx on the position and the size.
descriptions.AABB/method/is_finite:
Returns true if this bounding box's values are finite, by calling
Vector3.is_finite on the position and the size.
descriptions.AABB/method/merge:
Returns an AABB that encloses both this bounding box and with around the
edges. See also encloses.
descriptions.AESContext/method/finish: Close this AES context so it can be started again. See start.
descriptions.AESContext/method/get_iv_state:
Get the current IV state for this context (IV gets updated when calling
update). You normally don't need this function. Note: This function only
makes sense when the context is started with MODE_CBC_ENCRYPT or
MODE_CBC_DECRYPT.
descriptions.AESContext/method/start:
Start the AES context in the given mode. A key of either 16 or 32 bytes
must always be provided, while an iv (initialization vector) of exactly
16 bytes, is only needed when mode is either MODE_CBC_ENCRYPT or
MODE_CBC_DECRYPT.
descriptions.AESContext/method/update:
Run the desired operation for this AES context. Will return a
PackedByteArray containing the result of encrypting (or decrypting) the
given src. See start for mode of operation. Note: The size of src must
be a multiple of 16. Apply some padding if needed.
descriptions.AStar2D/method/_compute_cost:
Called when computing the cost between two connected points. Note that
this function is hidden in the default AStar2D class.
descriptions.AStar2D/method/_estimate_cost:
Called when estimating the cost between a point and the path's ending
point. Note that this function is hidden in the default AStar2D class.
descriptions.AStar2D/method/_filter_neighbor:
Called when neighboring enters processing and if neighbor_filter_enabled
is true. If true is returned the point will not be processed. Note that
this function is hidden in the default AStar2D class.
descriptions.AStar2D/method/add_point:

Fills the given region on the grid with the specified value for the
solid flag. Note: Calling update is not needed after the call of this
function.
descriptions.AStarGrid2D/method/fill_weight_scale_reg:
Fills the given region on the grid with the specified value for the
weight scale. Note: Calling update is not needed after the call of this
function.

position: Vector2, solid: bool, weight_scale: float) within a region.

descriptions.AStarGrid2D/method/get_point_position: Returns the position of the point associated with the given id.
descriptions.AStarGrid2D/method/get_point_weight_scal: Returns the weight scale of the point associated with the given id.
descriptions.AStarGrid2D/method/is_dirty:
Indicates that the grid parameters were changed and update needs to be
called.
descriptions.AStarGrid2D/method/is_in_bounds:
Returns true if the x and y is a valid grid coordinate (id), i.e. if it
is inside region. Equivalent to region.has_point(Vector2i(x, y)).
descriptions.AStarGrid2D/method/is_in_boundsv:
Returns true if the id vector is a valid grid coordinate, i.e. if it is
inside region. Equivalent to region.has_point(id).
descriptions.AStarGrid2D/method/is_point_solid:
Returns true if a point is disabled for pathfinding. By default, all
points are enabled.
descriptions.AStarGrid2D/method/set_point_solid:
Disables or enables the specified point for pathfinding. Useful for
making an obstacle. By default, all points are enabled. Note: Calling
update is not needed after the call of this function.
descriptions.AStarGrid2D/method/set_point_weight_scal:
Sets the weight_scale for the point with the given id. The weight_scale
is multiplied by the result of _compute_cost when determining the
overall cost of traveling across a segment from a neighboring point to
this point. Note: Calling update is not needed after the call of this
function.
descriptions.AStarGrid2D/method/update:
Updates the internal state of the grid according to the parameters to
prepare it to search the path. Needs to be called if parameters like
region, cell_size or offset are changed. is_dirty will return true if
this is the case and this needs to be called. Note: All point data
(solidity and weight scale) will be cleared.
descriptions.AcceptDialog/method/add_button:
Adds a button with label text and a custom action to the dialog and
returns the created button. If action is not empty, pressing the button
will emit the custom_action signal with the specified action string. If
true, right will place the button to the right of any sibling buttons.
You can use remove_button method to remove a button created with this...
descriptions.AcceptDialog/method/add_cancel_button:
Adds a button with label name and a cancel action to the dialog and
returns the created button. You can use remove_button method to remove a
button created with this method from the dialog.
descriptions.AcceptDialog/method/get_label:
Returns the label used for built-in text. Warning: This is a required
internal node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If you wish to
hide it or any of its children, use their CanvasItem.visible property.
descriptions.AcceptDialog/method/get_ok_button:
Returns the OK Button instance. Warning: This is a required internal
node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If you wish to hide it
or any of its children, use their CanvasItem.visible property.
descriptions.AcceptDialog/method/register_text_enter:
Registers a LineEdit in the dialog. When the enter key is pressed, the
dialog will be accepted.
descriptions.AcceptDialog/method/remove_button:
Removes the button from the dialog. Does NOT free the button. The button
must be a Button added with add_button or add_cancel_button method.
After removal, pressing the button will no longer emit this dialog's
custom_action or canceled signals.
descriptions.AcceptDialog/signal/canceled:
Emitted when the dialog is closed or the button created with
add_cancel_button is pressed.
descriptions.AcceptDialog/signal/confirmed: Emitted when the dialog is accepted, i.e. the OK button is pressed.
descriptions.AcceptDialog/signal/custom_action: Emitted when a custom button with an action is pressed. See add_button.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/create_elemen:
Creates a new, empty accessibility element resource. Note: An
accessibility element is created and freed automatically for each Node.
In general, this function should not be called manually.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/create_sub_el:
Creates a new, empty accessibility sub-element resource. Sub-elements
can be used to provide accessibility information for objects which are
not Nodes, such as list items, table cells, or menu items. Sub-elements
are freed automatically when the parent element is freed, or can be
freed early using the free_element method.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/create_sub_te:
Creates a new, empty accessibility sub-element from the shaped text
buffer. Sub-elements are freed automatically when the parent element is
freed, or can be freed early using the free_element method. If
is_last_line is true, no trailing newline is appended to the text
content. Set to true for the last line in multi-line text fields and for
single-line...
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/element_get_m: Returns the metadata of the accessibility element id.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/element_set_m: Sets the metadata of the accessibility element id to meta.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/free_element:
Frees the accessibility element id created by create_element,
create_sub_element, or create_sub_text_edit_elements.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/get_window_ro: Returns the main accessibility element of the OS native window.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/has_element: Returns true if id is a valid accessibility element.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/is_supported: Returns true if screen reader is support by this implementation.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/set_window_fo:
Sets the window focused state for assistive apps. Note: This method is
implemented on Linux, macOS, and Windows. Note: Advanced users only!
Window objects call this method automatically.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/set_window_re:
Sets window outer (with decorations) and inner (without decorations)
bounds for assistive apps. Note: This method is implemented on Linux,
macOS, and Windows. Note: Advanced users only! Window objects call this
method automatically.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_add_ac:
Adds a callback for the accessibility action (action which can be
performed by using a special screen reader command or buttons on the
Braille display), and marks this action as supported. The action
callback receives one Variant argument, which value depends on action
type.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_add_ch:
Adds a child accessibility element. Note: Node children and sub-elements
are added to the child list automatically.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_add_cu:
Adds support for a custom accessibility action. action_id is passed as
an argument to the callback of ACTION_CUSTOM action.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_add_re: Adds an element that is controlled by this element.
Adds an element that describes this element.
Adds an element that details this element.
Adds an element that this element flow into.
Adds an element that labels this element.

Adds an element that is part of the same radio group. Note: This method
should be called on each element of the group, using all other elements
as related_id.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_ac: Adds an element that is an active descendant of this element.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_bo: Sets element bounding box, relative to the node position.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_br: Sets element accessibility label for Braille display.
Sets element accessibility role description for Braille display.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_er: Sets an element which contains an error message for this element.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_ex: Sets element accessibility extra information added to the element name.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_in: Sets target element for the link.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_li: Sets number of items in the list.
Sets the position of the element in the list.
Sets the hierarchical level of the element in the list.
Sets the orientation of the list elements.
Sets the priority of the live region updates.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_me: Sets the element to be a member of the group.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_ne: Sets next element on the line.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_po: Sets popup type for popup buttons.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_pr: Sets previous element on the line.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_ro: Sets element accessibility role description text.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_sh: Sets the list of keyboard shortcuts used by element.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_st: Sets human-readable description of the current checked state.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_ta: Sets cell position in the table.
Sets number of columns in the table.
Sets number of rows in the table.
Sets position of the row in the table.
descriptions.AccessibilityServer/method/update_set_te:
Sets text selection to the text field. text_start_id and text_end_id
should be elements created by create_sub_text_edit_elements. Character
offsets are relative to the corresponding element.
descriptions.AimModifier3D/method/get_forward_axis: Returns the forward axis of the bone.
descriptions.AimModifier3D/method/get_primary_rotatio:
Returns the axis of the first rotation. It is enabled only if
is_using_euler is true.
descriptions.AimModifier3D/method/is_relative: Returns true if the relative option is enabled in the setting at index.
descriptions.AimModifier3D/method/is_using_euler: Returns true if it provides rotation with using euler.
descriptions.AimModifier3D/method/is_using_secondary_:
Returns true if it provides rotation by two axes. It is enabled only if
is_using_euler is true.
descriptions.AimModifier3D/method/set_forward_axis: Sets the forward axis of the bone.
descriptions.AimModifier3D/method/set_primary_rotatio:
Sets the axis of the first rotation. It is enabled only if
is_using_euler is true.
descriptions.AimModifier3D/method/set_relative:
Sets relative option in the setting at index to enabled. If sets enabled
to true, the rotation is applied relative to the pose. If sets enabled
to false, the rotation is applied relative to the rest. It means to
replace the current pose with the AimModifier3D's result.
descriptions.AimModifier3D/method/set_use_euler:
If sets enabled to true, it provides rotation with using euler. If sets
enabled to false, it provides rotation with using rotation by arc
generated from the forward axis vector and the vector toward the
reference.
descriptions.AimModifier3D/method/set_use_secondary_r:
If sets enabled to true, it provides rotation by two axes. It is enabled
only if is_using_euler is true.
descriptions.AnimatedSprite2D/method/get_playing_spee:
Returns the actual playing speed of current animation or 0 if not
playing. This speed is the speed_scale property multiplied by
custom_speed argument specified when calling the play method. Returns a
negative value if the current animation is playing backwards.
descriptions.AnimatedSprite2D/method/is_playing:
Returns true if an animation is currently playing (even if speed_scale
and/or custom_speed are 0).
descriptions.AnimatedSprite2D/method/pause:
Pauses the currently playing animation. The frame and frame_progress
will be kept and calling play or play_backwards without arguments will
resume the animation from the current playback position. See also stop.
descriptions.AnimatedSprite2D/method/play:
Plays the animation with key name. If custom_speed is negative and
from_end is true, the animation will play backwards (which is equivalent
to calling play_backwards). If this method is called with that same
animation name, or with no name parameter, the assigned animation will
resume playing if it was paused.
descriptions.AnimatedSprite2D/method/play_backwards:
Plays the animation with key name in reverse. This method is a shorthand
for play with custom_speed = -1.0 and from_end = true, so see its
description for more information.
descriptions.AnimatedSprite2D/method/set_frame_and_pr:
Sets frame and frame_progress to the given values. Unlike setting frame,
this method does not reset the frame_progress to 0.0 implicitly.
Example: Change the animation while keeping the same frame and
frame_progress:
descriptions.AnimatedSprite2D/method/stop:
Stops the currently playing animation. The animation position is reset
to 0 and the custom_speed is reset to 1.0. See also pause.
descriptions.AnimatedSprite2D/signal/animation_finish:
Emitted when the animation reaches the end, or the start if it is played
in reverse. When the animation finishes, it pauses the playback. Note:
This signal is not emitted if an animation is looping.
descriptions.AnimatedSprite3D/method/get_playing_spee:

playing. This speed is the speed_scale property multiplied by
custom_speed argument specified when calling the play method. Returns a

descriptions.AnimatedTexture/method/get_frame_duratio: Returns the given frame's duration, in seconds.
descriptions.AnimatedTexture/method/set_frame_duratio:
Sets the duration of any given frame. The final duration is affected by
the speed_scale. If set to 0, the frame is skipped during playback.
descriptions.AnimatedTexture/method/set_frame_texture:
Assigns a Texture2D to the given frame. Frame IDs start at 0, so the
first frame has ID 0, and the last frame of the animation has ID frames
- 1. You can define any number of textures up to MAX_FRAMES, but keep in
mind that only frames from 0 to frames - 1 will be part of the
animation.
descriptions.Animation/method/add_marker: Adds a marker to this Animation.
descriptions.Animation/method/add_track: Adds a track to the Animation.
descriptions.Animation/method/animation_track_get_key:
Returns the animation name at the key identified by key_idx. The
track_idx must be the index of an Animation Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/animation_track_insert_:
Inserts a key with value animation at the given time (in seconds). The
track_idx must be the index of an Animation Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/animation_track_set_key:
Sets the key identified by key_idx to value animation. The track_idx
must be the index of an Animation Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/audio_track_get_key_end:
Returns the end offset of the key identified by key_idx. The track_idx
must be the index of an Audio Track. End offset is the number of seconds
cut off at the ending of the audio stream.
descriptions.Animation/method/audio_track_get_key_sta:
Returns the start offset of the key identified by key_idx. The track_idx
must be the index of an Audio Track. Start offset is the number of
seconds cut off at the beginning of the audio stream.
descriptions.Animation/method/audio_track_get_key_str:
Returns the audio stream of the key identified by key_idx. The track_idx
must be the index of an Audio Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/audio_track_insert_key:
Inserts an Audio Track key at the given time in seconds. The track_idx
must be the index of an Audio Track. stream is the AudioStream resource
to play. start_offset is the number of seconds cut off at the beginning
of the audio stream, while end_offset is at the ending.
descriptions.Animation/method/audio_track_is_use_blen:
Returns true if the track at track_idx will be blended with other
animations.
descriptions.Animation/method/audio_track_set_key_end:
Sets the end offset of the key identified by key_idx to value offset.
The track_idx must be the index of an Audio Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/audio_track_set_key_sta:
Sets the start offset of the key identified by key_idx to value offset.
The track_idx must be the index of an Audio Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/audio_track_set_key_str:
Sets the stream of the key identified by key_idx to value stream. The
track_idx must be the index of an Audio Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/audio_track_set_use_ble:
Sets whether the track will be blended with other animations. If true,
the audio playback volume changes depending on the blend value.
descriptions.Animation/method/bezier_track_get_key_in:
Returns the in handle of the key identified by key_idx. The track_idx
must be the index of a Bezier Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/bezier_track_get_key_ou:
Returns the out handle of the key identified by key_idx. The track_idx
must be the index of a Bezier Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/bezier_track_get_key_va:
Returns the value of the key identified by key_idx. The track_idx must
be the index of a Bezier Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/bezier_track_insert_key:
Inserts a Bezier Track key at the given time in seconds. The track_idx
must be the index of a Bezier Track. in_handle is the left-side weight
of the added Bezier curve point, out_handle is the right-side one, while
value is the actual value at this point.
descriptions.Animation/method/bezier_track_interpolat:
Returns the interpolated value at the given time (in seconds). The
track_idx must be the index of a Bezier Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/bezier_track_set_key_in:
Sets the in handle of the key identified by key_idx to value in_handle.
The track_idx must be the index of a Bezier Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/bezier_track_set_key_ou:
Sets the out handle of the key identified by key_idx to value
out_handle. The track_idx must be the index of a Bezier Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/bezier_track_set_key_va:
Sets the value of the key identified by key_idx to the given value. The
track_idx must be the index of a Bezier Track.
descriptions.Animation/method/blend_shape_track_inser: Inserts a key in a given blend shape track. Returns the key index.
descriptions.Animation/method/blend_shape_track_inter:
Returns the interpolated blend shape value at the given time (in
seconds). The track_idx must be the index of a blend shape track.
descriptions.Animation/method/clear: Clear the animation (clear all tracks and reset all).
descriptions.Animation/method/compress:
Compress the animation and all its tracks in-place. This will make
track_is_compressed return true once called on this Animation.
Compressed tracks require less memory to be played, and are designed to
be used for complex 3D animations (such as cutscenes) imported from
external 3D software. Compression is lossy, but the difference is
usually not...
descriptions.Animation/method/copy_track:
Adds a new track to to_animation that is a copy of the given track from
this animation.
descriptions.Animation/method/find_track:
Returns the index of the specified track. If the track is not found,
return -1.
descriptions.Animation/method/get_marker_at_time: Returns the name of the marker located at the given time.
descriptions.Animation/method/get_marker_names: Returns every marker in this Animation, sorted ascending by time.
descriptions.Animation/method/get_next_marker:
Returns the closest marker that comes after the given time. If no such
marker exists, an empty string is returned.
descriptions.Animation/method/get_prev_marker:
Returns the closest marker that comes before the given time. If no such
marker exists, an empty string is returned.
descriptions.Animation/method/get_track_count: Returns the amount of tracks in the animation.
descriptions.Animation/method/has_marker: Returns true if this Animation contains a marker with the given name.
descriptions.Animation/method/method_track_get_name: Returns the method name of a method track.
descriptions.Animation/method/method_track_get_params:
Returns the arguments values to be called on a method track for a given
key in a given track.
descriptions.Animation/method/optimize:
Optimize the animation and all its tracks in-place. This will preserve
only as many keys as are necessary to keep the animation within the
specified bounds.
descriptions.Animation/method/position_track_insert_k: Inserts a key in a given 3D position track. Returns the key index.
descriptions.Animation/method/position_track_interpol:
Returns the interpolated position value at the given time (in seconds).
The track_idx must be the index of a 3D position track.
descriptions.Animation/method/remove_marker: Removes the marker with the given name from this Animation.
descriptions.Animation/method/remove_track: Removes a track by specifying the track index.
descriptions.Animation/method/rotation_track_insert_k: Inserts a key in a given 3D rotation track. Returns the key index.
descriptions.Animation/method/rotation_track_interpol:
Returns the interpolated rotation value at the given time (in seconds).
The track_idx must be the index of a 3D rotation track.
descriptions.Animation/method/scale_track_insert_key: Inserts a key in a given 3D scale track. Returns the key index.
descriptions.Animation/method/scale_track_interpolate:
Returns the interpolated scale value at the given time (in seconds). The
track_idx must be the index of a 3D scale track.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_find_key:
Finds the key index by time in a given track. Optionally, only find it
if the approx/exact time is given. If limit is true, it does not return
keys outside the animation range. If backward is true, the direction is
reversed in methods that rely on one directional processing. For
example, in case find_mode is FIND_MODE_NEAREST, if there is no key in
the...
descriptions.Animation/method/track_get_interpolation:
Returns true if the track at track_idx wraps the interpolation loop. New
tracks wrap the interpolation loop by default.
Returns the interpolation type of a given track.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_get_key_count: Returns the number of keys in a given track.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_get_key_time: Returns the time at which the key is located.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_get_key_transitio:
Returns the transition curve (easing) for a specific key (see the
built-in math function @GlobalScope.ease).
descriptions.Animation/method/track_get_key_value: Returns the value of a given key in a given track.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_get_path:
Gets the path of a track. For more information on the path format, see
track_set_path.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_get_type: Gets the type of a track.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_insert_key: Inserts a generic key in a given track. Returns the key index.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_is_compressed:
Returns true if the track is compressed, false otherwise. See also
compress.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_is_enabled: Returns true if the track at index track_idx is enabled.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_is_imported: Returns true if the given track is imported. Else, return false.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_move_to:
Changes the index position of track track_idx to the one defined in
to_idx.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_remove_key: Removes a key by index in a given track.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_remove_key_at_tim: Removes a key at time in a given track.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_set_enabled: Enables/disables the given track. Tracks are enabled by default.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_set_imported: Sets the given track as imported or not.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_set_interpolation: If true, the track at track_idx wraps the interpolation loop.
Sets the interpolation type of a given track.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_set_key_time: Sets the time of an existing key.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_set_key_transitio:
Sets the transition curve (easing) for a specific key (see the built-in
math function @GlobalScope.ease).
descriptions.Animation/method/track_set_key_value: Sets the value of an existing key.
descriptions.Animation/method/track_set_path:
Sets the path of a track. Paths must be valid scene-tree paths to a node
and must be specified starting from the AnimationMixer.root_node that
will reproduce the animation. Tracks that control properties or bones
must append their name after the path, separated by ":". For example,
"character/skeleton:ankle" or "character/mesh:transform/local".
descriptions.Animation/method/track_swap: Swaps the track track_idx's index position with the track with_idx.
descriptions.Animation/method/value_track_get_update_: Returns the update mode of a value track.
descriptions.Animation/method/value_track_interpolate:
Returns the interpolated value at the given time (in seconds). The
track_idx must be the index of a value track. A backward mainly affects
the direction of key retrieval of the track with UPDATE_DISCRETE
converted by
AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_DISCRETE_FORCE_CONTINUOUS to
match the result with track_find_key.
descriptions.Animation/method/value_track_set_update_: Sets the update mode of a value track.
descriptions.AnimationLibrary/method/add_animation: Adds the animation to the library, accessible by the key name.
descriptions.AnimationLibrary/method/get_animation:
Returns the Animation with the key name. If the animation does not
exist, null is returned and an error is logged.
descriptions.AnimationLibrary/method/get_animation_li: Returns the keys for the Animations stored in the library.
Returns the key count for the Animations stored in the library.
descriptions.AnimationLibrary/method/has_animation: Returns true if the library stores an Animation with name as the key.
descriptions.AnimationLibrary/method/remove_animation: Removes the Animation with the key name.
descriptions.AnimationLibrary/method/rename_animation:
Changes the key of the Animation associated with the key name to
newname.
descriptions.AnimationLibrary/signal/animation_added: Emitted when an Animation is added, under the key anim_name.
descriptions.AnimationLibrary/signal/animation_change:
Emitted when there's a change in one of the animations, e.g. tracks are
added, moved or have changed paths. anim_name is the key of the
animation that was changed. See also Resource.changed, which this acts
as a relay for.
descriptions.AnimationLibrary/signal/animation_remove: Emitted when an Animation stored with the key anim_name is removed.
descriptions.AnimationLibrary/signal/animation_rename:
Emitted when the key for an Animation is changed, from old_name to
new_name.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/_post_process_key_: A virtual function for processing after getting a key during playback.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/add_animation_libr:
Adds library to the animation player, under the key name. AnimationMixer
has a global library by default with an empty string as key. For adding
an animation to the global library:
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/advance: Manually advance the animations by the specified time (in seconds).
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/capture:
If the animation track specified by name has an option
Animation.UPDATE_CAPTURE, stores current values of the objects indicated
by the track path as a cache. If there is already a captured cache, the
old cache is discarded. After this it will interpolate with current
animation blending result during the playback process for the time
specified by...
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/clear_caches:
AnimationMixer caches animated nodes. It may not notice if a node
disappears; clear_caches forces it to update the cache again.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/find_animation: Returns the key of animation or an empty StringName if not found.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/find_animation_lib:
Returns the key for the AnimationLibrary that contains animation or an
empty StringName if not found.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/get_animation:
Returns the Animation with the key name. If the animation does not
exist, null is returned and an error is logged.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/get_animation_libr:
Returns the first AnimationLibrary with key name or null if not found.
To get the AnimationMixer's global animation library, use
get_animation_library("").
Returns the list of stored library keys.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/get_animation_list: Returns the list of stored animation keys.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/get_root_motion_po:
Retrieve the motion delta of position with the root_motion_track as a
Vector3 that can be used elsewhere. If root_motion_track is not a path
to a track of type Animation.TYPE_POSITION_3D, returns Vector3(0, 0, 0).
See also root_motion_track and RootMotionView. The most basic example is
applying position to CharacterBody3D:

Retrieve the blended value of the position tracks with the
root_motion_track as a Vector3 that can be used elsewhere. This is
useful in cases where you want to respect the initial key values of the
animation. For example, if an animation with only one key Vector3(0, 0,
0) is played in the previous frame and then an animation with only one
key Vector3(1,...
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/get_root_motion_ro:
Retrieve the motion delta of rotation with the root_motion_track as a
Quaternion that can be used elsewhere. If root_motion_track is not a
path to a track of type Animation.TYPE_ROTATION_3D, returns
Quaternion(0, 0, 0, 1). See also root_motion_track and RootMotionView.
The most basic example is applying rotation to CharacterBody3D:

Retrieve the blended value of the rotation tracks with the
root_motion_track as a Quaternion that can be used elsewhere. This is
necessary to apply the root motion position correctly, taking rotation
into account. See also get_root_motion_position. Also, this is useful in
cases where you want to respect the initial key values of the animation.
For...
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/get_root_motion_sc:
Retrieve the motion delta of scale with the root_motion_track as a
Vector3 that can be used elsewhere. If root_motion_track is not a path
to a track of type Animation.TYPE_SCALE_3D, returns Vector3(0, 0, 0).
See also root_motion_track and RootMotionView. The most basic example is
applying scale to CharacterBody3D:

Retrieve the blended value of the scale tracks with the
root_motion_track as a Vector3 that can be used elsewhere. For example,
if an animation with only one key Vector3(1, 1, 1) is played in the
previous frame and then an animation with only one key Vector3(2, 2, 2)
is played in the next frame, the difference can be calculated as
follows:
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/has_animation: Returns true if the AnimationMixer stores an Animation with key name.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/has_animation_libr:
Returns true if the AnimationMixer stores an AnimationLibrary with key
name.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/remove_animation_l: Removes the AnimationLibrary associated with the key name.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/method/rename_animation_l:
Moves the AnimationLibrary associated with the key name to the key
newname.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/signal/animation_finished:
Notifies when an animation finished playing. Note: This signal is not
emitted if an animation is looping.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/signal/animation_librarie: Notifies when the animation libraries have changed.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/signal/animation_list_cha: Notifies when an animation list is changed.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/signal/animation_started:
Notifies when an animation starts playing. Note: This signal is not
emitted if an animation is looping.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/signal/caches_cleared:
Notifies when the caches have been cleared, either automatically, or
manually via clear_caches.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/signal/mixer_applied:
Notifies when the blending result related have been applied to the
target objects.
descriptions.AnimationMixer/signal/mixer_updated: Notifies when the property related process have been updated.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/_get_caption:
When inheriting from AnimationRootNode, implement this virtual method to
override the text caption for this animation node.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/_get_child_by_name:
When inheriting from AnimationRootNode, implement this virtual method to
return a child animation node by its name.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/_get_child_nodes:
When inheriting from AnimationRootNode, implement this virtual method to
return all child animation nodes in order as a name: node dictionary.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/_get_parameter_defa:
When inheriting from AnimationRootNode, implement this virtual method to
return the default value of a parameter. Parameters are custom local
memory used for your animation nodes, given a resource can be reused in
multiple trees.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/_get_parameter_list:
When inheriting from AnimationRootNode, implement this virtual method to
return a list of the properties on this animation node. Parameters are
custom local memory used for your animation nodes, given a resource can
be reused in multiple trees. Format is similar to
Object.get_property_list.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/_has_filter:
When inheriting from AnimationRootNode, implement this virtual method to
return whether the blend tree editor should display filter editing on
this animation node.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/_is_parameter_read_:
When inheriting from AnimationRootNode, implement this virtual method to
return whether the parameter is read-only. Parameters are custom local
memory used for your animation nodes, given a resource can be reused in
multiple trees.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/_process:
When inheriting from AnimationRootNode, implement this virtual method to
run some code when this animation node is processed. The time parameter
is a relative delta, unless seek is true, in which case it is absolute.
Here, call the blend_input, blend_node or blend_animation functions. You
can also use get_parameter and set_parameter to modify local...
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/add_input:
Adds an input to the animation node. This is only useful for animation
nodes created for use in an AnimationNodeBlendTree. If the addition
fails, returns false.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/blend_animation:
Blends an animation by blend amount (name must be valid in the linked
AnimationPlayer). A time and delta may be passed, as well as whether
seeked happened. A looped_flag is used by internal processing
immediately after the loop.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/blend_input:
Blends an input. This is only useful for animation nodes created for an
AnimationNodeBlendTree. The time parameter is a relative delta, unless
seek is true, in which case it is absolute. A filter mode may be
optionally passed.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/blend_node:
Blend another animation node (in case this animation node contains child
animation nodes). This function is only useful if you inherit from
AnimationRootNode instead, otherwise editors will not display your
animation node for addition.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/find_input:
Returns the input index which corresponds to name. If not found, returns
-1.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/get_input_count:
Amount of inputs in this animation node, only useful for animation nodes
that go into AnimationNodeBlendTree.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/get_input_name: Gets the name of an input by index.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/get_parameter:
Gets the value of a parameter. Parameters are custom local memory used
for your animation nodes, given a resource can be reused in multiple
trees.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/get_processing_anim:
Returns the object id of the AnimationTree that owns this node. Note:
This method should only be called from within the
AnimationNodeExtension._process_animation_node method, and will return
an invalid id otherwise.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/is_path_filtered: Returns true if the given path is filtered.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/is_process_testing:
Returns true if this animation node is being processed in test-only
mode.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/remove_input: Removes an input, call this only when inactive.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/set_filter_path: Adds or removes a path for the filter.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/set_input_name:
Sets the name of the input at the given input index. If the setting
fails, returns false.
descriptions.AnimationNode/method/set_parameter:
Sets a custom parameter. These are used as local memory, because
resources can be reused across the tree or scenes.
descriptions.AnimationNode/signal/animation_node_remo:
Emitted by nodes that inherit from this class and that have an internal
tree when one of their animation nodes removes. The animation nodes that
emit this signal are AnimationNodeBlendSpace1D,
AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D, AnimationNodeStateMachine, and
AnimationNodeBlendTree.
descriptions.AnimationNode/signal/animation_node_rena:
Emitted by nodes that inherit from this class and that have an internal
tree when one of their animation node names changes. The animation nodes
that emit this signal are AnimationNodeBlendSpace1D,
AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D, AnimationNodeStateMachine, and
AnimationNodeBlendTree.
descriptions.AnimationNode/signal/node_updated:
Emitted by AnimationNodeAnimation when its
AnimationNodeAnimation.animation resource is changed, or by
AnimationNodeBlendTree when its connections change.
descriptions.AnimationNode/signal/tree_changed:
Emitted by nodes that inherit from this class and that have an internal
tree when one of their animation nodes changes. The animation nodes that
emit this signal are AnimationNodeBlendSpace1D,
AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D, AnimationNodeStateMachine,
AnimationNodeBlendTree and AnimationNodeTransition.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace1D/method/add_ble:
Adds a new point with name that represents a node on the virtual axis at
a given position set by pos. You can insert it at a specific index using
the at_index argument. If you use the default value for at_index, the
point is inserted at the end of the blend points array. Note: If no name
is provided, safe index is used as reference. In the future, empty...
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace1D/method/find_bl:
Returns the index of the blend point with the given name. Returns -1 if
no blend point with that name is found.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace1D/method/get_ble: Returns the number of points on the blend axis.
Returns the name of the blend point at index point.
Returns the AnimationNode referenced by the point at index point.
Returns the position of the point at index point.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace1D/method/remove_: Removes the point at index point from the blend axis.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace1D/method/reorder:
Swaps the blend points at indices from_index and to_index, exchanging
their positions and properties.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace1D/method/set_ble:
Sets the name of the blend point at index point. If the name conflicts
with an existing point, a unique name will be generated automatically.
Changes the AnimationNode referenced by the point at index point.
Updates the position of the point at index point on the blend axis.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D/method/add_ble:
Adds a new point with name that represents a node at the position set by
pos. You can insert it at a specific index using the at_index argument.
If you use the default value for at_index, the point is inserted at the
end of the blend points array. Note: If no name is provided, safe index
is used as reference. In the future, empty names will be...
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D/method/add_tri:
Creates a new triangle using three points x, y, and z. Triangles can
overlap. You can insert the triangle at a specific index using the
at_index argument. If you use the default value for at_index, the point
is inserted at the end of the blend points array.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D/method/find_bl:
Returns the index of the blend point with the given name. Returns -1 if
no blend point with that name is found.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D/method/get_ble: Returns the number of points in the blend space.
Returns the name of the blend point at index point.
Returns the AnimationRootNode referenced by the point at index point.
Returns the position of the point at index point.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D/method/get_tri: Returns the number of triangles in the blend space.

Returns the position of the point at index point in the triangle of
index triangle.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D/method/remove_: Removes the point at index point from the blend space.
Removes the triangle at index triangle from the blend space.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D/method/reorder:
Swaps the blend points at indices from_index and to_index, exchanging
their positions and properties.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D/method/set_ble:
Sets the name of the blend point at index point. If the name conflicts
with an existing point, a unique name will be generated automatically.
Changes the AnimationNode referenced by the point at index point.
Updates the position of the point at index point in the blend space.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D/signal/triangl:
Emitted every time the blend space's triangles are created, removed, or
when one of their vertices changes position.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendTree/method/add_node:
Adds an AnimationNode at the given position. The name is used to
identify the created sub animation node later.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendTree/method/connect_no:
Connects the output of an AnimationNode as input for another
AnimationNode, at the input port specified by input_index.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendTree/method/disconnect: Disconnects the animation node connected to the specified input.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendTree/method/get_node: Returns the sub animation node with the specified name.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendTree/method/get_node_l:
Returns a list containing the names of all sub animation nodes in this
blend tree.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendTree/method/get_node_p: Returns the position of the sub animation node with the specified name.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendTree/method/has_node: Returns true if a sub animation node with specified name exists.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendTree/method/rename_nod: Changes the name of a sub animation node.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendTree/method/set_node_p: Modifies the position of a sub animation node.
descriptions.AnimationNodeBlendTree/signal/node_chang: Emitted when the input port information is changed.
descriptions.AnimationNodeExtension/method/_process_a:
A version of the AnimationNode._process method that is meant to be
overridden by custom nodes. It returns a PackedFloat32Array with the
processed animation data. The PackedFloat64Array parameter contains the
playback information, containing the following values encoded as
floating point numbers (in order): playback time and delta, start and
end times,...
descriptions.AnimationNodeExtension/method/get_remain:
Returns the animation's remaining time for the given node info. For
looping animations, it will only return the remaining time if break_loop
is true, a large integer value will be returned otherwise.
descriptions.AnimationNodeExtension/method/is_looping: Returns true if the animation for the given node_info is looping.
descriptions.AnimationNodeStateMachine/method/add_nod:
Adds a new animation node to the graph. The position is used for display
in the editor.
descriptions.AnimationNodeStateMachine/method/add_tra: Adds a transition between the given animation nodes.
descriptions.AnimationNodeStateMachine/method/get_gra: Returns the draw offset of the graph. Used for display in the editor.
descriptions.AnimationNodeStateMachine/method/get_nod: Returns the animation node with the given name.

Returns a list containing the names of all animation nodes in this state
machine.
Returns the given animation node's name.

Returns the given animation node's coordinates. Used for display in the
editor.
descriptions.AnimationNodeStateMachine/method/get_tra: Returns the number of connections in the graph.
Returns the given transition's start node.
Returns the given transition's end node.
descriptions.AnimationNodeStateMachine/method/has_nod: Returns true if the graph contains the given animation node.
descriptions.AnimationNodeStateMachine/method/has_tra: Returns true if there is a transition between the given animation nodes.
descriptions.AnimationNodeStateMachine/method/remove_: Deletes the given animation node from the graph.
Deletes the transition between the two specified animation nodes.
Deletes the given transition by index.
descriptions.AnimationNodeStateMachine/method/replace: Replaces the given animation node with a new animation node.
descriptions.AnimationNodeStateMachine/method/set_gra: Sets the draw offset of the graph. Used for display in the editor.
descriptions.AnimationNodeStateMachine/method/set_nod: Sets the animation node's coordinates. Used for display in the editor.
descriptions.AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback/method:
Returns the current state length. Note: It is possible that any
AnimationRootNode can be nodes as well as animations. This means that
there can be multiple animations within a single state. Which animation
length has priority depends on the nodes connected inside it. Also, if a
transition does not reset, the remaining length at that point will be
returned.

Returns the currently playing animation state. Note: When using a
cross-fade, the current state changes to the next state immediately
after the cross-fade begins.
Returns the playback position within the current animation state.

Returns the playback state length of the node from get_fading_from_node.
Returns 0 if no animation fade is occurring.
Returns the starting state of currently fading animation.

Returns the playback position of the node from get_fading_from_node.
Returns 0 if no animation fade is occurring.

Returns the length of the current fade animation. Returns 0 if no
animation fade is occurring.

Returns the playback position of the current fade animation. Returns 0
if no animation fade is occurring.

Returns the current travel path as computed internally by the A*
algorithm.
Returns true if an animation is playing.

If there is a next path by travel or auto advance, immediately
transitions from the current state to the next state.

Starts playing the given animation. If reset is true, the animation is
played from the beginning.

Transitions from the current state to another one, following the
shortest path. If the path does not connect from the current state, the
animation will play after the state teleports. If reset_on_teleport is
true, the animation is played from the beginning when the travel cause a
teleportation.
descriptions.AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback/signal:
Emitted when the state finishes playback. If state is a state machine
set to grouped mode, its signals are passed through with its name
prefixed. If there is a crossfade, this will be fired when the influence
of the get_fading_from_node animation is no longer present.

Emitted when the state starts playback. If state is a state machine set
to grouped mode, its signals are passed through with its name prefixed.
descriptions.AnimationNodeTransition/method/is_input_:
Returns whether the animation breaks the loop at the end of the loop
cycle for transition.

Returns whether the animation restarts when the animation transitions
from the other animation.
Returns true if auto-advance is enabled for the given input index.
descriptions.AnimationNodeTransition/method/set_input:
Enables or disables auto-advance for the given input index. If enabled,
state changes to the next input after playing the animation once. If
enabled for the last input state, it loops to the first.

If true, breaks the loop at the end of the loop cycle for transition,
even if the animation is looping.

If true, the destination animation is restarted when the animation
transitions.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/animation_get_nex:
Returns the key of the animation which is queued to play after the
animation_from animation.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/animation_set_nex:
Triggers the animation_to animation when the animation_from animation
completes.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/get_blend_time:
Returns the blend time (in seconds) between two animations, referenced
by their keys.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/get_method_call_m: Returns the call mode used for "Call Method" tracks.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/get_playing_speed:
Returns the actual playing speed of current animation or 0 if not
playing. This speed is the speed_scale property multiplied by
custom_speed argument specified when calling the play method. Returns a
negative value if the current animation is playing backwards.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/get_process_callb: Returns the process notification in which to update animations.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/get_queue: Returns a list of the animation keys that are currently queued to play.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/get_root: Returns the node which node path references will travel from.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/get_section_end_t: Returns the end time of the section currently being played.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/get_section_start: Returns the start time of the section currently being played.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/has_section: Returns true if an animation is currently playing with a section.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/is_animation_acti:
Returns true if the an animation is currently active. An animation is
active if it was played by calling play and was not finished yet, or was
stopped by calling stop. This can be used to check whether an animation
is currently paused or stopped.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/is_playing:
Returns true if an animation is currently playing (even if speed_scale
and/or custom_speed are 0).
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/pause:
Pauses the currently playing animation. The current_animation_position
will be kept and calling play or play_backwards without arguments or
with the same animation name as assigned_animation will resume the
animation. See also stop.
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/play:
Plays the animation with key name. Custom blend times and speed can be
set. The from_end option only affects when switching to a new animation
track, or if the same track but at the start or end. It does not affect
resuming playback that was paused in the middle of an animation. If
custom_speed is negative and from_end is true, the animation will
play...
descriptions.AnimationPlayer/method/play_backwards:
Plays the animation with key name in reverse. This method is a shorthand
