Returns whether or not the specified layer of the collision_layer is
enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/method/get_collision_m:
Returns whether or not the specified layer of the collision_mask is
enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/method/get_shape_owner:
Returns an Array of owner_id identifiers. You can use these ids in other
methods that take owner_id as an argument.
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/method/is_shape_owner_: If true, the shape owner and its shapes are disabled.
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/method/set_collision_l:
Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the
collision_layer, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/method/set_collision_m:
Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the
collision_mask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/method/shape_find_owne: Returns the owner_id of the given shape.
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/method/shape_owner_add: Adds a Shape3D to the shape owner.
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/method/shape_owner_cle: Removes all shapes from the shape owner.
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/method/shape_owner_get: Returns the parent object of the given shape owner.
Returns the Shape3D with the given ID from the given shape owner.
Returns the number of shapes the given shape owner contains.

Returns the child index of the Shape3D with the given ID from the given
shape owner.
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/method/shape_owner_rem: Removes a shape from the given shape owner.
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/method/shape_owner_set: If true, disables the given shape owner.
Sets the Transform3D of the given shape owner.
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/signal/input_event:
Emitted when the object receives an unhandled InputEvent. event_position
is the location in world space of the mouse pointer on the surface of
the shape with index shape_idx and normal is the normal vector of the
surface at that point.
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/signal/mouse_entered:
Emitted when the mouse pointer enters any of this object's shapes.
Requires input_ray_pickable to be true and at least one collision_layer
bit to be set. Note: Due to the lack of continuous collision detection,
this signal may not be emitted in the expected order if the mouse moves
fast enough and the CollisionObject3D's area is small. This signal
may...
descriptions.CollisionObject3D/signal/mouse_exited:
Emitted when the mouse pointer exits all this object's shapes. Requires
input_ray_pickable to be true and at least one collision_layer bit to be
set. Note: Due to the lack of continuous collision detection, this
signal may not be emitted in the expected order if the mouse moves fast
enough and the CollisionObject3D's area is small. This signal may
also...
descriptions.CollisionShape3D/method/make_convex_from:
Sets the collision shape's shape to the addition of all its convexed
MeshInstance3D siblings geometry.
descriptions.Color/method/blend:
Returns a new color resulting from overlaying this color over the given
color. In a painting program, you can imagine it as the over color
painted over this color (including alpha).
descriptions.Color/method/clamp:
Returns a new color with all components clamped between the components
of min and max, by running @GlobalScope.clamp on each component.
descriptions.Color/method/darkened:
Returns a new color resulting from making this color darker by the
specified amount (ratio from 0.0 to 1.0). See also lightened.
descriptions.Color/method/from_hsv:
Constructs a color from an HSV profile. The hue (h), saturation (s), and
value (v) are typically between 0.0 and 1.0.
descriptions.Color/method/from_ok_hsl:
Constructs a color from an OK HSL profile. The hue (h), saturation (s),
and lightness (l) are typically between 0.0 and 1.0.
descriptions.Color/method/from_rgba8:
Returns a Color constructed from red (r8), green (g8), blue (b8), and
optionally alpha (a8) integer channels, each divided by 255.0 for their
final value.
descriptions.Color/method/from_rgbe9995:
Decodes a Color from an RGBE9995 format integer. See
Image.FORMAT_RGBE9995.
descriptions.Color/method/from_string:
Creates a Color from the given string, which can be either an HTML color
code or a named color (case-insensitive). Returns default if the color
cannot be inferred from the string. If you want to create a color from
String in a constant expression, use the equivalent constructor instead
(i.e. Color("color string")).
descriptions.Color/method/get_luminance:
Returns the light intensity of the color, as a value between 0.0 and 1.0
(inclusive). This is useful when determining light or dark color. Colors
with a luminance smaller than 0.5 can be generally considered dark.
Note: get_luminance relies on the color using linear encoding to return
an accurate relative luminance value. If the color uses the default...
descriptions.Color/method/hex:
Returns the Color associated with the provided hex integer in 32-bit
RGBA format (8 bits per channel). This method is the inverse of
to_rgba32. In GDScript and C#, the int is best visualized with
hexadecimal notation ("0x" prefix, making it "0xRRGGBBAA").
descriptions.Color/method/hex64:
Returns the Color associated with the provided hex integer in 64-bit
RGBA format (16 bits per channel). This method is the inverse of
to_rgba64. In GDScript and C#, the int is best visualized with
hexadecimal notation ("0x" prefix, making it "0xRRRRGGGGBBBBAAAA").
descriptions.Color/method/html:
Returns a new color from rgba, an HTML hexadecimal color string. rgba is
not case-sensitive, and may be prefixed by a hash sign (#). rgba must be
a valid three-digit or six-digit hexadecimal color string, and may
contain an alpha channel value. If rgba does not contain an alpha
channel value, an alpha channel value of 1.0 is applied. If rgba is
invalid,...
descriptions.Color/method/html_is_valid:
Returns true if color is a valid HTML hexadecimal color string. The
string must be a hexadecimal value (case-insensitive) of either 3, 4, 6
or 8 digits, and may be prefixed by a hash sign (#). This method is
identical to String.is_valid_html_color.
descriptions.Color/method/inverted:
Returns the color with its r, g, and b components inverted ((1 - r, 1 -
g, 1 - b, a)).
descriptions.Color/method/is_equal_approx:
Returns true if this color and to are approximately equal, by running
@GlobalScope.is_equal_approx on each component.
descriptions.Color/method/lerp:
Returns the linear interpolation between this color's components and
to's components. The interpolation factor weight should be between 0.0
and 1.0 (inclusive). See also @GlobalScope.lerp.
descriptions.Color/method/lightened:
Returns a new color resulting from making this color lighter by the
specified amount, which should be a ratio from 0.0 to 1.0. See also
darkened.
descriptions.Color/method/linear_to_srgb:
Returns a copy of the color that is encoded using the nonlinear sRGB
transfer function. This method requires the original color to use linear
encoding. See also srgb_to_linear which performs the opposite operation.
Note: The color's alpha channel (a) is not affected. The alpha channel
is always stored with linear encoding, regardless of the color space...
descriptions.Color/method/srgb_to_linear:
Returns a copy of the color that uses linear encoding. This method
requires the original color to be encoded using the nonlinear sRGB
transfer function. See also linear_to_srgb which performs the opposite
operation. Note: The color's alpha channel (a) is not affected. The
alpha channel is always stored with linear encoding, regardless of the
color space...
descriptions.Color/method/to_abgr32:
Returns the color converted to a 32-bit integer in ABGR format (each
component is 8 bits). ABGR is the reversed version of the default RGBA
format.
descriptions.Color/method/to_abgr64:
Returns the color converted to a 64-bit integer in ABGR format (each
component is 16 bits). ABGR is the reversed version of the default RGBA
format.
descriptions.Color/method/to_argb32:
Returns the color converted to a 32-bit integer in ARGB format (each
component is 8 bits). ARGB is more compatible with DirectX.
descriptions.Color/method/to_argb64:
Returns the color converted to a 64-bit integer in ARGB format (each
component is 16 bits). ARGB is more compatible with DirectX.
descriptions.Color/method/to_html:
Returns the color converted to an HTML hexadecimal color String in RGBA
format, without the hash (#) prefix. Setting with_alpha to false,
excludes alpha from the hexadecimal string, using RGB format instead of
RGBA format.
descriptions.Color/method/to_rgba32:
Returns the color converted to a 32-bit integer in RGBA format (each
component is 8 bits). RGBA is Godot's default format. This method is the
inverse of hex.
descriptions.Color/method/to_rgba64:
Returns the color converted to a 64-bit integer in RGBA format (each
component is 16 bits). RGBA is Godot's default format. This method is
the inverse of hex64.
descriptions.ColorPicker/method/add_preset:
Adds the given color to a list of color presets. The presets are
displayed in the color picker and the user will be able to select them.
Note: The presets list is only for this color picker.
descriptions.ColorPicker/method/add_recent_preset:
Adds the given color to a list of color recent presets so that it can be
picked later. Recent presets are the colors that were picked recently, a
new preset is automatically created and added to recent presets when you
pick a new color. Note: The recent presets list is only for this color
picker.
descriptions.ColorPicker/method/erase_preset:
Removes the given color from the list of color presets of this color
picker.
descriptions.ColorPicker/method/erase_recent_preset:
Removes the given color from the list of color recent presets of this
color picker.
descriptions.ColorPicker/method/get_presets: Returns the list of colors in the presets of the color picker.
descriptions.ColorPicker/method/get_recent_presets: Returns the list of colors in the recent presets of the color picker.
descriptions.ColorPicker/signal/color_changed: Emitted when the color is changed.
descriptions.ColorPicker/signal/preset_added: Emitted when a preset is added.
descriptions.ColorPicker/signal/preset_removed: Emitted when a preset is removed.
descriptions.ColorPickerButton/method/get_picker:
Returns the ColorPicker that this node toggles. Warning: This is a
required internal node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If
you wish to hide it or any of its children, use their CanvasItem.visible
property.
descriptions.ColorPickerButton/method/get_popup:
Returns the control's PopupPanel which allows you to connect to popup
signals. This allows you to handle events when the ColorPicker is shown
or hidden. Warning: This is a required internal node, removing and
freeing it may cause a crash. If you wish to hide it or any of its
children, use their Window.visible property.
descriptions.ColorPickerButton/signal/picker_created:
Emitted when the ColorPicker is created (the button is pressed for the
first time).
descriptions.ColorPickerButton/signal/popup_closed: Emitted when the ColorPicker is closed.
descriptions.CompositorEffect/method/_render_callback:
Implement this function with your custom rendering code.
effect_callback_type should always match the effect callback type you've
specified in effect_callback_type. render_data provides access to the
rendering state, it is only valid during rendering and should not be
stored.
descriptions.CompressedTexture2D/method/load: Loads the texture from the specified path.
descriptions.CompressedTexture3D/method/load: Loads the texture from the specified path.
descriptions.ConcavePolygonShape3D/method/set_faces:
Sets the faces of the trimesh shape from an array of vertices. The faces
array should be composed of triples such that each triple of vertices
defines a triangle.
descriptions.ConeTwistJoint3D/method/get_param: Returns the value of the specified parameter.
descriptions.ConeTwistJoint3D/method/set_param: Sets the value of the specified parameter.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/clear: Removes the entire contents of the config.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/encode_to_text:
Obtain the text version of this config file (the same text that would be
written to a file).
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/erase_section:
Deletes the specified section along with all the key-value pairs inside.
Raises an error if the section does not exist.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/erase_section_key:
Deletes the specified key in a section. Raises an error if either the
section or the key do not exist.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/get_section_keys:
Returns an array of all defined key identifiers in the specified
section. Raises an error and returns an empty array if the section does
not exist.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/get_sections: Returns an array of all defined section identifiers.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/get_value:
Returns the current value for the specified section and key. If either
the section or the key do not exist, the method returns the fallback
default value. If default is not specified or set to null, an error is
also raised.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/has_section: Returns true if the specified section exists.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/has_section_key: Returns true if the specified section-key pair exists.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/load:
Loads the config file specified as a parameter. The file's contents are
parsed and loaded in the ConfigFile object which the method was called
on. Returns OK on success, or one of the other Error values if the
operation failed.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/load_encrypted:
Loads the encrypted config file specified as a parameter, using the
provided key to decrypt it. The file's contents are parsed and loaded in
the ConfigFile object which the method was called on. Returns OK on
success, or one of the other Error values if the operation failed.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/load_encrypted_pass:
Loads the encrypted config file specified as a parameter, using the
provided password to decrypt it. The file's contents are parsed and
loaded in the ConfigFile object which the method was called on. Returns
OK on success, or one of the other Error values if the operation failed.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/parse:
Parses the passed string as the contents of a config file. The string is
parsed and loaded in the ConfigFile object which the method was called
on. Returns OK on success, or one of the other Error values if the
operation failed.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/save:
Saves the contents of the ConfigFile object to the file specified as a
parameter. The output file uses an INI-style structure. Returns OK on
success, or one of the other Error values if the operation failed.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/save_encrypted:
Saves the contents of the ConfigFile object to the AES-256 encrypted
file specified as a parameter, using the provided key to encrypt it. The
output file uses an INI-style structure. Returns OK on success, or one
of the other Error values if the operation failed.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/save_encrypted_pass:
Saves the contents of the ConfigFile object to the AES-256 encrypted
file specified as a parameter, using the provided password to encrypt
it. The output file uses an INI-style structure. Returns OK on success,
or one of the other Error values if the operation failed.
descriptions.ConfigFile/method/set_value:
Assigns a value to the specified key of the specified section. If either
the section or the key do not exist, they are created. Passing a null
value deletes the specified key if it exists, and deletes the section if
it ends up empty once the key has been removed.
descriptions.ConfirmationDialog/method/get_cancel_but:
Returns the cancel button. Warning: This is a required internal node,
removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If you wish to hide it or any
of its children, use their CanvasItem.visible property.
descriptions.Container/method/_get_allowed_size_flags:
Implement to return a list of allowed horizontal Control.SizeFlags for
child nodes. This doesn't technically prevent the usages of any other
size flags, if your implementation requires that. This only limits the
options available to the user in the Inspector dock. Note: Having no
size flags is equal to having Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN. As such,
this...

Implement to return a list of allowed vertical Control.SizeFlags for
child nodes. This doesn't technically prevent the usages of any other
size flags, if your implementation requires that. This only limits the
options available to the user in the Inspector dock. Note: Having no
size flags is equal to having Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN. As such, this
value...
descriptions.Container/method/fit_child_in_rect:
Fit a child control in a given rect. This is mainly a helper for
creating custom container classes.
descriptions.Container/method/queue_sort:
Queue resort of the contained children. This is called automatically
anyway, but can be called upon request.
descriptions.Container/signal/pre_sort_children: Emitted when children are going to be sorted.
descriptions.Container/signal/sort_children: Emitted when sorting the children is needed.
descriptions.Control/method/_accessibility_get_contex:
Return the description of the keyboard shortcuts and other contextual
help for this control.
descriptions.Control/method/_can_drop_data:
Godot calls this method to test if data from a control's _get_drag_data
can be dropped at at_position. at_position is local to this control.
This method should only be used to test the data. Process the data in
_drop_data. Note: If the drag was initiated by a keyboard shortcut or
accessibility_drag, at_position is set to Vector2.INF, and the
currently...
descriptions.Control/method/_drop_data:
Godot calls this method to pass you the data from a control's
_get_drag_data result. Godot first calls _can_drop_data to test if data
is allowed to drop at at_position where at_position is local to this
control. Note: If the drag was initiated by a keyboard shortcut or
accessibility_drag, at_position is set to Vector2.INF, and the currently
selected...
descriptions.Control/method/_get_accessibility_contai:
Override this method to return a human-readable description of the
position of the child node in the custom container, added to the
accessibility_name.
descriptions.Control/method/_get_cursor_shape:
Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns the cursor shape
for the position at_position in the control's local coordinates, which
will typically be used while hovering over this control. See
get_cursor_shape. If not overridden, defaults to
mouse_default_cursor_shape.
descriptions.Control/method/_get_drag_data:
Godot calls this method to get data that can be dragged and dropped onto
controls that expect drop data. Returns null if there is no data to
drag. Controls that want to receive drop data should implement
_can_drop_data and _drop_data. at_position is local to this control.
Drag may be forced with force_drag. A preview that will follow the mouse
that...
descriptions.Control/method/_get_maximum_size:
Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns the maximum size
for this control. Alternative to custom_maximum_size for controlling
maximum size via code. The actual maximum size will be the max value of
these two (in each axis separately). If not overridden, defaults to
Vector2.ZERO. Note: This method will not be called when the script is...
descriptions.Control/method/_get_minimum_size:
Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns the minimum size
for this control. Alternative to custom_minimum_size for controlling
minimum size via code. The actual minimum size will be the max value of
these two (in each axis separately). If not overridden, defaults to
Vector2.ZERO. Note: This method will not be called when the script is...
descriptions.Control/method/_get_tooltip:
Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns the tooltip text
for the position at_position in the control's local coordinates, which
will typically appear when the cursor is resting over this control. See
get_tooltip. Note: If this method returns an empty String and
_make_custom_tooltip is not overridden, no tooltip is displayed.
descriptions.Control/method/_get_tooltip_auto_transla:
Return the auto-translation mode at the given at_position. If not
implemented, the tooltip_auto_translate_mode property will be used
instead.
descriptions.Control/method/_gui_input:
Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Override this method to
handle and accept inputs on UI elements. See also accept_event. Example:
Click on the control to print a message:
descriptions.Control/method/_has_point:
Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns whether the given
point is inside this control. If not overridden, default behavior is
checking if the point is within the control's Rect. Note: If you want to
check if a point is inside the control, you can use Rect2(Vector2.ZERO,
size).has_point(point).
descriptions.Control/method/_make_custom_tooltip:
Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns a Control node
that should be used as a tooltip instead of the default one. for_text is
the return value of get_tooltip. The returned node must be of type
Control or Control-derived. It can have child nodes of any type. It is
freed when the tooltip disappears, so make sure you always provide a
new...
descriptions.Control/method/_structured_text_parser:
User defined BiDi algorithm override function. Returns an Array of
Vector3i text ranges and text base directions, in the left-to-right
order. Ranges should cover full source text without overlaps. BiDi
algorithm will be used on each range separately.
descriptions.Control/method/accept_event:
Marks an input event as handled. Once you accept an input event, it
stops propagating, even to nodes listening to Node._unhandled_input or
Node._unhandled_key_input. Note: This does not affect the methods in
Input, only the way events are propagated.
descriptions.Control/method/accessibility_drag: Starts drag-and-drop operation without using a mouse.
descriptions.Control/method/accessibility_drop: Ends drag-and-drop operation without using a mouse.
descriptions.Control/method/add_theme_color_override:
Creates a local override for a theme Color with the specified name.
Local overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the
control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_color_override.
See also get_theme_color. Example: Override a Label's color and reset it
later:
descriptions.Control/method/add_theme_constant_overri:
Creates a local override for a theme constant with the specified name.
Local overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the
control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_constant_override.
See also get_theme_constant.
descriptions.Control/method/add_theme_font_override:
Creates a local override for a theme Font with the specified name. Local
overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the
control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_font_override. See
also get_theme_font.
descriptions.Control/method/add_theme_font_size_overr:
Creates a local override for a theme font size with the specified name.
Local overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the
control. An override can be removed with
remove_theme_font_size_override. See also get_theme_font_size.
descriptions.Control/method/add_theme_icon_override:
Creates a local override for a theme icon with the specified name. Local
overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the
control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_icon_override. See
also get_theme_icon.
descriptions.Control/method/add_theme_stylebox_overri:
Creates a local override for a theme StyleBox with the specified name.
Local overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the
control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_stylebox_override.
See also get_theme_stylebox. Example: Modify a property in a StyleBox by
duplicating it:
descriptions.Control/method/begin_bulk_theme_override:
Prevents *_theme_*_override methods from emitting
NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED until end_bulk_theme_override is called.
descriptions.Control/method/end_bulk_theme_override: Ends a bulk theme override update. See begin_bulk_theme_override.
descriptions.Control/method/find_next_valid_focus: Finds the next (below in the tree) Control that can receive the focus.
descriptions.Control/method/find_prev_valid_focus:
Finds the previous (above in the tree) Control that can receive the
focus.
descriptions.Control/method/find_valid_focus_neighbor:
Finds the next Control that can receive the focus on the specified Side.
Note: This is different from get_focus_neighbor, which returns the path
of a specified focus neighbor.
descriptions.Control/method/force_drag:
Forces drag and bypasses _get_drag_data and set_drag_preview by passing
data and preview. Drag will start even if the mouse is neither over nor
pressed on this control. The methods _can_drop_data and _drop_data must
be implemented on controls that want to receive drop data.
descriptions.Control/method/get_anchor:
Returns the anchor for the specified Side. A getter method for
anchor_bottom, anchor_left, anchor_right and anchor_top.
descriptions.Control/method/get_begin: Returns offset_left and offset_top. See also position.
descriptions.Control/method/get_bound_minimum_size:
Returns the bound value of get_combined_minimum_size by
get_combined_maximum_size. This value is the true minimum size of the
container, as the maximum size has priority over the minimum size. For
example, if the combined minimum size is (100, 100) and the combined
maximum size is (50, 150), the bound minimum size will be (50, 100).
descriptions.Control/method/get_combined_maximum_size:
Returns the combined maximum size from custom_maximum_size and
get_maximum_size, as well as the custom_maximum_size of this node's
parent if it is a Control node with propagate_maximum_size set to true.
descriptions.Control/method/get_combined_minimum_size:
Returns the combined minimum size from custom_minimum_size and
get_minimum_size.
descriptions.Control/method/get_combined_pivot_offset:
Returns the combined value of pivot_offset and pivot_offset_ratio, in
pixels. The ratio is multiplied by the control's size.
descriptions.Control/method/get_cursor_shape:
Returns the mouse cursor shape for this control when hovered over
at_position in local coordinates. For most controls, this is the same as
mouse_default_cursor_shape, but some built-in controls implement more
complex logic. You can override _get_cursor_shape to implement custom
behavior for this method.
descriptions.Control/method/get_focus_mode_with_overr:
Returns the focus_mode, but takes the focus_behavior_recursive into
account. If focus_behavior_recursive is set to FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED,
or it is set to FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_INHERITED and its ancestor is set to
FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED, then this returns FOCUS_NONE.
descriptions.Control/method/get_focus_neighbor:
Returns the focus neighbor for the specified Side. A getter method for
focus_neighbor_bottom, focus_neighbor_left, focus_neighbor_right and
focus_neighbor_top. Note: To find the next Control on the specific Side,
even if a neighbor is not assigned, use find_valid_focus_neighbor.
descriptions.Control/method/get_global_rect:
Returns the position and size of the control relative to the containing
canvas. See global_position and size. Note: If the node itself or any
parent CanvasItem between the node and the canvas have a non default
rotation or skew, the resulting size is likely not meaningful. Note:
Setting Viewport.gui_snap_controls_to_pixels to true can lead to
rounding...
descriptions.Control/method/get_maximum_size: Returns the maximum size for this control. See custom_maximum_size.
descriptions.Control/method/get_minimum_size: Returns the minimum size for this control. See custom_minimum_size.
descriptions.Control/method/get_mouse_filter_with_ove:
Returns the mouse_filter, but takes the mouse_behavior_recursive into
account. If mouse_behavior_recursive is set to MOUSE_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED,
or it is set to MOUSE_BEHAVIOR_INHERITED and its ancestor is set to
MOUSE_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED, then this returns MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE.
descriptions.Control/method/get_offset:
Returns the offset for the specified Side. A getter method for
offset_bottom, offset_left, offset_right and offset_top.
descriptions.Control/method/get_parent_area_size: Returns the width/height occupied in the parent control.
descriptions.Control/method/get_rect:
Returns the position and size of the control in the coordinate system of
the containing node. See position, scale and size. Note: If rotation is
not the default rotation, the resulting size is not meaningful. Note:
Setting Viewport.gui_snap_controls_to_pixels to true can lead to
rounding inaccuracies between the displayed control and the returned
Rect2.
descriptions.Control/method/get_screen_position:
Returns the position of this Control in global screen coordinates (i.e.
taking window position into account). Mostly useful for editor plugins.
Equivalent to get_screen_transform().origin (see
CanvasItem.get_screen_transform). Example: Show a popup at the mouse
position:
descriptions.Control/method/get_theme_color:
Returns a Color from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme
has a color item with the specified name and theme_type. If theme_type
is omitted the class name of the current control is used as the type, or
theme_type_variation if it is defined. If the type is a class name its
parent classes are also checked, in order of inheritance. If the type...
descriptions.Control/method/get_theme_constant:
Returns a constant from the first matching Theme in the tree if that
Theme has a constant item with the specified name and theme_type. See
get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Control/method/get_theme_default_base_sc:
Returns the default base scale value from the first matching Theme in
the tree if that Theme has a valid Theme.default_base_scale value. See
get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Control/method/get_theme_default_font:
Returns the default font from the first matching Theme in the tree if
that Theme has a valid Theme.default_font value. See get_theme_color for
details.
descriptions.Control/method/get_theme_default_font_si:
Returns the default font size value from the first matching Theme in the
tree if that Theme has a valid Theme.default_font_size value. See
get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Control/method/get_theme_font:
Returns a Font from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme
has a font item with the specified name and theme_type. See
get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Control/method/get_theme_font_size:
Returns a font size from the first matching Theme in the tree if that
Theme has a font size item with the specified name and theme_type. See
get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Control/method/get_theme_icon:
Returns an icon from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme
has an icon item with the specified name and theme_type. See
get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Control/method/get_theme_stylebox:
Returns a StyleBox from the first matching Theme in the tree if that
Theme has a stylebox item with the specified name and theme_type. See
get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Control/method/get_tooltip:
Returns the tooltip text for the position at_position in the control's
local coordinates, which will typically appear when the cursor is
resting over this control. By default, it returns tooltip_text. You can
override _get_tooltip to implement custom behavior for this method.
Note: If this method returns an empty String and _make_custom_tooltip is
not...
descriptions.Control/method/grab_click_focus:
Creates an InputEventMouseButton that attempts to click the control. If
the event is received, the control gains focus.
descriptions.Control/method/grab_focus:
Steal the focus from another control and become the focused control (see
focus_mode). If hide_focus is true, the control will not visually show
its focused state. Has no effect for LineEdit and TextEdit when
ProjectSettings.gui/common/show_focus_state_on_pointer_event is set to
Text Input Controls, or for any control when it is set to Always. Note:
Using...
descriptions.Control/method/has_focus:
Returns true if this is the current focused control. See focus_mode. If
ignore_hidden_focus is true, controls that have their focus hidden will
always return false. Hidden focus happens automatically when controls
gain focus via mouse input, or manually using grab_focus with hide_focus
set to true.
descriptions.Control/method/has_theme_color:
Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a color
item with the specified name and theme_type. See get_theme_color for
details.
descriptions.Control/method/has_theme_color_override:
Returns true if there is a local override for a theme Color with the
specified name in this Control node. See add_theme_color_override.
descriptions.Control/method/has_theme_constant:
Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a
constant item with the specified name and theme_type. See
get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Control/method/has_theme_constant_overri:
Returns true if there is a local override for a theme constant with the
specified name in this Control node. See add_theme_constant_override.
descriptions.Control/method/has_theme_font:
Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a font
item with the specified name and theme_type. See get_theme_color for
details.
descriptions.Control/method/has_theme_font_override:
Returns true if there is a local override for a theme Font with the
specified name in this Control node. See add_theme_font_override.
descriptions.Control/method/has_theme_font_size:
Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a font
size item with the specified name and theme_type. See get_theme_color
for details.
descriptions.Control/method/has_theme_font_size_overr:
Returns true if there is a local override for a theme font size with the
specified name in this Control node. See add_theme_font_size_override.
descriptions.Control/method/has_theme_icon:
Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has an icon
item with the specified name and theme_type. See get_theme_color for
details.
descriptions.Control/method/has_theme_icon_override:
Returns true if there is a local override for a theme icon with the
specified name in this Control node. See add_theme_icon_override.
descriptions.Control/method/has_theme_stylebox:
Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a
stylebox item with the specified name and theme_type. See
get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Control/method/has_theme_stylebox_overri:
Returns true if there is a local override for a theme StyleBox with the
specified name in this Control node. See add_theme_stylebox_override.
descriptions.Control/method/is_drag_successful:
Returns true if a drag operation is successful. Alternative to
Viewport.gui_is_drag_successful. Best used with
Node.NOTIFICATION_DRAG_END.
descriptions.Control/method/is_layout_rtl: Returns true if the layout is right-to-left. See also layout_direction.
descriptions.Control/method/release_focus: Give up the focus. No other control will be able to receive input.
descriptions.Control/method/remove_theme_color_overri:
Removes a local override for a theme Color with the specified name
previously added by add_theme_color_override or via the Inspector dock.
descriptions.Control/method/remove_theme_constant_ove:
Removes a local override for a theme constant with the specified name
previously added by add_theme_constant_override or via the Inspector
dock.
descriptions.Control/method/remove_theme_font_overrid:
Removes a local override for a theme Font with the specified name
previously added by add_theme_font_override or via the Inspector dock.
descriptions.Control/method/remove_theme_font_size_ov:
Removes a local override for a theme font size with the specified name
previously added by add_theme_font_size_override or via the Inspector
dock.
descriptions.Control/method/remove_theme_icon_overrid:
Removes a local override for a theme icon with the specified name
previously added by add_theme_icon_override or via the Inspector dock.
descriptions.Control/method/remove_theme_stylebox_ove:
Removes a local override for a theme StyleBox with the specified name
previously added by add_theme_stylebox_override or via the Inspector
dock.
descriptions.Control/method/reset_size:
Resets the size to get_combined_minimum_size. This is equivalent to
calling set_size(Vector2()) (or any size below the minimum).
descriptions.Control/method/set_anchor:
Sets the anchor for the specified Side to anchor. A setter method for
anchor_bottom, anchor_left, anchor_right and anchor_top. If keep_offset
is true, offsets aren't updated after this operation. If
push_opposite_anchor is true and the opposite anchor overlaps this
anchor, the opposite one will have its value overridden. For example,
when setting left...
descriptions.Control/method/set_anchor_and_offset:
Works the same as set_anchor, but instead of keep_offset argument and
automatic update of offset, it allows to set the offset yourself (see
set_offset).
descriptions.Control/method/set_anchors_and_offsets_p:
Sets both anchor preset and offset preset. See set_anchors_preset and
set_offsets_preset.
descriptions.Control/method/set_anchors_preset:
Sets the anchors to a preset from Control.LayoutPreset enum. This is the
code equivalent to using the Layout menu in the 2D editor. If
keep_offsets is true, control's position will also be updated.
descriptions.Control/method/set_begin:
Sets offset_left and offset_top at the same time. Equivalent of changing
position.
descriptions.Control/method/set_drag_forwarding:
Sets the given callables to be used instead of the control's own
drag-and-drop virtual methods. If a callable is empty, its respective
virtual method is used as normal. The arguments for each callable should
be exactly the same as their respective virtual methods, which would be:
- drag_func corresponds to _get_drag_data and requires a Vector2; -...
descriptions.Control/method/set_drag_preview:
Shows the given control at the mouse pointer. A good time to call this
method is in _get_drag_data. The control must not be in the scene tree.
You should not free the control, and you should not keep a reference to
the control beyond the duration of the drag. It will be deleted
automatically after the drag has ended.
descriptions.Control/method/set_end: Sets offset_right and offset_bottom at the same time.
descriptions.Control/method/set_focus_neighbor:
Sets the focus neighbor for the specified Side to the Control at
neighbor node path. A setter method for focus_neighbor_bottom,
focus_neighbor_left, focus_neighbor_right and focus_neighbor_top.
descriptions.Control/method/set_global_position:
Sets the global_position to given position. If keep_offsets is true,
control's anchors will be updated instead of offsets.
descriptions.Control/method/set_offset:
Sets the offset for the specified Side to offset. A setter method for
offset_bottom, offset_left, offset_right and offset_top.
descriptions.Control/method/set_offsets_preset:
Sets the offsets to a preset from Control.LayoutPreset enum. This is the
code equivalent to using the Layout menu in the 2D editor. Use parameter
resize_mode with constants from Control.LayoutPresetMode to better
determine the resulting size of the Control. Constant size will be
ignored if used with presets that change size, e.g. PRESET_LEFT_WIDE.
Use...
descriptions.Control/method/set_position:
Sets the position to given position. If keep_offsets is true, control's
anchors will be updated instead of offsets.
descriptions.Control/method/set_size:
Sets the size (see size). If keep_offsets is true, control's anchors
will be updated instead of offsets.
descriptions.Control/method/update_maximum_size:
Invalidates the maximum size cache in this node and in parent nodes up
to top level. Intended to be used with get_maximum_size when the return
value is changed. Setting custom_maximum_size directly calls this method
automatically. Note: Calling this method also calls update_minimum_size
since the combined minimum size may be affected by the maximum size...
descriptions.Control/method/update_minimum_size:
Invalidates the minimum size cache in this node and in parent nodes up
to top level. Intended to be used with get_minimum_size when the return
value is changed. Setting custom_minimum_size directly calls this method
automatically.
descriptions.Control/method/warp_mouse:
Moves the mouse cursor to position, relative to position of this
Control. Note: warp_mouse is only supported on Windows, macOS and Linux.
It has no effect on Android, iOS and Web.
descriptions.Control/signal/focus_entered: Emitted when the node gains focus.
descriptions.Control/signal/focus_exited: Emitted when the node loses focus.
descriptions.Control/signal/gui_input: Emitted when the node receives an InputEvent.
descriptions.Control/signal/maximum_size_changed: Emitted when the node's maximum size changes.
descriptions.Control/signal/minimum_size_changed: Emitted when the node's minimum size changes.
descriptions.Control/signal/mouse_entered:
Emitted when the mouse cursor enters the control's (or any child
control's) visible area, that is not occluded behind other Controls or
Windows, provided its mouse_filter lets the event reach it and
regardless if it's currently focused or not. Note: CanvasItem.z_index
doesn't affect, which Control receives the signal.
descriptions.Control/signal/mouse_exited:
Emitted when the mouse cursor leaves the control's (and all child
control's) visible area, that is not occluded behind other Controls or
Windows, provided its mouse_filter lets the event reach it and
regardless if it's currently focused or not. Note: CanvasItem.z_index
doesn't affect, which Control receives the signal. Note: If you want to
check whether...
descriptions.Control/signal/resized: Emitted when the control changes size.
descriptions.Control/signal/size_flags_changed:
Emitted when one of the size flags changes. See size_flags_horizontal
and size_flags_vertical.
descriptions.Control/signal/theme_changed: Emitted when the NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED notification is sent.
descriptions.Controls/method/axis:
Returns this physics tick's scalar level in the range [-1, 1]. An
unavailable, neutral, or differently typed action returns zero.
descriptions.Controls/method/boot:
Attaches controls to an owner already inside the scene tree. Without a
layout, imports button actions from Godot's Input Map. The default
keyboard and mouse player can also use the first available gamepad. Use
an explicit nonnegative gamepad ID for a gamepad-only scope. Equivalent
calls on the same owner return the same handle. Use get_error to inspect
a...
descriptions.Controls/method/capture_pointer:
Captures the focused desktop pointer immediately. Returns
ERR_UNAVAILABLE when capture is unavailable, suspended, or disabled and
ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE when another scope owns it.
descriptions.Controls/method/close:
Retires this attachment, restores the visible pointer if owned, and
releases its input device assignment. Owner exit also retires the
attachment.
descriptions.Controls/method/for_node:
Returns the nearest live controls attached to this node or an ancestor,
or null when there is none.
descriptions.Controls/method/get_error:
Returns the attachment's original error code. Check is_ready to observe
later retirement.
descriptions.Controls/method/get_layout:
Returns the original layout resource, or null for a project Input Map
scope or retired handle. Editing the resource affects later boots.
descriptions.Controls/method/get_owner: Returns the live scene owner, or null after retirement or failed boot.
descriptions.Controls/method/has_action_kind: Reports whether this local scope has the requested action and type.
descriptions.Controls/method/held:
Reports this physics tick's held state for a button. Unavailable and
differently typed actions read as false.
descriptions.Controls/method/is_map_enabled:
Returns true if the named action map is enabled for this player. Returns
false for unknown maps or a retired scope. UI suspension does not change
this setting.
descriptions.Controls/method/is_ready: Reports whether this exact attachment is live.
descriptions.Controls/method/is_suspended:
Reports whether a watched menu, exclusive rebinding capture, loss of
focus, or retirement has neutralized these controls.
descriptions.Controls/method/motion:
Returns the sum of admitted relative pointer motion for the current
physics tick, in unscaled screen pixels. Reading the value leaves it
available to other readers. Unavailable and differently typed actions
read as zero.
descriptions.Controls/method/off_press:
Disconnects the exact callback from this action. An unknown action
returns ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST.
descriptions.Controls/method/on_press:
Registers a no-argument callback once for this button. Dispatch occurs
before gameplay physics callbacks. An invalid callback or nonbutton
action returns ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER.
descriptions.Controls/method/pointer_captured: Reports whether this local scope owns the captured desktop pointer.
descriptions.Controls/method/pressed:
Reports whether an admitted button press occurred for the current
physics tick. A quick tap may set both press and release.
descriptions.Controls/method/release_pointer:
Immediately makes the pointer visible if owned by this scope. Pending
button edges and relative motion are cleared. Releasing twice is safe.
descriptions.Controls/method/released:
Reports whether the logical button became released for the current
physics tick.
descriptions.Controls/method/set_map_enabled:
Enables or disables a named action group for this local player. Gameplay
is enabled at boot, including when empty. Other InputActionMap resources
start disabled. All enabled maps receive their bindings. If the same
control appears in two enabled maps, both can respond. Changing state
immediately clears that map's values and queued edges without
emitting...
descriptions.Controls/method/set_pointer_available:
Enables or disables pointer capture permission for this scope. Disabling
immediately releases a held pointer and clears pending input. Enabling
allows a later capture request.
descriptions.Controls/method/stop_suspending_while_vi: Stops watching this menu and recomputes suspension immediately.
descriptions.Controls/method/suspend_while_visible:
Neutralizes gameplay input and releases capture while this Control is
visible in the tree. Watches compose. Hiding or removing the final
active menu can restore the prior pointer lease when focus still permits
it. The menu must be in the same viewport.
descriptions.Controls/method/vector:
Returns this physics tick's normalized two-dimensional level, limited to
magnitude one. Unavailable and differently typed actions read as zero.
descriptions.Controls/signal/retired:
Emitted once when the attachment retires and the handle stops routing
input.
descriptions.Controls/signal/suspension_changed:
Emitted after the effective suspension state changes and pending input
has been cleared.
descriptions.ControlsComponent/method/boot:
Attaches local input and look to the parent character and its descendant
view. Pass live Controls from the same Input Layout and scene tree to
preserve bindings across body replacements. With null, uses body-scoped
controls. Returns null when the character body has no unique
ControlsComponent. If attachment fails after the component is resolved,
the...
descriptions.ControlsComponent/method/for_body:
Finds the unique direct ControlsComponent under body, regardless of the
component's node name. Returns null for a missing or non-character body,
or when no unique component exists.
descriptions.ConvertTransformModifier3D/method/get_ap: Returns the axis of the remapping destination transform.
Returns the maximum value of the remapping destination range.
Returns the minimum value of the remapping destination range.
Returns the operation of the remapping destination transform.
descriptions.ConvertTransformModifier3D/method/get_re: Returns the axis of the remapping source transform.
Returns the maximum value of the remapping source range.
Returns the minimum value of the remapping source range.
Returns the operation of the remapping source transform.
descriptions.ConvertTransformModifier3D/method/is_add: Returns true if the additive option is enabled in the setting at index.
descriptions.ConvertTransformModifier3D/method/is_rel: Returns true if the relative option is enabled in the setting at index.
descriptions.ConvertTransformModifier3D/method/set_ad:
Sets additive option in the setting at index to enabled. This mainly
affects the process of applying transform to the
BoneConstraint3D.set_apply_bone. If sets enabled to true, the processed
transform is added to the pose of the current apply bone. If sets
enabled to false, the pose of the current apply bone is replaced with
the processed transform....

Sets the maximum value of the remapping destination range.
Sets the minimum value of the remapping destination range.
Sets the operation of the remapping destination transform.

Sets the maximum value of the remapping source range.
Sets the minimum value of the remapping source range.
Sets the operation of the remapping source transform.

Sets relative option in the setting at index to enabled. If sets enabled
to true, the extracted and applying transform is relative to the rest.
If sets enabled to false, the extracted transform is absolute.
descriptions.ConvexPolygonShape2D/method/set_point_cl:
Based on the set of points provided, this assigns the points property
using the convex hull algorithm, removing all unneeded points. See
Geometry2D.convex_hull for details.
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/get_axis_: Returns the axis flags of the setting at index.
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/get_copy_: Returns the copy flags of the setting at index.
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/get_inver: Returns the invert flags of the setting at index.
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/is_additi: Returns true if the additive option is enabled in the setting at index.
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/is_axis_x:
Returns true if the enable flags has the flag for the X-axis in the
setting at index. See also set_axis_flags.

setting at index. See also set_invert_flags.
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/is_axis_y:

setting at index. See also set_axis_flags.

setting at index. See also set_invert_flags.
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/is_axis_z:

setting at index. See also set_axis_flags.

Returns true if the invert flags has the flag for the Z-axis in the
setting at index. See also set_invert_flags.

Returns true if the copy flags has the flag for the position in the
setting at index. See also set_copy_flags.
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/is_relati: Returns true if the relative option is enabled in the setting at index.
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/is_rotati:
Returns true if the copy flags has the flag for the rotation in the
setting at index. See also set_copy_flags.
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/is_scale_:
Returns true if the copy flags has the flag for the scale in the setting
at index. See also set_copy_flags.
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/set_addit:
Sets additive option in the setting at index to enabled. This mainly
affects the process of applying transform to the
BoneConstraint3D.set_apply_bone. If sets enabled to true, the processed
transform is added to the pose of the current apply bone. If sets
enabled to false, the pose of the current apply bone is replaced with
the processed transform....
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/set_axis_: Sets the flags to copy axes. If the flag is valid, the axis is copied.
If sets enabled to true, the X-axis will be copied.
If sets enabled to true, the X-axis will be inverted.
If sets enabled to true, the Y-axis will be copied.
If sets enabled to true, the Y-axis will be inverted.
If sets enabled to true, the Z-axis will be copied.
If sets enabled to true, the Z-axis will be inverted.
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/set_copy_:
Sets the flags to process the transform operations. If the flag is
valid, the transform operation is processed. Note: If the rotation is
valid for only one axis, it respects the roll of the valid axis. If the
rotation is valid for two axes, it discards the roll of the invalid
axis.
If sets enabled to true, the position will be copied.
If sets enabled to true, the rotation will be copied.
If sets enabled to true, the scale will be copied.
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/set_inver:
Sets the flags to inverte axes. If the flag is valid, the axis is
copied. Note: An inverted scale means an inverse number, not a negative
scale. For example, inverting 2.0 means 0.5. Note: An inverted rotation
flips the elements of the quaternion. For example, a two-axis inversion
will flip the roll of each axis, and a three-axis inversion will flip
the...
descriptions.CopyTransformModifier3D/method/set_relat:
Sets relative option in the setting at index to enabled. If sets enabled
to true, the extracted and applying transform is relative to the rest.
If sets enabled to false, the extracted transform is absolute.
descriptions.Crypto/method/constant_time_compare:
Compares two PackedByteArrays for equality without leaking timing
information in order to prevent timing attacks. See this blog post for
more information.
descriptions.Crypto/method/decrypt:
Decrypt the given ciphertext with the provided private key. Note: The
maximum size of accepted ciphertext is limited by the key size.
descriptions.Crypto/method/encrypt:
Encrypt the given plaintext with the provided public key. Note: The
maximum size of accepted plaintext is limited by the key size.
descriptions.Crypto/method/generate_random_bytes:
Generates a PackedByteArray of cryptographically secure random bytes
with given size.
descriptions.Crypto/method/generate_rsa:
Generates an RSA CryptoKey that can be used for creating self-signed
certificates and passed to StreamPeerTLS.accept_stream.
descriptions.Crypto/method/generate_self_signed_certi:
Generates a self-signed X509Certificate from the given CryptoKey and
issuer_name. The certificate validity will be defined by not_before and
not_after (first valid date and last valid date). The issuer_name must
contain at least "CN=" (common name, i.e. the domain name), "O="
(organization, i.e. your company name), "C=" (country, i.e. 2 lettered
ISO-3166...
descriptions.Crypto/method/hmac_digest:
Generates an HMAC digest of msg using key. The hash_type parameter is
the hashing algorithm that is used for the inner and outer hashes.
Currently, only HashingContext.HASH_SHA256 and HashingContext.HASH_SHA1
are supported.
descriptions.Crypto/method/sign: Sign a given hash of type hash_type with the provided private key.
descriptions.Crypto/method/verify:
Verify that a given signature for hash of type hash_type against the
provided public key.
descriptions.CryptoKey/method/is_public_only:
Returns true if this CryptoKey only has the public part, and not the
private one.
descriptions.CryptoKey/method/load:
Loads a key from path. If public_only is true, only the public key will
be loaded. Note: path should be a "*.pub" file if public_only is true, a
"*.key" file otherwise.
descriptions.CryptoKey/method/load_from_string:
Loads a key from the given string_key. If public_only is true, only the
public key will be loaded.
descriptions.CryptoKey/method/save:
Saves a key to the given path. If public_only is true, only the public
key will be saved. Note: path should be a "*.pub" file if public_only is
true, a "*.key" file otherwise.
descriptions.CryptoKey/method/save_to_string:
Returns a string containing the key in PEM format. If public_only is
true, only the public key will be included.
descriptions.Cubemap/method/create_placeholder: Creates a placeholder version of this resource (PlaceholderCubemap).
descriptions.CubemapArray/method/create_placeholder:
Creates a placeholder version of this resource
(PlaceholderCubemapArray).
descriptions.Curve/method/add_point:
Adds a point to the curve. For each side, if the *_mode is
TANGENT_LINEAR, the *_tangent angle (in degrees) uses the slope of the
curve halfway to the adjacent point. Allows custom assignments to the
*_tangent angle if *_mode is set to TANGENT_FREE.
descriptions.Curve/method/bake: Recomputes the baked cache of points for the curve.
descriptions.Curve/method/clean_dupes:
Removes duplicate points, i.e. points that are less than 0.00001 units
(engine epsilon value) away from their neighbor on the curve.
descriptions.Curve/method/clear_points: Removes all points from the curve.
descriptions.Curve/method/get_domain_range: Returns the difference between min_domain and max_domain.
descriptions.Curve/method/get_point_left_mode: Returns the left TangentMode for the point at index.
descriptions.Curve/method/get_point_left_tangent: Returns the left tangent angle (in degrees) for the point at index.
descriptions.Curve/method/get_point_position: Returns the curve coordinates for the point at index.
descriptions.Curve/method/get_point_right_mode: Returns the right TangentMode for the point at index.
descriptions.Curve/method/get_point_right_tangent: Returns the right tangent angle (in degrees) for the point at index.
descriptions.Curve/method/get_value_range: Returns the difference between min_value and max_value.
descriptions.Curve/method/remove_point: Removes the point at index from the curve.
descriptions.Curve/method/sample:
Returns the Y value for the point that would exist at the X position
offset along the curve.
descriptions.Curve/method/sample_baked:
Returns the Y value for the point that would exist at the X position
offset along the curve using the baked cache. Bakes the curve's points
if not already baked.
descriptions.Curve/method/set_point_left_mode: Sets the left TangentMode for the point at index to mode.
descriptions.Curve/method/set_point_left_tangent: Sets the left tangent angle for the point at index to tangent.
descriptions.Curve/method/set_point_offset: Assigns the horizontal position offset to the point at index.
descriptions.Curve/method/set_point_right_mode: Sets the right TangentMode for the point at index to mode.
descriptions.Curve/method/set_point_right_tangent: Sets the right tangent angle for the point at index to tangent.
descriptions.Curve/method/set_point_value: Assigns the vertical position y to the point at index.
descriptions.Curve/signal/domain_changed: Emitted when max_domain or min_domain is changed.
descriptions.Curve/signal/range_changed: Emitted when max_value or min_value is changed.
descriptions.Curve2D/method/add_point:
Adds a point with the specified position relative to the curve's own
position, with control points in and out. Appends the new point at the
end of the point list. If index is given, the new point is inserted
before the existing point identified by index index. Every existing
point starting from index is shifted further down the list of points.
The index...
descriptions.Curve2D/method/clear_points: Removes all points from the curve.
descriptions.Curve2D/method/get_baked_length:
Returns the total length of the curve, based on the cached points. Given
enough density (see bake_interval), it should be approximate enough.
descriptions.Curve2D/method/get_baked_points: Returns the cache of points as a PackedVector2Array.
descriptions.Curve2D/method/get_closest_offset:
Returns the closest offset to to_point. This offset is meant to be used
in sample_baked. to_point must be in this curve's local space.
descriptions.Curve2D/method/get_closest_point:
Returns the closest point on baked segments (in curve's local space) to
to_point. to_point must be in this curve's local space.
descriptions.Curve2D/method/get_point_in:
Returns the position of the control point leading to the vertex idx. The
returned position is relative to the vertex idx. If the index is out of
bounds, the function sends an error to the console, and returns (0, 0).
descriptions.Curve2D/method/get_point_out:
Returns the position of the control point leading out of the vertex idx.
The returned position is relative to the vertex idx. If the index is out
of bounds, the function sends an error to the console, and returns (0,
0).
descriptions.Curve2D/method/get_point_position:
Returns the position of the vertex idx. If the index is out of bounds,
the function sends an error to the console, and returns (0, 0).
descriptions.Curve2D/method/remove_point:
Deletes the point idx from the curve. Sends an error to the console if
idx is out of bounds.
descriptions.Curve2D/method/sample:
Returns the position between the vertex idx and the vertex idx + 1,
where t controls if the point is the first vertex (t = 0.0), the last
vertex (t = 1.0), or in between. Values of t outside the range (0.0 <= t
<= 1.0) give strange, but predictable results. If idx is out of bounds
it is truncated to the first or last vertex, and t is ignored. If the...
descriptions.Curve2D/method/sample_baked:
Returns a point within the curve at position offset, where offset is
measured as a pixel distance along the curve. To do that, it finds the
two cached points where the offset lies between, then interpolates the
values. This interpolation is cubic if cubic is set to true, or linear
if set to false. Cubic interpolation tends to follow the curves
better,...
descriptions.Curve2D/method/sample_baked_with_rotatio:
Similar to sample_baked, but returns Transform2D that includes a
rotation along the curve, with Transform2D.origin as the point position
and the Transform2D.x vector pointing in the direction of the path at
that point. Returns an empty transform if the length of the curve is 0.
descriptions.Curve2D/method/samplef:
Returns the position at the vertex fofs. It calls sample using the
integer part of fofs as idx, and its fractional part as t.
descriptions.Curve2D/method/set_point_in:
Sets the position of the control point leading to the vertex idx. If the
index is out of bounds, the function sends an error to the console. The
position is relative to the vertex.
descriptions.Curve2D/method/set_point_out:
Sets the position of the control point leading out of the vertex idx. If
the index is out of bounds, the function sends an error to the console.
The position is relative to the vertex.
descriptions.Curve2D/method/set_point_position:
Sets the position for the vertex idx. If the index is out of bounds, the
function sends an error to the console.
descriptions.Curve2D/method/tessellate:
Returns a list of points along the curve, with a curvature controlled
point density. That is, the curvier parts will have more points than the
straighter parts. This approximation makes straight segments between
each point, then subdivides those segments until the resulting shape is
similar enough. max_stages controls how many subdivisions a curve...
descriptions.Curve2D/method/tessellate_even_length:
Returns a list of points along the curve, with almost uniform density.
max_stages controls how many subdivisions a curve segment may face
before it is considered approximate enough. Each subdivision splits the
segment in half, so the default 5 stages may mean up to 32 subdivisions
per curve segment. Increase with care! tolerance_length controls the...
descriptions.Curve3D/method/add_point:

descriptions.Curve3D/method/get_baked_points: Returns the cache of points as a PackedVector3Array.
descriptions.Curve3D/method/get_baked_tilts: Returns the cache of tilts as a PackedFloat32Array.
descriptions.Curve3D/method/get_baked_up_vectors:
Returns the cache of up vectors as a PackedVector3Array. If
up_vector_enabled is false, the cache will be empty.
descriptions.Curve3D/method/get_closest_offset:
Returns the closest offset to to_point. This offset is meant to be used

curve's local space.
descriptions.Curve3D/method/get_closest_point:
Returns the closest point on baked segments (in curve's local space) to
to_point. to_point must be in this curve's local space.

Returns the position of the control point leading to the vertex idx. The
returned position is relative to the vertex idx. If the index is out of
bounds, the function sends an error to the console, and returns (0, 0,
0).
descriptions.Curve3D/method/get_point_out:
Returns the position of the control point leading out of the vertex idx.
The returned position is relative to the vertex idx. If the index is out
of bounds, the function sends an error to the console, and returns (0,
0, 0).
descriptions.Curve3D/method/get_point_position:
Returns the position of the vertex idx. If the index is out of bounds,
the function sends an error to the console, and returns (0, 0, 0).
descriptions.Curve3D/method/get_point_tilt:
Returns the tilt angle in radians for the point idx. If the index is out
of bounds, the function sends an error to the console, and returns 0.
descriptions.Curve3D/method/remove_point:
Deletes the point idx from the curve. Sends an error to the console if
idx is out of bounds.

measured as a distance in 3D units along the curve. To do that, it finds

linear if set to false. Cubic interpolation tends to follow the
curves...
descriptions.Curve3D/method/sample_baked_up_vector:
Returns an up vector within the curve at position offset, where offset
is measured as a distance in 3D units along the curve. To do that, it
finds the two cached up vectors where the offset lies between, then
interpolates the values. If apply_tilt is true, an interpolated tilt is
applied to the interpolated up vector. If the curve has no up vectors,
the...
descriptions.Curve3D/method/sample_baked_with_rotatio:
Returns a Transform3D with origin as point position, basis.x as sideway
vector, basis.y as up vector, basis.z as forward vector. When the curve
length is 0, there is no reasonable way to calculate the rotation, all
vectors aligned with global space axes. See also sample_baked.
descriptions.Curve3D/method/samplef:
Returns the position at the vertex fofs. It calls sample using the
integer part of fofs as idx, and its fractional part as t.
descriptions.Curve3D/method/set_point_in:
Sets the position of the control point leading to the vertex idx. If the
index is out of bounds, the function sends an error to the console. The
position is relative to the vertex.
descriptions.Curve3D/method/set_point_out:
Sets the position of the control point leading out of the vertex idx. If
the index is out of bounds, the function sends an error to the console.
The position is relative to the vertex.
descriptions.Curve3D/method/set_point_position:
Sets the position for the vertex idx. If the index is out of bounds, the
function sends an error to the console.
descriptions.Curve3D/method/set_point_tilt:
Sets the tilt angle in radians for the point idx. If the index is out of
bounds, the function sends an error to the console. The tilt controls
the rotation along the look-at axis an object traveling the path would
have. In the case of a curve controlling a PathFollow3D, this tilt is an
offset over the natural tilt the PathFollow3D calculates.

descriptions.DPITexture/method/create_from_string:
Creates a new DPITexture and initializes it by allocating and setting
the SVG data to source.
descriptions.DPITexture/method/get_scaled_rid:
Returns the RID of the texture rasterized to match the oversampling of
the currently drawn canvas item.
descriptions.DPITexture/method/get_source: Returns this SVG texture's source code.
descriptions.DPITexture/method/set_size_override: Resizes the texture to the specified dimensions.
descriptions.DPITexture/method/set_source: Sets this SVG texture's source code.
descriptions.DTLSServer/method/setup:
Setup the DTLS server to use the given server_options. See
TLSOptions.server.
descriptions.DTLSServer/method/take_connection:
Try to initiate the DTLS handshake with the given udp_peer which must be
already connected (see PacketPeerUDP.connect_to_host). Note: You must
check that the state of the return PacketPeerUDP is
PacketPeerDTLS.STATUS_HANDSHAKING, as it is normal that 50% of the new
connections will be invalid due to cookie exchange.
descriptions.Decal/method/get_texture:
Returns the Texture2D associated with the specified DecalTexture. This
is a convenience method, in most cases you should access the texture
directly. For example, instead of albedo_tex =
$Decal.get_texture(Decal.TEXTURE_ALBEDO), use albedo_tex =
$Decal.texture_albedo. One case where this is better than accessing the
texture directly is when you want to...
descriptions.Decal/method/set_texture:
Sets the Texture2D associated with the specified DecalTexture. This is a
convenience method, in most cases you should access the texture
directly. For example, instead of
$Decal.set_texture(Decal.TEXTURE_ALBEDO, albedo_tex), use
$Decal.texture_albedo = albedo_tex. One case where this is better than
accessing the texture directly is when you want to copy...
descriptions.Dictionary/method/assign:
Assigns elements of another dictionary into the dictionary. Resizes the
dictionary to match dictionary. Performs type conversions if the
dictionary is typed.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/clear: Clears the dictionary, removing all entries from it.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/duplicate:
Returns a new copy of the dictionary. By default, a shallow copy is
returned: all nested Array, Dictionary, and Resource keys and values are
shared with the original dictionary. Modifying any of those in one
dictionary will also affect them in the other. If deep is true, a deep
copy is returned: all nested arrays and dictionaries are also
duplicated...
descriptions.Dictionary/method/duplicate_deep:
Duplicates this dictionary, deeply, like duplicate when passing true,
with extra control over how subresources are handled.
deep_subresources_mode must be one of the values from
Resource.DeepDuplicateMode. By default, only internal resources will be
duplicated (recursively).
descriptions.Dictionary/method/erase:
Removes the dictionary entry by key, if it exists. Returns true if the
given key existed in the dictionary, otherwise false. Note: Do not erase
entries while iterating over the dictionary. You can iterate over the
keys array instead.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/find_key:
Finds and returns the first key whose associated value is equal to
value, or null if it is not found. Note: null is also a valid key. If
inside the dictionary, find_key may give misleading results.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/get:
Returns the corresponding value for the given key in the dictionary. If
the key does not exist, returns default, or null if the parameter is
omitted. Note: If the default argument is computationally expensive or
has unwanted side effects, consider using the has method instead:
descriptions.Dictionary/method/get_or_add:
Gets a value and ensures the key is set. If the key exists in the
dictionary, this behaves like get. Otherwise, the default value is
inserted into the dictionary and returned.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/get_typed_key_builtin:
Returns the built-in Variant type of the typed dictionary's keys as a
Variant.Type constant. If the keys are not typed, returns TYPE_NIL. See
also is_typed_key.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/get_typed_key_class_na:
Returns the built-in class name of the typed dictionary's keys, if the
built-in Variant type is TYPE_OBJECT. Otherwise, returns an empty
StringName. See also is_typed_key and Object.get_class.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/get_typed_key_script:
Returns the Script instance associated with this typed dictionary's
keys, or null if it does not exist. See also is_typed_key.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/get_typed_value_builti:
Returns the built-in Variant type of the typed dictionary's values as a
Variant.Type constant. If the values are not typed, returns TYPE_NIL.
See also is_typed_value.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/get_typed_value_class_:
Returns the built-in class name of the typed dictionary's values, if the
built-in Variant type is TYPE_OBJECT. Otherwise, returns an empty
StringName. See also is_typed_value and Object.get_class.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/get_typed_value_script:
Returns the Script instance associated with this typed dictionary's
values, or null if it does not exist. See also is_typed_value.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/has: Returns true if the dictionary contains an entry with the given key.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/has_all:
Returns true if the dictionary contains all keys in the given keys
array.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/hash:
Returns a hashed 32-bit integer value representing the dictionary
contents.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/is_empty: Returns true if the dictionary is empty (its size is 0). See also size.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/is_read_only:
Returns true if the dictionary is read-only. See make_read_only.
Dictionaries are automatically read-only if declared with const keyword.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/is_same_typed: Returns true if the dictionary is typed the same as dictionary.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/is_same_typed_key:
Returns true if the dictionary's keys are typed the same as dictionary's
keys.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/is_same_typed_value:
Returns true if the dictionary's values are typed the same as
dictionary's values.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/is_typed:
Returns true if the dictionary is typed. Typed dictionaries can only
store keys/values of their associated type and provide type safety for
the [] operator. Methods of typed dictionary still return Variant.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/is_typed_key: Returns true if the dictionary's keys are typed.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/is_typed_value: Returns true if the dictionary's values are typed.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/keys: Returns the list of keys in the dictionary.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/make_read_only:
Makes the dictionary read-only, i.e. disables modification of the
dictionary's contents. Does not apply to nested content, e.g. content of
nested dictionaries.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/merge:
Adds entries from dictionary to this dictionary. By default, duplicate
keys are not copied over, unless overwrite is true.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/merged:
Returns a copy of this dictionary merged with the other dictionary. By
default, duplicate keys are not copied over, unless overwrite is true.
See also merge. This method is useful for quickly making dictionaries
with default values:
descriptions.Dictionary/method/recursive_equal:
Returns true if the two dictionaries contain the same keys and values,
inner Dictionary and Array keys and values are compared recursively.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/set:
Sets the value of the element at the given key to the given value.
Returns true if the value is set successfully. Fails and returns false
if the dictionary is read-only, or if key and value don't match the
dictionary's types. This is the same as using the [] operator (dictkey =
value).
descriptions.Dictionary/method/size:
Returns the number of entries in the dictionary. Empty dictionaries ({
}) always return 0. See also is_empty.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/sort:
Sorts the dictionary in ascending order, by key. The final order is
dependent on the "less than" (<) comparison between keys.
descriptions.Dictionary/method/values: Returns the list of values in this dictionary.
descriptions.DirAccess/method/change_dir:
Changes the currently opened directory to the one passed as an argument.
The argument can be relative to the current directory (e.g. newdir or
../newdir), or an absolute path (e.g. /tmp/newdir or
res://somedir/newdir). Returns one of the Error code constants (OK on
success). Note: The new directory must be within the same scope, e.g.
when you had opened...
descriptions.DirAccess/method/copy:
Copies the from file to the to destination. Both arguments should be
paths to files, either relative or absolute. If the destination file
exists and is not access-protected, it will be overwritten. If
chmod_flags is different than -1, the Unix permissions for the
destination path will be set to the provided value, if available on the
current operating...
descriptions.DirAccess/method/copy_absolute: Static version of copy. Supports only absolute paths.
descriptions.DirAccess/method/create_link:
Creates symbolic link between files or folders. Note: On Windows, this
method works only if the application is running with elevated privileges
or Developer Mode is enabled. Note: This method is implemented on macOS,
Linux, and Windows.
descriptions.DirAccess/method/create_temp:
Creates a temporary directory. This directory will be freed when the
returned DirAccess is freed. If prefix is not empty, it will be prefixed
to the directory name, separated by a -. If keep is true, the directory
is not deleted when the returned DirAccess is freed. Returns null if
opening the directory failed. You can use get_open_error to check the...
descriptions.DirAccess/method/current_is_dir:
Returns whether the current item processed with the last get_next call
is a directory (. and .. are considered directories).
descriptions.DirAccess/method/dir_exists:
Returns whether the target directory exists. The argument can be
relative to the current directory, or an absolute path. Note: The
returned bool in the editor and after exporting when used on a path in
the res:// directory may be different. Some files are converted to
engine-specific formats when exported, potentially changing the
directory structure.
descriptions.DirAccess/method/dir_exists_absolute:
Static version of dir_exists. Supports only absolute paths. Note: The
returned bool in the editor and after exporting when used on a path in
the res:// directory may be different. Some files are converted to
engine-specific formats when exported, potentially changing the
directory structure.
descriptions.DirAccess/method/file_exists:
Returns whether the target file exists. The argument can be relative to
the current directory, or an absolute path. For a static equivalent, use
FileAccess.file_exists. Note: Many resources types are imported (e.g.
textures or sound files), and their source asset will not be included in
the exported game, as only the imported version is used. See...
descriptions.DirAccess/method/get_current_dir:
Returns the absolute path to the currently opened directory (e.g.
res://folder or C:\tmp\folder).
descriptions.DirAccess/method/get_current_drive:
Returns the currently opened directory's drive index. See get_drive_name
to convert returned index to the name of the drive.
descriptions.DirAccess/method/get_directories:
Returns a PackedStringArray containing filenames of the directory
contents, excluding files. The array is sorted alphabetically. Affected
by include_hidden and include_navigational. Note: The returned
directories in the editor and after exporting in the res:// directory
may differ as some files are converted to engine-specific formats when
exported.
descriptions.DirAccess/method/get_directories_at:
Returns a PackedStringArray containing filenames of the directory
contents, excluding files, at the given path. The array is sorted
alphabetically. Use get_directories if you want more control of what
gets included. Note: The returned directories in the editor and after
exporting in the res:// directory may differ as some files are converted
to...
