only supported on the Forward+ and Mobile rendering methods, not
Compatibility.
descriptions.GPUParticles3D/method/get_draw_pass_mesh: Returns the Mesh that is drawn at index pass.
descriptions.GPUParticles3D/method/request_particles_:
Requests the particles to process for extra process time during a single
frame. process_time defines the time that the particles will process
while emitting is on. process_time_residual defines the time that
particles will process with emitting turned off for the simulation. When
combined with speed_scale set to 0.0, this is useful to be able to seek
a...
descriptions.GPUParticles3D/method/restart:
Restarts the particle emission cycle, clearing existing particles. To
avoid particles vanishing from the viewport, wait for the finished
signal before calling. Note: The finished signal is only emitted by
one_shot emitters. If keep_seed is true, the current random seed will be
preserved. Useful for seeking and playback.
descriptions.GPUParticles3D/method/set_draw_pass_mesh: Sets the Mesh that is drawn at index pass.
descriptions.GPUParticles3D/signal/finished:
Emitted when all active particles have finished processing. To
immediately restart the emission cycle, call restart. This signal is
never emitted when one_shot is disabled, as particles will be emitted
and processed continuously. Note: For one_shot emitters, due to the
particles being computed on the GPU, there may be a short period after
receiving the...
descriptions.GPUParticlesCollisionHeightField3D/metho:
Returns true if the specified layer of the heightfield_mask is enabled,
given a layer_number between 1 and 20, inclusive.

Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the
heightfield_mask, given a layer_number between 1 and 20, inclusive.
descriptions.GPUParticlesCollisionSDF3D/method/get_ba:
Returns whether or not the specified layer of the bake_mask is enabled,
given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.GPUParticlesCollisionSDF3D/method/set_ba:
Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the
bake_mask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.Game/method/accept_invite:
Await the result of accepting the exact pending offer. A replaced offer
rejects and leaves its replacement pending.
descriptions.Game/method/bind_player:
Bind an identity verified by the game to an admitted peer in the
authority lobby.
descriptions.Game/method/boot_result:
Return the original boot outcome. An action additionally requires a live
attachment.
descriptions.Game/method/campaign:
Create a coordinated draft. Register game-owned state and permission
rules before starting.
descriptions.Game/method/codecs:
Return the codec registry for this game attachment. The same registry
survives session leave and restarts. An unsuccessful or retired game
returns null. When the game owner leaves the tree, retained references
to the registry reject further work with ERR_UNAVAILABLE.
descriptions.Game/method/configure: Create a solo-ready draft for a fixed world and player scene.
descriptions.Game/method/current:
Return the explicitly selected or sole live game, or null when
ambiguous.
descriptions.Game/method/dismiss_invite: Dismiss the exact pending offer without joining.
descriptions.Game/method/find_and_join:
Search the configured online game and await one verified playable join.
Empty search, admission failure, and cancellation have distinct
outcomes.
descriptions.Game/method/for_node: Resolve the nearest live game owning this scene branch.
descriptions.Game/method/get_local_player: Return the fixed-world local actor or null.
descriptions.Game/method/get_phase: Return the current Phase. Retired attachments report IDLE.
descriptions.Game/method/get_player: Return the fixed-world actor for the specified session peer or null.
descriptions.Game/method/get_port: Return the configured UDP port, or zero when unavailable.
descriptions.Game/method/get_world: Return the mounted world until travel or teardown.
descriptions.Game/method/host:
Await a playable host and online publication when configured. The
default bind is *. An optional public address advertises a direct route.
descriptions.Game/method/inventory: Return the configured inventory service, or null when disabled.
descriptions.Game/method/invite_friends:
Request Steam’s invite picker for the current owned lobby. Success
acknowledges the request.
descriptions.Game/method/is_player_controlled:
Returns true when this fixed-world game was configured with
authority-driven player movement.
descriptions.Game/method/join: Await a verified, playable direct join using the configured port.
descriptions.Game/method/join_listing: Await the result of joining the exact selected listing.
descriptions.Game/method/join_lobby:
Begin joining a coordinated ENet lobby. Observe phase changes for
admission and world readiness.
descriptions.Game/method/leave:
Await retirement of the pending start or active session. An idle game
succeeds immediately.
descriptions.Game/method/network_diagnostics:
Sample local connection and movement state for a debugger. Returns a
detached snapshot without changing the session. A detached game reports
GameNetworkDiagnostics.IDLE. Sample again for fresh values.
descriptions.Game/method/open_lobby: Open a coordinated ENet lobby for identity binding. Bind defaults to *.
descriptions.Game/method/pending_invite: Return the pending offer or null, including eligible launch-time offers.
descriptions.Game/method/perform:
Await the authority result for a coordinated command. The default
payload is an empty dictionary.
descriptions.Game/method/play: Await the GameResult after solo startup makes the world playable.
descriptions.Game/method/register_command:
Register a game-owned command before coordinated play. The authority
runs its handler. Possession is optional by default.
descriptions.Game/method/save_slot: Select a checkpoint slot in the configured coordinated game.
descriptions.Game/method/scenes: Return world actions tied to this attachment.
descriptions.Game/method/serve:
Await a playerless world with admission open. Bind defaults to *. The
optional advertised address defaults to empty.
descriptions.Game/method/set_default:
Select a live code-first game for global access, or pass null to clear
it.
descriptions.Game/method/start_match:
Await a coordinated world start after the authority binds its players.
The default is the configured starting world.
descriptions.Game/method/steam:
Return the Steamworks facade for this exact game, including an
unavailable facade when Steam is absent.
descriptions.Game/method/transactions:
Return the authority coordinator for game-owned store setup, or null
when unavailable.
descriptions.Game/signal/invite_changed: Emitted when the pending offer changes. Null clears the offer.
descriptions.Game/signal/peer_joined: Emitted when a peer is admitted.
descriptions.Game/signal/phase_changed: Emitted after the runtime publishes the new phase.
descriptions.Game/signal/world_ready: Emitted when the runtime publishes a playable world.
descriptions.GameBindings/method/session_transport:
Register a main-thread factory returning SessionTransport. Return OK,
ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER for an invalid callable, or ERR_BUSY after the
draft is sealed.
descriptions.GameConfig/method/boot:
Attach private services to a live scene-tree owner. Check the returned
Game's boot_result for a configuration failure.
descriptions.GameConfig/method/boot_server:
Attach the game and native CLI launcher. The launcher runs for the
explicit server role.
descriptions.GameConfig/method/from_definition: Adapt a saved or legacy definition using a detached snapshot.
descriptions.GameConfig/method/inventory: Enable game-owned inventory on a coordinated profile.
descriptions.GameConfig/method/lan:
Select direct play with total capacity including the listen host.
Defaults to two.
descriptions.GameConfig/method/on_port: Set the configured UDP port, from 1 to 65535, on a branch.
descriptions.GameConfig/method/player_controls:
Returns a branch that enables authority-driven movement and look for
fixed-world play. Omit profile to read movement settings from one
MoverComponent directly under the player scene's CharacterBody3D root.
Boot reports invalid or missing scene setup through Game.boot_result.
Supply an explicit profile to use its movement settings instead.
Enable...
descriptions.GameConfig/method/provider: Select an optional typed provider to run at boot.
descriptions.GameConfig/method/steam:
Select Steam listen play. Null settings use the launch app and
invite-only visibility. Capacity defaults to two.
descriptions.GameConfig/method/steam_server:
Select a configured Steam dedicated server. Capacity defaults to two
remote players.
descriptions.GameConfig/method/with_world: Add a destination to a coordinated draft.
descriptions.GameConfig/method/world_id: Set a durable starting world ID. The fixed-world default is start.
descriptions.GameDefinition/method/boot:
Creates a configured GameRuntime and attaches it to a live owner on the
main thread. Returns null and reports a Crimson diagnostic if attachment
fails or the tree retires the owner or child during attachment.
descriptions.GameInventory/method/backpack:
Return the current local player's backpack after coordinated gameplay
becomes ready. Returns null for an unavailable scope or a server with no
local player. A retained backpack expires when the match retires.
descriptions.GameInvites/method/is_available: Return whether this exact attachment has a ready invite backend.
descriptions.GameInvites/method/open_overlay:
Request the current hosted Steam lobby's invite picker. OK means Steam
accepted the request, and ERR_BUSY means the overlay is loading.
descriptions.GameInvites/method/pending:
Return the latest invite in this attachment, including one captured from
Steam Apps launch arguments or the ordinary lobby command line. Crimson
ignores malformed or conflicting lobby candidates. The game decides when
to join.
descriptions.GameInvites/method/send:
Submit one invite to the selected decimal SteamID64 from the current
owned lobby. OK means the request was submitted to Steam.
descriptions.GameInvites/signal/changed:
Emitted when the exact pending offer changes. A null offer clears the
current prompt after acceptance, dismissal, or attachment retirement.
descriptions.GameInvites/signal/received:
Emitted for a Steam request to join while this game attachment is
active, including Steam URL launches with a supported lobby argument.
Duplicate notifications for the same lobby within two seconds are
coalesced.
descriptions.GameOperation/method/get_result: Return the detached legacy result or an empty dictionary while pending.
descriptions.GameOperation/method/get_typed_result: Return the typed outcome or null before completion.
descriptions.GameOperation/method/is_finished: Return whether the operation has settled.
descriptions.GameOperation/method/wait: Return the legacy result or an awaitable completion signal.
descriptions.GameOperation/method/wait_result: Return the typed GameResult or an awaitable completion signal.
descriptions.GameOperation/signal/completed: Emitted once with the legacy outcome.
descriptions.GameOperation/signal/completed_typed: Emitted once with the typed outcome of the same operation.
descriptions.GameProvider/method/_register: Register replacements on this attachment's draft before boot seals it.
descriptions.GameResult/method/get_listing_id: Published lobby or server locator on successful online host.
descriptions.GameResult/method/get_reason: Transport or teardown reason when supplied.
descriptions.GameResult/method/get_world_epoch: Activated world epoch, or zero when unavailable.
descriptions.GameRuntime/method/invites:
Return this attachment's invite gateway if its provider supplies one. A
failed Steam attachment has an unavailable gateway.
descriptions.GameRuntime/method/join_listing:
Join a provider-owned discovery or invite snapshot through the normal
online game lifecycle. The provider resolves the current lobby, and the
operation succeeds after authenticated world and player readiness.
descriptions.GameRuntime/method/restore:
Prepares and publishes a checkpoint from the coordinated authority lobby
or ready world. Pass both generation selectors for an exact restore or
leave both empty to select the latest generation. The operation reports
the outcome code and message and includes guidance after restoring a
backup generation.
descriptions.GameRuntime/method/save:
Captures a checkpoint from the running coordinated authority. An
autosave can supersede an uncaptured autosave for the same slot. The
operation reports the outcome code and message, the generation identity
when available, and any storage warning.
descriptions.GameRuntime/method/save_slot:
Returns a handle scoped to this game for building a save request or
selecting a checkpoint to restore. The handle expires when its
originating game is unavailable.
descriptions.GameRuntime/method/set_projector:
Sets the authority's per-recipient view callback while the game is idle
or in its lobby. The callback receives the peer ID, player ID, world
epoch, and committed revision. Return a Dictionary with ok set to true
and a view Dictionary on success. A rejected projection can include a
message for the local console. Returns ERR_BUSY outside setup phases.
descriptions.GameRuntime/method/start_match:
Starts a coordinated match from the authority lobby. An empty world uses
the definition's starting world. The operation settles after the scene
and required participant baselines are ready or an error prevents
readiness.
descriptions.GameRuntime/method/start_offline:
Opens the coordinated offline lobby and starts the configured world. The
operation succeeds when the world is ready. Its result includes an
outcome code and a message. Failures appear in the Godot console.
descriptions.GameRuntime/method/travel_to:
Transitions the authority and admitted participants to a world ID
registered in the definition. The terminal result reports an outcome
code and message. Preparation failure preserves the current world, while
a failure after publication can pause gameplay in recovery.
descriptions.GameRuntime/method/voice:
Returns the persistent voice service for this exact Steam game
attachment. Returns null when no Steam client or dedicated Steam service
is configured.
descriptions.GameScenes/method/get_world: Return the mounted scene while the originating game is live.
descriptions.GameScenes/method/load:
Await a GameResult for travel to a registered destination in a
coordinated game.
descriptions.GameServiceProvider/method/_create_onlin:
Returns the optional online directory for this game scope. Configure an
authenticator on the session as well to use authenticated online host
and join operations.
descriptions.GameServiceProvider/method/_create_scene:
Returns a fresh detached scene loader. The game attaches and owns it.
Omit the override to use the default loader.
descriptions.GameServiceProvider/method/_create_sessi:
Returns a fresh detached session. The game attaches and owns it. Omit
the override to use the default session.
descriptions.GameSession/signal/peer_joined:
Emitted when an admitted remote peer enters this scope's roster. The
peer ID identifies a connection.
descriptions.GameSession/signal/peer_left:
Emitted when a remote peer leaves the active roster. Ending the entire
session clears the roster together.
descriptions.GameSession/signal/session_ended:
Emitted when a session ends or a pending connection fails. Reasons
include left, connection_failed, connection_timeout, protocol_mismatch,
server_disconnected, transport_replaced, and transport_disconnected.
Verified sessions can also report authentication_failed or
authentication_replaced. Removing the session node closes it silently.
descriptions.GameSession/signal/session_started:
Emitted after an offline or host session starts, or after the host
admits this guest. The peer ID identifies the active connection.
descriptions.GameSession/signal/state_changed:
Emitted when the session enters a new State, including while waiting for
admission.
descriptions.GameVoice/method/_voice_receive:
Internal authority-only delivery entry point. Accepts the attributed
sender only from the current authenticated authority and applies local
mute and queue limits.
descriptions.GameVoice/method/_voice_submit:
Internal unreliable ordered transport entry point. The authority takes
sender identity from the actual multiplayer context and rejects stale or
unauthorized frames.
descriptions.GameVoice/method/set_channel:
Selects the requested channel for future local frames. The game
authority evaluates the channel and recipient policy before any remote
delivery.
descriptions.GameVoice/method/set_muted:
Mutes or unmutes one remote session-local peer on this client. Muting
removes queued frames and ends its displayed speaking state.
descriptions.GameVoice/method/set_recipient_policy:
Configures trusted authority code accepting sender peer ID, recipient
peer ID and channel and returning a boolean. An empty callable enables
group delivery to eligible peers only. Supply authority-owned team or
proximity state when filtering those channels.
descriptions.GameVoice/method/start_talking:
Requests local microphone capture after explicit opt-in. Requires a
ready Steam participant in an online world. An occupied process
microphone returns ERR_BUSY.
descriptions.GameVoice/method/stop_talking:
Stops transmitting immediately and requests native capture stop. Any
final native audio is discarded by the capture scope.
descriptions.GameVoice/signal/frame_received:
Emitted with authorized decoded signed 16-bit mono samples for one
remote peer. Feed them to the game's playback queue at the reported
rate.
descriptions.GameVoice/signal/talking_changed:
Emitted when explicit local capture changes or decoded remote audio
begins, goes idle, is muted, or leaves the current world.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/bresenham_line:
Returns the Bresenham line between the from and to points. A Bresenham
line is a series of pixels that draws a line and is always 1-pixel thick
on every row and column of the drawing (never more, never less). Example
code to draw a line between two Marker2D nodes using a series of
CanvasItem.draw_rect calls:
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/clip_polygons:
Clips polygon_a against polygon_b and returns an array of clipped
polygons. This performs OPERATION_DIFFERENCE between polygons. Returns
an empty array if polygon_b completely overlaps polygon_a. If polygon_b
is enclosed by polygon_a, returns an outer polygon (boundary) and inner
polygon (hole) which could be distinguished by calling
is_polygon_clockwise.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/clip_polyline_with_pol:
Clips polyline against polygon and returns an array of clipped
polylines. This performs OPERATION_DIFFERENCE between the polyline and
the polygon. This operation can be thought of as cutting a line with a
closed shape.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/convex_hull:
Given an array of Vector2s, returns the convex hull as a list of points
in counterclockwise order. The last point is the same as the first one.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/decompose_polygon_in_c:
Decomposes the polygon into multiple convex hulls and returns an array
of PackedVector2Array.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/exclude_polygons:
Mutually excludes common area defined by intersection of polygon_a and
polygon_b (see intersect_polygons) and returns an array of excluded
polygons. This performs OPERATION_XOR between polygons. In other words,
returns all but common area between polygons. The operation may result
in an outer polygon (boundary) and inner polygon (hole) produced
which...
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/get_closest_point_to_s:
Returns the 2D point on the 2D segment (s1, s2) that is closest to
point. The returned point will always be inside the specified segment.

Returns the 2D point on the 2D line defined by (s1, s2) that is closest
to point. The returned point can be inside the segment (s1, s2) or
outside of it, i.e. somewhere on the line extending from the segment.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/get_closest_points_bet:
Given the two 2D segments (p1, q1) and (p2, q2), finds those two points
on the two segments that are closest to each other. Returns a
PackedVector2Array that contains this point on (p1, q1) as well the
accompanying point on (p2, q2).
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/intersect_polygons:
Intersects polygon_a with polygon_b and returns an array of intersected
polygons. This performs OPERATION_INTERSECTION between polygons. In
other words, returns common area shared by polygons. Returns an empty
array if no intersection occurs. The operation may result in an outer
polygon (boundary) and inner polygon (hole) produced which could be...
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/intersect_polyline_wit:
Intersects polyline with polygon and returns an array of intersected
polylines. This performs OPERATION_INTERSECTION between the polyline and
the polygon. This operation can be thought of as chopping a line with a
closed shape.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/is_point_in_circle:
Returns true if point is inside the circle or if it's located exactly on
the circle's boundary, otherwise returns false.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/is_point_in_polygon:
Returns true if point is inside polygon or if it's located exactly on
polygon's boundary, otherwise returns false.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/is_polygon_clockwise:
Returns true if polygon's vertices are ordered in clockwise order,
otherwise returns false. Note: Assumes a Cartesian coordinate system
where +x is right and +y is up. If using screen coordinates (+y is
down), the result will need to be flipped (i.e. a true result will
indicate counter-clockwise).
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/line_intersects_line:
Returns the point of intersection between the two lines (from_a, dir_a)
and (from_b, dir_b). Returns a Vector2, or null if the lines are
parallel. from and dir are not endpoints of a line segment or ray but
the slope (dir) and a known point (from) on that line. To get the
intersection between two line segments, use segment_intersects_segment.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/make_atlas:
Given an array of Vector2s representing tiles, builds an atlas. The
returned dictionary has two keys: points is a PackedVector2Array that
specifies the positions of each tile, size contains the overall size of
the whole atlas as Vector2i.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/merge_polygons:
Merges (combines) polygon_a and polygon_b and returns an array of merged
polygons. This performs OPERATION_UNION between polygons. The operation
may result in an outer polygon (boundary) and multiple inner polygons
(holes) produced which could be distinguished by calling
is_polygon_clockwise.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/offset_polygon:
Inflates or deflates polygon by delta units (pixels). If delta is
positive, makes the polygon grow outward. If delta is negative, shrinks
the polygon inward. Returns an array of polygons because
inflating/deflating may result in multiple discrete polygons. Returns an
empty array if delta is negative and the absolute value of it
approximately exceeds the...
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/offset_polyline:
Inflates or deflates polyline by delta units (pixels), producing
polygons. If delta is positive, makes the polyline grow outward. Returns
an array of polygons because inflating/deflating may result in multiple
discrete polygons. If delta is negative, returns an empty array. Each
polygon's vertices will be rounded as determined by join_type. Each...
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/point_is_inside_triang: Returns if point is inside the triangle specified by a, b and c.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/segment_intersects_cir:
Given the 2D segment (segment_from, segment_to), returns the position on
the segment (as a number between 0 and 1) at which the segment hits the
circle that is located at position circle_position and has radius
circle_radius. If the segment does not intersect the circle, -1 is
returned (this is also the case if the line extending the segment
would...
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/segment_intersects_seg:
Checks if two line segments intersect, with line a between from_a and
to_a and line b between from_b and to_b. If the line segments intersect,
the point of intersection is returned as a Vector2. If no intersection
takes place, null is returned.
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/triangulate_delaunay:
Triangulates the area specified by discrete set of points such that no
point is inside the circumcircle of any resulting triangle. Returns a
PackedInt32Array where each triangle consists of three consecutive point
indices into points (i.e. the returned array will have n * 3 elements,
with n being the number of found triangles). If the triangulation did...
descriptions.Geometry2D/method/triangulate_polygon:
Triangulates the polygon specified by the points in polygon. Returns a
PackedInt32Array where each triangle consists of three consecutive point
indices into polygon (i.e. the returned array will have n * 3 elements,
with n being the number of found triangles). Output triangles will
always be counter clockwise, and the contour will be flipped if it's...
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/build_box_planes:
Returns an array with 6 Planes that describe the sides of a box centered
at the origin. The box size is defined by extents, which represents one
(positive) corner of the box (i.e. half its actual size).
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/build_capsule_planes:
Returns an array of Planes closely bounding a faceted capsule centered
at the origin with radius radius and height height. The parameter sides
defines how many planes will be generated for the side part of the
capsule, whereas lats gives the number of latitudinal steps at the
bottom and top of the capsule. The parameter axis describes the axis
along...
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/build_cylinder_planes:
Returns an array of Planes closely bounding a faceted cylinder centered
at the origin with radius radius and height height. The parameter sides
defines how many planes will be generated for the round part of the
cylinder. The parameter axis describes the axis along which the cylinder
is oriented (0 for X, 1 for Y, 2 for Z).
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/clip_polygon:
Clips the polygon defined by the points in points against the plane and
returns the points of the clipped polygon.
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/compute_convex_mesh_po:
Calculates and returns all the vertex points of a convex shape defined
by an array of planes.
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/get_closest_point_to_s:
Returns the 3D point on the 3D segment (s1, s2) that is closest to
point. The returned point will always be inside the specified segment.

Returns the 3D point on the 3D line defined by (s1, s2) that is closest
to point. The returned point can be inside the segment (s1, s2) or
outside of it, i.e. somewhere on the line extending from the segment.
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/get_closest_points_bet:
Given the two 3D segments (p1, p2) and (q1, q2), finds those two points
on the two segments that are closest to each other. Returns a
PackedVector3Array that contains this point on (p1, p2) as well the
accompanying point on (q1, q2).
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/get_triangle_barycentr:
Returns a Vector3 containing weights based on how close a 3D position
(point) is to a triangle's different vertices (a, b and c). This is
useful for interpolating between the data of different vertices in a
triangle. One example use case is using this to smoothly rotate over a
mesh instead of relying solely on face normals. Here is a more
detailed...
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/ray_intersects_triangl:
Tests if the 3D ray starting at from with the direction of dir
intersects the triangle specified by a, b and c. If yes, returns the
point of intersection as Vector3. If no intersection takes place,
returns null.
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/segment_intersects_con:
Given a convex hull defined though the Planes in the array planes, tests
if the segment (from, to) intersects with that hull. If an intersection
is found, returns a PackedVector3Array containing the point the
intersection and the hull's normal. Otherwise, returns an empty array.
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/segment_intersects_cyl:
Checks if the segment (from, to) intersects the cylinder with height
height that is centered at the origin and has radius radius. If no,
returns an empty PackedVector3Array. If an intersection takes place, the
returned array contains the point of intersection and the cylinder's
normal at the point of intersection.
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/segment_intersects_sph:
Checks if the segment (from, to) intersects the sphere that is located
at sphere_position and has radius sphere_radius. If no, returns an empty
PackedVector3Array. If yes, returns a PackedVector3Array containing the
point of intersection and the sphere's normal at the point of
intersection.
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/segment_intersects_tri:
Tests if the segment (from, to) intersects the triangle a, b, c. If yes,
returns the point of intersection as Vector3. If no intersection takes
place, returns null.
descriptions.Geometry3D/method/tetrahedralize_delauna:
Tetrahedralizes the volume specified by a discrete set of points in 3D
space, ensuring that no point lies within the circumsphere of any
resulting tetrahedron. The method returns a PackedInt32Array where each
tetrahedron consists of four consecutive point indices into the points
array (resulting in an array with n * 4 elements, where n is the number
of...
descriptions.GeometryInstance3D/method/get_instance_s: Get the value of a shader parameter as set on this instance.
descriptions.GeometryInstance3D/method/set_instance_s:
Set the value of a shader uniform for this instance only (per-instance
uniform). See also ShaderMaterial.set_shader_parameter to assign a
uniform on all instances using the same ShaderMaterial. Note: For a
shader uniform to be assignable on a per-instance basis, it must be
defined with instance uniform ... rather than uniform ... in the shader
code....
descriptions.GodotInstance/method/focus_in: Notifies the instance that it is now in focus.
descriptions.GodotInstance/method/focus_out: Notifies the instance that it is now not in focus.
descriptions.GodotInstance/method/is_started: Returns true if this instance has been fully started.
descriptions.GodotInstance/method/iteration:
Runs a single iteration of the main loop. Returns true if the engine is
attempting to quit.
descriptions.GodotInstance/method/pause: Notifies the instance that it is going to be paused.
descriptions.GodotInstance/method/resume: Notifies the instance that it is being resumed.
descriptions.GodotInstance/method/start: Finishes this instance's startup sequence. Returns true on success.
descriptions.Gradient/method/add_point: Adds the specified color to the gradient, with the specified offset.
descriptions.Gradient/method/get_color: Returns the color of the gradient color at index point.
descriptions.Gradient/method/get_offset: Returns the offset of the gradient color at index point.
descriptions.Gradient/method/get_point_count: Returns the number of colors in the gradient.
descriptions.Gradient/method/remove_point: Removes the color at index point.
descriptions.Gradient/method/reverse:
Reverses/mirrors the gradient. Note: This method mirrors all points
around the middle of the gradient, which may produce unexpected results
when interpolation_mode is set to GRADIENT_INTERPOLATE_CONSTANT.
descriptions.Gradient/method/sample:
Returns the interpolated color specified by offset. offset should be
between 0.0 and 1.0 (inclusive). Using a value lower than 0.0 will
return the same color as 0.0, and using a value higher than 1.0 will
return the same color as 1.0. If your input value is not within this
range, consider using @GlobalScope.remap on the input value with output
values set...
descriptions.Gradient/method/set_color: Sets the color of the gradient color at index point.
descriptions.Gradient/method/set_offset: Sets the offset for the gradient color at index point.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/_get_connection_line:
Virtual method which can be overridden to customize how connections are
drawn.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/_is_in_input_hotzone:
Returns whether the mouse_position is in the input hot zone. By default,
a hot zone is a Rect2 positioned such that its center is at
in_node.GraphNode.get_input_port_position(in_port) (For output's case,
call GraphNode.get_output_port_position instead). The hot zone's width
is twice the Theme Property port_grab_distance_horizontal, and its
height is...
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/_is_in_output_hotzone:
Returns whether the mouse_position is in the output hot zone. For more
information on hot zones, see _is_in_input_hotzone. Below is a sample
code to help get started:
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/_is_node_hover_valid:
This virtual method can be used to insert additional error detection
while the user is dragging a connection over a valid port. Return true
if the connection is indeed valid or return false if the connection is
impossible. If the connection is impossible, no snapping to the port and
thus no connection request to that port will happen. In this example
a...
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/add_valid_connection_ty:
Allows the connection between two different port types. The port type is
defined individually for the left and the right port of each slot with
the GraphNode.set_slot method. See also is_valid_connection_type and
remove_valid_connection_type.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/add_valid_left_disconne:
Allows to disconnect nodes when dragging from the left port of the
GraphNode's slot if it has the specified type. See also
remove_valid_left_disconnect_type.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/add_valid_right_disconn:
Allows to disconnect nodes when dragging from the right port of the
GraphNode's slot if it has the specified type. See also
remove_valid_right_disconnect_type.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/arrange_nodes:
Rearranges selected nodes in a layout with minimum crossings between
connections and uniform horizontal and vertical gap between nodes.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/attach_graph_element_to: Attaches the element GraphElement to the frame GraphFrame.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/connect_node:
Create a connection between the from_port of the from_node GraphNode and
the to_port of the to_node GraphNode. If the connection already exists,
no connection is created. Connections with keep_alive set to false may
be deleted automatically if invalid during a redraw.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/detach_graph_element_fr:
Detaches the element GraphElement from the GraphFrame it is currently
attached to.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/disconnect_node:
Removes the connection between the from_port of the from_node GraphNode
and the to_port of the to_node GraphNode. If the connection does not
exist, no connection is removed.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/force_connection_drag_e:
Ends the creation of the current connection. In other words, if you are
dragging a connection you can use this method to abort the process and
remove the line that followed your cursor. This is best used together
with connection_drag_started and connection_drag_ended to add custom
behavior like node addition through shortcuts. Note: This method...
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/get_attached_nodes_of_f:
Returns an array of node names that are attached to the GraphFrame with
the given name.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/get_closest_connection_:
Returns the closest connection to the given point in screen space. If no
connection is found within max_distance pixels, an empty Dictionary is
returned. A connection is represented as a Dictionary in the form of:
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/get_connection_count: Returns the number of connections from from_port of from_node.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/get_connection_line:
Returns the points which would make up a connection between from_node
and to_node.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/get_connection_list_fro:
Returns an Array containing a list of all connections for node. A
connection is represented as a Dictionary in the form of:
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/get_connections_interse:
Returns an Array containing the list of connections that intersect with
the given Rect2. A connection is represented as a Dictionary in the form
of:
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/get_element_frame:
Returns the GraphFrame that contains the GraphElement with the given
name.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/get_menu_hbox:
Gets the HBoxContainer that contains the zooming and grid snap controls
in the top left of the graph. You can use this method to reposition the
toolbar or to add your own custom controls to it. Warning: This is a
required internal node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If
you wish to hide it or any of its children, use their
CanvasItem.visible...
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/is_node_connected:
Returns true if the from_port of the from_node GraphNode is connected to
the to_port of the to_node GraphNode.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/is_valid_connection_typ:
Returns whether it's possible to make a connection between two different
port types. The port type is defined individually for the left and the
right port of each slot with the GraphNode.set_slot method. See also
add_valid_connection_type and remove_valid_connection_type.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/remove_valid_connection:
Disallows the connection between two different port types previously
allowed by add_valid_connection_type. The port type is defined
individually for the left and the right port of each slot with the
GraphNode.set_slot method. See also is_valid_connection_type.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/remove_valid_left_disco:
Disallows to disconnect nodes when dragging from the left port of the
GraphNode's slot if it has the specified type. Use this to disable a
disconnection previously allowed with add_valid_left_disconnect_type.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/remove_valid_right_disc:
Disallows to disconnect nodes when dragging from the right port of the
GraphNode's slot if it has the specified type. Use this to disable a
disconnection previously allowed with add_valid_right_disconnect_type.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/set_connection_activity:
Sets the coloration of the connection between from_node's from_port and
to_node's to_port with the color provided in the activity theme
property. The color is linearly interpolated between the connection
color and the activity color using amount as weight.
descriptions.GraphEdit/method/set_selected: Sets the specified node as the one selected.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/begin_node_move: Emitted at the beginning of a GraphElement's movement.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/connection_drag_ended: Emitted at the end of a connection drag.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/connection_drag_started: Emitted at the beginning of a connection drag.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/connection_from_empty:
Emitted when user drags a connection from an input port into the empty
space of the graph.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/connection_request:
Emitted to the GraphEdit when the connection between the from_port of
the from_node GraphNode and the to_port of the to_node GraphNode is
attempted to be created.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/connection_to_empty:
Emitted when user drags a connection from an output port into the empty
space of the graph.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/copy_nodes_request:
Emitted when this GraphEdit captures a ui_copy action (Ctrl + C by
default). In general, this signal indicates that the selected
GraphElements should be copied.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/cut_nodes_request:
Emitted when this GraphEdit captures a ui_cut action (Ctrl + X by
default). In general, this signal indicates that the selected
GraphElements should be cut.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/delete_nodes_request:
Emitted when this GraphEdit captures a ui_graph_delete action (Delete by
default). nodes is an array of node names that should be removed. These
usually include all selected nodes.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/disconnection_request:
Emitted to the GraphEdit when the connection between from_port of
from_node GraphNode and to_port of to_node GraphNode is attempted to be
removed.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/duplicate_nodes_request:
Emitted when this GraphEdit captures a ui_graph_duplicate action (Ctrl +
D by default). In general, this signal indicates that the selected
GraphElements should be duplicated.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/end_node_move: Emitted at the end of a GraphElement's movement.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/frame_rect_changed: Emitted when the GraphFrame frame is resized to new_rect.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/graph_elements_linked_t:
Emitted when one or more GraphElements are dropped onto the GraphFrame
named frame, when they were not previously attached to any other one.
elements is an array of GraphElements to be attached.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/node_deselected: Emitted when the given GraphElement node is deselected.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/node_selected: Emitted when the given GraphElement node is selected.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/paste_nodes_request:
Emitted when this GraphEdit captures a ui_paste action (Ctrl + V by
default). In general, this signal indicates that previously copied
GraphElements should be pasted.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/popup_request:
Emitted when a popup is requested. Happens on right-clicking in the
GraphEdit. at_position is the position of the mouse pointer when the
signal is sent.
descriptions.GraphEdit/signal/scroll_offset_changed:
Emitted when the scroll offset is changed by the user. It will not be
emitted when changed in code.
descriptions.GraphElement/signal/delete_request: Emitted when removing the GraphElement is requested.
descriptions.GraphElement/signal/dragged: Emitted when the GraphElement is dragged.
descriptions.GraphElement/signal/node_deselected: Emitted when the GraphElement is deselected.
descriptions.GraphElement/signal/node_selected: Emitted when the GraphElement is selected.
descriptions.GraphElement/signal/position_offset_chan: Emitted when the GraphElement is moved.
descriptions.GraphElement/signal/raise_request:
Emitted when displaying the GraphElement over other ones is requested.
Happens on focusing (clicking into) the GraphElement.
descriptions.GraphElement/signal/resize_end:
Emitted when releasing the mouse button after dragging the resizer
handle (see resizable).
descriptions.GraphElement/signal/resize_request:
Emitted when resizing the GraphElement is requested. Happens on dragging
the resizer handle (see resizable).
descriptions.GraphFrame/method/get_titlebar_hbox:
Returns the HBoxContainer used for the title bar, only containing a
Label for displaying the title by default. This can be used to add
custom controls to the title bar such as option or close buttons.
descriptions.GraphFrame/signal/autoshrink_changed: Emitted when autoshrink_enabled or autoshrink_margin changes.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/clear_all_slots:
Disables all slots of the GraphNode. This will remove all input/output
ports from the GraphNode.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/clear_slot:
Disables the slot with the given slot_index. This will remove the
corresponding input and output port from the GraphNode.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_input_port_color: Returns the Color of the input port with the given port_idx.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_input_port_count: Returns the number of slots with an enabled input port.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_input_port_position: Returns the position of the input port with the given port_idx.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_input_port_slot:
Returns the corresponding slot index of the input port with the given
port_idx.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_input_port_type: Returns the type of the input port with the given port_idx.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_output_port_color: Returns the Color of the output port with the given port_idx.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_output_port_count: Returns the number of slots with an enabled output port.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_output_port_positio: Returns the position of the output port with the given port_idx.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_output_port_slot:
Returns the corresponding slot index of the output port with the given
port_idx.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_output_port_type: Returns the type of the output port with the given port_idx.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_slot_color_left: Returns the left (input) Color of the slot with the given slot_index.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_slot_color_right: Returns the right (output) Color of the slot with the given slot_index.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_slot_custom_icon_le:
Returns the left (input) custom Texture2D of the slot with the given
slot_index.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_slot_custom_icon_ri:
Returns the right (output) custom Texture2D of the slot with the given
slot_index.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_slot_metadata_left: Returns the left (input) metadata of the slot with the given slot_index.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_slot_metadata_right:
Returns the right (output) metadata of the slot with the given
slot_index.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_slot_type_left: Returns the left (input) type of the slot with the given slot_index.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_slot_type_right: Returns the right (output) type of the slot with the given slot_index.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/get_titlebar_hbox:
Returns the HBoxContainer used for the title bar, only containing a
Label for displaying the title by default. This can be used to add
custom controls to the title bar such as option or close buttons.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/is_slot_draw_stylebox:
Returns true if the background StyleBox of the slot with the given
slot_index is drawn.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/is_slot_enabled_left:
Returns true if left (input) side of the slot with the given slot_index
is enabled.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/is_slot_enabled_right:
Returns true if right (output) side of the slot with the given
slot_index is enabled.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/set_slot:
Sets properties of the slot with the given slot_index. If
enable_left_port/enable_right_port is true, a port will appear and the
slot will be able to be connected from this side. With
type_left/type_right an arbitrary type can be assigned to each port. Two
ports can be connected if they share the same type, or if the connection
between their types is...
descriptions.GraphNode/method/set_slot_color_left:
Sets the Color of the left (input) side of the slot with the given
slot_index to color.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/set_slot_color_right:
Sets the Color of the right (output) side of the slot with the given
slot_index to color.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/set_slot_custom_icon_le:
Sets the custom Texture2D of the left (input) side of the slot with the
given slot_index to custom_icon.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/set_slot_custom_icon_ri:
Sets the custom Texture2D of the right (output) side of the slot with
the given slot_index to custom_icon.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/set_slot_draw_stylebox: Toggles the background StyleBox of the slot with the given slot_index.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/set_slot_enabled_left:
Toggles the left (input) side of the slot with the given slot_index. If
enable is true, a port will appear on the left side and the slot will be
able to be connected from this side.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/set_slot_enabled_right:
Toggles the right (output) side of the slot with the given slot_index.
If enable is true, a port will appear on the right side and the slot
will be able to be connected from this side.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/set_slot_metadata_left:
Sets the custom metadata for the left (input) side of the slot with the
given slot_index to value.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/set_slot_metadata_right:
Sets the custom metadata for the right (output) side of the slot with
the given slot_index to value.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/set_slot_type_left:
Sets the left (input) type of the slot with the given slot_index to
type. If the value is negative, all connections will be disallowed to be
created via user inputs.
descriptions.GraphNode/method/set_slot_type_right:
Sets the right (output) type of the slot with the given slot_index to
type. If the value is negative, all connections will be disallowed to be
created via user inputs.
descriptions.GraphNode/signal/slot_sizes_changed: Emitted when any slot's size might have changed.
descriptions.GraphNode/signal/slot_updated: Emitted when any GraphNode's slot is updated.
descriptions.GridMap/method/clear_baked_meshes: Clears all baked meshes. See make_baked_meshes.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_bake_mesh_instance: Returns RID of a baked mesh with the given idx.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_bake_meshes:
Returns an array of ArrayMeshes and Transform3D references of all bake
meshes that exist within the current GridMap. Even indices contain
ArrayMeshes, while odd indices contain Transform3Ds that are always
equal to Transform3D.IDENTITY. This method relies on the output of
make_baked_meshes, which will be called with gen_lightmap_uv set to true
and...
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_basis_with_orthogonal:
Returns one of 24 possible rotations that lie along the vectors (x,y,z)
with each component being either -1, 0, or 1. For further details, refer
to the Godot source code.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_cell_item:
The MeshLibrary item index located at the given grid coordinates. If the
cell is empty, INVALID_CELL_ITEM will be returned.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_cell_item_basis: Returns the basis that gives the specified cell its orientation.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_cell_item_orientation:
The orientation of the cell at the given grid coordinates. -1 is
returned if the cell is empty.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_collision_layer_value:
Returns whether or not the specified layer of the collision_layer is
enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_collision_mask_value:
Returns whether or not the specified layer of the collision_mask is
enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_meshes:
Returns an array of Transform3D and Mesh references corresponding to the
non-empty cells in the grid. The transforms are specified in local
space. Even indices contain Transform3Ds, while odd indices contain
Meshes related to the Transform3D in the index preceding it.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_navigation_map:
Returns the RID of the navigation map this GridMap node uses for its
cell baked navigation meshes. This function returns always the map set
on the GridMap node and not the map on the NavigationServer. If the map
is changed directly with the NavigationServer API the GridMap node will
not be aware of the map change.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_octant_coords_from_ce:
Returns the Vector3i octant coordinates of the octant that the cell at
cell_coords belongs to.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_octants_in_bounds:
Returns an array of Vector3i octant coordinates that are inside the
given bounds, including octants that have no cells in use.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_orthogonal_index_from:
This function considers a discretization of rotations into 24 points on
unit sphere, lying along the vectors (x,y,z) with each component being
either -1, 0, or 1, and returns the index (in the range from 0 to 23) of
the point best representing the orientation of the object. For further
details, refer to the Godot source code.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_used_cells:
Returns an array of Vector3 with the non-empty cell coordinates in the
grid map.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_used_cells_by_item:
Returns an array of all cells with the given item index specified in
item.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_used_cells_in_octant:
Returns an array of Vector3is with the cell coordinates of non-empty
cells inside the octant at octant_coords.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_used_cells_in_octant_:
Returns an array of Vector3is with the cell coordinates of cells inside
the octant at octant_coords that use the specified cell item.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_used_octants:
Returns an array of Vector3is with the octant coordinates of the
non-empty octants in the grid map.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_used_octants_by_item:
Returns an array of Vector3is with the octant coordinates of the octants
that use the specified item in the grid map.
descriptions.GridMap/method/get_used_octants_in_bound:
Returns an array of Vector3is with the octant coordinates of non-empty
octants that are inside the local bounds.
descriptions.GridMap/method/local_to_map:
Returns the map coordinates of the cell containing the given
local_position. If local_position is in global coordinates, consider
using Node3D.to_local before passing it to this method. See also
map_to_local.
descriptions.GridMap/method/make_baked_meshes:
Generates a baked mesh that represents all meshes in the assigned
MeshLibrary for use with LightmapGI. If gen_lightmap_uv is true, UV2
data will be generated for each mesh currently used in the GridMap.
Otherwise, only meshes that already have UV2 data present will be able
to use baked lightmaps. When generating UV2, lightmap_uv_texel_size
controls the...
descriptions.GridMap/method/map_to_local:
Returns the position of a grid cell in the GridMap's local coordinate
space. To convert the returned value into global coordinates, use
Node3D.to_global. See also local_to_map.
descriptions.GridMap/method/set_cell_item:
Sets the mesh index for the cell referenced by its grid coordinates. A
negative item index such as INVALID_CELL_ITEM will clear the cell.
Optionally, the item's orientation can be passed. For valid orientation
values, see get_orthogonal_index_from_basis.
descriptions.GridMap/method/set_collision_layer_value:
Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the
collision_layer, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.GridMap/method/set_collision_mask_value:
Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the
collision_mask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.GridMap/method/set_navigation_map:
Sets the RID of the navigation map this GridMap node should use for its
cell baked navigation meshes.
descriptions.GridMap/signal/changed: Emitted when the MeshLibrary of this GridMap changes.
descriptions.HMACContext/method/finish:
Returns the resulting HMAC. If the HMAC failed, an empty PackedByteArray
is returned.
descriptions.HMACContext/method/start:
Initializes the HMACContext. This method cannot be called again on the
same HMACContext until finish has been called.
descriptions.HMACContext/method/update:
Updates the message to be HMACed. This can be called multiple times
before finish is called to append data to the message, but cannot be
called until start has been called.
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/close: Closes the current connection, allowing reuse of this HTTPClient.
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/connect_to_host:
Connects to a host. This needs to be done before any requests are sent.
If no port is specified (or -1 is used), it is automatically set to 80
for HTTP and 443 for HTTPS. You can pass the optional tls_options
parameter to customize the trusted certification authorities, or the
common name verification when using HTTPS. See TLSOptions.client and...
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/get_response_body_leng:
Returns the response's body length. Note: Some Web servers may not send
a body length. In this case, the value returned will be -1. If using
chunked transfer encoding, the body length will also be -1. Note: This
function always returns -1 on the Web platform due to browsers
limitations.
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/get_response_code: Returns the response's HTTP status code.
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/get_response_headers_a:
Returns all response headers as a Dictionary. Each entry is composed by
the header name, and a String containing the values separated by "; ".
The casing is kept the same as the headers were received.
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/get_status:
Returns a Status constant. Need to call poll in order to get status
updates.
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/has_response: If true, this HTTPClient has a response available.
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/is_response_chunked: If true, this HTTPClient has a response that is chunked.
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/poll:
This needs to be called in order to have any request processed. Check
results with get_status.
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/query_string_from_dict:
Generates a GET/POST application/x-www-form-urlencoded style query
string from a provided dictionary, e.g.:
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/read_response_body_chu: Reads one chunk from the response.
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/request:
Sends an HTTP request to the connected host with the given method. The
URL parameter is usually just the part after the host, so for
https://example.com/index.php, it is /index.php. When sending requests
to an HTTP proxy server, it should be an absolute URL. For
HTTPClient.METHOD_OPTIONS requests, * is also allowed. For
HTTPClient.METHOD_CONNECT...
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/request_raw:
Sends a raw HTTP request to the connected host with the given method.
The URL parameter is usually just the part after the host, so for
https://example.com/index.php, it is /index.php. When sending requests
to an HTTP proxy server, it should be an absolute URL. For
HTTPClient.METHOD_OPTIONS requests, * is also allowed. For
HTTPClient.METHOD_CONNECT...
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/set_http_proxy:
Sets the proxy server for HTTP requests. The proxy server is unset if
host is empty or port is -1.
descriptions.HTTPClient/method/set_https_proxy:
Sets the proxy server for HTTPS requests. The proxy server is unset if
host is empty or port is -1.
descriptions.HTTPRequest/method/get_body_size:
Returns the response body length. Note: Some Web servers may not send a
body length. In this case, the value returned will be -1. If using
chunked transfer encoding, the body length will also be -1.
descriptions.HTTPRequest/method/get_downloaded_bytes: Returns the number of bytes this HTTPRequest downloaded.
descriptions.HTTPRequest/method/get_http_client_statu: Returns the current status of the underlying HTTPClient.
descriptions.HTTPRequest/method/request:
Creates request on the underlying HTTPClient. If there is no
configuration errors, it tries to connect using
HTTPClient.connect_to_host and passes parameters onto
HTTPClient.request. Returns OK if request is successfully created. (Does
not imply that the server has responded), ERR_UNCONFIGURED if not in the
tree, ERR_BUSY if still processing previous...
descriptions.HTTPRequest/method/request_raw:
Creates request on the underlying HTTPClient using a raw array of bytes
for the request body. If there is no configuration errors, it tries to
connect using HTTPClient.connect_to_host and passes parameters onto
HTTPClient.request. Returns OK if request is successfully created. (Does
not imply that the server has responded), ERR_UNCONFIGURED if not in
the...
descriptions.HTTPRequest/method/set_http_proxy:
Sets the proxy server for HTTP requests. The proxy server is unset if
host is empty or port is -1.
descriptions.HTTPRequest/method/set_https_proxy:
Sets the proxy server for HTTPS requests. The proxy server is unset if
host is empty or port is -1.
descriptions.HTTPRequest/method/set_tls_options:
Sets the TLSOptions to be used when connecting to an HTTPS server. See
TLSOptions.client.
descriptions.HTTPRequest/signal/request_completed: Emitted when a request is completed.
descriptions.HashingContext/method/finish: Closes the current context, and return the computed hash.
descriptions.HashingContext/method/start:
Starts a new hash computation of the given type (e.g. HASH_SHA256 to
start computation of an SHA-256).
descriptions.HashingContext/method/update: Updates the computation with the given chunk of data.
descriptions.HeightMapShape3D/method/get_max_height:
Returns the largest height value found in map_data. Recalculates only
when map_data changes.
descriptions.HeightMapShape3D/method/get_min_height:
Returns the smallest height value found in map_data. Recalculates only
when map_data changes.
descriptions.HeightMapShape3D/method/update_map_data_:
Updates map_data with data read from an Image reference. Automatically
resizes heightmap map_width and map_depth to fit the full image width
and height. The image needs to be in either Image.FORMAT_RF (32 bit),
Image.FORMAT_RH (16 bit), or Image.FORMAT_R8 (8 bit). Each image pixel
is read in as a float on the range from 0.0 (black pixel) to 1.0
(white...
descriptions.HingeJoint3D/method/get_flag: Returns the value of the specified flag.
descriptions.HingeJoint3D/method/get_param: Returns the value of the specified parameter.
descriptions.HingeJoint3D/method/set_flag: If true, enables the specified flag.
descriptions.HingeJoint3D/method/set_param: Sets the value of the specified parameter.
descriptions.IKModifier3D/method/reset: Resets a state with respect to the current bone pose.
descriptions.IP/method/clear_cache:
Removes all of a hostname's cached references. If no hostname is given,
all cached IP addresses are removed.
descriptions.IP/method/erase_resolve_item:
Removes a given item id from the queue. This should be used to free a
queue after it has completed to enable more queries to happen.
descriptions.IP/method/get_local_addresses: Returns all the user's current IPv4 and IPv6 addresses as an array.
descriptions.IP/method/get_local_interfaces:
Returns all network adapters as an array. Each adapter is a dictionary
of the form:
descriptions.IP/method/get_resolve_item_address:
Returns a queued hostname's IP address, given its queue id. Returns an
empty string on error or if resolution hasn't happened yet (see
get_resolve_item_status).
descriptions.IP/method/get_resolve_item_addresses:
Returns resolved addresses, or an empty array if an error happened or
resolution didn't happen yet (see get_resolve_item_status).
descriptions.IP/method/get_resolve_item_status:
Returns a queued hostname's status as a ResolverStatus constant, given
its queue id.
descriptions.IP/method/resolve_hostname:
Returns a given hostname's IPv4 or IPv6 address when resolved
(blocking-type method). The address type returned depends on the Type
constant given as ip_type.
descriptions.IP/method/resolve_hostname_addresses:
Resolves a given hostname in a blocking way. Addresses are returned as
an Array of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses depending on ip_type.
descriptions.IP/method/resolve_hostname_queue_item:
Creates a queue item to resolve a hostname to an IPv4 or IPv6 address
depending on the Type constant given as ip_type. Returns the queue ID if
successful, or RESOLVER_INVALID_ID on error.
descriptions.Image/method/adjust_bcs:
Adjusts this image's brightness, contrast, and saturation by the given
values. Does not work if the image is compressed (see is_compressed).
descriptions.Image/method/blend_rect:
Alpha-blends src_rect from src image to this image at coordinates dst,
clipped accordingly to both image bounds. This image and src image must
have the same format. src_rect with non-positive size is treated as
empty.
descriptions.Image/method/blend_rect_mask:
Alpha-blends src_rect from src image to this image using mask image at
coordinates dst, clipped accordingly to both image bounds. Alpha
channels are required for both src and mask. dst pixels and src pixels
will blend if the corresponding mask pixel's alpha value is not 0. This
image and src image must have the same format. src image and mask image
must...
descriptions.Image/method/blit_rect:
Copies src_rect from src image to this image at coordinates dst, clipped
accordingly to both image bounds. This image and src image must have the
same format. src_rect with non-positive size is treated as empty. Note:
The alpha channel data in src will overwrite the corresponding data in
this image at the target position. To blend alpha channels, use...
descriptions.Image/method/blit_rect_mask:
Blits src_rect area from src image to this image at the coordinates
given by dst, clipped accordingly to both image bounds. src pixel is
copied onto dst if the corresponding mask pixel's alpha value is not 0.
This image and src image must have the same format. src image and mask
image must have the same size (width and height) but they can have
different...
descriptions.Image/method/bump_map_to_normal_map:
Converts a bump map to a normal map. A bump map provides a height offset
per-pixel, while a normal map provides a normal direction per pixel.
descriptions.Image/method/compress:
Compresses the image with a VRAM-compressed format to use less memory.
Can not directly access pixel data while the image is compressed.
Returns error if the chosen compression mode is not available. The
source parameter helps to pick the best compression method for DXT and
ETC2 formats. It is ignored for ASTC compression. The astc_format
parameter is...
descriptions.Image/method/compress_from_channels:
Compresses the image with a VRAM-compressed format to use less memory.
Can not directly access pixel data while the image is compressed.
Returns error if the chosen compression mode is not available. This is
an alternative to compress that lets the user supply the channels used
in order for the compressor to pick the best DXT and ETC2 formats. For
other...
descriptions.Image/method/compute_image_metrics:
Compute image metrics on the current image and the compared image. This
can be used to calculate the similarity between two images. The
dictionary contains max, mean, mean_squared, root_mean_squared and
peak_snr.
descriptions.Image/method/convert: Converts this image's format to the given format.
descriptions.Image/method/copy_from: Copies src image to this image.
descriptions.Image/method/create:
Creates an empty image of the given size and format. If use_mipmaps is
true, generates mipmaps for this image (see generate_mipmaps).
descriptions.Image/method/create_empty:
Creates an empty image of the given size and format. If use_mipmaps is
true, generates mipmaps for this image (see generate_mipmaps).
descriptions.Image/method/create_from_data:
Creates a new image of the given size and format. Fills the image with
the given raw data. If use_mipmaps is true, loads the mipmaps for this
image from data. See generate_mipmaps.
descriptions.Image/method/crop:
Crops the image to the given width and height. If the specified size is
larger than the current size, the extra area is filled with black
pixels.
descriptions.Image/method/decompress:
Decompresses the image if it is VRAM-compressed in a supported format.
This increases memory utilization, but allows modifying the image.
Returns OK if the format is supported, otherwise ERR_UNAVAILABLE. All
VRAM-compressed formats supported by Godot can be decompressed with this
method, except FORMAT_ETC2_R11S, FORMAT_ETC2_RG11S, and
FORMAT_ETC2_RGB8A1.
descriptions.Image/method/detect_alpha:
Returns ALPHA_BLEND if the image has data for alpha values. Returns
ALPHA_BIT if all the alpha values are stored in a single bit. Returns
ALPHA_NONE if no data for alpha values is found.
descriptions.Image/method/detect_used_channels:
Returns the color channels used by this image. If the image is
compressed, the original source must be specified.
descriptions.Image/method/fix_alpha_edges: Blends low-alpha pixels with nearby pixels.
descriptions.Image/method/generate_mipmaps:
Generates mipmaps for the image. Mipmaps are precalculated
lower-resolution copies of the image that are automatically used if the
image needs to be scaled down when rendered. They help improve image
quality and performance when rendering. This method returns an error if
the image is compressed, in a custom format, or if the image's
width/height is 0....
descriptions.Image/method/get_data: Returns a copy of the image's raw data.
descriptions.Image/method/get_data_size: Returns size (in bytes) of the image's raw data.
descriptions.Image/method/get_mipmap_count:
Returns the number of mipmap levels or 0 if the image has no mipmaps.
The largest main level image is not counted as a mipmap level by this
method, so if you want to include it you can add 1 to this count.
descriptions.Image/method/get_mipmap_offset:
Returns the offset where the image's mipmap with index mipmap is stored
in the data dictionary.
descriptions.Image/method/get_pixel:
Returns the color of the pixel at (x, y). This is the same as
get_pixelv, but with two integer arguments instead of a Vector2i
argument.
descriptions.Image/method/get_pixelv:
Returns the color of the pixel at point. This is the same as get_pixel,
but with a Vector2i argument instead of two integer arguments.
descriptions.Image/method/get_region:
Returns a new Image that is a copy of this Image's area specified with
region.
descriptions.Image/method/get_size: Returns the image's size (width and height).
descriptions.Image/method/get_used_rect:
Returns a Rect2i enclosing the visible portion of the image, considering
each pixel with a non-zero alpha channel as visible.
descriptions.Image/method/has_mipmaps: Returns true if the image has generated mipmaps.
descriptions.Image/method/is_compressed: Returns true if the image is compressed.
descriptions.Image/method/is_empty: Returns true if the image has no data.
descriptions.Image/method/is_invisible:
Returns true if all the image's pixels have an alpha value of 0. Returns
false if any pixel has an alpha value higher than 0.
descriptions.Image/method/linear_to_srgb:
Converts the entire image from linear encoding to nonlinear sRGB
encoding by using a lookup table. Only works on images with FORMAT_RGB8
or FORMAT_RGBA8 formats.
descriptions.Image/method/load:
Loads an image from file path. See Supported image formats for a list of
supported image formats and limitations. Warning: This method should
only be used in the editor or in cases when you need to load external
images at run-time, such as images located at the user:// directory, and
may not work in exported projects. See also ImageTexture description...
descriptions.Image/method/load_bmp_from_buffer:
Loads an image from the binary contents of a BMP file. Note: Godot's BMP
module doesn't support 16-bit per pixel images. Only 1-bit, 4-bit,
8-bit, 24-bit, and 32-bit per pixel images are supported. Note: This
method is only available in engine builds with the BMP module enabled.
By default, the BMP module is enabled, but it can be disabled at
build-time...
descriptions.Image/method/load_dds_from_buffer:
Loads an image from the binary contents of a DDS file. Note: This method
is only available in engine builds with the DDS module enabled. By
default, the DDS module is enabled, but it can be disabled at build-time
using the module_dds_enabled=no SCons option.
descriptions.Image/method/load_exr_from_buffer: Loads an image from the binary contents of an OpenEXR file.
descriptions.Image/method/load_from_file: Creates a new Image and loads data from the specified file.
descriptions.Image/method/load_jpg_from_buffer: Loads an image from the binary contents of a JPEG file.
descriptions.Image/method/load_ktx_from_buffer:
Loads an image from the binary contents of a KTX file. Unlike most image
formats, KTX can store VRAM-compressed data and embed mipmaps. Note:
Godot's libktx implementation only supports 2D images. Cubemaps, texture
arrays, and de-padding are not supported. Note: This method is only
available in engine builds with the KTX module enabled. By default,
the...
descriptions.Image/method/load_png_from_buffer: Loads an image from the binary contents of a PNG file.
descriptions.Image/method/load_svg_from_buffer:
Loads an image from the UTF-8 binary contents of an uncompressed SVG
file (.svg). Note: Beware when using compressed SVG files (like .svgz),
they need to be decompressed before loading. Note: This method is only
available in engine builds with the SVG module enabled. By default, the
SVG module is enabled, but it can be disabled at build-time using the...
descriptions.Image/method/load_svg_from_string:
Loads an image from the string contents of an SVG file (.svg). Note:
This method is only available in engine builds with the SVG module
enabled. By default, the SVG module is enabled, but it can be disabled
at build-time using the module_svg_enabled=no SCons option.
descriptions.Image/method/load_tga_from_buffer:
Loads an image from the binary contents of a TGA file. Note: This method
is only available in engine builds with the TGA module enabled. By
default, the TGA module is enabled, but it can be disabled at build-time
using the module_tga_enabled=no SCons option.
descriptions.Image/method/load_webp_from_buffer: Loads an image from the binary contents of a WebP file.
descriptions.Image/method/normal_map_to_xy:
Converts the image's data to represent coordinates on a 3D plane. This
is used when the image represents a normal map. A normal map can add
lots of detail to a 3D surface without increasing the polygon count.
descriptions.Image/method/premultiply_alpha:
Multiplies color values with alpha values. Resulting color values for a
pixel are (color * alpha)/256. See also CanvasItemMaterial.blend_mode.
descriptions.Image/method/resize:
Resizes the image to the given width and height. New pixels are
calculated using the interpolation mode defined via Interpolation
constants. Note: If the image's format is FORMAT_RGBA4444,
FORMAT_RGB565, or FORMAT_RGBE9995, it will be temporarily converted to
either FORMAT_RGBA8 or FORMAT_RGBAH. This can affect the quality of the
resized image.
descriptions.Image/method/resize_to_po2:
Resizes the image to the nearest power of 2 for the width and height. If
square is true, sets width and height to be the same. New pixels are
calculated using the interpolation mode defined via Interpolation
constants.
descriptions.Image/method/rgbe_to_srgb:
Converts a standard linear RGBE (Red Green Blue Exponent) image to an
image that uses nonlinear sRGB encoding.
descriptions.Image/method/rotate_180:
Rotates the image by 180 degrees. The width and height of the image must
be greater than 1.
descriptions.Image/method/rotate_90:
Rotates the image in the specified direction by 90 degrees. The width
and height of the image must be greater than 1. If the width and height
are not equal, the image will be resized.
descriptions.Image/method/save_dds:
Saves the image as a DDS (DirectDraw Surface) file to path. DDS is a
container format that can store textures in various compression formats,
such as DXT1, DXT5, or BC7. This function will return ERR_UNAVAILABLE if
Godot was compiled without the DDS module. Note: The DDS module may be
disabled in certain builds, which means save_dds will return...
descriptions.Image/method/save_dds_to_buffer:
Saves the image as a DDS (DirectDraw Surface) file to a byte array. DDS
is a container format that can store textures in various compression
formats, such as DXT1, DXT5, or BC7. This function will return an empty
byte array if Godot was compiled without the DDS module. Note: The DDS
module may be disabled in certain builds, which means
save_dds_to_buffer...
descriptions.Image/method/save_exr:
Saves the image as an EXR file to path. If grayscale is true and the
image has only one channel, it will be saved explicitly as monochrome
rather than one red channel. Set color_image to true when saving a color
image, such as a screenshot. Negative values will be included when
color_image is false, which may be useful for saving raw floating point
data...
descriptions.Image/method/save_exr_to_buffer:
Saves the image as an EXR file to a byte array. If grayscale is true and
the image has only one channel, it will be saved explicitly as
monochrome rather than one red channel. Set color_image to true when
saving a color image, such as a screenshot. Negative values will be
included when color_image is false, which may be useful for saving raw
floating...
descriptions.Image/method/save_jpg:
Saves the image as a JPEG file to path with the specified quality
between 0.01 and 1.0 (inclusive). Higher quality values result in
better-looking output at the cost of larger file sizes. Recommended
quality values are between 0.75 and 0.90. Even at quality 1.00, JPEG
compression remains lossy. Note: JPEG does not save an alpha channel. If
the Image...
descriptions.Image/method/save_jpg_to_buffer:
Saves the image as a JPEG file to a byte array with the specified
quality between 0.01 and 1.0 (inclusive). Higher quality values result
in better-looking output at the cost of larger byte array sizes (and
therefore memory usage). Recommended quality values are between 0.75 and
0.90. Even at quality 1.00, JPEG compression remains lossy. Note: JPEG
does...
descriptions.Image/method/save_png: Saves the image as a PNG file to the file at path.
descriptions.Image/method/save_png_to_buffer: Saves the image as a PNG file to a byte array.
descriptions.Image/method/save_webp:
Saves the image as a WebP (Web Picture) file to the file at path. By
default it will save lossless. If lossy is true, the image will be saved
lossy, using the quality setting between 0.0 and 1.0 (inclusive).
Lossless WebP offers more efficient compression than PNG. Note: The WebP
format is limited to a size of 16383×16383 pixels, while PNG can save...
descriptions.Image/method/save_webp_to_buffer:
Saves the image as a WebP (Web Picture) file to a byte array. By default
it will save lossless. If lossy is true, the image will be saved lossy,
using the quality setting between 0.0 and 1.0 (inclusive). Lossless WebP
offers more efficient compression than PNG. Note: The WebP format is
limited to a size of 16383×16383 pixels, while PNG can save larger...
descriptions.Image/method/set_data:
Overwrites data of an existing Image. Non-static equivalent of
create_from_data.
descriptions.Image/method/set_pixel: Sets the Color of the pixel at (x, y) to color.
descriptions.Image/method/set_pixelv: Sets the Color of the pixel at point to color.
descriptions.Image/method/shrink_x2:
Shrinks the image by a factor of 2 on each axis (this divides the pixel
count by 4).
descriptions.Image/method/srgb_to_linear:
Converts the raw data from nonlinear sRGB encoding to linear encoding
using a lookup table. Only works on images with FORMAT_RGB8 or
FORMAT_RGBA8 formats. Note: The 8-bit formats required by this method
are not suitable for storing linearly encoded values; a significant
amount of color information will be lost in darker values. To maintain
image quality,...
descriptions.ImageFormatLoaderExtension/method/_get_r:
Returns the list of file extensions for this image format. Files with
the given extensions will be treated as image file and loaded using this
class.
descriptions.ImageFormatLoaderExtension/method/_load_: Loads the content of fileaccess into the provided image.
descriptions.ImageFormatLoaderExtension/method/add_fo:
Add this format loader to the engine, allowing it to recognize the file
extensions returned by _get_recognized_extensions.
descriptions.ImageFormatLoaderExtension/method/remove: Remove this format loader from the engine.
descriptions.ImageTexture/method/create_from_image:
Creates a new ImageTexture and initializes it by allocating and setting
the data from an Image.
descriptions.ImageTexture/method/set_image:
Replaces the texture's data with a new Image. This will re-allocate new
memory for the texture. If you want to update the image, but don't need
to change its parameters (format, size), use update instead for better
performance.
