Internally, this uses the same encoding mechanism as the
@GlobalScope.var_to_bytes method.
descriptions.MatchInventory/method/pick_up:
Request pickup of the stable world item ID. Await the result to receive
an InventoryResult. The authority checks eligibility, finds space, and
commits placement and consumption together. A stale backpack or an
unavailable source returns a failure result.
descriptions.Material/method/_can_do_next_pass:
Only exposed for the purpose of overriding. You cannot call this
function directly. Used internally to determine if next_pass should be
shown in the editor or not.
descriptions.Material/method/_can_use_render_priority:
Only exposed for the purpose of overriding. You cannot call this
function directly. Used internally to determine if render_priority
should be shown in the editor or not.
descriptions.Material/method/_get_shader_mode:
Only exposed for the purpose of overriding. You cannot call this
function directly. Used internally by various editor tools.
descriptions.Material/method/_get_shader_rid:
Only exposed for the purpose of overriding. You cannot call this
function directly. Used internally by various editor tools. Used to
access the RID of the Material's Shader.
descriptions.Material/method/create_placeholder: Creates a placeholder version of this resource (PlaceholderMaterial).
descriptions.Material/method/inspect_native_shader_co:
Only available when running in the editor. Opens a popup that visualizes
the generated shader code, including all variants and internal shader
code. See also Shader.inspect_native_shader_code.
descriptions.MenuBar/method/get_menu_popup: Returns PopupMenu associated with menu item.
descriptions.MenuBar/method/is_menu_disabled: Returns true if the menu item is disabled.
descriptions.MenuBar/method/is_menu_hidden: Returns true if the menu item is hidden.
descriptions.MenuBar/method/is_native_menu:
Returns true if the current system's global menu is supported and used
by this MenuBar.
descriptions.MenuBar/method/set_disable_shortcuts:
If true, shortcuts are disabled and cannot be used to trigger the
button.
descriptions.MenuBar/method/set_menu_disabled: If true, menu item is disabled.
descriptions.MenuBar/method/set_menu_hidden: If true, menu item is hidden.
descriptions.MenuButton/method/get_popup:
Returns the PopupMenu contained in this button. Warning: This is a
required internal node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If
you wish to hide it or any of its children, use their Window.visible
property.
descriptions.MenuButton/method/set_disable_shortcuts:
If true, shortcuts are disabled and cannot be used to trigger the
button.
descriptions.MenuButton/method/show_popup:
Adjusts popup position and sizing for the MenuButton, then shows the
PopupMenu. Prefer this over using get_popup().popup().
descriptions.MenuButton/signal/about_to_popup: Emitted when the PopupMenu of this MenuButton is about to show.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_get_aabb: Virtual method to override the AABB for a custom class extending Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_get_blend_shape_count:
Virtual method to override the number of blend shapes for a custom class
extending Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_get_blend_shape_name:
Virtual method to override the retrieval of blend shape names for a
custom class extending Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_get_surface_count:
Virtual method to override the surface count for a custom class
extending Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_set_blend_shape_name:
Virtual method to override the names of blend shapes for a custom class
extending Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_surface_get_array_index_len:
Virtual method to override the surface array index length for a custom
class extending Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_surface_get_array_len:
Virtual method to override the surface array length for a custom class
extending Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_surface_get_arrays:
Virtual method to override the surface arrays for a custom class
extending Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_surface_get_blend_shape_arr:
Virtual method to override the blend shape arrays for a custom class
extending Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_surface_get_format:
Virtual method to override the surface format for a custom class
extending Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_surface_get_lods:
Virtual method to override the surface LODs for a custom class extending
Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_surface_get_material:
Virtual method to override the surface material for a custom class
extending Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_surface_get_primitive_type:
Virtual method to override the surface primitive type for a custom class
extending Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/_surface_set_material:
Virtual method to override the setting of a material at the given index
for a custom class extending Mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/create_convex_shape:
Calculate a ConvexPolygonShape3D from the mesh. If clean is true
(default), duplicate and interior vertices are removed automatically.
You can set it to false to make the process faster if not needed. If
simplify is true, the geometry can be further simplified to reduce the
number of vertices. Disabled by default.
descriptions.Mesh/method/create_outline:
Calculate an outline mesh at a defined offset (margin) from the original
mesh. Note: This method typically returns the vertices in reverse order
(e.g. clockwise to counterclockwise).
descriptions.Mesh/method/create_placeholder: Creates a placeholder version of this resource (PlaceholderMesh).
descriptions.Mesh/method/create_trimesh_shape: Calculate a ConcavePolygonShape3D from the mesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/generate_triangle_mesh:
Generate a TriangleMesh from the mesh. Considers only surfaces using one
of these primitive types: PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLE_STRIP.
descriptions.Mesh/method/get_aabb:
Returns the smallest AABB enclosing this mesh in local space. Not
affected by custom_aabb. Note: This is only implemented for ArrayMesh
and PrimitiveMesh.
descriptions.Mesh/method/get_faces:
Returns all the vertices that make up the faces of the mesh. Each three
vertices represent one triangle.
descriptions.Mesh/method/get_surface_count:
Returns the number of surfaces that the Mesh holds. This is equivalent
to MeshInstance3D.get_surface_override_material_count.
descriptions.Mesh/method/surface_get_arrays:
Returns the arrays for the vertices, normals, UVs, etc. that make up the
requested surface (see ArrayMesh.add_surface_from_arrays).
descriptions.Mesh/method/surface_get_blend_shape_arra: Returns the blend shape arrays for the requested surface.
descriptions.Mesh/method/surface_get_material:
Returns a Material in a given surface. Surface is rendered using this
material. Note: This returns the material within the Mesh resource, not
the Material associated to the MeshInstance3D's Surface Material
Override properties. To get the Material associated to the
MeshInstance3D's Surface Material Override properties, use...
descriptions.Mesh/method/surface_set_material:
Sets a Material for a given surface. Surface will be rendered using this
material. Note: This assigns the material within the Mesh resource, not
the Material associated to the MeshInstance3D's Surface Material
Override properties. To set the Material associated to the
MeshInstance3D's Surface Material Override properties, use...
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/clear: Clears all data currently in MeshDataTool.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/commit_to_surface: Adds a new surface to specified Mesh with edited data.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/create_from_surface:
Uses specified surface of given Mesh to populate data for MeshDataTool.
Requires Mesh with primitive type Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_edge_count: Returns the number of edges in this Mesh.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_edge_faces: Returns array of faces that touch given edge.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_edge_meta: Returns meta information assigned to given edge.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_edge_vertex:
Returns the index of the specified vertex connected to the edge at index
idx. vertex can only be 0 or 1, as edges are composed of two vertices.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_face_count: Returns the number of faces in this Mesh.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_face_edge:
Returns the edge associated with the face at index idx. edge argument
must be either 0, 1, or 2 because a face only has three edges.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_face_meta: Returns the metadata associated with the given face.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_face_normal: Calculates and returns the face normal of the given face.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_face_vertex:
Returns the specified vertex index of the given face. vertex must be
either 0, 1, or 2 because faces contain three vertices.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_format:
Returns the Mesh's format as a combination of the Mesh.ArrayFormat
flags. For example, a mesh containing both vertices and normals would
return a format of 3 because Mesh.ARRAY_FORMAT_VERTEX is 1 and
Mesh.ARRAY_FORMAT_NORMAL is 2.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_material: Returns the material assigned to the Mesh.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_vertex: Returns the position of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_vertex_bones: Returns the bones of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_vertex_color: Returns the color of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_vertex_count: Returns the total number of vertices in Mesh.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_vertex_edges: Returns an array of edges that share the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_vertex_faces: Returns an array of faces that share the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_vertex_meta: Returns the metadata associated with the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_vertex_normal: Returns the normal of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_vertex_tangent: Returns the tangent of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_vertex_uv: Returns the UV of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_vertex_uv2: Returns the UV2 of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/get_vertex_weights: Returns bone weights of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/set_edge_meta: Sets the metadata of the given edge.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/set_face_meta: Sets the metadata of the given face.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/set_material: Sets the material to be used by newly-constructed Mesh.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/set_vertex: Sets the position of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/set_vertex_bones: Sets the bones of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/set_vertex_color: Sets the color of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/set_vertex_meta: Sets the metadata associated with the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/set_vertex_normal: Sets the normal of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/set_vertex_tangent:
Sets the tangent of the given vertex. Note: Even though tangent is a
Plane, it does not directly represent the tangent plane. Its Plane.x,
Plane.y, and Plane.z represent the tangent vector and Plane.d should be
either -1 or 1. See also Mesh.ARRAY_TANGENT.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/set_vertex_uv: Sets the UV of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/set_vertex_uv2: Sets the UV2 of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshDataTool/method/set_vertex_weights: Sets the bone weights of the given vertex.
descriptions.MeshInstance2D/signal/texture_changed: Emitted when the texture is changed.
descriptions.MeshInstance3D/method/bake_mesh_from_cur:
Takes a snapshot from the current ArrayMesh with all blend shapes
applied according to their current weights and bakes it to the provided
existing mesh. If no existing mesh is provided a new ArrayMesh is
created, baked and returned. Mesh surface materials are not copied.
Performance: Mesh data needs to be received from the GPU, stalling
the...

Takes a snapshot of the current animated skeleton pose of the skinned
mesh and bakes it to the provided existing mesh. If no existing mesh is
provided a new ArrayMesh is created, baked, and returned. Requires a
skeleton with a registered skin to work. Blendshapes are ignored. Mesh
surface materials are not copied. Performance: Mesh data needs to be...
descriptions.MeshInstance3D/method/create_convex_coll:
This helper creates a StaticBody3D child node with a
ConvexPolygonShape3D collision shape calculated from the mesh geometry.
It's mainly used for testing. If clean is true (default), duplicate and
interior vertices are removed automatically. You can set it to false to
make the process faster if not needed. If simplify is true, the geometry
can be further...
descriptions.MeshInstance3D/method/create_debug_tange:
This helper creates a MeshInstance3D child node with gizmos at every
vertex calculated from the mesh geometry. It's mainly used for testing.
descriptions.MeshInstance3D/method/create_multiple_co:
This helper creates a StaticBody3D child node with multiple
ConvexPolygonShape3D collision shapes calculated from the mesh geometry
via convex decomposition. The convex decomposition operation can be
controlled with parameters from the optional settings.
descriptions.MeshInstance3D/method/create_trimesh_col:
This helper creates a StaticBody3D child node with a
ConcavePolygonShape3D collision shape calculated from the mesh geometry.
It's mainly used for testing.
descriptions.MeshInstance3D/method/find_blend_shape_b:
Returns the index of the blend shape with the given name. Returns -1 if
no blend shape with this name exists, including when mesh is null.
descriptions.MeshInstance3D/method/get_active_materia:
Returns the Material that will be used by the Mesh when drawing. This
can return the GeometryInstance3D.material_override, the surface
override Material defined in this MeshInstance3D, or the surface
Material defined in the mesh. For example, if
GeometryInstance3D.material_override is used, all surfaces will return
the override material. Returns null if...
descriptions.MeshInstance3D/method/get_blend_shape_co:
Returns the number of blend shapes available. Produces an error if mesh
is null.
descriptions.MeshInstance3D/method/get_blend_shape_va:
Returns the value of the blend shape at the given blend_shape_idx.
Returns 0.0 and produces an error if mesh is null or doesn't have a
blend shape at that index.
descriptions.MeshInstance3D/method/get_skin_reference:
Returns the internal SkinReference containing the skeleton's RID
attached to this RID. See also Resource.get_rid,
SkinReference.get_skeleton, and
RenderingServer.instance_attach_skeleton.
descriptions.MeshInstance3D/method/get_surface_overri:
Returns the override Material for the specified surface of the Mesh
resource. See also get_surface_override_material_count. Note: This
returns the Material associated to the MeshInstance3D's Surface Material
Override properties, not the material within the Mesh resource. To get
the material within the Mesh resource, use Mesh.surface_get_material
instead.

Returns the number of surface override materials. This is equivalent to
Mesh.get_surface_count. See also get_surface_override_material.
descriptions.MeshInstance3D/method/set_blend_shape_va:
Sets the value of the blend shape at blend_shape_idx to value. Produces
an error if mesh is null or doesn't have a blend shape at that index.
descriptions.MeshInstance3D/method/set_surface_overri:
Sets the override material for the specified surface of the Mesh
resource. This material is associated with this MeshInstance3D rather
than with mesh. Note: This assigns the Material associated to the
MeshInstance3D's Surface Material Override properties, not the material
within the Mesh resource. To set the material within the Mesh resource,
use...
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/create_item:
Creates a new item in the library with the given ID. You can get an
unused ID from get_last_unused_item_id.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/find_item_by_name: Returns the first item with the given name, or -1 if no item is found.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/get_item_count: Returns the number of items present in the library.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/get_item_list: Returns the list of item IDs in use.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/get_item_mesh_cast_sh: Returns the item's shadow casting mode.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/get_item_mesh_transfo: Returns the transform applied to the item's mesh.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/get_item_navigation_l: Returns the item's navigation layers bitmask.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/get_item_navigation_m: Returns the transform applied to the item's navigation mesh.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/get_item_preview:
When running in the editor, returns a generated item preview (a 3D
rendering in isometric perspective). When used in a running project,
returns the manually-defined item preview which can be set using
set_item_preview. Returns an empty Texture2D if no preview was manually
set in a running project.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/get_item_shapes:
Returns an item's collision shapes. The array consists of each Shape3D
followed by its Transform3D.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/get_last_unused_item_: Gets an unused ID for a new item.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/set_item_mesh_cast_sh: Sets the item's shadow casting mode to shadow_casting_setting.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/set_item_mesh_transfo: Sets the transform to apply to the item's mesh.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/set_item_name:
Sets the item's name. This name is shown in the editor. It can also be
used to look up the item later using find_item_by_name.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/set_item_navigation_l: Sets the item's navigation layers bitmask.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/set_item_navigation_m: Sets the transform to apply to the item's navigation mesh.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/set_item_preview: Sets a texture to use as the item's preview icon in the editor.
descriptions.MeshLibrary/method/set_item_shapes:
Sets an item's collision shapes. The array should consist of Shape3D
objects, each followed by a Transform3D that will be applied to it. For
shapes that should not have a transform, use Transform3D.IDENTITY.
descriptions.MethodTweener/method/set_delay:
Sets the time in seconds after which the MethodTweener will start
interpolating. By default there's no delay.
descriptions.MethodTweener/method/set_ease:
Sets the type of used easing from Tween.EaseType. If not set, the
default easing is used from the Tween that contains this Tweener.
descriptions.MethodTweener/method/set_trans:
Sets the type of used transition from Tween.TransitionType. If not set,
the default transition is used from the Tween that contains this
Tweener.
descriptions.MotionRule/method/get_gravity_scale: Read the multiplier for grounded gravity.
descriptions.MotionRule/method/get_jump_speed:
Read the grounded takeoff speed in metres per second. Zero disables
jumping.
descriptions.MotionRule/method/is_grounded:
Return whether this rule constrains steering to the body's support plane
and applies gravity.
descriptions.MotionRule/method/set_gravity_scale:
Set a finite, nonnegative multiplier for the gravity vector supplied by
the body. An invalid value leaves the previous multiplier in place.
descriptions.MotionRule/method/set_grounded:
Enable or disable support-plane steering and gravity. Enable this for
bodies using grounded CharacterBody3D motion.
descriptions.MotionRule/method/set_jump_speed:
Set a finite takeoff speed from 0 to 1000 metres per second. An invalid
value leaves the previous speed in place.
descriptions.Mover/method/attach:
Attach to a CharacterBody3D or a Node3D without its own collision body.
Use a main-thread process group. Omit rule for unconstrained steering in
three dimensions without gravity. A grounded rule requires a
CharacterBody3D in grounded motion mode. Returns the existing attachment
for a body that already has one, without changing its rule. Use use_rule
to...
descriptions.Mover/method/for_node:
Get the attachment for this exact body without creating one. Returns
null if the body has no active attachment or the call is off the main
thread.
descriptions.Mover/method/get_velocity:
Read the actual world-space velocity from the last committed physics
step, in metres per second. Returns zero before a step, after
retirement, or when called off the main thread.
descriptions.Mover/method/jump:
Queue one grounded jump attempt for the next live physics step. The body
takes off only if it has floor support on that step. Airborne attempts
expire immediately. Returns OK when queued, ERR_BUSY off the main
thread, or ERR_UNAVAILABLE if jumps are disabled, the body is outside
the scene tree, the attachment has retired, or a session owns the
replayable...
descriptions.Mover/method/move:
Set the world-space steering target in metres per second. The target
persists until replaced, stopped, or cleared by scene exit. A grounded
rule projects steering onto the plane perpendicular to the body's up
direction and uses its acceleration, braking, and air control to
approach the target. Neutral movement applies the requested velocity
directly....
descriptions.Mover/method/stop:
Clear steering. A grounded character brakes while on the floor and
coasts while airborne. Gravity and collision continue. Returns OK on
success, ERR_UNAVAILABLE when the attachment has retired, or ERR_BUSY
when called off the main thread.
descriptions.Mover/method/use_rule:
Use a snapshot of rule from the next step, or pass null to restore
neutral steering. Keeps the current steering request. Returns OK on
success, ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER for a grounded rule on an incompatible
body, ERR_UNAVAILABLE when the attachment has retired, or ERR_BUSY when
called off the main thread.
descriptions.MoverComponent/method/mover:
Returns the existing Mover attached to the parent CharacterBody3D, or
null when none is attached. Network guests use the session's movement
path and have no local Mover handle.
descriptions.MovieWriter/method/_get_audio_mix_rate:
Called when the audio sample rate used for recording the audio is
requested by the engine. The value returned must be specified in Hz.
Defaults to 48000 Hz if _get_audio_mix_rate is not overridden.
descriptions.MovieWriter/method/_get_audio_speaker_mo:
Called when the audio speaker mode used for recording the audio is
requested by the engine. This can affect the number of output channels
in the resulting audio file/stream. Defaults to
AudioServer.SPEAKER_MODE_STEREO if _get_audio_speaker_mode is not
overridden.
descriptions.MovieWriter/method/_get_supported_extens:
Returns the list of supported filename extensions for movies written
with this MovieWriter.
descriptions.MovieWriter/method/_handles_file:
Called when the engine determines whether this MovieWriter is able to
handle the file at path. Must return true if this MovieWriter is able to
handle the given file path, false otherwise. Typically, _handles_file is
overridden as follows to allow the user to record a file at any path
with a given file extension:
descriptions.MovieWriter/method/_write_begin:
Called once before the engine starts writing video and audio data.
movie_size is the width and height of the video to save. fps is the
number of frames per second specified in the project settings or using
the --fixed-fps <fps> command line argument.
descriptions.MovieWriter/method/_write_end:
Called when the engine finishes writing. This occurs when the engine
quits by pressing the window manager's close button, or when
SceneTree.quit is called. Note: Pressing Ctrl + C on the terminal
running the editor/project does not result in _write_end being called.
descriptions.MovieWriter/method/_write_frame:
Called at the end of every rendered frame. The frame_image and
audio_frame_block function arguments should be written to.
descriptions.MovieWriter/method/add_writer:
Adds a writer to be usable by the engine. The supported file extensions
can be set by overriding _handles_file. Note: add_writer must be called
early enough in the engine initialization to work, as movie writing is
designed to start at the same time as the rest of the engine.
descriptions.MultiMesh/method/get_aabb: Returns the visibility axis-aligned bounding box in local space.
descriptions.MultiMesh/method/get_instance_color: Gets a specific instance's color multiplier.
descriptions.MultiMesh/method/get_instance_custom_dat: Returns the custom data that has been set for a specific instance.
descriptions.MultiMesh/method/get_instance_transform: Returns the Transform3D of a specific instance.
descriptions.MultiMesh/method/get_instance_transform_: Returns the Transform2D of a specific instance.
descriptions.MultiMesh/method/reset_instance_physics_:
When using physics interpolation, this function allows you to prevent
interpolation on an instance in the current physics tick. This allows
you to move instances instantaneously, and should usually be used when
initially placing an instance such as a bullet to prevent graphical
glitches.
descriptions.MultiMesh/method/reset_instances_physics:
When using physics interpolation, this function allows you to prevent
interpolation for all instances in the current physics tick. This allows
you to move all instances instantaneously, and should usually be used
when initially placing instances to prevent graphical glitches.
descriptions.MultiMesh/method/set_buffer_interpolated:
An alternative to setting the buffer property, which can be used with
physics interpolation. This method takes two arrays, and can set the
data for the current and previous tick in one go. The renderer will
automatically interpolate the data at each frame. This is useful for
situations where the order of instances may change from physics tick to
tick,...
descriptions.MultiMesh/method/set_instance_color:
Sets the color of a specific instance by multiplying the mesh's existing
vertex colors. This allows for different color tinting per instance.
Note: Each component is stored in 32 bits in the Forward+ and Mobile
rendering methods, but is packed into 16 bits in the Compatibility
rendering method. For the color to take effect, ensure that use_colors
is true...
descriptions.MultiMesh/method/set_instance_custom_dat:
Sets custom data for a specific instance. custom_data is a Color type
only to contain 4 floating-point numbers. Note: Each number is stored in
32 bits in the Forward+ and Mobile rendering methods, but is packed into
16 bits in the Compatibility rendering method. For the custom data to be
used, ensure that use_custom_data is true. This custom instance...
descriptions.MultiMesh/method/set_instance_transform: Sets the Transform3D for a specific instance.
descriptions.MultiMesh/method/set_instance_transform_: Sets the Transform2D for a specific instance.
descriptions.MultiMeshInstance2D/signal/texture_chang: Emitted when the texture is changed.
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/method/create_default_int: Returns a new instance of the default MultiplayerAPI.
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/method/get_default_interf:
Returns the default MultiplayerAPI implementation class name. This is
usually "SceneMultiplayer" when SceneMultiplayer is available. See
set_default_interface.
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/method/get_peers:
Returns the peer IDs of all connected peers of this MultiplayerAPI's
multiplayer_peer.
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/method/get_remote_sender_:
Returns the sender's peer ID for the RPC currently being executed. Note:
This method returns 0 when called outside of an RPC. As such, the
original peer ID may be lost when code execution is delayed (such as
with GDScript's await keyword).
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/method/get_unique_id: Returns the unique peer ID of this MultiplayerAPI's multiplayer_peer.
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/method/has_multiplayer_pe: Returns true if there is a multiplayer_peer set.
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/method/is_server:
Returns true if this MultiplayerAPI's multiplayer_peer is valid and in
server mode (listening for connections).
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/method/object_configurati:
Notifies the MultiplayerAPI of a new configuration for the given object.
This method is used internally by SceneTree to configure the root path
for this MultiplayerAPI (passing null and a valid NodePath as
configuration). This method can be further used by MultiplayerAPI
implementations to provide additional features, refer to specific
implementation...

Notifies the MultiplayerAPI to remove a configuration for the given
object. This method is used internally by SceneTree to configure the
root path for this MultiplayerAPI (passing null and an empty NodePath as
configuration). This method can be further used by MultiplayerAPI
implementations to provide additional features, refer to specific
implementation...
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/method/poll:
Method used for polling the MultiplayerAPI. You only need to worry about
this if you set SceneTree.multiplayer_poll to false. By default,
SceneTree will poll its MultiplayerAPI(s) for you. Note: This method
results in RPCs being called, so they will be executed in the same
context of this function (e.g. _process, physics, Thread).
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/method/rpc:
Sends an RPC to the target peer. The given method will be called on the
remote object with the provided arguments. The RPC may also be called
locally depending on the implementation and RPC configuration. See
Node.rpc and Node.rpc_config. Note: Prefer using Node.rpc, Node.rpc_id,
or my_method.rpc(peer, arg1, arg2, ...) (in GDScript), since they are...
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/method/set_default_interf:
Sets the default MultiplayerAPI implementation class. This method can be
used by modules and extensions to configure which implementation will be
used by SceneTree when the engine starts.
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/signal/connected_to_serve:
Emitted when this MultiplayerAPI's multiplayer_peer successfully
connected to a server. Only emitted on clients.
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/signal/connection_failed:
Emitted when this MultiplayerAPI's multiplayer_peer fails to establish a
connection to a server. Only emitted on clients.
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/signal/peer_connected:
Emitted when this MultiplayerAPI's multiplayer_peer connects with a new
peer. ID is the peer ID of the new peer. Clients get notified when other
clients connect to the same server. Upon connecting to a server, a
client also receives this signal for the server (with ID being 1).
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/signal/peer_disconnected:
Emitted when this MultiplayerAPI's multiplayer_peer disconnects from a
peer. Clients get notified when other clients disconnect from the same
server.
descriptions.MultiplayerAPI/signal/server_disconnecte:
Emitted when this MultiplayerAPI's multiplayer_peer disconnects from
server. Only emitted on clients.
descriptions.MultiplayerAPIExtension/method/_get_mult: Called when the MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer is retrieved.
descriptions.MultiplayerAPIExtension/method/_set_mult: Called when the MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer is set.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeer/method/close:
Immediately close the multiplayer peer returning to the state
CONNECTION_DISCONNECTED. Connected peers will be dropped without
emitting peer_disconnected.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeer/method/disconnect_peer:
Disconnects the given peer from this host. If force is true the
peer_disconnected signal will not be emitted for this peer.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeer/method/generate_unique_i:
Returns a randomly generated integer that can be used as a network
unique ID.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeer/method/get_connection_st: Returns the current state of the connection.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeer/method/get_packet_channe:
Returns the channel over which the next available packet was received.
See PacketPeer.get_available_packet_count.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeer/method/get_packet_mode:
Returns the transfer mode the remote peer used to send the next
available packet. See PacketPeer.get_available_packet_count.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeer/method/get_packet_peer:
Returns the ID of the MultiplayerPeer who sent the next available
packet. See PacketPeer.get_available_packet_count.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeer/method/get_unique_id: Returns the ID of this MultiplayerPeer.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeer/method/is_server_relay_s:
Returns true if the server can act as a relay in the current
configuration. That is, if the higher level MultiplayerAPI should notify
connected clients of other peers, and implement a relay protocol to
allow communication between them.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeer/method/poll: Waits up to 1 second to receive a new network event.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeer/method/set_target_peer:
Sets the peer to which packets will be sent. The id can be one of:
TARGET_PEER_BROADCAST to send to all connected peers, TARGET_PEER_SERVER
to send to the peer acting as server, a valid peer ID to send to that
specific peer, a negative peer ID to send to all peers except that one.
By default, the target peer is TARGET_PEER_BROADCAST.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeer/signal/peer_connected: Emitted when a remote peer connects.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeer/signal/peer_disconnected: Emitted when a remote peer has disconnected.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_close:
Called when the multiplayer peer should be immediately closed (see
MultiplayerPeer.close).
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_disconn:
Called when the connected peer should be forcibly disconnected (see
MultiplayerPeer.disconnect_peer).
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_get_ava:
Called when the available packet count is internally requested by the
MultiplayerAPI.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_get_con:
Called when the connection status is requested on the MultiplayerPeer
(see MultiplayerPeer.get_connection_status).
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_get_max:
Called when the maximum allowed packet size (in bytes) is requested by
the MultiplayerAPI.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_get_pac:
Called when a packet needs to be received by the MultiplayerAPI, with
r_buffer_size being the size of the binary r_buffer in bytes.

Called to get the channel over which the next available packet was
received. See MultiplayerPeer.get_packet_channel.

Called to get the transfer mode the remote peer used to send the next
available packet. See MultiplayerPeer.get_packet_mode.

Called when the ID of the MultiplayerPeer who sent the most recent
packet is requested (see MultiplayerPeer.get_packet_peer).

Called when a packet needs to be received by the MultiplayerAPI, if
_get_packet isn't implemented. Use this when extending this class via
GDScript.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_get_tra:
Called when the transfer channel to use is read on this MultiplayerPeer
(see MultiplayerPeer.transfer_channel).

Called when the transfer mode to use is read on this MultiplayerPeer
(see MultiplayerPeer.transfer_mode).
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_get_uni:
Called when the unique ID of this MultiplayerPeer is requested (see
MultiplayerPeer.get_unique_id). The value must be between 1 and
2147483647.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_is_refu:
Called when the "refuse new connections" status is requested on this
MultiplayerPeer (see MultiplayerPeer.refuse_new_connections).
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_is_serv:
Called when the "is server" status is requested on the MultiplayerAPI.
See MultiplayerAPI.is_server.

Called to check if the server can act as a relay in the current
configuration. See MultiplayerPeer.is_server_relay_supported.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_poll: Called when the MultiplayerAPI is polled. See MultiplayerAPI.poll.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_put_pac:
Called when a packet needs to be sent by the MultiplayerAPI, with
buffer_size being the size of the binary buffer in bytes.

Called when a packet needs to be sent by the MultiplayerAPI, if
_put_packet isn't implemented. Use this when extending this class via
GDScript.
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_set_ref:
Called when the "refuse new connections" status is set on this
MultiplayerPeer (see MultiplayerPeer.refuse_new_connections).
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_set_tar:
Called when the target peer to use is set for this MultiplayerPeer (see
MultiplayerPeer.set_target_peer).
descriptions.MultiplayerPeerExtension/method/_set_tra:
Called when the channel to use is set for this MultiplayerPeer (see
MultiplayerPeer.transfer_channel).

Called when the transfer mode is set on this MultiplayerPeer (see
MultiplayerPeer.transfer_mode).
descriptions.MultiplayerSpawner/method/add_spawnable_:
Adds a scene path to spawnable scenes, making it automatically
replicated from the multiplayer authority to other peers when added as
children of the node pointed by spawn_path.
descriptions.MultiplayerSpawner/method/clear_spawnabl:
Clears all spawnable scenes. Does not despawn existing instances on
remote peers.
descriptions.MultiplayerSpawner/method/get_spawnable_: Returns the spawnable scene path by index.
Returns the count of spawnable scene paths.
descriptions.MultiplayerSpawner/method/spawn:
Requests a custom spawn, with data passed to spawn_function on all
peers. Returns the locally spawned node instance already inside the
scene tree, and added as a child of the node pointed by spawn_path.
Note: Spawnable scenes are spawned automatically. spawn is only needed
for custom spawns.
descriptions.MultiplayerSpawner/signal/despawned:
Emitted when a spawnable scene or custom spawn was despawned by the
multiplayer authority. Only called on remote peers.
descriptions.MultiplayerSpawner/signal/spawned:
Emitted when a spawnable scene or custom spawn was spawned by the
multiplayer authority. Only called on remote peers.
descriptions.MultiplayerSynchronizer/method/add_visib:
Adds a peer visibility filter for this synchronizer. filter should take
a peer ID int and return a bool.
descriptions.MultiplayerSynchronizer/method/get_visib: Queries the current visibility for peer peer.
descriptions.MultiplayerSynchronizer/method/remove_vi: Removes a peer visibility filter from this synchronizer.
descriptions.MultiplayerSynchronizer/method/set_visib:
Sets the visibility of peer to visible. If peer is 0, the value of
public_visibility will be updated instead.
descriptions.MultiplayerSynchronizer/method/update_vi:
Updates the visibility of for_peer according to visibility filters. If
for_peer is 0 (the default), all peers' visibilties are updated.
descriptions.MultiplayerSynchronizer/signal/delta_syn:
Emitted when a new delta synchronization state is received by this
synchronizer after the properties have been updated.
descriptions.MultiplayerSynchronizer/signal/synchroni:
Emitted when a new synchronization state is received by this
synchronizer after the properties have been updated.
descriptions.MultiplayerSynchronizer/signal/visibilit: Emitted when visibility of for_peer is updated. See update_visibility.
descriptions.Mutex/method/lock:
Locks this Mutex, blocks until it is unlocked by the current owner.
Note: This function returns without blocking if the thread already has
ownership of the mutex.
descriptions.Mutex/method/try_lock:
Tries locking this Mutex, but does not block. Returns true on success,
false otherwise. Note: This function returns true if the thread already
has ownership of the mutex.
descriptions.Mutex/method/unlock:
Unlocks this Mutex, leaving it to other threads. Note: If a thread
called lock or try_lock multiple times while already having ownership of
the mutex, it must also call unlock the same number of times in order to
unlock it correctly. Warning: Calling unlock more times than lock on a
given thread, thus ending up trying to unlock a non-locked mutex, is...
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/add_check_item:
Adds a new checkable item with text label to the global menu rid.
Returns index of the inserted item, it's not guaranteed to be the same
as index value. An accelerator can optionally be defined, which is a
keyboard shortcut that can be pressed to trigger the menu button even if
it's not currently open. The accelerator is generally a combination
of...
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/add_icon_check_item:
Adds a new checkable item with text label and icon icon to the global
menu rid. Returns index of the inserted item, it's not guaranteed to be
the same as index value. An accelerator can optionally be defined, which
is a keyboard shortcut that can be pressed to trigger the menu button
even if it's not currently open. The accelerator is generally a...
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/add_icon_item:
Adds a new item with text label and icon icon to the global menu rid.
Returns index of the inserted item, it's not guaranteed to be the same
as index value. An accelerator can optionally be defined, which is a
keyboard shortcut that can be pressed to trigger the menu button even if
it's not currently open. The accelerator is generally a combination
of...
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/add_icon_radio_check_i:
Adds a new radio-checkable item with text label and icon icon to the
global menu rid. Returns index of the inserted item, it's not guaranteed
to be the same as index value. An accelerator can optionally be defined,
which is a keyboard shortcut that can be pressed to trigger the menu
button even if it's not currently open. The accelerator is generally
a...
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/add_item:
Adds a new item with text label to the global menu rid. Returns index of
the inserted item, it's not guaranteed to be the same as index value. An
accelerator can optionally be defined, which is a keyboard shortcut that
can be pressed to trigger the menu button even if it's not currently
open. The accelerator is generally a combination of KeyModifierMasks...
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/add_multistate_item:
Adds a new item with text label to the global menu rid. Contrarily to
normal binary items, multistate items can have more than two states, as
defined by max_states. Each press or activate of the item will increase
the state by one. The default value is defined by default_state. Returns
index of the inserted item, it's not guaranteed to be the same as...
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/add_radio_check_item:
Adds a new radio-checkable item with text label to the global menu rid.
Returns index of the inserted item, it's not guaranteed to be the same
as index value. An accelerator can optionally be defined, which is a
keyboard shortcut that can be pressed to trigger the menu button even if
it's not currently open. The accelerator is generally a combination
of...
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/add_separator:
Adds a separator between items to the global menu rid. Separators also
occupy an index. Returns index of the inserted item, it's not guaranteed
to be the same as index value. Note: This method is implemented on macOS
and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/add_submenu_item:
Adds an item that will act as a submenu of the global menu rid. The
submenu_rid argument is the RID of the global menu that will be shown
when the item is clicked. Returns index of the inserted item, it's not
guaranteed to be the same as index value. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/clear:
Removes all items from the global menu rid. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/create_menu:
Creates a new global menu object. Note: This method is implemented on
macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/find_item_index_with_s:
Returns the index of the item with the submenu specified by submenu_rid.
Indices are automatically assigned to each item by the engine. Note:
This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/find_item_index_with_t:
Returns the index of the item with the specified tag. Indices are
automatically assigned to each item by the engine. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows.

Returns the index of the item with the specified text. Indices are
automatically assigned to each item by the engine. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/free_menu:
Frees a global menu object created by this NativeMenu. Note: This method
is implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_item_accelerator:
Returns the accelerator of the item at index idx. Accelerators are
special combinations of keys that activate the item, no matter which
control is focused. Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_item_callback:
Returns the callback of the item at index idx. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_item_count:
Returns number of items in the global menu rid. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_item_icon:
Returns the icon of the item at index idx. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_item_indentation_l:
Returns the horizontal offset of the item at the given idx. Note: This
method is implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_item_key_callback:
Returns the callback of the item accelerator at index idx. Note: This
method is implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_item_max_states:
Returns number of states of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item
for details. Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_item_state:
Returns the state of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item for
details. Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_item_submenu:
Returns the submenu ID of the item at index idx. See add_submenu_item
for more info on how to add a submenu. Note: This method is implemented
on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_item_tag:
Returns the metadata of the specified item, which might be of any type.
You can set it with set_item_tag, which provides a simple way of
assigning context data to items. Note: This method is implemented on
macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_item_text:
Returns the text of the item at index idx. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_item_tooltip:
Returns the tooltip associated with the specified index idx. Note: This
method is implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_minimum_width:
Returns global menu minimum width. Note: This method is implemented only
on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_popup_close_callba:
Returns global menu close callback. Note: This method is implemented on
macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_popup_open_callbac:
Returns global menu open callback. Note: This method is implemented only
on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_size:
Returns global menu size. Note: This method is implemented on macOS and
Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_system_menu:
Returns RID of a special system menu. Note: This method is implemented
only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_system_menu_name:
Returns readable name of a special system menu. Note: This method is
implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/get_system_menu_text:
Returns the text of the system menu item. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/has_feature:
Returns true if the specified feature is supported by the current
NativeMenu, false otherwise. Note: This method is implemented on macOS
and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/has_menu:
Returns true if rid is valid global menu. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/has_system_menu:
Returns true if a special system menu is supported. Note: This method is
implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/is_item_checkable:
Returns true if the item at index idx is checkable in some way, i.e. if
it has a checkbox or radio button. Note: This method is implemented on
macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/is_item_checked:
Returns true if the item at index idx is checked. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/is_item_disabled:
Returns true if the item at index idx is disabled. When it is disabled
it can't be selected, or its action invoked. See set_item_disabled for
more info on how to disable an item. Note: This method is implemented on
macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/is_item_hidden:
Returns true if the item at index idx is hidden. See set_item_hidden for
more info on how to hide an item. Note: This method is implemented only
on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/is_item_radio_checkabl:
Returns true if the item at index idx has radio button-style
checkability. Note: This is purely cosmetic; you must add the logic for
checking/unchecking items in radio groups. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/is_opened:
Returns true if the menu is currently opened. Note: This method is
implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/is_system_menu:
Return true is global menu is a special system menu. Note: This method
is implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/popup:
Shows the global menu at position in the screen coordinates. Note: This
method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/remove_item:
Removes the item at index idx from the global menu rid. Note: The
indices of items after the removed item will be shifted by one. Note:
This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_interface_directio:
Sets the menu text layout direction from right-to-left if is_rtl is
true. Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_accelerator:
Sets the accelerator of the item at index idx. keycode can be a single
Key, or a combination of KeyModifierMasks and Keys using bitwise OR such
as KEY_MASK_CTRL | KEY_A (Ctrl + A). Note: This method is implemented
only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_callback:
Sets the callback of the item at index idx. Callback is emitted when an
item is pressed. Note: The callback Callable needs to accept exactly one
Variant parameter, the parameter passed to the Callable will be the
value passed to the tag parameter when the menu item was created. Note:
This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_checkable:
Sets whether the item at index idx has a checkbox. If false, sets the
type of the item to plain text. Note: This method is implemented on
macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_checked:
Sets the checkstate status of the item at index idx. Note: This method
is implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_disabled:
Enables/disables the item at index idx. When it is disabled, it can't be
selected and its action can't be invoked. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_hidden:
Hides/shows the item at index idx. When it is hidden, an item does not
appear in a menu and its action cannot be invoked. Note: This method is
implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_hover_callbac:
Sets the callback of the item at index idx. The callback is emitted when
an item is hovered. Note: The callback Callable needs to accept exactly
one Variant parameter, the parameter passed to the Callable will be the
value passed to the tag parameter when the menu item was created. Note:
This method is implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_icon:
Replaces the Texture2D icon of the specified idx. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows. Note: This method is not supported by
macOS Dock menu items.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_indentation_l:
Sets the horizontal offset of the item at the given idx. Note: This
method is implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_index:
Changes the index of the item at index idx to be at index target_idx.
This can be used to move an item above other items. Returns the new
index of the moved item, it's not guaranteed to be the same as
target_idx. Note: The indices of any items between index idx and index
target_idx will be shifted by one. Note: This method is implemented on
macOS and...
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_key_callback:
Sets the callback of the item at index idx. Callback is emitted when its
accelerator is activated. Note: The key_callback Callable needs to
accept exactly one Variant parameter, the parameter passed to the
Callable will be the value passed to the tag parameter when the menu
item was created. Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_max_states:
Sets number of state of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item for
details. Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_radio_checkab:
Sets the type of the item at the specified index idx to radio button. If
false, sets the type of the item to plain text. Note: This is purely
cosmetic; you must add the logic for checking/unchecking items in radio
groups. Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_state:
Sets the state of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item for
details. Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_submenu:
Sets the submenu RID of the item at index idx. The submenu is a global
menu that would be shown when the item is clicked. Note: This method is
implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_tag:
Sets the metadata of an item, which may be of any type. You can later
get it with get_item_tag, which provides a simple way of assigning
context data to items. Note: This method is implemented on macOS and
Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_text:
Sets the text of the item at index idx. Note: This method is implemented
on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_item_tooltip:
Sets the String tooltip of the item at the specified index idx. Note:
This method is implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_minimum_width:
Sets the minimum width of the global menu. Note: This method is
implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_popup_close_callba:
Registers callable to emit when the menu is about to show. Note: The OS
can simulate menu opening to track menu item changes and global
shortcuts, in which case the corresponding close callback is not
triggered. Use is_opened to check if the menu is currently opened. Note:
This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_popup_open_callbac:
Registers callable to emit after the menu is closed. Note: This method
is implemented only on macOS.
descriptions.NativeMenu/method/set_system_menu_text:
Sets the text of the system menu item. Note: This method is implemented
on macOS.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/distance_to_tar:
Returns the distance to the target position, using the agent's global
position. The user must set target_position in order for this to be
accurate.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/get_avoidance_l:
Returns whether or not the specified layer of the avoidance_layers
bitmask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/get_avoidance_m:
Returns whether or not the specified mask of the avoidance_mask bitmask
is enabled, given a mask_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/get_current_nav:
Returns this agent's current path from start to finish in global
coordinates. The path only updates when the target position is changed
or the agent requires a repath. The path array is not intended to be
used in direct path movement as the agent has its own internal path
logic that would get corrupted by changing the path array manually. Use
the...

Returns which index the agent is currently on in the navigation path's
PackedVector2Array.

Returns the path query result for the path the agent is currently
following.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/get_final_posit:
Returns the reachable final position of the current navigation path in
global coordinates. This position can change if the agent needs to
update the navigation path which makes the agent emit the path_changed
signal.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/get_navigation_:
Returns whether or not the specified layer of the navigation_layers
bitmask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.

Returns the RID of the navigation map for this NavigationAgent node.
This function returns always the map set on the NavigationAgent node and
not the map of the abstract agent on the NavigationServer. If the agent
map is changed directly with the NavigationServer API the
NavigationAgent node will not be aware of the map change. Use
set_navigation_map to...
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/get_next_path_p:
Returns the next position in global coordinates that can be moved to,
making sure that there are no static objects in the way. If the agent
does not have a navigation path, it will return the position of the
agent's parent. The use of this function once every physics frame is
required to update the internal path logic of the NavigationAgent.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/get_path_length:
Returns the length of the currently calculated path. The returned value
is 0.0, if the path is still calculating or no calculation has been
requested yet.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/get_rid: Returns the RID of this agent on the NavigationServer2D.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/is_navigation_f:
Returns true if the agent's navigation has finished. If the target is
reachable, navigation ends when the target is reached. If the target is
unreachable, navigation ends when the last waypoint of the path is
reached. Note: While true prefer to stop calling update functions like
get_next_path_position. This avoids jittering the standing agent due
to...
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/is_target_reach:
Returns true if get_final_position is within target_desired_distance of
the target_position.

Returns true if the agent reached the target, i.e. the agent moved
within target_desired_distance of the target_position. It may not always
be possible to reach the target but it should always be possible to
reach the final position. See get_final_position.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/set_avoidance_l:
Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the
avoidance_layers bitmask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/set_avoidance_m:
Based on value, enables or disables the specified mask in the
avoidance_mask bitmask, given a mask_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/set_navigation_:
Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the
navigation_layers bitmask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.

Sets the RID of the navigation map this NavigationAgent node should use
and also updates the agent on the NavigationServer.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/method/set_velocity_fo:
Replaces the internal velocity in the collision avoidance simulation
with velocity. When an agent is teleported to a new position this
function should be used in the same frame. If called frequently this
function can get agents stuck.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/signal/link_reached:
Signals that the agent reached a navigation link. Emitted when the agent
moves within path_desired_distance of the next position of the path when
that position is a navigation link. The details dictionary may contain
the following keys depending on the value of path_metadata_flags: -
position: The start position of the link that was reached. - type:...
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/signal/navigation_fini:
Signals that the agent's navigation has finished. If the target is
reachable, navigation ends when the target is reached. If the target is
unreachable, navigation ends when the last waypoint of the path is
reached. This signal is emitted only once per loaded path. This signal
will be emitted just after target_reached when the target is reachable.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/signal/path_changed:
Emitted when the agent had to update the loaded path: - because path was
previously empty. - because navigation map has changed. - because agent
pushed further away from the current path segment than the
path_max_distance.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/signal/target_reached:
Signals that the agent reached the target, i.e. the agent moved within
target_desired_distance of the target_position. This signal is emitted
only once per loaded path. This signal will be emitted just before
navigation_finished when the target is reachable. It may not always be
possible to reach the target but it should always be possible to reach
the...
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/signal/velocity_comput:
Notifies when the collision avoidance velocity is calculated. Emitted
every update as long as avoidance_enabled is true and the agent has a
navigation map.
descriptions.NavigationAgent2D/signal/waypoint_reache:
Signals that the agent reached a waypoint. Emitted when the agent moves
within path_desired_distance of the next position of the path. The
details dictionary may contain the following keys depending on the value
of path_metadata_flags: - position: The position of the waypoint that
was reached. - type: The type of navigation primitive (region or
link)...

descriptions.NavigationAgent3D/signal/navigation_fini:
Signals that the agent's navigation has finished. If the target is
reachable, navigation ends when the target is reached. If the target is
unreachable, navigation ends when the last waypoint of the path is
reached. This signal is emitted only once per loaded path. This signal
will be emitted just after target_reached when the target is reachable.

descriptions.NavigationAgent3D/signal/target_reached:

target_desired_distance of the target_position. This signal is emitted

possible to reach the target but it should always be possible to reach

descriptions.NavigationAgent3D/signal/waypoint_reache:

descriptions.NavigationMeshSourceGeometryData3D/metho:
Adds an array of vertex positions to the geometry data for navigation
mesh baking to form triangulated faces. For each face the array must
have three vertex positions in clockwise winding order. Since
NavigationMesh resources have no transform, all vertex positions need to
be offset by the node's transform using xform.

data. The mesh must have valid triangulated mesh data to be considered.
Since NavigationMesh resources have no transform, all vertex positions
need to be offset by the node's transform using xform.

Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX and indices at index Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX to the
navigation mesh baking data. The array must have valid triangulated mesh
data to be considered. Since NavigationMesh resources have no transform,
all vertex positions need to be offset by the node's transform using
xform.

Adds a projected obstruction shape to the source geometry. The vertices
are considered projected on an xz-axes plane, placed at the global
y-axis elevation and extruded by height. If carve is true the carved
shape will not be affected by additional offsets (e.g. agent radius) of
the navigation mesh baking process.

larger this number, the sooner this agent will respond to the presence
of other agents, but the less freedom this agent has in choosing its
velocities. A too high value will slow down agents movement
considerably....

the presence of static avoidance obstacles, but the less freedom this

a...

larger this number, the sooner this agent will respond to the presence
of other agents, but the less freedom this agent has in choosing its
velocities. A too high value will slow down agents movement

in 3D for the xyz-axis, e.g. for games that take place in air,
underwater or space. The 3D using agent only avoids other 3D avoidance
using agent's. The 3D using agent only reacts to radius based avoidance
obstacles....

avoidance simulation will try to fulfill this velocity if possible but

frequently this function can get agents stuck.

removed. The simplification amount is in worlds units and controlled by
epsilon. The simplification uses a variant of Ramer-Douglas-Peucker
algorithm for curve point decimation. Path simplification can be helpful
to mitigate various path following issues that can arise with certain
agent...
descriptions.NavigationServer3D/method/source_geometr:
Creates a new source geometry parser. If a Callable is set for the
parser with source_geometry_parser_set_callback the callback will be
called for every single node that gets parsed whenever
parse_source_geometry_data is used.

Sets the callback Callable for the specific source geometry parser. The
Callable will receive a call with the following parameters: -
navigation_mesh - The NavigationMesh reference used to define the parse
settings. Do NOT edit or add directly to the navigation mesh. -
source_geometry_data - The NavigationMeshSourceGeometryData3D reference.
Add custom...
descriptions.NavigationServer3D/signal/avoidance_debu:
Emitted when avoidance debug settings are changed. Only available in
debug builds.
descriptions.NavigationServer3D/signal/map_changed:
Emitted when a navigation map is updated, when a region moves or is
modified.
descriptions.NavigationServer3D/signal/navigation_deb:
Emitted when navigation debug settings are changed. Only available in
debug builds.
descriptions.NavigationServer3DManager/method/registe:
Registers a NavigationServer3D implementation by passing a name and a
Callable that returns a NavigationServer3D object.
descriptions.NavigationServer3DManager/method/set_def:
Sets the default NavigationServer3D implementation to the one identified
by name, if priority is greater than the priority of the current default
implementation.
descriptions.NetworkCodecs/method/decode:
Run the selected decoder with a new NetworkReader. The result contains
its value only when the reader consumes the whole payload and records no
error. A schema may reject data with NetworkReader.fail. A successful
decoder can return null. An unknown registration returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST. A callback invocation error returns
ERR_INVALID_DECLARATION.
descriptions.NetworkCodecs/method/encode:
Run the selected encoder with a new NetworkWriter. The result contains
the complete payload only when the callback returns OK and all writes
succeed. An unknown registration returns ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST. A callback
invocation error or invalid return type returns ERR_INVALID_DECLARATION.
descriptions.NetworkCodecs/method/register_codec:
Register one codec with synchronous callbacks. The identifier accepts 1
to 64 ASCII letters, digits, dots, hyphens, and underscores. The version
is from 1 through 65,535. The encoder accepts a NetworkWriter and one
game value and returns a Godot error. The decoder accepts a
NetworkReader and returns a game value. An invalid registration
returns...
descriptions.NetworkDecodeResult/method/get_error: Return the terminal Godot error, or OK.
descriptions.NetworkDecodeResult/method/get_value:
Return the decoded value, or null on failure. A successful codec may
also return null.
descriptions.NetworkDecodeResult/method/is_ok: Return true when the operation completed successfully.
descriptions.NetworkEncodeResult/method/get_bytes: Return the completed payload, or empty bytes on failure.
descriptions.NetworkEncodeResult/method/get_error: Return the terminal Godot error, or OK.
descriptions.NetworkEncodeResult/method/is_ok: Return true when the operation completed successfully.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/fail:
Record a schema validation error when the fields are readable but the
decoded values are invalid for the game. If reason is OK, records
ERR_INVALID_DATA. Later operations preserve the first error.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/finish:
Return OK when every byte was consumed without errors. Record
ERR_INVALID_DATA for trailing bytes and preserve an existing error.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/get_error:
Return the first reader error, or OK without checking for trailing
bytes.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/get_remaining: Return the number of payload bytes that have not been consumed.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/open:
Open bytes with a payload budget from 0 through 1,048,576 bytes.
Oversized input returns a reader with ERR_INVALID_DATA. The reader
retains its input until released.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/read_bool:
Read one byte, with 0 for false and 1 for true. Only 0 and 1 are valid.
Return false if reading fails and record the error.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/read_bytes:
Read a byte array preceded by its unsigned 32-bit length. The optional
limit counts field bytes. Return an empty byte array if reading fails
and record the error.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/read_f32:
Read a finite IEEE-754 binary32 float. Return 0.0 if reading fails and
record the error.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/read_f64:
Read a finite IEEE-754 binary64 float. Return 0.0 if reading fails and
record the error.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/read_i16:
Read a signed 16-bit integer from -32,768 to 32,767. Return 0 if reading
fails and record the error.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/read_i32:
Read a signed 32-bit integer from -2,147,483,648 to 2,147,483,647.
Return 0 if reading fails and record the error.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/read_i64:
Read a signed 64-bit integer in the full Godot integer range. Return 0
if reading fails and record the error.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/read_i8:
Read a signed 8-bit integer from -128 to 127. Return 0 if reading fails
and record the error.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/read_string:
Read a UTF-8 string preceded by its unsigned 32-bit byte length. The
optional limit counts encoded bytes. Invalid UTF-8, a leading byte-order
mark, and embedded zero bytes fail. Return an empty string if reading
fails and record the error.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/read_u16:
Read an unsigned 16-bit integer from 0 to 65,535. Return 0 if reading
fails and record the error.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/read_u32:
Read an unsigned 32-bit integer from 0 to 4,294,967,295. Return 0 if
reading fails and record the error.
descriptions.NetworkReader/method/read_u8:
Read an unsigned 8-bit integer from 0 to 255. Return 0 if reading fails
and record the error.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/create:
Allocate a writer with a payload budget from 0 through 1,048,576 bytes.
Inspect get_error for an invalid budget or allocation failure.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/finish:
Seal the writer and return its complete payload. On failure returns
empty bytes. An empty message can succeed, so check get_error to
distinguish the two. Repeated calls return the same payload.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/get_error:
Return the first writer error, or OK. Exceeding the byte budget returns
ERR_OUT_OF_MEMORY. An out-of-range numeric value returns
ERR_PARAMETER_RANGE_ERROR.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/get_size: Return the number of accepted payload bytes before sealing or failure.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/write_bool:
Write one byte, with 0 for false and 1 for true. Return OK or the first
writer error. A sealed writer returns ERR_LOCKED.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/write_bytes:
Write a byte array preceded by its unsigned 32-bit length. Return OK or
the first writer error. A sealed writer returns ERR_LOCKED.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/write_f32:
Write a finite IEEE-754 binary32 float. The value rounds to binary32
precision. Return OK or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns
ERR_LOCKED.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/write_f64:
Write a finite IEEE-754 binary64 float. Return OK or the first writer
error. A sealed writer returns ERR_LOCKED.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/write_i16:
Write a signed 16-bit integer from -32,768 to 32,767. Return OK or the
first writer error. A sealed writer returns ERR_LOCKED.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/write_i32:
Write a signed 32-bit integer from -2,147,483,648 to 2,147,483,647.
Return OK or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns ERR_LOCKED.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/write_i64:
Write a signed 64-bit integer in the full Godot integer range. Return OK
or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns ERR_LOCKED.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/write_i8:
Write a signed 8-bit integer from -128 to 127. Return OK or the first
writer error. A sealed writer returns ERR_LOCKED.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/write_string:
Write a UTF-8 string preceded by its unsigned 32-bit byte length. The
string may be empty. A leading byte-order mark and embedded zero
codepoints are rejected. Return OK or the first writer error. A sealed
writer returns ERR_LOCKED.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/write_u16:
Write an unsigned 16-bit integer from 0 to 65,535. Return OK or the
first writer error. A sealed writer returns ERR_LOCKED.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/write_u32:
Write an unsigned 32-bit integer from 0 to 4,294,967,295. Return OK or
the first writer error. A sealed writer returns ERR_LOCKED.
descriptions.NetworkWriter/method/write_u8:
Write an unsigned 8-bit integer from 0 to 255. Return OK or the first
writer error. A sealed writer returns ERR_LOCKED.
descriptions.NinePatchRect/method/get_patch_margin: Returns the size of the margin on the specified Side.
descriptions.NinePatchRect/method/set_patch_margin: Sets the size of the margin on the specified Side to value pixels.
descriptions.NinePatchRect/signal/texture_changed: Emitted when the node's texture changes.
descriptions.Node/method/_enter_tree:
Called when the node enters the SceneTree (e.g. upon instantiating,
scene changing, or after calling add_child in a script). If the node has
children, its _enter_tree callback will be called first, and then that
of the children. Corresponds to the NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE notification
in Object._notification.
descriptions.Node/method/_exit_tree:
Called when the node is about to leave the SceneTree (e.g. upon freeing,
scene changing, or after calling remove_child in a script). If the node
has children, its _exit_tree callback will be called last, after all its
children have left the tree. Corresponds to the NOTIFICATION_EXIT_TREE
notification in Object._notification and signal tree_exiting. To...
descriptions.Node/method/_get_accessibility_configura:
The elements in the array returned from this method are displayed as
warnings in the Scene dock if the script that overrides it is a tool
script, and accessibility warnings are enabled in the editor settings.
Returning an empty array produces no warnings.
descriptions.Node/method/_get_configuration_warnings:
The elements in the array returned from this method are displayed as
warnings in the Scene dock if the script that overrides it is a tool
script. Returning an empty array produces no warnings. Call
update_configuration_warnings when the warnings need to be updated for
this node.
descriptions.Node/method/_get_focused_accessibility_e:
Called during accessibility information updates to determine the
currently focused sub-element, should return a sub-element RID or the
value returned by get_accessibility_element.
descriptions.Node/method/_input:
Called when there is an input event. The input event propagates up
through the node tree until a node consumes it. It is only called if
input processing is enabled, which is done automatically if this method
is overridden, and can be toggled with set_process_input. To consume the
input event and stop it propagating further to other nodes,...
descriptions.Node/method/_physics_process:
Called once on each physics tick, and allows Nodes to synchronize their
logic with physics ticks. delta is the logical time between physics
ticks in seconds and is equal to Engine.time_scale /
Engine.physics_ticks_per_second. It is only called if physics processing
is enabled for this Node, which is done automatically if this method is
overridden, and...
descriptions.Node/method/_process:
Called on each idle frame, prior to rendering, and after physics ticks
have been processed. delta is the time between frames in seconds. It is
only called if processing is enabled for this Node, which is done
automatically if this method is overridden, and can be toggled with
set_process. Processing happens in order of process_priority, lower
priority...
descriptions.Node/method/_ready:
Called when the node is "ready", i.e. when both the node and its
children have entered the scene tree. If the node has children, their
_ready callbacks get triggered first, and the parent node will receive
the ready notification afterwards. Corresponds to the NOTIFICATION_READY
notification in Object._notification. See also the @onready annotation
for...
descriptions.Node/method/_shortcut_input:
Called when an InputEventKey, InputEventShortcut, or
InputEventJoypadButton hasn't been consumed by _input or any GUI Control
item. It is called before _unhandled_key_input and _unhandled_input. The
input event propagates up through the node tree until a node consumes
it. It is only called if shortcut processing is enabled, which is done
automatically if...
descriptions.Node/method/_unhandled_input:
Called when an InputEvent hasn't been consumed by _input or any GUI
Control item. It is called after _shortcut_input and after
_unhandled_key_input. The input event propagates up through the node
tree until a node consumes it. It is only called if unhandled input
processing is enabled, which is done automatically if this method is
overridden, and can be...
descriptions.Node/method/_unhandled_key_input:
Called when an InputEventKey hasn't been consumed by _input or any GUI
Control item. It is called after _shortcut_input but before
_unhandled_input. The input event propagates up through the node tree
until a node consumes it. It is only called if unhandled key input
processing is enabled, which is done automatically if this method is
overridden, and can...
descriptions.Node/method/add_child:
Adds a child node. Nodes can have any number of children, but every
child must have a unique name. Child nodes are automatically deleted
when the parent node is deleted, so an entire scene can be removed by
deleting its topmost node. If force_readable_name is true, improves the
readability of the added node. If not named, the node is renamed to its
type,...
descriptions.Node/method/add_sibling:
Adds a sibling node to this node's parent, and moves the added sibling
right below this node. If force_readable_name is true, improves the
readability of the added sibling. If not named, the sibling is renamed
to its type, and if it shares name with a sibling, a number is suffixed
more appropriately. This operation is very slow. As such, it is...
descriptions.Node/method/add_to_group:
Adds the node to the group. Groups can be helpful to organize a subset
of nodes, for example "enemies" or "collectables". See notes in the
description, and the group methods in SceneTree. If persistent is true,
the group will be stored when saved inside a PackedScene. All groups
created and displayed in the Groups dock are persistent. Note: To
improve...
descriptions.Node/method/atr:
Translates a message, using the translation catalogs configured in the
