descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_error_stri: Returns an error string for the given XrResult.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_hand_track:
Returns the corresponding XRHandTrackerEXT handle for the given hand
index value.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_instance:
Returns the XrInstance created during the initialization of the OpenXR
API.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_instance_p:
Returns the function pointer of the OpenXR function with the specified
name, cast to an integer. If the function with the given name does not
exist, the method returns 0. Note: openxr/util.h contains utility macros
for acquiring OpenXR functions, e.g.
GDEXTENSION_INIT_XR_FUNC_V(xrCreateAction).
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_next_frame: Returns the predicted display timing for the next frame.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_openxr_ver:
Returns the version of OpenXR that was initialized. Only valid after the
OpenXR instance has been created. See XR_MAKE_VERSION for how the
version is calculated.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_play_space: Returns the play space, which is an XrSpace cast to an integer.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_predicted_: Returns the predicted display timing for the current frame.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_projection:
Returns a pointer to the render state's XrCompositionLayerProjection
struct. Note: This method should only be called from the rendering
thread.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_render_sta:
Returns the far boundary value of the camera frustum. Note: This is only
accessible in the render thread.

Returns the near boundary value of the camera frustum. Note: This is
only accessible in the render thread.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_session: Returns the OpenXR session, which is an XrSession cast to an integer.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_supported_: Returns an array of supported swapchain formats.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_swapchain_: Returns the name of the specified swapchain format.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_system_id: Returns the ID of the system, which is an XrSystemId cast to an integer.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_view_confi:
Returns the view configuration type, which is an XrViewConfigurationType
cast to an integer.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/get_view_count:
Returns the number of views. It is usually two, one for each eye, but
may differ with different view configurations.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/insert_debug_l:
Inserts a debug label, this label is reported in any debug message
resulting from the OpenXR calls that follows, until any of
begin_debug_label_region, end_debug_label_region, or insert_debug_label
is called.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/is_environment:
Returns OpenXRAPIExtension.OpenXRAlphaBlendModeSupport denoting if
XRInterface.XR_ENV_BLEND_MODE_ALPHA_BLEND is really supported, emulated
or not supported at all.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/is_initialized: Returns true if OpenXR is initialized.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/is_running:
Returns true if OpenXR is running (xrBeginSession was successfully
called and the swapchains were created).
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/openxr_is_enab: Returns true if OpenXR is enabled.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/openxr_swapcha: Acquires the image of the provided swapchain.

Returns a pointer to a new swapchain created using the provided
parameters.
Destroys the provided swapchain and frees it from memory.
Returns the RID of the provided swapchain's image.
Returns the XrSwapchain handle of the provided swapchain.
Releases the image of the provided swapchain.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/register_compo:
Registers the given extension as a composition layer provider. Note:
This cannot be called after the OpenXR session has started. However, it
can be called in OpenXRExtensionWrapper._on_session_created.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/register_frame:
Registers the given extension as modifying frame info via the
OpenXRExtensionWrapper._set_frame_wait_info_and_get_next_pointer,
OpenXRExtensionWrapper._set_view_locate_info_and_get_next_pointer, or
OpenXRExtensionWrapper._set_frame_end_info_and_get_next_pointer virtual
methods. Note: This cannot be called after the OpenXR session has
started. However, it...
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/register_proje:
Registers the given extension as modifying XrCompositionLayerProjection
via the
OpenXRExtensionWrapper._set_projection_layer_and_get_next_pointer
virtual method. Note: This cannot be called after the OpenXR session has
started. However, it can be called in
OpenXRExtensionWrapper._on_session_created.

Registers the given extension as a provider of additional data
structures to projections views. Note: This cannot be called after the
OpenXR session has started. However, it can be called in
OpenXRExtensionWrapper._on_session_created.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/set_custom_pla:
Sets the reference space used by OpenXR to the given XrSpace (cast to a
void *).
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/set_emulate_en:
If set to true, an OpenXR extension is loaded which is capable of
emulating the XRInterface.XR_ENV_BLEND_MODE_ALPHA_BLEND blend mode.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/set_object_nam:
Set the object name of an OpenXR object, used for debug output.
object_type must be a valid OpenXR XrObjectType enum and object_handle
must be a valid OpenXR object handle.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/set_render_reg:
Sets the render region to render_region, overriding the normal render
target's rect.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/set_velocity_d: Sets the render target of the velocity depth texture.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/set_velocity_t: Sets the target size of the velocity and velocity depth textures.
Sets the render target of the velocity texture.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/transform_from: Creates a Transform3D from an XrPosef.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/unregister_com:
Unregisters the given extension as a composition layer provider. Note:
This cannot be called while the OpenXR session is still running.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/unregister_fra:
Unregisters the given extension as modifying frame info. Note: This
cannot be called while the OpenXR session is still running.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/unregister_pro:
Unregisters the given extension as modifying
XrCompositionLayerProjection. Note: This cannot be called while the
OpenXR session is still running.

Unregisters the given extension as a provider of additional data
structures to projections views. Note: This cannot be called while the
OpenXR session is still running.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/update_main_sw:
Request the recommended resolution from the OpenXR runtime and update
the main swapchain size if it has changed.
descriptions.OpenXRAPIExtension/method/xr_result:
Returns true if the provided XrResult (cast to an integer) is
successful. Otherwise returns false and prints the XrResult converted to
a string, with the specified additional information.
descriptions.OpenXRActionMap/method/create_default_ac: Setup this action set with our default actions.
descriptions.OpenXRActionMap/method/find_action_set: Retrieve an action set by name.
descriptions.OpenXRActionMap/method/find_interaction_: Find an interaction profile by its name (path).
descriptions.OpenXRActionMap/method/get_action_set: Retrieve the action set at this index.
descriptions.OpenXRActionMap/method/get_action_set_co: Retrieve the number of actions sets in our action map.
descriptions.OpenXRActionMap/method/get_interaction_p: Get the interaction profile at this index.
Retrieve the number of interaction profiles in our action map.
descriptions.OpenXRActionSet/method/add_action: Add an action to this action set.
descriptions.OpenXRActionSet/method/get_action_count: Retrieve the number of actions in our action set.
descriptions.OpenXRActionSet/method/remove_action: Remove an action from this action set.
descriptions.OpenXRAnchorTracker/method/has_uuid: Returns true if a non-zero UUID is set.
descriptions.OpenXRAnchorTracker/signal/uuid_changed: Emitted when the UUID for this anchor was changed.
descriptions.OpenXRAndroidThreadSettingsExtension/met:
Sets the thread type of the given thread, so that the XR runtime can
adjust its scheduling priority accordingly. thread_id refers to the OS
thread id (ie from gettid()). When thread_id is 0, it will set the
thread type of the current thread. NOTE: The id returned by
Thread.get_id is incompatible with thread_id.
descriptions.OpenXRBindingModifier/method/_get_descri:
Return the description of this class that is used for the title bar of
the binding modifier editor.
descriptions.OpenXRBindingModifier/method/_get_ip_mod:
Returns the data that is sent to OpenXR when submitting the suggested
interacting bindings this modifier is a part of. Note: This must be data
compatible with an XrBindingModificationBaseHeaderKHR structure.
descriptions.OpenXRCompositionLayer/method/get_androi:
Returns a JavaObject representing an android.view.Surface if
use_android_surface is enabled and OpenXR has created the surface.
Otherwise, this will return null. Note: The surface can only be created
during an active OpenXR session. So, if use_android_surface is enabled
outside of an OpenXR session, it won't be created until a new session
fully starts.
descriptions.OpenXRCompositionLayer/method/intersects:
Returns UV coordinates where the given ray intersects with the
composition layer. origin and direction must be in global space. Returns
Vector2(-1.0, -1.0) if the ray doesn't intersect.
descriptions.OpenXRCompositionLayer/method/is_nativel:
Returns true if the OpenXR runtime natively supports this composition
layer type. Note: This will only return an accurate result after the
OpenXR session has started.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_get_compo:
Returns a pointer to an XrCompositionLayerBaseHeader struct to provide
the given composition layer. This will only be called if the extension
previously registered itself with
OpenXRAPIExtension.register_composition_layer_provider. Note: This
virtual method will be called on the render thread. Additionally, the
data it returns will be used shortly after...

Returns the number of composition layers this extension wrapper provides
via _get_composition_layer. This will only be called if the extension
previously registered itself with
OpenXRAPIExtension.register_composition_layer_provider. Note: This
virtual method will be called on the render thread. Additionally, the
data it returns will be used shortly after...

Returns an integer that will be used to sort the given composition layer
provided via _get_composition_layer. Lower numbers will move the layer
to the front of the list, and higher numbers to the end. The default
projection layer has an order of 0, so layers provided by this method
should probably be above or below (but not exactly) 0. This will only
be...
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_get_reque:
Returns a Dictionary of OpenXR extensions related to this extension.
xr_version specifies the OpenXR version we're instantiating. This will
be zero if the editor requests this list to flag supported features. The
Dictionary should contain the name of the extension, mapped to a bool *
cast to an integer: - If the bool * is a nullptr this extension is...
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_get_sugge:
Returns a PackedStringArray of positional tracker names that are used
within the extension wrapper.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_get_viewp:
Gets an array of Dictionarys that represent properties, just like
Object._get_property_list, that will be added to OpenXRCompositionLayer
nodes. Note: This virtual method will be called on the render thread.

Gets a Dictionary containing the default values for the properties
returned by _get_viewport_composition_layer_extension_properties.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_on_before:
Called before the OpenXR instance is created. Note: This virtual method
will be called on the main thread, however, it will be called before
OpenXR becomes involved in rendering, so it is safe to write to data
that will be used by the render thread.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_on_event_:
Called when there is an OpenXR event to process. When implementing,
return true if the event was handled, return false otherwise.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_on_instan:
Called right after the OpenXR instance is created. Note: This virtual
method will be called on the main thread, however, it will be called
before OpenXR becomes involved in rendering, so it is safe to write to
data that will be used by the render thread.

Called right before the OpenXR instance is destroyed. Note: This virtual
method will be called on the main thread, however, it will be called
after OpenXR is done being involved in rendering, so it is safe to write
to data that was used by the render thread.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_on_main_s:
Called right after the main swapchains are (re)created. Note: This
virtual method will be called on the render thread.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_on_post_d:
Called right after the given viewport is rendered. Note: The draw
commands might only be queued at this point, not executed. Note: This
virtual method will be called on the render thread.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_on_pre_dr:
Called right before the given viewport is rendered. Note: This virtual
method will be called on the render thread.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_on_pre_re:
Called right before the XR viewports begin their rendering step. Note:
This virtual method will be called on the render thread.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_on_proces:
Called as part of the OpenXR process handling. This happens right before
general and physics processing steps of the main loop. During this step
controller data is queried and made available to game logic.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_on_regist:
Allows extensions to register additional controller metadata. This
function is called even when the OpenXR API is not constructed as the
metadata needs to be available to the editor. Extensions should also
provide metadata regardless of whether they are supported on the host
system. The controller data is used to setup action maps for users who
may have...
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_on_sessio:
Called right after the OpenXR session is created. Note: This virtual
method will be called on the main thread, however, it will be called
before OpenXR becomes involved in rendering, so it is safe to write to
data that will be used by the render thread.

Called right before the OpenXR session is destroyed. Note: This virtual
method will be called on the main thread, however, it will be called
after OpenXR is done being involved in rendering, so it is safe to write
to data that was used by the render thread.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_on_state_: Called when the OpenXR session state is changed to exiting.

Called when the OpenXR session state is changed to focused. This state
is the active state when the game runs.
Called when the OpenXR session state is changed to idle.
Called when the OpenXR session state is changed to loss pending.

Called when the OpenXR session state is changed to ready. This means
OpenXR is ready to set up the session.
Called when the OpenXR session state is changed to stopping.

Called when the OpenXR session state is changed to synchronized. OpenXR
also returns to this state when the application loses focus.

Called when the OpenXR session state is changed to visible. This means
OpenXR is now ready to receive frames.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_on_sync_a: Called when OpenXR has performed its action sync.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_on_viewpo:
Called when a composition layer created via OpenXRCompositionLayer is
destroyed. layer is a pointer to an XrCompositionLayerBaseHeader struct.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_prepare_v:
Called before _set_view_configuration_and_get_next_pointer to allow the
extension to reserve data for the given number of views.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_print_vie:
Called to allow an extension to print additional information about its
view configuration, if applicable. This will only be called if verbose
output is enabled.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_set_andro:
Add additional data structures to Android surface swapchains created by
OpenXRCompositionLayer. property_values contains the values of the
properties returned by
_get_viewport_composition_layer_extension_properties. Note: This virtual
method will be called on the render thread.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_set_frame:
Add additional data structures to XrFrameEndInfo. This will only be
called if the extension previously registered itself with
OpenXRAPIExtension.register_frame_info_extension. Note: This virtual
method will be called on the render thread. Additionally, the data it
returns will be used shortly after this method is called, so it needs to
remain valid until...

Add additional data structures to XrFrameWaitInfo. This will only be
called if the extension previously registered itself with
OpenXRAPIExtension.register_frame_info_extension. Note: This virtual
method will be called on the render thread.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_set_hand_: Add additional data structures when each hand tracker is created.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_set_insta:
Add additional data structures when the OpenXR instance is created.
xr_version specifies the OpenXR version we're instantiating.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_set_proje:
Adds additional data structures to XrCompositionLayerProjection. This
will only be called if the extension previously registered itself with
OpenXRAPIExtension.register_projection_layer_extension.

Add additional data structures to the projection view of the given
view_index. Note: This virtual method will be called on the render
thread. Additionally, the data it returns will be used shortly after
this method is called, so it needs to remain valid until the next time
_on_pre_render runs.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_set_refer: Add additional data structures to XrReferenceSpaceCreateInfo.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_set_sessi: Add additional data structures when the OpenXR session is created.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_set_swapc: Add additional data structures when creating OpenXR swapchains.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_set_syste: Add additional data structures when querying OpenXR system abilities.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_set_view_: Add additional data structures when querying OpenXR view configuration.

Add additional data structures to XrViewLocateInfo. This will only be
called if the extension previously registered itself with
OpenXRAPIExtension.register_frame_info_extension. Note: This virtual
method will be called on the render thread. Additionally, the data it
returns will be used shortly after this method is called, so it needs to
remain valid...
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/_set_viewp:
Add additional data structures to composition layers created by
OpenXRCompositionLayer. property_values contains the values of the
properties returned by
_get_viewport_composition_layer_extension_properties. layer is a pointer
to an XrCompositionLayerBaseHeader struct. Note: This virtual method
will be called on the render thread. Additionally, the data...
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/get_openxr:
Returns the created OpenXRAPIExtension, which can be used to access the
OpenXR API.
descriptions.OpenXRExtensionWrapper/method/register_e:
Registers the extension. This should happen at core module
initialization level. Note: This cannot be called once OpenXR has been
initialized.
descriptions.OpenXRFrameSynthesisExtension/method/is_:
Returns true if frame synthesis is enabled in the project settings and
the current XR runtime supports frame synthesis. The value returned will
only be valid once OpenXR has been initialized.
descriptions.OpenXRFrameSynthesisExtension/method/ski:
Queues the next frame to be skipped when supplying motion vector and
depth data. Call this after teleporting your player or a similar action
has moved the player to prevent incorrect reprojection results due to
this movement.
descriptions.OpenXRFutureExtension/method/cancel_futu:
Cancels an in-progress future. future must be an XrFutureEXT value
previously returned by an API that started an asynchronous function.
descriptions.OpenXRFutureExtension/method/is_active:
Returns true if futures are available in the OpenXR runtime used. This
function will only return a usable result after OpenXR has been
initialized.
descriptions.OpenXRFutureExtension/method/register_fu:
Register an OpenXR Future object so we monitor for completion. future
must be an XrFutureEXT value previously returned by an API that started
an asynchronous function. You can optionally specify on_success, it will
be invoked on successful completion of the future. Or you can use the
returned OpenXRFutureResult object to await its...
descriptions.OpenXRFutureResult/method/cancel_future:
Cancel this future, this will interrupt and stop the asynchronous
function.
descriptions.OpenXRFutureResult/method/get_future: Return the XrFutureEXT value this result relates to.
descriptions.OpenXRFutureResult/method/get_result_val:
Returns the result value of our asynchronous function (if set by the
extension). The type of this result value depends on the function being
called. Consult the documentation of the relevant function.
descriptions.OpenXRFutureResult/method/get_status: Returns the status of this result.
descriptions.OpenXRFutureResult/method/set_result_val:
Stores the result value we expose to the user. Note: This method should
only be called by an OpenXR extension that implements an asynchronous
function.
descriptions.OpenXRFutureResult/signal/completed:
Emitted when the asynchronous function is finished or has been
cancelled.
descriptions.OpenXRIPBinding/method/add_path: Add an input/output path to this binding.
descriptions.OpenXRIPBinding/method/get_binding_modif: Get the OpenXRBindingModifier at this index.
Get the number of binding modifiers for this binding.
descriptions.OpenXRIPBinding/method/get_path_count: Get the number of input/output paths in this binding.
descriptions.OpenXRIPBinding/method/has_path: Returns true if this input/output path is part of this binding.
descriptions.OpenXRIPBinding/method/remove_path: Removes this input/output path from this binding.
descriptions.OpenXRInteractionProfile/method/get_bind: Retrieve the binding at this index.
Get the number of bindings in this interaction profile.
Get the OpenXRBindingModifier at this index.
Get the number of binding modifiers in this interaction profile.
descriptions.OpenXRInteractionProfileMetadata/method/:
Registers an interaction profile using its OpenXR designation (e.g.
/interaction_profiles/khr/simple_controller is the profile for OpenXR's
simple controller profile). display_name is the description shown to the
user. openxr_path is the interaction profile path being registered.
openxr_extension_names optionally restricts this profile to the given...

Registers an input/output path for the given interaction_profile. The
profile should previously have been registered using
register_interaction_profile. display_name is the description shown to
the user. toplevel_path specifies the bind path this input/output can be
bound to (e.g. /user/hand/left or /user/hand/right). openxr_path is the
action...

Allows for renaming old input/output paths to new paths in order to load
and process older action maps.

Allows for renaming old interaction profile paths to new paths in order
to load and process older action maps.

Registers a top level path to which profiles can be bound. For instance
/user/hand/left refers to the bind point for the player's left hand.
Extensions can register additional top level paths, for instance a
haptic vest extension might register /user/body/vest. display_name is
the name shown to the user. openxr_path is the top level path being...
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/get_action_sets:
Returns a list of action sets registered with Godot (loaded from the
action map at runtime).
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/get_available_dis:
Returns a list of display refresh rates supported by the current HMD.
Only returned if this feature is supported by the OpenXR runtime and
after the interface has been initialized.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/get_hand_joint_an:
If handtracking is enabled, returns the angular velocity of a joint
(joint) of a hand (hand) as provided by OpenXR. This is relative to
XROrigin3D!
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/get_hand_joint_fl:
If handtracking is enabled, returns flags that inform us of the validity
of the tracking data.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/get_hand_joint_li:
If handtracking is enabled, returns the linear velocity of a joint
(joint) of a hand (hand) as provided by OpenXR. This is relative to
XROrigin3D without worldscale applied!
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/get_hand_joint_po:
If handtracking is enabled, returns the position of a joint (joint) of a
hand (hand) as provided by OpenXR. This is relative to XROrigin3D
without worldscale applied!
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/get_hand_joint_ra:
If handtracking is enabled, returns the radius of a joint (joint) of a
hand (hand) as provided by OpenXR. This is without worldscale applied!
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/get_hand_joint_ro:
If handtracking is enabled, returns the rotation of a joint (joint) of a
hand (hand) as provided by OpenXR.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/get_hand_tracking:
If handtracking is enabled and hand tracking source is supported, gets
the source of the hand tracking data for hand.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/get_motion_range:
If handtracking is enabled and motion range is supported, gets the
currently configured motion range for hand.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/get_session_state: Returns the current state of our OpenXR session.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/is_action_set_act: Returns true if the given action set is active.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/is_eye_gaze_inter:
Returns the capabilities of the eye gaze interaction extension. Note:
This only returns a valid value after OpenXR has been initialized.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/is_foveation_supp:
Returns true if OpenXR's foveation extension is supported. The interface
must be initialized before this returns a valid value. Note: When using
the Vulkan rendering driver, Viewport.vrs_mode must be set to
Viewport.VRS_XR to support foveation.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/is_hand_interacti:
Returns true if OpenXR's hand interaction profile is supported and
enabled. Note: This only returns a valid value after OpenXR has been
initialized.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/is_hand_tracking_:
Returns true if OpenXR's hand tracking is supported and enabled. Note:
This only returns a valid value after OpenXR has been initialized.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/is_user_presence_:
Returns true if OpenXR's user presence extension is supported and
enabled. Note: This only returns a valid value after OpenXR has been
initialized.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/is_user_present:
Returns true if system has detected the presence of a user in the XR
experience.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/set_action_set_ac: Sets the given action set as active or inactive.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/set_cpu_level: Sets the CPU performance level of the OpenXR device.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/set_gpu_level: Sets the GPU performance level of the OpenXR device.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/method/set_motion_range:
If handtracking is enabled and motion range is supported, sets the
currently configured motion range for hand to motion_range.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/signal/cpu_level_changed:
Informs the device CPU performance level has changed in the specified
subdomain.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/signal/gpu_level_changed:
Informs the device GPU performance level has changed in the specified
subdomain.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/signal/instance_exiting: Informs our OpenXR instance is exiting.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/signal/pose_recentered: Informs the user queued a recenter of the player position.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/signal/refresh_rate_chan:
Informs the user the HMD refresh rate has changed. Note: Only emitted if
XR runtime supports the refresh rate extension.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/signal/session_begun: Informs our OpenXR session has been started.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/signal/session_focussed:
Informs our OpenXR session now has focus, for example output is sent to
the HMD and we're receiving XR input.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/signal/session_loss_pend: Informs our OpenXR session is in the process of being lost.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/signal/session_stopping: Informs our OpenXR session is stopping.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/signal/session_synchroni: Informs our OpenXR session has been synchronized.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/signal/session_visible:
Informs our OpenXR session is now visible, for example output is sent to
the HMD but we don't receive XR input.
descriptions.OpenXRInterface/signal/user_presence_cha:
Signal emitted when the user presence value changes. Note: This signal
will not be emitted during application startup and application shutdown.
Developers should assume user presence is gained on startup and lost on
shutdown.
descriptions.OpenXRMarkerTracker/method/get_marker_da:
Returns the marker data for this marker. This can return a String or
PackedByteArray. Only applicable to QR Code based markers.
descriptions.OpenXRMarkerTracker/method/set_marker_da:
Sets the marker data for this marker. Note: This should only be set by
marker discovery logic.
descriptions.OpenXRPlaneTracker/method/clear_mesh_dat:
Clears the mesh data for this tracker. You should only call this if you
are handling your own discovery logic.
descriptions.OpenXRPlaneTracker/method/get_mesh:
Gets a mesh created from either the mesh data or from our bounding size
for this plane.
descriptions.OpenXRPlaneTracker/method/get_mesh_offse:
Gets the transform by which to offset the mesh and collision shape from
our pose to display these correctly.
descriptions.OpenXRPlaneTracker/method/get_shape:
Gets a collision shape built either from the mesh data or from our
bounding size for this plane.
descriptions.OpenXRPlaneTracker/method/set_mesh_data:
Sets the mesh data for this plane. You should only call this if you are
handling your own discovery logic.
descriptions.OpenXRPlaneTracker/signal/mesh_changed:
Emitted when our mesh data has changed the mesh instance and collision
needs to be updated.
descriptions.OpenXRRenderModel/method/get_top_level_p: Returns the top level path related to this render model.
descriptions.OpenXRRenderModel/signal/render_model_to: Emitted when the top level path of this render model has changed.
descriptions.OpenXRRenderModelExtension/method/is_act:
Returns true if OpenXR's render model extension is supported and
enabled. Note: This only returns a valid value after OpenXR has been
initialized.
descriptions.OpenXRRenderModelExtension/method/render:
Creates a render model object within OpenXR using a render model id.
Note: This function is exposed for dependent OpenXR extensions that
provide render model ids to be used with the render model extension.

Destroys a render model object within OpenXR that was previously created
with render_model_create. Note: This function is exposed for dependent
OpenXR extensions that provide render model ids to be used with the
render model extension.

Returns an array of all currently active render models registered with
this extension.
Returns the number of animatable nodes this render model has.
Returns the name of the given animatable node.

Returns the current local transform for an animatable node. This is
updated every frame.

Returns the tracking confidence of the tracking data for the render
model.

Returns the root transform of a render model. This is the tracked
position relative to our XROrigin3D node.

Returns a list of active subaction paths for this render_model. Note: If
different devices are bound to your actions than available in suggested
interaction bindings, this information shows paths related to the
interaction bindings being mimicked by that device.

Returns the top level path associated with this render_model. If
provided this identifies whether the render model is associated with the
player's hands or other body part.
Returns true if this animatable node should be visible.

Returns an instance of a subscene that contains all MeshInstance3D nodes
that allow you to visualize the render model.
descriptions.OpenXRRenderModelExtension/signal/render: Emitted when a new render model is added.
Emitted when a render model is removed.
Emitted when the top level path associated with a render model changed.
descriptions.OpenXRRenderModelManager/signal/render_m: Emitted when a render model node is added as a child to this node.

Emitted when a render model child node is about to be removed from this
node.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialAnchorCapability/method/cre:
Calls create_persistence_context with a configuration that likely works
with the XR runtime. user_callback is called when the context is
created.

Creates a new anchor that will be tracked by the XR runtime. The
transform should be a transform in the local space of your XROrigin3D
node. If spatial_context is not specified the default will be used, this
requires
ProjectSettings.xr/openxr/extensions/spatial_entity/enable_builtin_anchor_detection
to be set. The returned tracker will track the location...

Creates a new persistence context for storing persistent data. Note:
This is an asynchronous method and returns an OpenXRFutureResult object
with which to track the status, discarding this object will not cancel
the creation process. On success user_callback will be called if
specified. The result value for this function is the RID for our
persistence...
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialAnchorCapability/method/do_:
Calls OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.update_spatial_entities and
OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.query_snapshot with the anchor entities
associated with spatial_context. component_data are the
OpenXRSpatialComponentDatas to update for this anchor capability. If
next_snapshot_create is non-null, then pass this to the next parameter
in...
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialAnchorCapability/method/fre:
Frees a persistence context previously created with
create_persistence_context.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialAnchorCapability/method/get:
Returns the internal handle for this persistence context. Note: For
GDExtension implementations.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialAnchorCapability/method/is_:
Returns true if this persistence scope is supported by our spatial
anchor capability. Note: Only valid after an OpenXR instance has been
created.

Returns true if spatial anchors are supported by the hardware. Only
returns a valid value after OpenXR has been initialized.

Returns true if persistent spatial anchors are supported by the
hardware. Only returns a valid value after OpenXR has been initialized.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialAnchorCapability/method/per:
Changes this anchor into a persistent anchor. This means its location
will be stored on the device and the anchor will be restored the next
time your application starts. If persistence_context is not specified
the default will be used, this requires
ProjectSettings.xr/openxr/extensions/spatial_entity/enable_builtin_anchor_detection
to be set. Note: This...
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialAnchorCapability/method/rem:
Remove an anchor previously created with create_new_anchor. If this
anchor was persistent you must first call unpersist_anchor and await its
callback.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialAnchorCapability/method/sta:
Calls OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.discover_spatial_entities and
OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.query_snapshot with the anchor entities
associated with spatial_context. component_data are the
OpenXRSpatialComponentDatas to discover for this anchor capability. If
next_snapshot_create is non-null, then pass this to the next parameter
in...
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialAnchorCapability/method/unp:
Removes the persistent data from this anchor. The runtime will not
recreate the anchor when your application restarts. If
persistence_context is not specified the default will be used, this
requires ProjectSettings.xr/openxr/extensions/spatial_entity/enabled to
be set. Note: This is an asynchronous method and returns an
OpenXRFutureResult object with...
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialCapabilityConfigurationAnch:
Returns the components enabled by this configuration. Note: Only valid
after this configuration was used to create a spatial context.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialCapabilityConfigurationApri:
Returns the components enabled by this configuration. Note: Only valid
after this configuration was used to create a spatial context.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialCapabilityConfigurationAruc:
Returns the components enabled by this configuration. Note: Only valid
after this configuration was used to create a spatial context.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBase:
Return a pointer (encoded as an int64_t) to a struct holding the spatial
capability configuration data. The memory for this struct should remain
accessible as long as this object remains instantiated.

Return true if this object contains a valid configuration that can be
retrieved when calling _get_configuration.

Gets a pointer to the XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT
struct. Note: This method is intended to be used from GDExtensions.

Returns true if this object contains a valid configuration that can be
used when calling OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.create_spatial_context.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialCapabilityConfigurationMicr:
Returns the components enabled by this configuration. Note: Only valid
after this configuration was used to create a spatial context.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialCapabilityConfigurationPlan:
Returns the components enabled by this configuration. Note: Only valid
after this configuration was used to create a spatial context.

Returns true if we support the plane semantic label component (only
valid after the OpenXR session has started). You can query these using
the OpenXRSpatialComponentPlaneSemanticLabelList data object.

Returns true if we support the mesh 2D component (only valid after the
OpenXR session has started). You can query these using the
OpenXRSpatialComponentMesh2DList data object.

Returns true if we support the polygon 2D component (only valid after
the OpenXR session has started). You can query these using the
OpenXRSpatialComponentPolygon2DList data object.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialCapabilityConfigurationQrCo:
Returns the components enabled by this configuration. Note: Only valid

descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentAnchorList/method/: Returns the transform for the entity at this index.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentBounded2DList/meth:
Returns the center of our bounding rectangle for the entity at this
index.
Returns the size of our bounding rectangle for the entity at this index.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentBounded3DList/meth: Returns the center of our bounding box for the entity at this index.
Returns the size of our bounding box for the entity at this index.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentData/method/_get_c: Return the component type for the component we store data for.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentData/method/_get_s:
Return a pointer to the structure data that will be submitted along with
the snapshot query. This pointer must remain valid as long as this
object is instantiated.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentData/method/_set_c:
Sets the expected capacity as provided by the spatial entities query
system. Buffers should be initialized with the correct storage.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentData/method/set_ca:
Sets the expected capacity as provided by the spatial entities query
system. Buffers should be initialized with the correct storage.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentMarkerList/method/:
Returns either a String or a PackedByteArray buffer with data for the
marker at this index. Only applicable for QR code markers.

Returns the marker ID for the marker at this index. Only applicable for
Aruco or April Tag markers.
Returns the marker type for the marker at this index.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentMesh2DList/method/: Returns the mesh indices for the entity at this index.

Returns the transform for positioning our mesh for the entity at this
index.
Returns the mesh vertices for the entity at this index.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentMesh3DList/method/: Returns the mesh for the entity at this index.

Returns the transform for positioning our mesh for the entity at this
index.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentParentList/method/: Returns the RID for the parent entity at this index.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentPersistenceList/me:
Returns the persistent state (XrSpatialPersistenceStateEXT) for the
entity at this index.
Returns the persistent uuid for the entity at this index.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentPlaneAlignmentList: Returns the plane alignment for the parent entity at this index.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentPlaneSemanticLabel: Returns the plane semantic label for the parent entity at this index.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialComponentPolygon2DList/meth:
Returns the transform for positioning our polygon for the entity at this
index.
Returns the polygon vertices for the entity at this index.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialContextPersistenceConfig/me:
Adds a persistence context to this configuration. You must add at least
one persistence context to create a valid configuration. You can create
a persistence context by calling
OpenXRSpatialAnchorCapability.create_persistence_context.

Gets the persistence context(s) (as RIDs) received by
add_persistence_context.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension/method/add_: Registers an entity that was created directly on the OpenXR runtime.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension/method/crea:
Creates a new spatial context that handles entities for the provided
capability configurations. capability_configurations is an array of
OpenXRSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeader with the needed
capability configuration data. next is an optional parameter that can
contain additional information for creating our spatial context. Note:
This is an...
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension/method/disc:
Starts a new discovery query, this will gather all objects tracked by
the spatial_context that have at least one of the component types
specified in component_types. next is an optional parameter that can
contain additional information for executing the discovery query. Note:
This is an asynchronous method and returns an OpenXRFutureResult object
with...

Convenience method when the caller only has an Array of
OpenXRSpatialComponentData and needs to discover spatial entities.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension/method/find: Returns the RID for the specified spatial entity ID.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension/method/free:
Frees a spatial context previously created when calling
create_spatial_context. If the spatial context creation is still
ongoing, the asynchronous process is cancelled.

Frees an entity previously created when calling add_spatial_entity or
make_spatial_entity.

Frees a spatial snapshot previously created when calling
discover_spatial_entities. If the spatial snapshot creation is still
ongoing, the asynchronous process is cancelled.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension/method/get_:
Returns a buffer with floats from a buffer that was retrieved when
taking a snapshot.

Returns the OpenXR spatial context handle for this snapshot. Note: This
method is intended to be used from GDExtensions that implement spatial
entity capability handlers.

Returns true if the spatial context finished its creation and is ready
to be used.
Returns the spatial context for this entity.
Returns the internal XrSpatialEntityIdEXT associated with the entity.
Returns the spatial context related to this spatial snapshot.

Returns the OpenXR spatial snapshot handle for this snapshot. Note: This
method is intended to be used from GDExtensions that implement spatial
entity capability handlers.

snapshot.

taking a snapshot.

descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension/method/make:
Creates a new entity for this entity_id. The spatial_context should
match the context that discovered the entity.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension/method/quer:
Queries the snapshot data. This will find all entities in the snapshot
that contain all requested components in component_data. The objects
held within component_data will then be populated with the queried data.
component_data must always have an object of
OpenXRSpatialQueryResultData as the first entry. next is an optional
parameter that can contain...
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension/method/supp:
Returns true if this spatial entity capability is supported by the
hardware used.
Returns true if this capability supports the component_type.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension/method/upda:
Performs a snapshot for a limited number of entities. This is NOT an
asynchronous method and will return the snapshot immediately.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension/signal/spat:
Emitted when OpenXR recommends running a discovery query because
entities managed by this spatial context have (likely) changed.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityTracker/method/add_ne:
Adds a new OpenXRStructureBase to the next-chain. get_next will return
this next until either add_next is called again or it's removed in
remove_next.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityTracker/method/get_ne:
Gets the head OpenXRStructureBase in the next-chain. See also add_next
and remove_next.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityTracker/method/get_sp: Gets the spatial context used to create this OpenXRSpatialEntityTracker.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityTracker/method/remove: Removes a next object previously added in add_next from the next-chain.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityTracker/method/set_sp: Sets the spatial context used to create this tracker.
descriptions.OpenXRSpatialEntityTracker/signal/next_c:
Emitted when the next-chain changes, from either add_next or
remove_next.

associated with spatial_context. component_data are the
OpenXRSpatialComponentDatas to update for this marker capability. If
next_snapshot_create is non-null, then pass this to the next parameter
in...

descriptions.OpenXRSpatialQueryResultData/method/get_: Returns the number of entities that were retrieved.

Returns the entity id (XrSpatialEntityIdEXT) for the entity at this
index.
Returns the entity state for the entity at this index.
descriptions.OpenXRStructureBase/method/get_structure:
Returns the structure type (OpenXR XrStructureType) used for this
structure.
descriptions.OptimizedTranslation/method/generate:
Generates and sets an optimized translation from the given Translation
resource. Returns true if successful. Note: Messages in from should not
use context or plural forms. Note: This method is intended to be used in
the editor. It does nothing when called from an exported project.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/add_icon_item:
Adds an item, with a texture icon, text label and (optionally) id. If no
id is passed, the item index will be used as the item's ID. New items
are appended at the end. Note: The item will be selected if there are no
other items.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/add_item:
Adds an item, with text label and (optionally) id. If no id is passed,
the item index will be used as the item's ID. New items are appended at
the end. Note: The item will be selected if there are no other items.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/add_separator:
Adds a separator to the list of items. Separators help to group items,
and can optionally be given a text header. A separator also gets an
index assigned, and is appended at the end of the item list.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/clear: Clears all the items in the OptionButton.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/get_item_auto_transl: Returns the auto translate mode of the item at index idx.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/get_item_icon: Returns the icon of the item at index idx.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/get_item_id: Returns the ID of the item at index idx.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/get_item_index: Returns the index of the item with the given id.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/get_item_metadata:
Retrieves the metadata of an item. Metadata may be any type and can be
used to store extra information about an item, such as an external
string ID.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/get_item_text: Returns the text of the item at index idx.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/get_item_tooltip: Returns the tooltip of the item at index idx.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/get_popup:
Returns the PopupMenu contained in this button. Warning: This is a
required internal node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If
you wish to hide it or any of its children, use their Window.visible
property.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/get_selectable_item:
Returns the index of the first item which is not disabled, or marked as
a separator. If from_last is true, the items will be searched in reverse
order. Returns -1 if no item is found.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/get_selected_id: Returns the ID of the selected item, or -1 if no item is selected.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/get_selected_metadat:
Gets the metadata of the selected item. Metadata for items can be set
using set_item_metadata.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/has_selectable_items:
Returns true if this button contains at least one item which is not
disabled, or marked as a separator.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/is_item_disabled: Returns true if the item at index idx is disabled.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/is_item_separator: Returns true if the item at index idx is marked as a separator.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/remove_item: Removes the item at index idx.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/select:
Selects an item by index and makes it the current item. This will work
even if the item is disabled. Passing -1 as the index deselects any
currently selected item.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/set_disable_shortcut:
If true, shortcuts are disabled and cannot be used to trigger the
button.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/set_item_auto_transl:
Sets the auto translate mode of the item at index idx. Items use
Node.AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_INHERIT by default, which uses the same auto
translate mode as the OptionButton itself.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/set_item_disabled:
Sets whether the item at index idx is disabled. Disabled items are drawn
differently in the dropdown and are not selectable by the user. If the
current selected item is set as disabled, it will remain selected.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/set_item_icon: Sets the icon of the item at index idx.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/set_item_id: Sets the ID of the item at index idx.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/set_item_metadata:
Sets the metadata of an item. Metadata may be of any type and can be
used to store extra information about an item, such as an external
string ID.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/set_item_text: Sets the text of the item at index idx.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/set_item_tooltip: Sets the tooltip of the item at index idx.
descriptions.OptionButton/method/show_popup:
Adjusts popup position and sizing for the OptionButton, then shows the
PopupMenu. Prefer this over using get_popup().popup().
descriptions.OptionButton/signal/item_focused:
Emitted when the user navigates to an item using the
ProjectSettings.input/ui_up or ProjectSettings.input/ui_down input
actions. The index of the item focused is passed as argument.
descriptions.OptionButton/signal/item_selected:
Emitted when the current item has been changed by the user. The index of
the item selected is passed as argument. allow_reselect must be enabled
to reselect an item.
descriptions.PCKPacker/method/add_file:
Adds the source_path file to the current PCK package at the target_path
internal path. The res:// prefix for target_path is optional and
stripped internally. File content is immediately written to the PCK.
descriptions.PCKPacker/method/add_file_from_buffer:
Adds the data to the current PCK package at the target_path internal
path. The res:// prefix for target_path is optional and stripped
internally. File content is immediately written to the PCK.
descriptions.PCKPacker/method/add_file_removal:
Registers a file removal of the target_path internal path to the PCK.
This is mainly used for patches. If the file at this path has been
loaded from a previous PCK, it will be removed. The res:// prefix for
target_path is optional and stripped internally.
descriptions.PCKPacker/method/flush:
Writes the file directory and closes the PCK. If verbose is true, a list
of files added will be printed to the console for easier debugging.
Note: PCKPacker will automatically flush when it's freed, which happens
when it goes out of scope or when it gets assigned with null. In C# the
reference must be disposed after use, either with the using statement...
descriptions.PCKPacker/method/pck_start:
Creates a new PCK file at the file path pck_path. The .pck file
extension isn't added automatically, so it should be part of pck_path
(even though it's not required).
descriptions.PackedByteArray/method/append: Appends an element at the end of the array (alias of push_back).
descriptions.PackedByteArray/method/append_array: Appends a PackedByteArray at the end of this array.
descriptions.PackedByteArray/method/bsearch:
Finds the index of an existing value (or the insertion index that
maintains sorting order, if the value is not yet present in the array)
using binary search. Optionally, a before specifier can be passed. If

modified.

modified.

multiple of 8, bytes after the last processed 64-bit segment are not
modified.

descriptions.PacketPeer/method/get_available_packet_c: Returns the number of packets currently available in the ring-buffer.

Returns the error state of the last packet received (via get_packet and
get_var).
descriptions.PacketPeer/method/get_var:
Gets a Variant. If allow_objects is true, decoding objects is allowed.
Internally, this uses the same decoding mechanism as the
@GlobalScope.bytes_to_var method. Warning: Deserialized objects can
contain code which gets executed. Do not use this option if the
serialized object comes from untrusted sources to avoid potential
security threats such as...
descriptions.PacketPeer/method/put_var:
Sends a Variant as a packet. If full_objects is true, encoding objects
is allowed (and can potentially include code). Internally, this uses the
same encoding mechanism as the @GlobalScope.var_to_bytes method.
descriptions.PacketPeerDTLS/method/connect_to_peer:
Connects a packet_peer beginning the DTLS handshake using the underlying
PacketPeerUDP which must be connected (see
PacketPeerUDP.connect_to_host). You can optionally specify the
client_options to be used while verifying the TLS connections. See
TLSOptions.client and TLSOptions.client_unsafe.
descriptions.PacketPeerDTLS/method/disconnect_from_pe: Disconnects this peer, terminating the DTLS session.
descriptions.PacketPeerDTLS/method/get_status: Returns the status of the connection.
descriptions.PacketPeerDTLS/method/poll:
Poll the connection to check for incoming packets. Call this frequently
to update the status and keep the connection working.
descriptions.PacketPeerUDP/method/bind:
Binds this PacketPeerUDP to the specified port and bind_address with a
buffer size recv_buf_size, allowing it to receive incoming packets. If
bind_address is set to "*" (default), the peer will be bound on all
available addresses (both IPv4 and IPv6). If bind_address is set to
"0.0.0.0" (for IPv4) or "::" (for IPv6), the peer will be bound to
all...
descriptions.PacketPeerUDP/method/close: Closes the PacketPeerUDP's underlying UDP socket.
descriptions.PacketPeerUDP/method/connect_to_host:
Calling this method connects this UDP peer to the given host/port pair.
UDP is in reality connectionless, so this option only means that
incoming packets from different addresses are automatically discarded,
and that outgoing packets are always sent to the connected address
(future calls to set_dest_address are not allowed). This method does not
send any...
descriptions.PacketPeerUDP/method/get_local_port: Returns the local port to which this peer is bound.
descriptions.PacketPeerUDP/method/get_packet_ip:
Returns the IP of the remote peer that sent the last packet(that was
received with PacketPeer.get_packet or PacketPeer.get_var).
descriptions.PacketPeerUDP/method/get_packet_port:
Returns the port of the remote peer that sent the last packet(that was
received with PacketPeer.get_packet or PacketPeer.get_var).
descriptions.PacketPeerUDP/method/is_bound:
Returns whether this PacketPeerUDP is bound to an address and can
receive packets.
descriptions.PacketPeerUDP/method/is_socket_connected:
Returns true if the UDP socket is open and has been connected to a
remote address. See connect_to_host.
descriptions.PacketPeerUDP/method/join_multicast_grou:
Joins the multicast group specified by multicast_address using the
interface identified by interface_name. You can join the same multicast
group with multiple interfaces. Use IP.get_local_interfaces to know
which are available. Note: Some Android devices might require the
CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE permission for multicast to work.
descriptions.PacketPeerUDP/method/leave_multicast_gro:
Removes the interface identified by interface_name from the multicast
group specified by multicast_address.
descriptions.PacketPeerUDP/method/set_broadcast_enabl:
Enable or disable sending of broadcast packets (e.g.
set_dest_address("255.255.255.255", 4343). This option is disabled by
default. Note: Some Android devices might require the
CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE permission and this option to be enabled to
receive broadcast packets too.
descriptions.PacketPeerUDP/method/set_dest_address:
Sets the destination address and port for sending packets and variables.
A hostname will be resolved using DNS if needed. Note:
set_broadcast_enabled must be enabled before sending packets to a
broadcast address (e.g. 255.255.255.255).
descriptions.PacketPeerUDP/method/wait:

can't be interrupted once it has been called. This can be worked around

component corresponds to maximum.

descriptions.ParticleProcessMaterial/signal/emission_:
Emitted when this material's emission shape is changed in any way. This
includes changes to emission_shape, emission_shape_scale, or
emission_sphere_radius, and any other property that affects the emission
shape's offset, size, scale, or orientation. Note: This signal is only
emitted inside the editor for performance reasons.
descriptions.PathFollow3D/method/correct_posture:
Correct the transform. rotation_mode implicitly specifies how posture
(forward, up and sideway direction) is calculated.
descriptions.Performance/method/add_custom_monitor:
Adds a custom monitor with the name id. You can specify the category of
the monitor using slash delimiters in id (for example:
"Game/NumberOfNPCs"). If there is more than one slash delimiter, then
the default category is used. The default category is "Custom". Prints
an error if given id is already present.
descriptions.Performance/method/get_custom_monitor:
Returns the value of custom monitor with given id. The callable is
called to get the value of custom monitor. See also has_custom_monitor.
Prints an error if the given id is absent.
descriptions.Performance/method/get_custom_monitor_na: Returns the names of active custom monitors in an Array.
descriptions.Performance/method/get_custom_monitor_ty: Returns the MonitorType values of active custom monitors in an Array.
descriptions.Performance/method/get_monitor:
Returns the value of one of the available built-in monitors. You should
provide one of the Monitor constants as the argument, like this:
descriptions.Performance/method/get_monitor_modificat:
Returns the last tick in which custom monitor was added/removed (in
microseconds since the engine started). This is set to
Time.get_ticks_usec when the monitor is updated.
descriptions.Performance/method/has_custom_monitor:
Returns true if custom monitor with the given id is present, false
otherwise.
descriptions.Performance/method/remove_custom_monitor:
Removes the custom monitor with given id. Prints an error if the given
id is already absent.
descriptions.PhysicalBone2D/method/get_joint:
Returns the first Joint2D child node, if one exists. This is mainly a
helper function to make it easier to get the Joint2D that the

descriptions.PhysicalBone2D/method/is_simulating_phys:
Returns a boolean that indicates whether the PhysicalBone2D is running
and simulating using the Godot 2D physics engine. When true, the
PhysicalBone2D node is using physics.
descriptions.PhysicalBone3D/method/_integrate_forces:
Called during physics processing, allowing you to read and safely modify
the simulation state for the object. By default, it is called before the
standard force integration, but the custom_integrator property allows
you to disable the standard force integration and do fully custom force
integration for a body.

time-independent! Applying an impulse every frame would result in a
framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it should only be used when

descriptions.PhysicalBone3D/method/apply_impulse:
Applies a positioned impulse to the PhysicsBone3D. An impulse is
time-independent! Applying an impulse every frame would result in a
framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it should only be used when
simulating one-time impacts (use the "_integrate_forces" functions
otherwise). position is the offset from the PhysicsBone3D origin in
global coordinates.
descriptions.PhysicalBone3D/method/get_bone_id: Returns the unique identifier of the PhysicsBone3D.
descriptions.PhysicalBone3D/method/get_simulate_physi: Returns true if the PhysicsBone3D is allowed to simulate physics.
descriptions.PhysicalBone3D/method/is_simulating_phys: Returns true if the PhysicsBone3D is currently simulating physics.
descriptions.PhysicalBoneSimulator3D/method/is_simula:

running and simulating.
descriptions.PhysicalBoneSimulator3D/method/physical_:

body...
descriptions.PhysicsBody3D/method/add_collision_excep: Adds a body to the list of bodies that this body can't collide with.

descriptions.PhysicsDirectBodyState2D/method/get_velo:

descriptions.PhysicsDirectBodyState2D/method/integrat:
Updates the body's linear and angular velocity by applying gravity and
damping for the equivalent of one physics tick.
descriptions.PhysicsDirectBodyState2D/method/set_cons:
Sets the body's total constant positional forces applied during each

Sets the body's total constant rotational forces applied during each

Sets which physics layers the area will monitor, via a bitmask.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/area_set_monitor_:
Sets the area's body monitor callback. This callback will be called when
any other (shape of a) body enters or exits (a shape of) the given area,
and must take the following five parameters: 1. an integer status:
either AREA_BODY_ADDED or AREA_BODY_REMOVED depending on whether the
other body shape entered or exited the area, 2. an RID body_rid: the
RID...
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/area_set_monitora:
Sets whether the area is monitorable or not. If monitorable is true, the
area monitoring callback of other areas will be called when this area
enters or exits them.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/area_set_param: Sets the value of the given area parameter.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/area_set_shape:
Replaces the area's shape at the given index by another shape, while not
affecting the transform and disabled properties at the same index.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/area_set_shape_di:
Sets the disabled property of the area's shape with the given index. If
disabled is true, then the shape will not detect any other shapes
entering or exiting it.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/area_set_shape_tr:
Sets the local transform matrix of the area's shape with the given
index.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/area_set_space:
Adds the area to the given space, after removing the area from the
previously assigned space (if any). Note: To remove an area from a space
without immediately adding it back elsewhere, use
PhysicsServer2D.area_set_space(area, RID()).
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/area_set_transfor: Sets the transform matrix of the area.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_add_collisio:
Adds excepted_body to the body's list of collision exceptions, so that
collisions with it are ignored.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_add_constant:
Adds a constant directional force to the body. The force does not affect
rotation. The force remains applied over time until cleared with
PhysicsServer2D.body_set_constant_force(body, Vector2(0, 0)). This is
equivalent to using body_add_constant_force at the body's center of
mass.

Adds a constant positioned force to the body. The force can affect
rotation if position is different from the body's center of mass. The
force remains applied over time until cleared with
PhysicsServer2D.body_set_constant_force(body, Vector2(0, 0)). position
is the offset from the body origin in global coordinates.

Adds a constant rotational force to the body. The force does not affect
position. The force remains applied over time until cleared with
PhysicsServer2D.body_set_constant_torque(body, 0).
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_add_shape:
Adds a shape to the area, with the given local transform. The shape
(together with its transform and disabled properties) is added to an
array of shapes, and the shapes of a body are usually referenced by
their index in this array.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_apply_centra:
Applies a directional force to the body, at the body's center of mass.
The force does not affect rotation. A force is time dependent and meant
to be applied every physics update. This is equivalent to using
body_apply_force at the body's center of mass.

Applies a directional impulse to the body, at the body's center of mass.
The impulse does not affect rotation. An impulse is time-independent!
Applying an impulse every frame would result in a framerate-dependent
force. For this reason, it should only be used when simulating one-time
impacts (use the "_force" functions otherwise). This is equivalent to...
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_apply_force:
Applies a positioned force to the body. The force can affect rotation if
position is different from the body's center of mass. A force is time
dependent and meant to be applied every physics update. position is the
offset from the body origin in global coordinates.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_apply_impuls:
Applies a positioned impulse to the body. The impulse can affect
rotation if position is different from the body's center of mass. An
impulse is time-independent! Applying an impulse every frame would
result in a framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it should only
be used when simulating one-time impacts (use the "_force" functions
otherwise)....
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_apply_torque:
Applies a rotational force to the body. The force does not affect
position. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every
physics update.

Applies a rotational impulse to the body. The impulse does not affect
position. An impulse is time-independent! Applying an impulse every
frame would result in a framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it
should only be used when simulating one-time impacts (use the "_force"
functions otherwise).
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_attach_canva:
Attaches the ObjectID of a canvas to the body. Use
Object.get_instance_id to get the ObjectID of a CanvasLayer.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_attach_objec:
Attaches the ObjectID of an Object to the body. Use
Object.get_instance_id to get the ObjectID of a CollisionObject2D.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_clear_shapes:
Removes all shapes from the body. This does not delete the shapes
themselves, so they can continue to be used elsewhere or added back
later.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_create:
Creates a 2D body object in the physics server, and returns the RID that
identifies it. The default settings for the created area include a
collision layer and mask set to 1, and body mode set to BODY_MODE_RIGID.
Use body_add_shape to add shapes to it, use body_set_state to set its
transform, and use body_set_space to add the body to a space.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_get_collisio: Returns the physics layer or layers the body belongs to, as a bitmask.

Returns the physics layer or layers the body can collide with, as a
bitmask.

Returns the body's collision priority. This is used in the depenetration
phase of body_test_motion. The higher the priority is, the lower the
penetration into the body will be.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_get_constant:
Returns the body's total constant positional force applied during each
physics update. See body_add_constant_force and
body_add_constant_central_force.

Returns the body's total constant rotational force applied during each
physics update. See body_add_constant_torque.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_get_continuo: Returns the body's continuous collision detection mode.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_get_direct_s:
Returns the PhysicsDirectBodyState2D of the body. Returns null if the
body is destroyed or not assigned to a space.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_get_max_cont:
Returns the maximum number of contacts that the body can report. See
body_set_max_contacts_reported.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_get_param: Returns the value of the given body parameter.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_get_shape:
Returns the RID of the shape with the given index in the body's array of
shapes.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_get_shape_co: Returns the number of shapes added to the body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_get_shape_tr:
Returns the local transform matrix of the shape with the given index in
the area's array of shapes.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_get_space:
Returns the RID of the space assigned to the body. Returns an empty RID
if no space is assigned.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_get_state: Returns the value of the given state of the body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_is_omitting_:
Returns true if the body is omitting the standard force integration. See
body_set_omit_force_integration.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_remove_colli:
Removes excepted_body from the body's list of collision exceptions, so
that collisions with it are no longer ignored.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_remove_shape:
Removes the shape with the given index from the body's array of shapes.
The shape itself is not deleted, so it can continue to be used elsewhere
or added back later. As a result of this operation, the body's shapes
which used to have indices higher than shape_idx will have their index
decreased by one.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_reset_mass_p:
Restores the default inertia and center of mass of the body based on its
shapes. This undoes any custom values previously set using
body_set_param.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_axis_vel:
Modifies the body's linear velocity so that its projection to the axis
axis_velocity.normalized() is exactly axis_velocity.length(). This is
useful for jumping behavior.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_collisio: Sets the physics layer or layers the body belongs to, via a bitmask.

Sets the physics layer or layers the body can collide with, via a
bitmask.

Sets the body's collision priority. This is used in the depenetration
phase of body_test_motion. The higher the priority is, the lower the
penetration into the body will be.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_constant:
Sets the body's total constant positional force applied during each
physics update. See body_add_constant_force and
body_add_constant_central_force.

Sets the body's total constant rotational force applied during each
physics update. See body_add_constant_torque.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_continuo:
Sets the continuous collision detection mode. Continuous collision
detection tries to predict where a moving body would collide in between
physics updates, instead of moving it and correcting its movement if it
collided.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_force_in:
Sets the body's custom force integration callback function to callable.
Use an empty Callable (Callable()) to clear the custom callback. The
function callable will be called every physics tick, before the standard
force integration (see body_set_omit_force_integration). It can be used
for example to update the body's linear and angular velocity based on...
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_max_cont:
Sets the maximum number of contacts that the body can report. If amount
is greater than zero, then the body will keep track of at most this many
contacts with other bodies.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_omit_for:
Sets whether the body omits the standard force integration. If enable is
true, the body will not automatically use applied forces, torques, and
damping to update the body's linear and angular velocity. In this case,
body_set_force_integration_callback can be used to manually update the
linear and angular velocity instead. This method is called when the...
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_param: Sets the value of the given body parameter.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_shape:
Replaces the body's shape at the given index by another shape, while not
affecting the transform, disabled, and one-way collision properties at
the same index.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_shape_as:
Sets the one-way collision properties of the body's shape with the given
index. If enable is true, the one-way collision direction given by
direction in the shape's local space (that is
body_get_shape_transform(body,
shape_idx).basis_xform(direction).normalized() in the body's local
space) will be used to ignore collisions with the shape in the
opposite...
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_shape_di:
Sets the disabled property of the body's shape with the given index. If
disabled is true, then the shape will be ignored in all collision
detection.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_shape_tr:
Sets the local transform matrix of the body's shape with the given
index.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_space:
Adds the body to the given space, after removing the body from the
previously assigned space (if any). If the body's mode is set to
BODY_MODE_RIGID, then adding the body to a space will have the following
additional effects: - If the parameter BODY_PARAM_CENTER_OF_MASS has
never been set explicitly, then the value of that parameter will be
recalculated...
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_state:
Sets the value of a body's state. Note: The state change doesn't take
effect immediately. The state will change on the next physics frame.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_set_state_sy:
Sets the body's state synchronization callback function to callable. Use
an empty Callable (Callable()) to clear the callback. The function
callable will be called every physics frame, assuming that the body was
active during the previous physics tick, and can be used to fetch the
latest state from the physics server. The function callable must take
the...
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/body_test_motion:
Returns true if a collision would result from moving the body along a
motion vector from a given point in space. See
PhysicsTestMotionParameters2D for the available motion parameters.
Optionally a PhysicsTestMotionResult2D object can be passed, which will
be used to store the information about the resulting collision.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/capsule_shape_cre:
Creates a 2D capsule shape in the physics server, and returns the RID
that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the capsule's height and
radius.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/circle_shape_crea:
Creates a 2D circle shape in the physics server, and returns the RID
that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the circle's radius.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/concave_polygon_s:
Creates a 2D concave polygon shape in the physics server, and returns
the RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the concave
polygon's segments.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/convex_polygon_sh:
Creates a 2D convex polygon shape in the physics server, and returns the
RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the convex polygon's
points.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/damped_spring_joi: Returns the value of the given damped spring joint parameter.
Sets the value of the given damped spring joint parameter.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/free_rid:
Destroys any of the objects created by PhysicsServer2D. If the RID
passed is not one of the objects that can be created by PhysicsServer2D,
an error will be printed to the console.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/get_process_info: Returns the value of a physics engine state specified by process_info.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/joint_clear:
Destroys the joint with the given RID, creates a new uninitialized
joint, and makes the RID refer to this new joint.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/joint_create:
Creates a 2D joint in the physics server, and returns the RID that
identifies it. To set the joint type, use joint_make_damped_spring,
joint_make_groove or joint_make_pin. Use joint_set_param to set generic
joint parameters.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/joint_disable_col:
Sets whether the bodies attached to the Joint2D will collide with each
other.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/joint_get_param: Returns the value of the given joint parameter.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/joint_is_disabled:
Returns whether the bodies attached to the Joint2D will collide with
each other.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/joint_make_damped:
Makes the joint a damped spring joint, attached at the point anchor_a
(given in global coordinates) on the body body_a and at the point
anchor_b (given in global coordinates) on the body body_b. To set the
parameters which are specific to the damped spring, see
damped_spring_joint_set_param.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/joint_make_groove: Makes the joint a groove joint.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/joint_make_pin:
Makes the joint a pin joint. If body_b is an empty RID, then body_a is
pinned to the point anchor (given in global coordinates); otherwise,
body_a is pinned to body_b at the point anchor (given in global
coordinates). To set the parameters which are specific to the pin joint,
see pin_joint_set_param.
