descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/joint_set_param: Sets the value of the given joint parameter.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/pin_joint_get_par: Returns the value of a pin joint parameter.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/rectangle_shape_c:
Creates a 2D rectangle shape in the physics server, and returns the RID
that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the rectangle's
half-extents.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/segment_shape_cre:
Creates a 2D segment shape in the physics server, and returns the RID
that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the segment's start and
end points.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/separation_ray_sh:
Creates a 2D separation ray shape in the physics server, and returns the
RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the shape's length and
slide_on_slope properties.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/set_active:
Activates or deactivates the 2D physics server. If active is false, then
the physics server will not do anything in its physics step.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/shape_get_data:
Returns the shape data that defines the configuration of the shape, such
as the half-extents of a rectangle or the segments of a concave shape.
See shape_set_data for the precise format of this data in each case.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/shape_set_data:
Sets the shape data that defines the configuration of the shape. The
data to be passed depends on the shape's type (see shape_get_type): -
SHAPE_WORLD_BOUNDARY: an array of length two containing a Vector2 normal
direction and a float distance d, - SHAPE_SEPARATION_RAY: a dictionary
containing the key length with a float value and the key
slide_on_slope...
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/space_create:
Creates a 2D space in the physics server, and returns the RID that
identifies it. A space contains bodies and areas, and controls the
stepping of the physics simulation of the objects in it.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/space_get_direct_:
Returns the state of a space, a PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D. This object
can be used for collision/intersection queries.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/space_get_param: Returns the value of the given space parameter.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/space_is_active: Returns true if the space is active.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/space_set_active:
Activates or deactivates the space. If active is false, then the physics
server will not do anything with this space in its physics step.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/space_set_param: Sets the value of the given space parameter.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2D/method/world_boundary_sh:
Creates a 2D world boundary shape in the physics server, and returns the
RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the shape's normal
direction and distance properties.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_area_se:
If set to true, allows the area with the given RID to detect mouse
inputs when the mouse cursor is hovering on it. Overridable version of
PhysicsServer2D's internal area_set_pickable method. Corresponds to
CollisionObject2D.input_pickable.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_body_co:
Given a body, a shape, and their respective parameters, this method
should return true if a collision between the two would occur, with
additional details passed in r_results. Overridable version of
PhysicsServer2D's internal shape_collide method. Corresponds to
PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D.collide_shape.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_body_ge:
Returns the RIDs of all bodies added as collision exceptions for the
given body. See also _body_add_collision_exception and
_body_remove_collision_exception. Overridable version of
PhysicsServer2D's internal body_get_collision_exceptions method.
Corresponds to PhysicsBody2D.get_collision_exceptions.

Overridable version of PhysicsServer2D's internal
body_get_contacts_reported_depth_threshold method. Note: This method is
currently unused by Godot's default physics implementation.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_body_se:
Overridable version of PhysicsServer2D's internal
body_set_contacts_reported_depth_threshold method. Note: This method is
currently unused by Godot's default physics implementation.

If set to true, allows the body with the given RID to detect mouse
inputs when the mouse cursor is hovering on it. Overridable version of
PhysicsServer2D's internal body_set_pickable method. Corresponds to
CollisionObject2D.input_pickable.

Assigns the body to call the given callable during the synchronization
phase of the loop, before _step is called. See also _sync. Overridable
version of PhysicsServer2D.body_set_state_sync_callback.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_body_te:
Overridable version of PhysicsServer2D.body_test_motion. Unlike the
exposed implementation, this method does not receive all of the
arguments inside a PhysicsTestMotionParameters2D.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_end_syn:
Called to indicate that the physics server has stopped synchronizing. It
is in the loop's iteration/physics phase, and can access physics objects
even if running on a separate thread. See also _sync. Overridable
version of PhysicsServer2D's internal end_sync method.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_finish:
Called when the main loop finalizes to shut down the physics server. See
also MainLoop._finalize and _init. Overridable version of
PhysicsServer2D's internal finish method.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_flush_q:
Called every physics step before _step to process all remaining queries.
Overridable version of PhysicsServer2D's internal flush_queries method.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_init:
Called when the main loop is initialized and creates a new instance of
this physics server. See also MainLoop._initialize and _finish.
Overridable version of PhysicsServer2D's internal init method.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_is_flus:
Overridable method that should return true when the physics server is
processing queries. See also _flush_queries. Overridable version of
PhysicsServer2D's internal is_flushing_queries method.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_shape_c:
Given two shapes and their parameters, should return true if a collision
between the two would occur, with additional details passed in
r_results. Overridable version of PhysicsServer2D's internal
shape_collide method. Corresponds to
PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D.collide_shape.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_shape_g:
Should return the custom solver bias of the given shape, which defines
how much bodies are forced to separate on contact when this shape is
involved. Overridable version of PhysicsServer2D's internal
shape_get_custom_solver_bias method. Corresponds to
Shape2D.custom_solver_bias.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_shape_s:
Should set the custom solver bias for the given shape. It defines how
much bodies are forced to separate on contact. Overridable version of
PhysicsServer2D's internal shape_get_custom_solver_bias method.
Corresponds to Shape2D.custom_solver_bias.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_space_g:
Should return how many contacts have occurred during the last physics
step in the given space. See also _space_get_contacts and
_space_set_debug_contacts. Overridable version of PhysicsServer2D's
internal space_get_contact_count method.

Should return the positions of all contacts that have occurred during
the last physics step in the given space. See also
_space_get_contact_count and _space_set_debug_contacts. Overridable
version of PhysicsServer2D's internal space_get_contacts method.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_space_s:
Used internally to allow the given space to store contact points, up to
max_contacts. This is automatically set for the main World2D's space
when SceneTree.debug_collisions_hint is true, or by checking "Visible
Collision Shapes" in the editor. Only works in debug builds. Overridable
version of PhysicsServer2D's internal space_set_debug_contacts method.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_step:
Called every physics step to process the physics simulation. step is the
time elapsed since the last physics step, in seconds. It is usually the
same as the value returned by Node.get_physics_process_delta_time.
Overridable version of PhysicsServer2D's internal step method.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/_sync:
Called to indicate that the physics server is synchronizing and cannot
access physics states if running on a separate thread. See also
_end_sync. Overridable version of PhysicsServer2D's internal sync
method.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DExtension/method/body_tes:
Returns true if the body with the given RID is being excluded from
_body_test_motion. See also Object.get_instance_id.

Returns true if the object with the given instance ID is being excluded
from _body_test_motion. See also Object.get_instance_id.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DManager/method/register_s:
Register a PhysicsServer2D implementation by passing a name and a
Callable that returns a PhysicsServer2D object.
descriptions.PhysicsServer2DManager/method/set_defaul:
Set the default PhysicsServer2D implementation to the one identified by
name, if priority is greater than the priority of the current default
implementation.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_add_shape:
Adds a shape to the area, along with a transform matrix. Shapes are
usually referenced by their index, so you should track which shape has a
given index.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_attach_objec:
Assigns the area to a descendant of Object, so it can exist in the node
tree.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_clear_shapes:
Removes all shapes from an area. It does not delete the shapes, so they
can be reassigned later.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_create:
Creates a 3D area object in the physics server, and returns the RID that
identifies it. The default settings for the created area include a
collision layer and mask set to 1, and monitorable set to false. Use
area_add_shape to add shapes to it, use area_set_transform to set its
transform, and use area_set_space to add the area to a space. If you
want the...
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_get_collisio: Returns the physics layer or layers an area belongs to.
Returns the physics layer or layers an area can contact with.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_get_object_i: Gets the instance ID of the object the area is assigned to.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_get_param:
Returns an area parameter value. A list of available parameters is on
the AreaParameter constants.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_get_shape: Returns the RID of the nth shape of an area.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_get_shape_co: Returns the number of shapes assigned to an area.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_get_shape_tr: Returns the transform matrix of a shape within an area.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_get_space: Returns the space assigned to the area.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_get_transfor: Returns the transform matrix for an area.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_remove_shape:
Removes a shape from an area. It does not delete the shape, so it can be
reassigned later.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_set_area_mon:
Sets the area's area monitor callback. This callback will be called when
any other (shape of an) area enters or exits (a shape of) the given
area, and must take the following five parameters: 1. an integer status:
either AREA_BODY_ADDED or AREA_BODY_REMOVED depending on whether the
other area's shape entered or exited the area, 2. an RID area_rid:
the...
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_set_collisio: Assigns the area to one or many physics layers.
Sets which physics layers the area will monitor.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_set_monitor_:
Sets the area's body monitor callback. This callback will be called when
any other (shape of a) body enters or exits (a shape of) the given area,
and must take the following five parameters: 1. an integer status:
either AREA_BODY_ADDED or AREA_BODY_REMOVED depending on whether the
other body shape entered or exited the area, 2. an RID body_rid: the
RID...
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_set_param:
Sets the value for an area parameter. A list of available parameters is
on the AreaParameter constants.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_set_shape:
Substitutes a given area shape by another. The old shape is selected by
its index, the new one by its RID.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_set_shape_tr: Sets the transform matrix for an area shape.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_set_space: Assigns a space to the area.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/area_set_transfor: Sets the transform matrix for an area.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_add_collisio: Adds a body to the list of bodies exempt from collisions.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_add_constant:
Adds a constant directional force without affecting rotation that keeps
being applied over time until cleared with body_set_constant_force(body,
Vector3(0, 0, 0)). This is equivalent to using body_add_constant_force
at the body's center of mass.

Adds a constant positioned force to the body that keeps being applied
over time until cleared with body_set_constant_force(body, Vector3(0, 0,
0)). position is the offset from the body origin in global coordinates.

Adds a constant rotational force without affecting position that keeps
being applied over time until cleared with
body_set_constant_torque(body, Vector3(0, 0, 0)).
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_add_shape:
Adds a shape to the body, along with a transform matrix. Shapes are
usually referenced by their index, so you should track which shape has a
given index.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_apply_centra:
Applies a directional force without affecting rotation. A force is time
dependent and meant to be applied every physics update. This is
equivalent to using body_apply_force at the body's center of mass.

Applies a directional impulse without affecting rotation. An impulse is
time-independent! Applying an impulse every frame would result in a
framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it should only be used when
simulating one-time impacts (use the "_force" functions otherwise). This
is equivalent to using body_apply_impulse at the body's center of mass.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_apply_force:
Applies a positioned force to the body. A force is time dependent and
meant to be applied every physics update. position is the offset from
the body origin in global coordinates.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_apply_impuls:
Applies a positioned impulse to the body. An impulse is
time-independent! Applying an impulse every frame would result in a
framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it should only be used when
simulating one-time impacts (use the "_force" functions otherwise).
position is the offset from the body origin in global coordinates.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_apply_torque:
Applies a rotational force without affecting position. A force is time
dependent and meant to be applied every physics update.

Applies a rotational impulse to the body without affecting the position.
An impulse is time-independent! Applying an impulse every frame would
result in a framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it should only
be used when simulating one-time impacts (use the "_force" functions
otherwise).
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_attach_objec:
Assigns the area to a descendant of Object, so it can exist in the node
tree.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_clear_shapes: Removes all shapes from a body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_create:
Creates a 3D body object in the physics server, and returns the RID that
identifies it. The default settings for the created area include a
collision layer and mask set to 1, and body mode set to BODY_MODE_RIGID.
Use body_add_shape to add shapes to it, use body_set_state to set its
transform, and use body_set_space to add the body to a space.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_get_collisio: Returns the physics layer or layers a body belongs to.
Returns the physics layer or layers a body can collide with.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_get_constant:
Returns the body's total constant positional forces applied during each
physics update. See body_add_constant_force and
body_add_constant_central_force.

Returns the body's total constant rotational forces applied during each
physics update. See body_add_constant_torque.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_get_direct_s:
Returns the PhysicsDirectBodyState3D of the body. Returns null if the
body is destroyed or removed from the physics space.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_get_max_cont:
Returns the maximum contacts that can be reported. See
body_set_max_contacts_reported.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_get_object_i: Gets the instance ID of the object the area is assigned to.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_get_param:
Returns the value of a body parameter. A list of available parameters is
on the BodyParameter constants.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_get_shape: Returns the RID of the nth shape of a body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_get_shape_co: Returns the number of shapes assigned to a body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_get_shape_tr: Returns the transform matrix of a body shape.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_get_space: Returns the RID of the space assigned to a body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_is_continuou: If true, the continuous collision detection mode is enabled.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_is_omitting_:
Returns true if the body is omitting the standard force integration. See
body_set_omit_force_integration.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_remove_colli:
Removes a body from the list of bodies exempt from collisions.
Continuous collision detection tries to predict where a moving body will
collide, instead of moving it and correcting its movement if it
collided.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_remove_shape:
Removes a shape from a body. The shape is not deleted, so it can be
reused afterwards.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_reset_mass_p:
Restores the default inertia and center of mass based on shapes to
cancel any custom values previously set using body_set_param.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_set_axis_vel:
Sets an axis velocity. The velocity in the given vector axis will be set
as the given vector length. This is useful for jumping behavior.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_set_collisio: Sets the physics layer or layers a body belongs to.
Sets the physics layer or layers a body can collide with.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_set_constant:
Sets the body's total constant positional forces applied during each
physics update. See body_add_constant_force and
body_add_constant_central_force.

Sets the body's total constant rotational forces applied during each
physics update. See body_add_constant_torque.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_set_enable_c:
If true, the continuous collision detection mode is enabled. Continuous
collision detection tries to predict where a moving body will collide,
instead of moving it and correcting its movement if it collided.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_set_force_in:
Sets the body's custom force integration callback function to callable.
Use an empty Callable (Callable()) to clear the custom callback. The
function callable will be called every physics tick, before the standard
force integration (see body_set_omit_force_integration). It can be used
for example to update the body's linear and angular velocity based on...
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_set_max_cont:
Sets the maximum contacts to report. Bodies can keep a log of the
contacts with other bodies. This is enabled by setting the maximum
number of contacts reported to a number greater than 0.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_set_omit_for:
Sets whether the body omits the standard force integration. If enable is
true, the body will not automatically use applied forces, torques, and
damping to update the body's linear and angular velocity. In this case,
body_set_force_integration_callback can be used to manually update the
linear and angular velocity instead. This method is called when the...
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_set_param:
Sets a body parameter. A list of available parameters is on the
BodyParameter constants.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_set_ray_pick: Sets the body pickable with rays if enable is set.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_set_shape:
Substitutes a given body shape by another. The old shape is selected by
its index, the new one by its RID.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_set_shape_tr: Sets the transform matrix for a body shape.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_set_space: Assigns a space to the body (see space_create).
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_set_state_sy:
Sets the body's state synchronization callback function to callable. Use
an empty Callable (Callable()) to clear the callback. The function
callable will be called every physics frame, assuming that the body was
active during the previous physics tick, and can be used to fetch the
latest state from the physics server. The function callable must take
the...
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/body_test_motion:
Returns true if a collision would result from moving along a motion
vector from a given point in space. PhysicsTestMotionParameters3D is
passed to set motion parameters. PhysicsTestMotionResult3D can be passed
to return additional information.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/box_shape_create:
Creates a 3D box shape in the physics server, and returns the RID that
identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the box's half-extents.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/capsule_shape_cre:
Creates a 3D capsule shape in the physics server, and returns the RID
that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the capsule's height and
radius.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/concave_polygon_s:
Creates a 3D concave polygon shape in the physics server, and returns
the RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the concave
polygon's triangles.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/cone_twist_joint_: Gets a cone twist joint parameter.
Sets a cone twist joint parameter.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/convex_polygon_sh:
Creates a 3D convex polygon shape in the physics server, and returns the
RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the convex polygon's
points.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/custom_shape_crea:
Creates a custom shape in the physics server, and returns the RID that
identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the shape's data. Note: Custom
shapes are not supported by the built-in physics servers, so calling
this method always produces an error when using Godot Physics or Jolt
Physics. Custom physics servers implemented as GDExtensions may support
a...
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/cylinder_shape_cr:
Creates a 3D cylinder shape in the physics server, and returns the RID
that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the cylinder's height and
radius.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/free_rid:
Destroys any of the objects created by PhysicsServer3D. If the RID
passed is not one of the objects that can be created by PhysicsServer3D,
an error will be sent to the console.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/generic_6dof_join: Returns the value of a generic 6DOF joint flag.
Returns the value of a generic 6DOF joint parameter.
Sets the value of a given generic 6DOF joint flag.
Sets the value of a given generic 6DOF joint parameter.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/get_process_info: Returns the value of a physics engine state specified by process_info.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/heightmap_shape_c:
Creates a 3D heightmap shape in the physics server, and returns the RID
that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the heightmap's data.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/joint_disable_col:
Sets whether the bodies attached to the Joint3D will collide with each
other.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/joint_get_solver_:
Gets the priority value of the Joint3D. Note: Only supported when using
GodotPhysics3D. This method always returns 1 when using Jolt Physics, as
it does not support joint solver priority.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/joint_get_type: Returns the type of the Joint3D.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/joint_is_disabled:
Returns whether the bodies attached to the Joint3D will collide with
each other.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/joint_make_generi:
Make the joint a generic six degrees of freedom (6DOF) joint. Use
generic_6dof_joint_set_flag and generic_6dof_joint_set_param to set the
joint's flags and parameters respectively.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/joint_set_solver_:
Sets the priority value of the Joint3D. Note: Only supported when using
GodotPhysics3D. This method has no effect when using Jolt Physics, as it
does not support joint solver priority.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/pin_joint_get_loc: Returns position of the joint in the local space of body a of the joint.
Returns position of the joint in the local space of body b of the joint.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/pin_joint_set_loc: Sets position of the joint in the local space of body a of the joint.
Sets position of the joint in the local space of body b of the joint.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/separation_ray_sh:
Creates a 3D separation ray shape in the physics server, and returns the
RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the shape's length and
slide_on_slope properties.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/set_active: Activates or deactivates the 3D physics engine.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/shape_get_data:
Returns the shape data that configures the shape, such as the
half-extents of a box or the triangles of a concave (trimesh) shape. See
shape_set_data for the precise format of this data in each case.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/shape_get_margin:
Returns the collision margin for the shape. Note: This is not used in
Godot Physics, so will always return 0.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/shape_set_data:
Sets the shape data that configures the shape. The data to be passed
depends on the shape's type (see shape_get_type): -
SHAPE_WORLD_BOUNDARY: a Plane, - SHAPE_SEPARATION_RAY: a dictionary
containing the key "length" with a float value and the key
"slide_on_slope" with a bool value, - SHAPE_SPHERE: a float that is the
radius of the sphere, - SHAPE_BOX: a...
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/shape_set_margin:
Sets the collision margin for the shape. Note: This is not used in Godot
Physics.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_add_col: Adds the given body to the list of bodies exempt from collisions.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_apply_c:
Distributes and applies a force to all points. A force is time dependent
and meant to be applied every physics update.

Distributes and applies an impulse to all points. An impulse is
time-independent! Applying an impulse every frame would result in a
framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it should only be used when
simulating one-time impacts (use the "_force" functions otherwise).
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_apply_p:
Applies a force to a point. A force is time dependent and meant to be
applied every physics update.

Applies an impulse to a point. An impulse is time-independent! Applying
an impulse every frame would result in a framerate-dependent force. For
this reason, it should only be used when simulating one-time impacts
(use the "_force" functions otherwise).
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_create: Creates a new soft body and returns its internal RID.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_get_bou: Returns the bounds of the given soft body in global coordinates.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_get_col: Returns the physics layer or layers that the given soft body belongs to.

Returns the physics layer or layers that the given soft body can collide
with.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_get_dam: Returns the damping coefficient of the given soft body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_get_dra: Returns the drag coefficient of the given soft body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_get_lin: Returns the linear stiffness of the given soft body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_get_poi:
Returns the current position of the given soft body point in global
coordinates.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_get_pre: Returns the pressure coefficient of the given soft body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_get_shr: Returns the shrinking factor of the given soft body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_get_sim: Returns the simulation precision of the given soft body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_get_spa: Returns the RID of the space assigned to the given soft body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_get_sta:
Returns the given soft body state. Note: Godot's default physics
implementation does not support BODY_STATE_LINEAR_VELOCITY,
BODY_STATE_ANGULAR_VELOCITY, BODY_STATE_SLEEPING, or
BODY_STATE_CAN_SLEEP.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_get_tot: Returns the total mass assigned to the given soft body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_is_poin: Returns whether the given soft body point is pinned.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_move_po: Moves the given soft body point to a position in global coordinates.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_pin_poi:
Pins or unpins the given soft body point based on the value of pin.
Note: Pinning a point effectively makes it kinematic, preventing it from
being affected by forces, but you can still move it using
soft_body_move_point.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_remove_: Unpins all points of the given soft body.
Removes the given body from the list of bodies exempt from collisions.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_set_col: Sets the physics layer or layers the given soft body belongs to.
Sets the physics layer or layers the given soft body can collide with.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_set_dam:
Sets the damping coefficient of the given soft body. Higher values will
slow down the body more noticeably when forces are applied.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_set_dra:
Sets the drag coefficient of the given soft body. Higher values increase
this body's air resistance. Note: This value is currently unused by
Godot's default physics implementation.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_set_lin:
Sets the linear stiffness of the given soft body. Higher values will
result in a stiffer body, while lower values will increase the body's
ability to bend. The value can be between 0.0 and 1.0 (inclusive).
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_set_mes: Sets the mesh of the given soft body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_set_pre:
Sets the pressure coefficient of the given soft body. Simulates pressure
build-up from inside this body. Higher values increase the strength of
this effect.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_set_ray:
Sets whether the given soft body will be pickable when using object
picking.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_set_shr: Sets the shrinking factor of the given soft body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_set_sim:
Sets the simulation precision of the given soft body. Increasing this
value will improve the resulting simulation, but can affect performance.
Use with care.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_set_spa: Assigns a space to the given soft body (see space_create).
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_set_sta:
Sets the given body state for the given body. Note: Godot's default
physics implementation does not support BODY_STATE_LINEAR_VELOCITY,
BODY_STATE_ANGULAR_VELOCITY, BODY_STATE_SLEEPING, or
BODY_STATE_CAN_SLEEP.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_set_tot: Sets the total mass for the given soft body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_set_tra: Sets the global transform of the given soft body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/soft_body_update_:
Requests that the physics server updates the rendering server with the
latest positions of the given soft body's points through the
rendering_server_handler interface.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/space_create:
Creates a space. A space is a collection of parameters for the physics
engine that can be assigned to an area or a body. It can be assigned to
an area with area_set_space, or to a body with body_set_space.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/space_get_direct_:
Returns the state of a space, a PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D. This object
can be used to make collision/intersection queries.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/space_get_param: Returns the value of a space parameter.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/space_is_active: Returns whether the space is active.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/space_set_active:
Marks a space as active. It will not have an effect, unless it is
assigned to an area or body.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/space_set_param:
Sets the value for a space parameter. A list of available parameters is
on the SpaceParameter constants.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/sphere_shape_crea:
Creates a 3D sphere shape in the physics server, and returns the RID
that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the sphere's radius.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3D/method/world_boundary_sh:
Creates a 3D world boundary shape in the physics server, and returns the
RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data to set the shape's normal
direction and distance properties.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3DManager/method/register_s:
Register a PhysicsServer3D implementation by passing a name and a
Callable that returns a PhysicsServer3D object.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3DManager/method/set_defaul:
Set the default PhysicsServer3D implementation to the one identified by
name, if priority is greater than the priority of the current default
implementation.
descriptions.PhysicsServer3DRenderingServerHandler/me:
Called by the PhysicsServer3D to set the bounding box for the
SoftBody3D.

Called by the PhysicsServer3D to set the normal for the SoftBody3D
vertex at the index specified by vertex_id. Note: The normal parameter
used to be of type const void* prior to Godot 4.2.

Called by the PhysicsServer3D to set the position for the SoftBody3D
vertex at the index specified by vertex_id. Note: The vertex parameter
used to be of type const void* prior to Godot 4.2.
Sets the bounding box for the SoftBody3D.

Sets the normal for the SoftBody3D vertex at the index specified by
vertex_id.

Sets the position for the SoftBody3D vertex at the index specified by
vertex_id.
descriptions.PhysicsTestMotionResult2D/method/get_col: Returns the colliding body's attached Object, if a collision occurred.

Returns the unique instance ID of the colliding body's attached Object,
if a collision occurred. See Object.get_instance_id.

Returns the colliding body's RID used by the PhysicsServer2D, if a
collision occurred.

Returns the colliding body's shape index, if a collision occurred. See
CollisionObject2D.
Returns the colliding body's velocity, if a collision occurred.

Returns the length of overlap along the collision normal, if a collision
occurred.
Returns the moving object's colliding shape, if a collision occurred.

Returns the colliding body's shape's normal at the point of collision,
if a collision occurred.

Returns the point of collision in global coordinates, if a collision
occurred.

Returns the maximum fraction of the motion that can occur without a
collision, between 0 and 1.

Returns the minimum fraction of the motion needed to collide, if a
collision occurred, between 0 and 1.
descriptions.PhysicsTestMotionResult2D/method/get_rem: Returns the moving object's remaining movement vector.
descriptions.PhysicsTestMotionResult2D/method/get_tra: Returns the moving object's travel before collision.
descriptions.PhysicsTestMotionResult3D/method/get_col:
Returns the colliding body's attached Object given a collision index
(the deepest collision by default), if a collision occurred.

Returns the unique instance ID of the colliding body's attached Object
given a collision index (the deepest collision by default), if a
collision occurred. See Object.get_instance_id.

Returns the colliding body's RID used by the PhysicsServer3D given a
collision index (the deepest collision by default), if a collision
occurred.

Returns the colliding body's shape index given a collision index (the
deepest collision by default), if a collision occurred. See
CollisionObject3D.

Returns the colliding body's velocity given a collision index (the
deepest collision by default), if a collision occurred.
Returns the number of detected collisions.

Returns the length of overlap along the collision normal given a
collision index (the deepest collision by default), if a collision
occurred.

Returns the moving object's colliding shape given a collision index (the
deepest collision by default), if a collision occurred.

Returns the colliding body's shape's normal at the point of collision
given a collision index (the deepest collision by default), if a
collision occurred.

Returns the point of collision in global coordinates given a collision
index (the deepest collision by default), if a collision occurred.

Returns the maximum fraction of the motion that can occur without a
collision, between 0 and 1.

Returns the minimum fraction of the motion needed to collide, if a
collision occurred, between 0 and 1.
descriptions.PhysicsTestMotionResult3D/method/get_rem: Returns the moving object's remaining movement vector.
descriptions.PhysicsTestMotionResult3D/method/get_tra: Returns the moving object's travel before collision.
descriptions.PinJoint3D/method/get_param: Returns the value of the specified parameter.
descriptions.PinJoint3D/method/set_param: Sets the value of the specified parameter.
descriptions.Plane/method/distance_to:
Returns the shortest distance from the plane to the position point. If
the point is above the plane, the distance will be positive. If below,
the distance will be negative.
descriptions.Plane/method/get_center: Returns the center of the plane.
descriptions.Plane/method/has_point:
Returns true if point is inside the plane. Comparison uses a custom
minimum tolerance threshold.
descriptions.Plane/method/intersect_3:
Returns the intersection point of the three planes b, c and this plane.
If no intersection is found, null is returned.
descriptions.Plane/method/intersects_ray:
Returns the intersection point of a ray consisting of the position from
and the direction normal dir with this plane. If no intersection is
found, null is returned.
descriptions.Plane/method/intersects_segment:
Returns the intersection point of a segment from position from to
position to with this plane. If no intersection is found, null is
returned.
descriptions.Plane/method/is_equal_approx:
Returns true if this plane and to_plane are approximately equal, by
running @GlobalScope.is_equal_approx on each component.
descriptions.Plane/method/is_finite:
Returns true if this plane is finite, by calling @GlobalScope.is_finite
on each component.
descriptions.Plane/method/is_point_over: Returns true if point is located above the plane.
descriptions.Plane/method/normalized:
Returns a copy of the plane, with normalized normal (so it's a unit
vector). Returns Plane(0, 0, 0, 0) if normal can't be normalized (it has
zero length).
descriptions.Plane/method/project: Returns the orthogonal projection of point into a point in the plane.
descriptions.PlayerControl/method/clear_lock_on:
Clears the selected target. Lock-On steering follows the view again.
Safe to call after the controller is detached.
descriptions.PlayerControl/method/controls:
Returns the exact local input handle used by the controller, or null if
boot failed.
descriptions.PlayerControl/method/get_message:
Returns the initial attachment failure text, or an empty string after
success.
descriptions.PlayerControl/method/is_ready: Returns true while the attached controller and its input owner are live.
descriptions.PlayerControl/method/lock_on:
Uses the bearing to target for the body's facing and movement axes. The
view keeps its own aim. The game chooses the target and handles any
camera tracking. Returns OK on success, ERR_UNCONFIGURED if the
controller is inactive, ERR_UNAVAILABLE for other styles, or
ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER for a null, unmounted, queued-for-deletion,
same-character, or...
descriptions.PlayerControl/method/mover:
Returns the body's movement handle on standalone or authority-side
actors. Returns null on a network guest, which sends input intent to the
authority, or if boot failed.
descriptions.PlayerControlProfile/method/boot:
Attaches local control to a mounted CharacterBody3D and a descendant
used for aim and view-relative movement. Standalone bodies with a
MoverComponent use its movement settings. Fixed-world sessions use the
settings captured by GameConfig.player_controls. Supply existing live
controls for the same input layout and tree to retain bindings across
bodies....
descriptions.PlayerControlProfile/method/configure:
Creates an editable profile with the supplied layout and standard
movement and look defaults. Edit its typed properties before boot.
descriptions.Polygon2D/method/add_bone: Adds a bone with the specified path and weights.
descriptions.Polygon2D/method/clear_bones: Removes all bones from this Polygon2D.
descriptions.Polygon2D/method/erase_bone: Removes the specified bone from this Polygon2D.
descriptions.Polygon2D/method/get_bone_count: Returns the number of bones in this Polygon2D.
descriptions.Polygon2D/method/get_bone_path: Returns the path to the node associated with the specified bone.
descriptions.Polygon2D/method/get_bone_weights: Returns the weight values of the specified bone.
descriptions.Polygon2D/method/set_bone_path: Sets the path to the node associated with the specified bone.
descriptions.Polygon2D/method/set_bone_weights: Sets the weight values for the specified bone.
descriptions.PolygonPathFinder/method/is_point_inside: Returns true if point falls inside the polygon area.
descriptions.PolygonPathFinder/method/setup:
Sets up PolygonPathFinder with an array of points that define the
vertices of the polygon, and an array of indices that determine the
edges of the polygon. The length of connections must be even, returns an
error if odd.
descriptions.Popup/signal/popup_hide: Emitted when the popup is hidden.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/activate_item_by_event:
Checks the provided event against the PopupMenu's shortcuts and
accelerators, and activates the first item with matching events. If
for_global_only is true, only shortcuts and accelerators with global set
to true will be called. Returns true if an item was successfully
activated. Note: Certain Controls, such as MenuButton, will call this
method...
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_check_item:
Adds a new checkable item with text label. An id can optionally be
provided, as well as an accelerator (accel). If no id is provided, one
will be created from the index. If no accel is provided, then the
default value of 0 (corresponding to @GlobalScope.KEY_NONE) will be
assigned to the item (which means it won't have any accelerator). See...
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_check_shortcut:
Adds a new checkable item and assigns the specified Shortcut to it. Sets
the label of the checkbox to the Shortcut's name. An id can optionally
be provided. If no id is provided, one will be created from the index.
Note: Checkable items just display a checkmark, but don't have any
built-in checking behavior and must be checked/unchecked manually.
See...
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_icon_check_item:
Adds a new checkable item with text label and icon texture. An id can
optionally be provided, as well as an accelerator (accel). If no id is
provided, one will be created from the index. If no accel is provided,
then the default value of 0 (corresponding to @GlobalScope.KEY_NONE)
will be assigned to the item (which means it won't have any
accelerator)....
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_icon_check_shortcut:
Adds a new checkable item and assigns the specified Shortcut and icon
texture to it. Sets the label of the checkbox to the Shortcut's name. An
id can optionally be provided. If no id is provided, one will be created
from the index. Note: Checkable items just display a checkmark, but
don't have any built-in checking behavior and must be
checked/unchecked...
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_icon_item:
Adds a new item with text label and icon texture. An id can optionally
be provided, as well as an accelerator (accel). If no id is provided,
one will be created from the index. If no accel is provided, then the
default value of 0 (corresponding to @GlobalScope.KEY_NONE) will be
assigned to the item (which means it won't have any accelerator). See...
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_icon_radio_check_it: Same as add_icon_check_item, but uses a radio check button.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_icon_radio_check_sh: Same as add_icon_check_shortcut, but uses a radio check button.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_icon_shortcut:
Adds a new item and assigns the specified Shortcut and icon texture to
it. Sets the label of the checkbox to the Shortcut's name. An id can
optionally be provided. If no id is provided, one will be created from
the index. If allow_echo is true, the shortcut can be activated with
echo events.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_item:
Adds a new item with text label. An id can optionally be provided, as
well as an accelerator (accel). If no id is provided, one will be
created from the index. If no accel is provided, then the default value
of 0 (corresponding to @GlobalScope.KEY_NONE) will be assigned to the
item (which means it won't have any accelerator). See
get_item_accelerator for...
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_multistate_item:
Adds a new multistate item with text label. Contrarily to normal binary
items, multistate items can have more than two states, as defined by
max_states. The default value is defined by default_state. An id can
optionally be provided, as well as an accelerator (accel). If no id is
provided, one will be created from the index. If no accel is provided,
then...
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_radio_check_item:
Adds a new radio check button with text label. An id can optionally be
provided, as well as an accelerator (accel). If no id is provided, one
will be created from the index. If no accel is provided, then the
default value of 0 (corresponding to @GlobalScope.KEY_NONE) will be
assigned to the item (which means it won't have any accelerator). See...
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_radio_check_shortcu:
Adds a new radio check button and assigns a Shortcut to it. Sets the
label of the checkbox to the Shortcut's name. An id can optionally be
provided. If no id is provided, one will be created from the index.
Note: Checkable items just display a checkmark, but don't have any
built-in checking behavior and must be checked/unchecked manually.
See...
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_separator:
Adds a separator between items. Separators also occupy an index, which
you can set by using the id parameter. A label can optionally be
provided, which will appear at the center of the separator.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_shortcut:
Adds a Shortcut. An id can optionally be provided. If no id is provided,
one will be created from the index. If allow_echo is true, the shortcut
can be activated with echo events.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_submenu_item:
Adds an item that will act as a submenu of the parent PopupMenu node
when clicked. The submenu argument must be the name of an existing
PopupMenu that has been added as a child to this node. This submenu will
be shown when the item is clicked, hovered for long enough, or activated
using the ui_select or ui_right input actions. An id can optionally
be...
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/add_submenu_node_item:
Adds an item that will act as a submenu of the parent PopupMenu node
when clicked. This submenu will be shown when the item is clicked,
hovered for long enough, or activated using the ui_select or ui_right
input actions. submenu must be either child of this PopupMenu or has no
parent node (in which case it will be automatically added as a child).
If the...
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/clear:
Removes all items from the PopupMenu. If free_submenus is true, the
submenu nodes are automatically freed.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_focused_item:
Returns the index of the currently focused item. Returns -1 if no item
is focused.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_accelerator:
Returns the accelerator of the item at the given index. An accelerator
is a keyboard shortcut that can be pressed to trigger the menu button
even if it's not currently open. The return value is an integer which is
generally a combination of KeyModifierMasks and Keys using bitwise OR
such as KEY_MASK_CTRL | KEY_A (Ctrl + A). If no accelerator is
defined...
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_auto_translate: Returns the auto translate mode of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_icon: Returns the icon of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_icon_max_width:
Returns the maximum allowed width of the icon for the item at the given
index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_icon_modulate: Returns a Color modulating the item's icon at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_id: Returns the ID of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_indent: Returns the horizontal offset of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_index:
Returns the index of the item containing the specified id. The index is
automatically assigned to each item by the engine when added and
represents the order items will be displayed.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_metadata:
Returns the metadata of the specified item, which might be of any type.
You can set it with set_item_metadata, which provides a simple way of
assigning context data to items.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_multistate: Returns the state of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_multistate_max: Returns the max states of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_shortcut: Returns the Shortcut associated with the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_submenu:
Returns the submenu name of the item at the given index. See
add_submenu_item for more info on how to add a submenu.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_submenu_node:
Returns the submenu of the item at the given index, or null if no
submenu was added. See add_submenu_node_item for more info on how to add
a submenu.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_text: Returns the text of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_text_direction: Returns item's text base writing direction.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/get_item_tooltip: Returns the tooltip associated with the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/is_item_checkable:
Returns true if the item at the given index is checkable in some way,
i.e. if it has a checkbox or radio button. Note: Checkable items just
display a checkmark or radio button, but don't have any built-in
checking behavior and must be checked/unchecked manually.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/is_item_checked: Returns true if the item at the given index is checked.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/is_item_disabled:
Returns true if the item at the given index is disabled. When it is
disabled it can't be selected, or its action invoked. See
set_item_disabled for more info on how to disable an item.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/is_item_radio_checkable:
Returns true if the item at the given index has radio button-style
checkability. Note: This is purely cosmetic; you must add the logic for
checking/unchecking items in radio groups.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/is_item_separator:
Returns true if the item is a separator. If it is, it will be displayed
as a line. See add_separator for more info on how to add a separator.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/is_item_shortcut_disabl: Returns true if the specified item's shortcut is disabled.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/is_native_menu:
Returns true if the system native menu is supported and currently used
by this PopupMenu.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/is_system_menu: Returns true if the menu is bound to the special system menu.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/remove_item:
Removes the item at the given index from the menu. Note: The indices of
items after the removed item will be shifted by one.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/scroll_to_item: Moves the scroll view to make the item at the given index visible.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_focused_item:
Sets the currently focused item as the given index. Passing -1 as the
index makes so that no item is focused.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_accelerator:
Sets the accelerator of the item at the given index. An accelerator is a
keyboard shortcut that can be pressed to trigger the menu button even if
it's not currently open. accel is generally a combination of
KeyModifierMasks and Keys using bitwise OR such as KEY_MASK_CTRL | KEY_A
(Ctrl + A).
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_as_checkable:
Sets whether the item at the given index has a checkbox. If false, sets
the type of the item to plain text. Note: Checkable items just display a
checkmark, but don't have any built-in checking behavior and must be
checked/unchecked manually.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_as_radio_check:
Sets the type of the item at the given index to radio button. If false,
sets the type of the item to plain text.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_as_separator:
Mark the item at the given index as a separator, which means that it
would be displayed as a line. If false, sets the type of the item to
plain text.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_auto_translate:
Sets the auto translate mode of the item at the given index. Items use
Node.AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_INHERIT by default, which uses the same auto
translate mode as the PopupMenu itself.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_checked: Sets the checkstate status of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_disabled:
Enables/disables the item at the given index. When it is disabled, it
can't be selected and its action can't be invoked.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_icon: Replaces the Texture2D icon of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_icon_max_width:
Sets the maximum allowed width of the icon for the item at the given
index. This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon and
on top of icon_max_width. The height is adjusted according to the icon's
ratio.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_icon_modulate: Sets a modulating Color of the item's icon at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_id:
Sets the id of the item at the given index. The id is used in id_pressed
and id_focused signals.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_indent: Sets the horizontal offset of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_index:
Changes the index of the item at index index to be at index
target_index. This can be used to move an item above other items. The
moved item will keep the same ID, even if it was generated from the
original index. Note: The indices of any items between index index and
index target_index will be shifted by one.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_language:
Sets the language code of the text for the item at the given index to
language. This is used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If
language is empty, the current locale is used.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_metadata:
Sets the metadata of an item, which may be of any type. You can later
get it with get_item_metadata, which provides a simple way of assigning
context data to items.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_multistate:
Sets the state of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item for
details.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_multistate_max:
Sets the max states of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item for
details.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_shortcut: Sets a Shortcut for the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_shortcut_disab: Disables the Shortcut of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_submenu:
Sets the submenu of the item at the given index. The submenu is the name
of a child PopupMenu node that would be shown when the item is clicked.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_submenu_node:
Sets the submenu of the item at the given index. The submenu is a
PopupMenu node that would be shown when the item is clicked. It must
either be a child of this PopupMenu or has no parent (in which case it
will be automatically added as a child). If the submenu popup has
another parent, this method will fail.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_text: Sets the text of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_text_direction: Sets item's text base writing direction.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/set_item_tooltip: Sets the String tooltip of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/toggle_item_checked: Toggles the check state of the item at the given index.
descriptions.PopupMenu/method/toggle_item_multistate:
Cycle to the next state of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item
for details.
descriptions.PopupMenu/signal/id_focused:
Emitted when the user navigated to an item of some id using the
ProjectSettings.input/ui_up or ProjectSettings.input/ui_down input
action.
descriptions.PopupMenu/signal/id_pressed:
Emitted when an item of some id is pressed. Also emitted when its
accelerator is activated on macOS. Note: If id is negative (either
explicitly or due to overflow), this will return the corresponding index
instead.
descriptions.PopupMenu/signal/index_pressed:
Emitted when an item of some index is pressed. Also emitted when its
accelerator is activated on macOS.
descriptions.PopupMenu/signal/menu_changed: Emitted when any item is added, modified or removed.
descriptions.PortableCompressedTexture2D/method/creat:
Initializes the compressed texture from a base image. The compression
mode must be provided. normal_map is recommended to ensure optimum
quality if this image will be used as a normal map. If lossy compression
is requested, the quality setting can optionally be provided. This maps
to Lossy WebP compression quality.
descriptions.PortableCompressedTexture2D/method/get_c: Return the compression mode used (valid after initialized).
descriptions.PortableCompressedTexture2D/method/is_ke: Returns true if the flag is overridden for all textures of this type.
descriptions.PortableCompressedTexture2D/method/set_b:
Sets the compressor parameters for Basis Universal compression. See also
the settings in ResourceImporterTexture. Note: This method must be
called before create_from_image for this to work.
descriptions.PortableCompressedTexture2D/method/set_k:
If keep is true, overrides the flag globally for all textures of this
type. This is used primarily by the editor.
descriptions.PrimitiveMesh/method/_create_mesh_array:
Override this method to customize how this primitive mesh should be
generated. Should return an Array where each element is another Array of
values required for the mesh (see the Mesh.ArrayType constants).
descriptions.PrimitiveMesh/method/get_mesh_arrays:
Returns the mesh arrays used to make up the surface of this primitive
mesh. Example: Pass the result to ArrayMesh.add_surface_from_arrays to
create a new surface:
descriptions.PrimitiveMesh/method/request_update: Request an update of this primitive mesh based on its properties.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/add_property_info:
Adds a custom property info to a property. The dictionary must contain:
- "name": String (the property's name) - "type": int (see Variant.Type)
- optionally "hint": int (see PropertyHint) and "hint_string": String
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/check_changed_set:
Checks if any settings with the prefix setting_prefix exist in the set
of changed settings. See also get_changed_settings.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/clear: Clears the whole configuration (not recommended, may break things).
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/get_changed_setti:
Gets an array of the settings which have been changed since the last
save. Note that internally changed_settings is cleared after a
successful save, so generally the most appropriate place to use this
method is when processing settings_changed.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/get_global_class_:
Returns an Array of registered global classes. Each global class is
represented as a Dictionary that contains the following entries: - base
is a name of the base class; - class is a name of the registered global
class; - icon is a path to a custom icon of the global class, if it has
any; - language is a name of a programming language in which the
global...
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/get_order:
Returns the order of a configuration value (influences when saved to the
config file).
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/get_setting:
Returns the value of the setting identified by name. If the setting
doesn't exist and default_value is specified, the value of default_value
is returned. Otherwise, null is returned.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/get_setting_with_:
Similar to get_setting, but applies feature tag overrides if any exists
and is valid. Example: If the setting override
"application/config/name.windows" exists, and the following code is
executed on a Windows operating system, the overridden setting is
printed instead:

Similar to get_setting_with_override, but applies feature tag overrides
instead of current OS features.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/globalize_path:
Returns the absolute, native OS path corresponding to the localized path
(starting with res:// or user://). The returned path will vary depending
on the operating system and user preferences. See File paths in Godot
projects to see what those paths convert to. See also localize_path.
Note: globalize_path with res:// will not work in an exported
project....
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/has_setting:
Returns true if a configuration value is present. Note: In order to be
be detected, custom settings have to be either defined with set_setting,
or exist in the project.godot file. This is especially relevant when
using set_initial_value.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/load_resource_pac:
Loads the contents of the .pck or .zip file specified by pack into the
resource filesystem (res://). Returns true on success. Note: If a file
from pack shares the same path as a file already in the resource
filesystem, any attempts to load that file will use the file from pack
unless replace_files is set to false. Note: The optional offset
parameter can...
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/localize_path:
Returns the localized path (starting with res://) corresponding to the
absolute, native OS path. See also globalize_path.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/save:
Saves the configuration to the project.godot file. Note: This method is
intended to be used by editor plugins, as modified ProjectSettings can't
be loaded back in the running app. If you want to change project
settings in exported projects, use save_custom to save an override.cfg
file.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/save_custom:
Saves the configuration to a custom file. The file extension must be
.godot (to save in text-based ConfigFile format) or .binary (to save in
binary format). You can also save an override.cfg file, which is also
text, but can be used in exported projects unlike other formats.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/set_as_basic:
Defines if the specified setting is considered basic or advanced. Basic
settings will always be shown in the project settings. Advanced settings
will only be shown if the user enables the "Advanced Settings" option.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/set_as_internal:
Defines if the specified setting is considered internal. An internal
setting won't show up in the Project Settings dialog. This is mostly
useful for addons that need to store their own internal settings without
exposing them directly to the user.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/set_initial_value:
Sets the specified setting's initial value. This is the value the
setting reverts to. The setting should already exist before calling this
method. Note that project settings equal to their default value are not
saved, so your code needs to account for that.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/set_order:
Sets the order of a configuration value (influences when saved to the
config file).
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/set_restart_if_ch:
Sets whether a setting requires restarting the editor to properly take
effect. Note: This is just a hint to display to the user that the editor
must be restarted for changes to take effect. Enabling
set_restart_if_changed does not delay the setting being set when
changed.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/method/set_setting: Sets the value of a setting.
descriptions.ProjectSettings/signal/settings_changed: Emitted when any setting is changed, up to once per process frame.
descriptions.Projection/method/create_depth_correctio:
Creates a new Projection that projects positions from a depth range of
-1 to 1 to one that ranges from 0 to 1, and flips the projected
positions vertically, according to flip_y.
descriptions.Projection/method/create_fit_aabb:
Creates a new Projection that scales a given projection to fit around a
given AABB in projection space.
descriptions.Projection/method/create_for_hmd:
Creates a new Projection for projecting positions onto a head-mounted
display with the given X:Y aspect ratio, distance between eyes, display
width, distance to lens, oversampling factor, and depth clipping planes.
eye creates the projection for the left eye when set to 1, or the right
eye when set to 2.
descriptions.Projection/method/create_frustum:
Creates a new Projection that projects positions in a frustum with the
given clipping planes.
descriptions.Projection/method/create_frustum_aspect:
Creates a new Projection that projects positions in a frustum with the
given size, X:Y aspect ratio, offset, and clipping planes. flip_fov
determines whether the projection's field of view is flipped over its
diagonal.
descriptions.Projection/method/create_light_atlas_rec: Creates a new Projection that projects positions into the given Rect2.
descriptions.Projection/method/create_orthogonal:
Creates a new Projection that projects positions using an orthogonal
projection with the given clipping planes.
descriptions.Projection/method/create_orthogonal_aspe:
Creates a new Projection that projects positions using an orthogonal
projection with the given size, X:Y aspect ratio, and clipping planes.
flip_fov determines whether the projection's field of view is flipped
over its diagonal.
descriptions.Projection/method/create_perspective:
Creates a new Projection that projects positions using a perspective
projection with the given Y-axis field of view (in degrees), X:Y aspect
ratio, and clipping planes. flip_fov determines whether the projection's
field of view is flipped over its diagonal.
descriptions.Projection/method/create_perspective_hmd:
Creates a new Projection that projects positions using a perspective
projection with the given Y-axis field of view (in degrees), X:Y aspect
ratio, and clipping distances. The projection is adjusted for a
head-mounted display with the given distance between eyes and distance
to a point that can be focused on. eye creates the projection for the
left eye...
descriptions.Projection/method/determinant:
Returns a scalar value that is the signed factor by which areas are
scaled by this matrix. If the sign is negative, the matrix flips the
orientation of the area. The determinant can be used to calculate the
invertibility of a matrix or solve linear systems of equations involving
the matrix, among other applications.
descriptions.Projection/method/flipped_y:
Returns a copy of this Projection with the signs of the values of the Y
column flipped.
descriptions.Projection/method/get_aspect: Returns the X:Y aspect ratio of this Projection's viewport.
descriptions.Projection/method/get_far_plane_half_ext:
Returns the dimensions of the far clipping plane of the projection,
divided by two.
descriptions.Projection/method/get_fov: Returns the horizontal field of view of the projection (in degrees).
descriptions.Projection/method/get_fovy:
Returns the vertical field of view of the projection (in degrees)
associated with the given horizontal field of view (in degrees) and
aspect ratio. Note: Unlike most methods of Projection, aspect is
expected to be 1 divided by the X:Y aspect ratio.
descriptions.Projection/method/get_lod_multiplier:
Returns the factor by which the visible level of detail is scaled by
this Projection.
descriptions.Projection/method/get_pixels_per_meter:
Returns for_pixel_width divided by the viewport's width measured in
meters on the near plane, after this Projection is applied.
descriptions.Projection/method/get_projection_plane:
Returns the clipping plane of this Projection whose index is given by
plane. plane should be equal to one of PLANE_NEAR, PLANE_FAR,
PLANE_LEFT, PLANE_TOP, PLANE_RIGHT, or PLANE_BOTTOM.
descriptions.Projection/method/get_viewport_half_exte:
Returns the dimensions of the viewport plane that this Projection
projects positions onto, divided by two.
descriptions.Projection/method/get_z_far:
Returns the distance for this Projection beyond which positions are
clipped.
descriptions.Projection/method/get_z_near:
Returns the distance for this Projection before which positions are
clipped.
descriptions.Projection/method/inverse:
Returns a Projection that performs the inverse of this Projection's
projective transformation.
descriptions.Projection/method/is_orthogonal: Returns true if this Projection performs an orthogonal projection.
descriptions.Projection/method/jitter_offseted:
Returns a Projection with the X and Y values from the given Vector2
added to the first and second values of the final column respectively.
descriptions.Projection/method/perspective_znear_adju:
Returns a Projection with the near clipping distance adjusted to be
new_znear. Note: The original Projection must be a perspective
projection.
descriptions.PropertyTweener/method/as_relative:
When called, the final value will be used as a relative value instead.
Example: Move the node by 100 pixels to the right.
descriptions.PropertyTweener/method/from:
Sets a custom initial value to the PropertyTweener. Example: Move the
node from position (100, 100) to (200, 100).
descriptions.PropertyTweener/method/from_current:
Makes the PropertyTweener use the current property value (i.e. at the
time of creating this PropertyTweener) as a starting point. This is
equivalent of using from with the current value. These two calls will do
the same:
descriptions.PropertyTweener/method/set_custom_interp:
Allows interpolating the value with a custom easing function. The
provided interpolator_method will be called with a value ranging from
0.0 to 1.0 and is expected to return a value within the same range
(values outside the range can be used for overshoot). The return value
of the method is then used for interpolation between initial and final
value. Note...
descriptions.PropertyTweener/method/set_delay:
Sets the time in seconds after which the PropertyTweener will start
interpolating. By default there's no delay.
descriptions.PropertyTweener/method/set_ease:
Sets the type of used easing from Tween.EaseType. If not set, the
default easing is used from the Tween that contains this Tweener.
descriptions.PropertyTweener/method/set_trans:
Sets the type of used transition from Tween.TransitionType. If not set,
the default transition is used from the Tween that contains this
Tweener.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/angle_to:
Returns the angle between this quaternion and to. This is the magnitude
of the angle you would need to rotate by to get from one to the other.
Note: The magnitude of the floating-point error for this method is
abnormally high, so methods such as is_zero_approx will not work
reliably.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/dot:
Returns the dot product between this quaternion and with. This is
equivalent to (quat.x * with.x) + (quat.y * with.y) + (quat.z * with.z)
+ (quat.w * with.w).
descriptions.Quaternion/method/exp:
Returns the exponential of this quaternion. The rotation axis of the
result is the normalized rotation axis of this quaternion, the angle of
the result is the length of the vector part of this quaternion.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/from_euler:
Constructs a new Quaternion from the given Vector3 of Euler angles, in
radians. In Godot, Euler angles always use intrinsic order. This method
always uses the intrinsic YXZ convention (EULER_ORDER_YXZ).
descriptions.Quaternion/method/get_angle:
Returns the angle of the rotation represented by this quaternion. Note:
The quaternion must be normalized.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/get_axis:
Returns the rotation axis of the rotation represented by this
quaternion.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/get_euler:
Returns this quaternion's rotation as a Vector3 of Euler angles, in
radians. The order of each consecutive rotation can be changed with
order (see EulerOrder constants). In Godot, Euler angles always use
intrinsic order. By default, the intrinsic YXZ convention is used
(EULER_ORDER_YXZ): since we are decomposing, local Z (roll) is
calculated first, then...
descriptions.Quaternion/method/inverse:
Returns the inverse version of this quaternion, inverting the sign of
every component except w.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/is_equal_approx:
Returns true if this quaternion and to are approximately equal, by
calling @GlobalScope.is_equal_approx on each component.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/is_finite:
Returns true if this quaternion is finite, by calling
@GlobalScope.is_finite on each component.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/is_normalized: Returns true if this quaternion is normalized. See also normalized.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/length: Returns this quaternion's length, also called magnitude.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/length_squared:
Returns this quaternion's length, squared. Note: This method is faster
than length, so prefer it if you only need to compare quaternion
lengths.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/log:
Returns the logarithm of this quaternion. Multiplies this quaternion's
rotation axis by its rotation angle, and stores the result in the
returned quaternion's vector part (x, y, and z). The returned
quaternion's real part (w) is always 0.0.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/normalized:
Returns a copy of this quaternion, normalized so that its length is 1.0.
See also is_normalized.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/slerp:
Performs a spherical-linear interpolation with the to quaternion, given
a weight and returns the result. Both this quaternion and to must be
normalized.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/slerpni:
Performs a spherical-linear interpolation with the to quaternion, given
a weight and returns the result. Unlike slerp, this method does not
check if the rotation path is smaller than 90 degrees. Both this
quaternion and to must be normalized.
descriptions.Quaternion/method/spherical_cubic_interp:
Performs a spherical cubic interpolation between quaternions pre_a, this
vector, b, and post_b, by the given amount weight.

Performs a spherical cubic interpolation between quaternions pre_a, this
vector, b, and post_b, by the given amount weight. It can perform
smoother interpolation than spherical_cubic_interpolate by the time
values.
descriptions.RDPipelineColorBlendStateAttachment/meth:
Convenience method to perform standard mix blending with straight
(non-premultiplied) alpha. This sets enable_blend to true,
src_color_blend_factor to RenderingDevice.BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_ALPHA,
dst_color_blend_factor to
RenderingDevice.BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA, src_alpha_blend_factor
to RenderingDevice.BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_ALPHA and...
descriptions.RDShaderFile/method/get_spirv:
Returns the SPIR-V intermediate representation for the specified shader
version.
descriptions.RDShaderFile/method/get_version_list: Returns the list of compiled versions for this shader.
descriptions.RDShaderFile/method/set_bytecode:
Sets the SPIR-V bytecode that will be compiled for the specified
version.
descriptions.RDShaderSPIRV/method/get_stage_bytecode:
Equivalent to getting one of bytecode_compute, bytecode_fragment,
bytecode_tesselation_control, bytecode_tesselation_evaluation,
bytecode_vertex.
descriptions.RDShaderSPIRV/method/get_stage_compile_e:
Returns the compilation error message for the given shader stage.
Equivalent to getting one of compile_error_compute,
compile_error_fragment, compile_error_tesselation_control,
compile_error_tesselation_evaluation, compile_error_vertex.
descriptions.RDShaderSPIRV/method/set_stage_bytecode:
Sets the SPIR-V bytecode for the given shader stage. Equivalent to
setting one of bytecode_compute, bytecode_fragment,
bytecode_tesselation_control, bytecode_tesselation_evaluation,
bytecode_vertex.
descriptions.RDShaderSPIRV/method/set_stage_compile_e:
Sets the compilation error message for the given shader stage to
compile_error. Equivalent to setting one of compile_error_compute,
compile_error_fragment, compile_error_tesselation_control,
compile_error_tesselation_evaluation, compile_error_vertex.
descriptions.RDShaderSource/method/get_stage_source:
Returns source code for the specified shader stage. Equivalent to
getting one of source_compute, source_fragment,
source_tesselation_control, source_tesselation_evaluation or
source_vertex.
descriptions.RDShaderSource/method/set_stage_source:
Sets source code for the specified shader stage. Equivalent to setting
one of source_compute, source_fragment, source_tesselation_control,
source_tesselation_evaluation or source_vertex. Note: If you set the
compute shader source code using this method directly, remember to
remove the Godot-specific hint #compute.
descriptions.RDTextureFormat/method/add_shareable_for:
Adds format as a valid format for the corresponding RDTextureView's
RDTextureView.format_override property. If any format is added as
shareable, then the main format must also be added.
descriptions.RDTextureFormat/method/remove_shareable_:
Removes format from the list of valid formats that the corresponding
RDTextureView's RDTextureView.format_override property can be set to.
descriptions.RDUniform/method/add_id:
Binds the given id to the uniform. The data associated with the id is
then used when the uniform is passed to a shader.
descriptions.RDUniform/method/clear_ids: Unbinds all ids currently bound to the uniform.
descriptions.RDUniform/method/get_ids: Returns an array of all ids currently bound to the uniform.
descriptions.RID/method/get_id: Returns the ID of the referenced low-level resource.
