descriptions.SaveCoordinator/method/get_last_admissio:
Returns the stable code for the most recent admission or setup
rejection, or an empty string when the coordinator has no recorded
rejection. A later rejection replaces the code and a successful
admission clears it. A call from outside the main thread returns
WrongThread.

Returns the reason or recovery guidance for the rejection reported by
get_last_admission_error. Read it immediately after a request returns
zero. A later rejection replaces the message and a successful admission
clears it. A call from outside the main thread returns guidance to
submit requests on the main thread.
descriptions.SceneMultiplayer/method/clear:
Clears the current SceneMultiplayer network state (you shouldn't call
this unless you know what you are doing).
descriptions.SceneMultiplayer/method/complete_auth:
Mark the authentication step as completed for the remote peer identified
by id. The MultiplayerAPI.peer_connected signal will be emitted for this
peer once the remote side also completes the authentication. No further
authentication messages are expected to be received from this peer. If a
peer disconnects before completing authentication, either due to...
descriptions.SceneMultiplayer/method/disconnect_peer:
Disconnects the peer identified by id, removing it from the list of
connected peers, and closing the underlying connection with it.
descriptions.SceneMultiplayer/method/get_authenticati:
Returns the IDs of the peers currently trying to authenticate with this
MultiplayerAPI.
descriptions.SceneMultiplayer/method/send_auth:
Sends the specified data to the remote peer identified by id as part of
an authentication message. This can be used to authenticate peers, and
control when MultiplayerAPI.peer_connected is emitted (and the remote
peer accepted as one of the connected peers).
descriptions.SceneMultiplayer/method/send_bytes:
Sends the given raw bytes to a specific peer identified by id (see
MultiplayerPeer.set_target_peer). Default ID is 0, i.e. broadcast to all
peers.
descriptions.SceneMultiplayer/signal/peer_authenticat:
Emitted when this MultiplayerAPI's MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer
connects to a new peer and a valid auth_callback is set. In this case,
the MultiplayerAPI.peer_connected will not be emitted until
complete_auth is called with given peer id. While in this state, the
peer will not be included in the list returned by
MultiplayerAPI.get_peers (but in the...

Emitted when this MultiplayerAPI's MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer
disconnects from a peer for which authentication had not yet completed.
See peer_authenticating.
descriptions.SceneMultiplayer/signal/peer_packet:
Emitted when this MultiplayerAPI's MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer
receives a packet with custom data (see send_bytes). ID is the peer ID
of the peer that sent the packet.
descriptions.SceneReplicationConfig/method/add_proper:
Adds the property identified by the given path to the list of the
properties being synchronized, optionally passing an index. Note: For
details on restrictions and limitations on property synchronization, see
MultiplayerSynchronizer.
descriptions.SceneReplicationConfig/method/get_proper: Returns a list of synchronized property NodePaths.
descriptions.SceneReplicationConfig/method/has_proper: Returns true if the given path is configured for synchronization.
descriptions.SceneReplicationConfig/method/property_g: Finds the index of the given path.

Returns the replication mode for the property identified by the given
path.

Returns true if the property identified by the given path is configured
to be synchronized on spawn.

Returns true if the property identified by the given path is configured
to be synchronized on process.

Returns true if the property identified by the given path is configured
to be reliably synchronized when changes are detected on process.
descriptions.SceneReplicationConfig/method/property_s:
Sets the synchronization mode for the property identified by the given
path.

Sets whether the property identified by the given path is configured to
be synchronized on spawn.

Sets whether the property identified by the given path is configured to
be synchronized on process.

Sets whether the property identified by the given path is configured to
be reliably synchronized when changes are detected on process.
descriptions.SceneReplicationConfig/method/remove_pro:
Removes the property identified by the given path from the
configuration.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_base_scene_state:
Returns the SceneState of the scene that this scene inherits from, or
null if it doesn't inherit from any scene.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_connection_binds: Returns the list of bound parameters for the signal at idx.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_connection_count:
Returns the number of signal connections in the scene. The idx argument
used to query connection metadata in other get_connection_* methods in
the interval [0, get_connection_count() - 1].
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_connection_flags:
Returns the connection flags for the signal at idx. See
Object.ConnectFlags constants.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_connection_method: Returns the method connected to the signal at idx.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_connection_signal: Returns the name of the signal at idx.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_connection_source:
Returns the path to the node that owns the signal at idx, relative to
the root node.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_connection_target:
Returns the path to the node that owns the method connected to the
signal at idx, relative to the root node.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_connection_unbinds: Returns the number of unbound parameters for the signal at idx.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_node_count:
Returns the number of nodes in the scene. The idx argument used to query
node data in other get_node_* methods in the interval [0,
get_node_count() - 1].
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_node_groups: Returns the list of group names associated with the node at idx.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_node_index:
Returns the node's index, which is its position relative to its
siblings. This is only relevant and saved in scenes for cases where new
nodes are added to an instantiated or inherited scene among siblings
from the base scene. Despite the name, this index is not related to the
idx argument used here and in other methods.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_node_instance:
Returns a PackedScene for the node at idx (i.e. the whole branch
starting at this node, with its child nodes and resources), or null if
the node is not an instance.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_node_instance_plac:
Returns the path to the represented scene file if the node at idx is an
InstancePlaceholder.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_node_name: Returns the name of the node at idx.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_node_owner_path:
Returns the path to the owner of the node at idx, relative to the root
node.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_node_path:
Returns the path to the node at idx. If for_parent is true, returns the
path of the idx node's parent instead.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_node_property_coun:
Returns the number of exported or overridden properties for the node at
idx. The prop_idx argument used to query node property data in other
get_node_property_* methods in the interval [0,
get_node_property_count() - 1].
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_node_property_name: Returns the name of the property at prop_idx for the node at idx.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_node_property_valu: Returns the value of the property at prop_idx for the node at idx.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_node_type: Returns the type of the node at idx.
descriptions.SceneState/method/get_path: Returns the resource path to the represented PackedScene.
descriptions.SceneState/method/is_node_instance_place: Returns true if the node at idx is an InstancePlaceholder.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/call_group:
Calls method on each node inside this tree added to the given group. You
can pass arguments to method by specifying them at the end of this
method call. Nodes that cannot call method (either because the method
doesn't exist or the arguments do not match) are ignored. See also
set_group and notify_group. Note: This method acts immediately on all
selected...
descriptions.SceneTree/method/call_group_flags:
Calls the given method on each node inside this tree added to the given
group. Use flags to customize this method's behavior (see
GroupCallFlags). Additional arguments for method can be passed at the
end of this method. Nodes that cannot call method (either because the
method doesn't exist or the arguments do not match) are ignored.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/change_scene_to_file:
Changes the running scene to the one at the given path, after loading it
into a PackedScene and creating a new instance. Returns OK on success,
ERR_CANT_OPEN if the path cannot be loaded into a PackedScene, or
ERR_CANT_CREATE if that scene cannot be instantiated. Note: See
change_scene_to_node for details on the order of operations.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/change_scene_to_node:
Changes the running scene to the provided Node. Useful when you want to
set up the new scene before changing. Returns OK on success,
ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER if the node is null, or ERR_UNCONFIGURED if the
node is already inside the scene tree. Note: Operations happen in the
following order when change_scene_to_node is called: 1. The current
scene node is...
descriptions.SceneTree/method/change_scene_to_packed:
Changes the running scene to a new instance of the given PackedScene
(which must be valid). Returns OK on success, ERR_CANT_CREATE if the
scene cannot be instantiated, or ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER if the scene is
invalid. Note: See change_scene_to_node for details on the order of
operations.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/create_timer:
Returns a new SceneTreeTimer. After time_sec in seconds have passed, the
timer will emit SceneTreeTimer.timeout and will be automatically freed.
If process_always is false, the timer will be paused when setting
SceneTree.paused to true. If process_in_physics is true, the timer will
update at the end of the physics frame, instead of the process frame.
If...
descriptions.SceneTree/method/create_tween:
Creates and returns a new Tween processed in this tree. The Tween will
start automatically on the next process frame or physics frame
(depending on its Tween.TweenProcessMode). Note: A Tween created using
this method is not bound to any Node. It may keep working until there is
nothing left to animate. If you want the Tween to be automatically
killed when...
descriptions.SceneTree/method/get_first_node_in_group:
Returns the first Node found inside the tree, that has been added to the
given group, in scene hierarchy order. Returns null if no match is
found. See also get_nodes_in_group.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/get_frame:
Returns how many physics process steps have been processed, since the
application started. This is not a measurement of elapsed time. See also
physics_frame. For the number of frames rendered, see
Engine.get_process_frames.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/get_multiplayer:
Searches for the MultiplayerAPI configured for the given path, if one
does not exist it searches the parent paths until one is found. If the
path is empty, or none is found, the default one is returned. See
set_multiplayer.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/get_node_count: Returns the number of nodes inside this tree.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/get_node_count_in_group: Returns the number of nodes assigned to the given group.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/get_nodes_in_group:
Returns an Array containing all nodes inside this tree, that have been
added to the given group, in scene hierarchy order.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/get_processed_tweens:
Returns an Array of currently existing Tweens in the tree, including
paused tweens.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/has_group: Returns true if a node added to the given group name exists in the tree.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/is_accessibility_enable:
Returns true if accessibility features are enabled, and accessibility
information updates are actively processed.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/is_accessibility_suppor:
Returns true if accessibility features are supported by the OS and
enabled in project settings.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/notify_group:
Calls Object.notification with the given notification to all nodes
inside this tree added to the group. See also Godot notifications and
call_group and set_group. Note: This method acts immediately on all
selected nodes at once, which may cause stuttering in some
performance-intensive situations.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/notify_group_flags:
Calls Object.notification with the given notification to all nodes
inside this tree added to the group. Use call_flags to customize this
method's behavior (see GroupCallFlags).
descriptions.SceneTree/method/queue_delete:
Queues the given obj to be deleted, calling its Object.free at the end
of the current frame. This method is similar to Node.queue_free.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/quit:
Quits the application at the end of the current iteration, with the
given exit_code. By convention, an exit code of 0 indicates success,
whereas any other exit code indicates an error. For portability reasons,
it should be between 0 and 125 (inclusive). Note: On iOS this method
doesn't work. Instead, as recommended by the iOS Human Interface
Guidelines,...
descriptions.SceneTree/method/reload_current_scene:
Reloads the currently active scene, replacing current_scene with a new
instance of its original PackedScene. Returns OK on success,
ERR_UNCONFIGURED if no current_scene is defined, ERR_CANT_OPEN if
current_scene cannot be loaded into a PackedScene, or ERR_CANT_CREATE if
the scene cannot be instantiated.
descriptions.SceneTree/method/set_group:
Sets the given property to value on all nodes inside this tree added to
the given group. Nodes that do not have the property are ignored. See
also call_group and notify_group. Note: This method acts immediately on
all selected nodes at once, which may cause stuttering in some
performance-intensive situations. Note: In C#, property must be in
snake_case...
descriptions.SceneTree/method/set_group_flags:
Sets the given property to value on all nodes inside this tree added to
the given group. Nodes that do not have the property are ignored. Use
call_flags to customize this method's behavior (see GroupCallFlags).
Note: In C#, property must be in snake_case when referring to built-in
Godot properties. Prefer using the names exposed in the PropertyName
class...
descriptions.SceneTree/method/set_multiplayer:
Sets a custom MultiplayerAPI with the given root_path (controlling also
the relative subpaths), or override the default one if root_path is
empty. Note: No MultiplayerAPI must be configured for the subpath
containing root_path, nested custom multiplayers are not allowed. I.e.
if one is configured for "/root/Foo" setting one for "/root/Foo/Bar"
will cause...
descriptions.SceneTree/method/unload_current_scene: If a current scene is loaded, calling this method will unload it.
descriptions.SceneTree/signal/node_added: Emitted when the node enters this tree.
descriptions.SceneTree/signal/node_configuration_warn:
Emitted when the node's Node.update_configuration_warnings is called.
Only emitted in the editor.
descriptions.SceneTree/signal/node_removed: Emitted when the node exits this tree.
descriptions.SceneTree/signal/node_renamed: Emitted when the node's Node.name is changed.
descriptions.SceneTree/signal/physics_frame:
Emitted immediately before Node._physics_process is called on every node
in this tree.
descriptions.SceneTree/signal/process_frame:
Emitted immediately before Node._process is called on every node in this
tree.
descriptions.SceneTree/signal/scene_changed:
Emitted after the new scene is added to scene tree and initialized. Can
be used to reliably access current_scene when changing scenes.
descriptions.SceneTree/signal/tree_changed:
Emitted any time the tree's hierarchy changes (nodes being moved,
renamed, etc.).
descriptions.SceneTree/signal/tree_process_mode_chang:
Emitted when the Node.process_mode of any node inside the tree is
changed. Only emitted in the editor, to update the visibility of
disabled nodes.
descriptions.Script/method/can_instantiate: Returns true if the script can be instantiated.
descriptions.Script/method/get_base_script: Returns the script directly inherited by this script.
descriptions.Script/method/get_global_name:
Returns the class name associated with the script, if there is one.
Returns an empty string otherwise. To give the script a global name, you
can use the class_name keyword in GDScript and the GlobalClass attribute
in C#.
descriptions.Script/method/get_property_default_value: Returns the default value of the specified property.
descriptions.Script/method/get_rpc_config:
Returns a Dictionary mapping method names to their RPC configuration
defined by this script.
descriptions.Script/method/get_script_constant_map: Returns a dictionary containing constant names and their values.
descriptions.Script/method/get_script_method_list:
Returns the list of methods in this Script. Note: The dictionaries
returned by this method are formatted identically to those returned by
Object.get_method_list.
descriptions.Script/method/get_script_property_list:
Returns the list of properties in this Script. Note: The dictionaries
returned by this method are formatted identically to those returned by
Object.get_property_list.
descriptions.Script/method/get_script_signal_list:
Returns the list of signals defined in this Script. Note: The
dictionaries returned by this method are formatted identically to those
returned by Object.get_signal_list.
descriptions.Script/method/has_script_method:
Returns true if the script, or a base class, defines a method with the
given name.
descriptions.Script/method/has_script_signal:
Returns true if the script, or a base class, defines a signal with the
given name.
descriptions.Script/method/has_source_code:
Returns true if the script contains non-empty source code. Note: If a
script does not have source code, this does not mean that it is invalid
or unusable. For example, a GDScript that was exported with binary
tokenization has no source code, but still behaves as expected and could
be instantiated. This can be checked with can_instantiate.
descriptions.Script/method/instance_has: Returns true if base_object is an instance of this script.
descriptions.Script/method/is_abstract:
Returns true if the script is an abstract script. An abstract script
does not have a constructor and cannot be instantiated.
descriptions.Script/method/is_tool:
Returns true if the script is a tool script. A tool script can run in
the editor.
descriptions.Script/method/reload: Reloads the script's class implementation. Returns an error code.
descriptions.ScriptBacktrace/method/format:
Converts the backtrace to a String, where the entire string will be
indented by indent_all number of spaces, and the individual stack frames
will be additionally indented by indent_frames number of spaces. Note:
Calling Object.to_string on a ScriptBacktrace will produce the same
output as calling format with all parameters left at their default
values.
descriptions.ScriptBacktrace/method/get_frame_count: Returns the number of stack frames in the backtrace.
descriptions.ScriptBacktrace/method/get_frame_file:
Returns the file name of the call site represented by the stack frame at
the specified index.
descriptions.ScriptBacktrace/method/get_frame_functio:
Returns the name of the function called at the stack frame at the
specified index.
descriptions.ScriptBacktrace/method/get_frame_line:
Returns the line number of the call site represented by the stack frame
at the specified index.
descriptions.ScriptBacktrace/method/get_global_variab:
Returns the number of global variables (e.g. autoload singletons) in the
backtrace. Note: This will be non-zero only if the include_variables
parameter was true when capturing the backtrace with
Engine.capture_script_backtraces.
Returns the name of the global variable at the specified index.

Returns the value of the global variable at the specified index.
Warning: With GDScript backtraces, the returned Variant will be the
variable's actual value, including any object references. This means
that storing the returned Variant will prevent any such object from
being deallocated, so it's generally recommended not to do so.
descriptions.ScriptBacktrace/method/get_language_name:
Returns the name of the script language that this backtrace was captured
from.
descriptions.ScriptBacktrace/method/get_local_variabl:
Returns the number of local variables in the stack frame at the
specified index. Note: This will be non-zero only if the
include_variables parameter was true when capturing the backtrace with
Engine.capture_script_backtraces.

Returns the name of the local variable at the specified variable_index
in the stack frame at the specified frame_index.

Returns the value of the local variable at the specified variable_index
in the stack frame at the specified frame_index. Warning: With GDScript
backtraces, the returned Variant will be the variable's actual value,
including any object references. This means that storing the returned
Variant will prevent any such object from being deallocated, so it's...
descriptions.ScriptBacktrace/method/get_member_variab:
Returns the number of member variables in the stack frame at the
specified index. Note: This will be non-zero only if the
include_variables parameter was true when capturing the backtrace with
Engine.capture_script_backtraces.

Returns the name of the member variable at the specified variable_index
in the stack frame at the specified frame_index.

Returns the value of the member variable at the specified variable_index
in the stack frame at the specified frame_index. Warning: With GDScript
backtraces, the returned Variant will be the variable's actual value,
including any object references. This means that storing the returned
Variant will prevent any such object from being deallocated, so it's...
descriptions.ScriptBacktrace/method/is_empty: Returns true if the backtrace has no stack frames.
descriptions.ScriptExtension/method/_get_script_metho:
Return the expected argument count for the given method, or null if it
can't be determined (which will then fall back to the default behavior).
descriptions.ScriptExtension/method/_is_abstract:
Returns true if the script is an abstract script. Abstract scripts
cannot be instantiated directly, instead other scripts should inherit
them. Abstract scripts will be either unselectable or hidden in the
Create New Node dialog (unselectable if there are non-abstract classes
inheriting it, otherwise hidden).
descriptions.ScriptLanguageExtension/method/_debug_ge: Returns the source associated with a given debug stack position.
descriptions.ScriptLanguageExtension/method/_find_fun:
Returns the line where the function is defined in the code, or -1 if the
function is not present.
descriptions.ScriptLanguageExtension/method/_reload_s:
Reloads all scripts from disk and the specifics of how that happens is
ScriptLanguageExtension specific.
descriptions.ScriptLanguageExtension/method/_reload_t:
Reloads the given script from disk and the specifics of how that happens
is ScriptLanguageExtension specific.
descriptions.ScrollBar/signal/scrolling: Emitted when the scrollbar is being scrolled.
descriptions.ScrollContainer/method/ensure_control_vi:
Ensures the given control is visible (must be a direct or indirect child
of the ScrollContainer). Used by follow_focus. Note: This will not work
on a node that was just added during the same frame. If you want to
scroll to a newly added child, you must wait until the next frame using
SceneTree.process_frame:
descriptions.ScrollContainer/method/get_h_scroll_bar:
Returns the horizontal scrollbar HScrollBar of this ScrollContainer.
Warning: This is a required internal node, removing and freeing it may
cause a crash. If you wish to disable or hide a scrollbar, you can use
horizontal_scroll_mode.
descriptions.ScrollContainer/method/get_v_scroll_bar:
Returns the vertical scrollbar VScrollBar of this ScrollContainer.
Warning: This is a required internal node, removing and freeing it may
cause a crash. If you wish to disable or hide a scrollbar, you can use
vertical_scroll_mode.
descriptions.ScrollContainer/signal/scroll_ended:
Emitted when scrolling stops when dragging the scrollable area with a
touch event. This signal is not emitted when scrolling by dragging the
scrollbar, scrolling with the mouse wheel or scrolling with
keyboard/gamepad events. Note: This signal is only emitted on Android or
iOS, or on desktop/web platforms when...
descriptions.ScrollContainer/signal/scroll_started:
Emitted when scrolling starts when dragging the scrollable area with a
touch event. This signal is not emitted when scrolling by dragging the
scrollbar, scrolling with the mouse wheel or scrolling with
keyboard/gamepad events. Note: This signal is only emitted on Android or
iOS, or on desktop/web platforms when...
descriptions.Semaphore/method/post:
Lowers the Semaphore, allowing one thread in, or more if count is
specified.
descriptions.Semaphore/method/try_wait:
Like wait, but won't block, so if the value is zero, fails immediately
and returns false. If non-zero, it returns true to report success.
descriptions.Semaphore/method/wait: Waits for the Semaphore, if its value is zero, blocks until non-zero.
descriptions.Shader/method/get_default_texture_parame:
Returns the texture that is set as default for the specified parameter.
Note: name must match the name of the uniform in the code exactly. Note:
If the sampler array is used use index to access the specified texture.
descriptions.Shader/method/get_mode: Returns the shader mode for the shader.
descriptions.Shader/method/get_shader_uniform_list:
Returns the list of shader uniforms that can be assigned to a
ShaderMaterial, for use with ShaderMaterial.set_shader_parameter and
ShaderMaterial.get_shader_parameter. The parameters returned are
contained in dictionaries in a similar format to the ones returned by
Object.get_property_list. If argument get_groups is true, parameter
grouping hints are...
descriptions.Shader/method/inspect_native_shader_code:
Only available when running in the editor. Opens a popup that visualizes
the generated shader code, including all variants and internal shader
code. See also Material.inspect_native_shader_code.
descriptions.Shader/method/set_default_texture_parame:
Sets the default texture to be used with a texture uniform. The default
is used if a texture is not set in the ShaderMaterial. Note: name must
match the name of the uniform in the code exactly. Note: If the sampler
array is used use index to access the specified texture.
descriptions.ShaderIncludeDB/method/get_built_in_incl:
Returns the code for the built-in shader fragment. You can also access
this in your shader code through #include "filename".
descriptions.ShaderIncludeDB/method/has_built_in_incl: Returns true if an include file with this name exists.
descriptions.ShaderIncludeDB/method/list_built_in_inc: Returns a list of built-in include files that are currently registered.
descriptions.ShaderMaterial/method/get_shader_paramet:
Returns the current value set for this material of a uniform in the
shader.
descriptions.ShaderMaterial/method/set_shader_paramet:
Changes the value set for this material of a uniform in the shader.
Note: param is case-sensitive and must match the name of the uniform in
the code exactly (not the capitalized name in the inspector). Note:
Changes to the shader uniform will be effective on all instances using
this ShaderMaterial. To prevent this, use per-instance uniforms with...
descriptions.Shape2D/method/collide:
Returns true if this shape is colliding with another. This method needs
the transformation matrix for this shape (local_xform), the shape to
check collisions with (with_shape), and the transformation matrix of
that shape (shape_xform).
descriptions.Shape2D/method/collide_and_get_contacts:
Returns a list of contact point pairs where this shape touches another.
If there are no collisions, the returned list is empty. Otherwise, the
returned list contains contact points arranged in pairs, with entries
alternating between points on the boundary of this shape and points on
the boundary of with_shape. A collision pair A, B can be used to...
descriptions.Shape2D/method/collide_with_motion:
Returns whether this shape would collide with another, if a given
movement was applied. This method needs the transformation matrix for
this shape (local_xform), the movement to test on this shape
(local_motion), the shape to check collisions with (with_shape), the
transformation matrix of that shape (shape_xform), and the movement to
test onto the other...
descriptions.Shape2D/method/collide_with_motion_and_g:
Returns a list of contact point pairs where this shape would touch
another, if a given movement was applied. If there would be no
collisions, the returned list is empty. Otherwise, the returned list
contains contact points arranged in pairs, with entries alternating
between points on the boundary of this shape and points on the boundary
of with_shape. A...
descriptions.Shape2D/method/draw:
Draws a solid shape onto a CanvasItem with the RenderingServer API
filled with the specified color. The exact drawing method is specific
for each shape and cannot be configured.
descriptions.Shape2D/method/get_rect: Returns a Rect2 representing the shapes boundary.
descriptions.Shape3D/method/get_debug_mesh: Returns the ArrayMesh used to draw the debug collision for this Shape3D.
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/add_exception:
Adds a collision exception so the shape does not report collisions with
the specified node.
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/add_exception_rid:
Adds a collision exception so the shape does not report collisions with
the specified RID.
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/clear_exceptions: Removes all collision exceptions for this shape.
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/force_shapecast_updat:
Updates the collision information for the shape immediately, without
waiting for the next _physics_process call. Use this method, for
example, when the shape or its parent has changed state. Note: Setting
enabled to true is not required for this to work.
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/get_closest_collision:
Returns the fraction from this cast's origin to its target_position of
how far the shape can move without triggering a collision, as a value
between 0.0 and 1.0.

Returns the fraction from this cast's origin to its target_position of
how far the shape must move to trigger a collision, as a value between
0.0 and 1.0. In ideal conditions this would be the same as
get_closest_collision_safe_fraction, however shape casting is calculated
in discrete steps, so the precise point of collision can occur between
two...
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/get_collider:
Returns the collided Object of one of the multiple collisions at index,
or null if no object is intersecting the shape (i.e. is_colliding
returns false).
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/get_collider_rid:
Returns the RID of the collided object of one of the multiple collisions
at index.
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/get_collider_shape:
Returns the shape ID of the colliding shape of one of the multiple
collisions at index, or 0 if no object is intersecting the shape (i.e.
is_colliding returns false).
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/get_collision_count:
The number of collisions detected at the point of impact. Use this to
iterate over multiple collisions as provided by get_collider,
get_collider_shape, get_collision_point, and get_collision_normal
methods.
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/get_collision_mask_va:
Returns whether or not the specified layer of the collision_mask is
enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/get_collision_normal:
Returns the normal of one of the multiple collisions at index of the
intersecting object.
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/get_collision_point:
Returns the collision point of one of the multiple collisions at index
where the shape intersects the colliding object. Note: This point is in
the global coordinate system.
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/is_colliding:
Returns whether any object is intersecting with the shape's vector
(considering the vector length).
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/remove_exception:
Removes a collision exception so the shape does report collisions with
the specified node.
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/remove_exception_rid:
Removes a collision exception so the shape does report collisions with
the specified RID.
descriptions.ShapeCast2D/method/set_collision_mask_va:
Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the
collision_mask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.ShapeCast3D/method/add_exception:
Adds a collision exception so the shape does not report collisions with
the specified node.
descriptions.ShapeCast3D/method/add_exception_rid:
Adds a collision exception so the shape does not report collisions with
the specified RID.
descriptions.ShapeCast3D/method/clear_exceptions: Removes all collision exceptions for this shape.
descriptions.ShapeCast3D/method/force_shapecast_updat:
Updates the collision information for the shape immediately, without
waiting for the next _physics_process call. Use this method, for
example, when the shape or its parent has changed state. Note: Setting
enabled to true is not required for this to work.
descriptions.ShapeCast3D/method/get_closest_collision:
Returns the fraction from this cast's origin to its target_position of
how far the shape can move without triggering a collision, as a value
between 0.0 and 1.0.

Returns the fraction from this cast's origin to its target_position of
how far the shape must move to trigger a collision, as a value between

descriptions.ShapeCast3D/method/get_collider_rid:
Returns the RID of the collided object of one of the multiple collisions

descriptions.ShapeCast3D/method/get_collider_shape:

collisions at index, or 0 if no object is intersecting the shape (i.e.

descriptions.ShapeCast3D/method/get_collision_normal:

descriptions.ShapeCast3D/method/is_colliding:
Returns whether any object is intersecting with the shape's vector

descriptions.ShapeCast3D/method/remove_exception:
Removes a collision exception so the shape does report collisions with

descriptions.ShapeCast3D/method/remove_exception_rid:
Removes a collision exception so the shape does report collisions with
the specified RID.
descriptions.ShapeCast3D/method/set_collision_mask_va:
Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the
collision_mask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.Shortcut/method/get_as_text: Returns the shortcut's first valid InputEvent as a String.
descriptions.Shortcut/method/has_valid_event: Returns whether events contains an InputEvent which is valid.
descriptions.Shortcut/method/matches_event:
Returns whether any InputEvent in events equals event. This uses
InputEvent.is_match to compare events.
descriptions.Signal/method/connect:
Connects this signal to the specified callable. Optional flags can be
also added to configure the connection's behavior (see
Object.ConnectFlags constants). You can provide additional arguments to
the connected callable by using Callable.bind. A signal can only be
connected once to the same Callable. If the signal is already connected,
this method...
descriptions.Signal/method/disconnect:
Disconnects this signal from the specified Callable. If the connection
does not exist, generates an error. Use is_connected to make sure that
the connection exists.
descriptions.Signal/method/emit:
Emits this signal. All Callables connected to this signal will be
triggered. This method supports a variable number of arguments, so
parameters can be passed as a comma separated list.
descriptions.Signal/method/get_connections:
Returns an Array of connections for this signal. Each connection is
represented as a Dictionary that contains three entries: - signal is a
reference to this signal; - callable is a reference to the connected
Callable; - flags is a combination of Object.ConnectFlags.
descriptions.Signal/method/get_name: Returns the name of this signal.
descriptions.Signal/method/get_object: Returns the object emitting this signal.
descriptions.Signal/method/get_object_id:
Returns the ID of the object emitting this signal (see
Object.get_instance_id).
descriptions.Signal/method/has_connections: Returns true if any Callable is connected to this signal.
descriptions.Signal/method/is_connected: Returns true if the specified Callable is connected to this signal.
descriptions.Signal/method/is_null:
Returns true if this Signal has no object and the signal name is empty.
Equivalent to signal == Signal().
descriptions.Skeleton2D/method/execute_modifications:
Executes all the modifications on the SkeletonModificationStack2D, if
the Skeleton2D has one assigned.
descriptions.Skeleton2D/method/get_bone:
Returns a Bone2D from the node hierarchy parented by Skeleton2D. The
object to return is identified by the parameter idx. Bones are indexed
by descending the node hierarchy from top to bottom, adding the children
of each branch before moving to the next sibling.
descriptions.Skeleton2D/method/get_bone_count:
Returns the number of Bone2D nodes in the node hierarchy parented by
Skeleton2D.
descriptions.Skeleton2D/method/get_bone_local_pose_ov: Returns the local pose override transform for bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton2D/method/get_modification_stack:
Returns the SkeletonModificationStack2D attached to this skeleton, if
one exists.
descriptions.Skeleton2D/method/get_skeleton: Returns the RID of a Skeleton2D instance.
descriptions.Skeleton2D/method/set_bone_local_pose_ov:
Sets the local pose transform, override_pose, for the bone at bone_idx.
strength is the interpolation strength that will be used when applying
the pose, and persistent determines if the applied pose will remain.
Note: The pose transform needs to be a local transform relative to the
Bone2D node at bone_idx!
descriptions.Skeleton2D/method/set_modification_stack: Sets the SkeletonModificationStack2D attached to this skeleton.
descriptions.Skeleton2D/signal/bone_setup_changed:
Emitted when the Bone2D setup attached to this skeletons changes. This
is primarily used internally within the skeleton.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/add_bone:
Adds a new bone with the given name. Returns the new bone's index, or -1
if this method fails. Note: Bone names should be unique, non empty, and
cannot include the : and / characters.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/advance:
Manually advance the child SkeletonModifier3Ds by the specified time (in
seconds). Note: The delta is temporarily accumulated in the Skeleton3D,
and the deferred process uses the accumulated value to process the
modification.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/clear_bones: Clear all the bones in this skeleton.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/clear_bones_global_pos: Removes the global pose override on all bones in the skeleton.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/find_bone:
Returns the bone index that matches name as its name. Returns -1 if no
bone with this name exists.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/force_update_all_bone_: Force updates the bone transforms/poses for all bones in the skeleton.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/force_update_bone_chil:
Force updates the bone transform for the bone at bone_idx and all of its
children.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_children:
Returns an array containing the bone indexes of all the child node of
the passed in bone, bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_count: Returns the number of bones in the skeleton.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_global_pose:
Returns the overall transform of the specified bone, with respect to the
skeleton. Being relative to the skeleton frame, this is not the actual
"global" transform of the bone. Note: This is the global pose you set to
the skeleton in the process, the final global pose can get overridden by
modifiers in the deferred process, if you want to access the final...
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_global_pose_n:
Returns the overall transform of the specified bone, with respect to the
skeleton, but without any global pose overrides. Being relative to the
skeleton frame, this is not the actual "global" transform of the bone.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_global_pose_o: Returns the global pose override transform for bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_global_rest: Returns the global rest transform for bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_meta: Returns the metadata with the given key for the bone at index bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_meta_list: Returns the list of all metadata keys for the bone at index bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_name: Returns the name of the bone at index bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_parent:
Returns the bone index which is the parent of the bone at bone_idx. If
-1, then bone has no parent. Note: The parent bone returned will always
be less than bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_pose:
Returns the pose transform of the specified bone. Note: This is the pose
you set to the skeleton in the process, the final pose can get
overridden by modifiers in the deferred process, if you want to access
the final pose, use SkeletonModifier3D.modification_processed.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_pose_position:
Returns the pose position of the bone at bone_idx. The returned Vector3
is in the local coordinate space of the Skeleton3D node.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_pose_rotation:
Returns the pose rotation of the bone at bone_idx. The returned
Quaternion is local to the bone with respect to the rotation of any
parent bones.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_pose_scale: Returns the pose scale of the bone at bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_bone_rest: Returns the rest transform for a bone bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_concatenated_bone_:
Returns all bone names concatenated with commas (,) as a single
StringName. It is useful to set it as a hint for the enum property.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_parentless_bones:
Returns an array with all of the bones that are parentless. Another way
to look at this is that it returns the indexes of all the bones that are
not dependent or modified by other bones in the Skeleton.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/get_version:
Returns the number of times the bone hierarchy has changed within this
skeleton, including renames. The Skeleton version is not serialized:
only use within a single instance of Skeleton3D. Use for invalidating
caches in IK solvers and other nodes which process bones.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/has_bone_meta:
Returns true if the bone at index bone_idx has metadata with the given
key.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/is_bone_enabled: Returns whether the bone pose for the bone at bone_idx is enabled.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/localize_rests: Returns all bones in the skeleton to their rest poses.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/physical_bones_add_col:
Adds a collision exception to the physical bone. Works just like the
RigidBody3D node.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/physical_bones_remove_:
Removes a collision exception to the physical bone. Works just like the
RigidBody3D node.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/physical_bones_start_s:
Tells the PhysicalBone3D nodes in the Skeleton to start simulating and
reacting to the physics world. Optionally, a list of bone names can be
passed-in, allowing only the passed-in bones to be simulated.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/physical_bones_stop_si: Tells the PhysicalBone3D nodes in the Skeleton to stop simulating.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/register_skin: Binds the given Skin to the Skeleton.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/reset_bone_pose: Sets the bone pose to rest for bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/reset_bone_poses: Sets all bone poses to rests.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/set_bone_enabled:
Disables the pose for the bone at bone_idx if false, enables the bone
pose if true.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/set_bone_global_pose:
Sets the global pose transform, pose, for the bone at bone_idx. Note: If
other bone poses have been changed, this method executes a dirty poses
recalculation and will cause performance to deteriorate. If you know
that multiple global poses will be applied, consider using set_bone_pose
with precalculation.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/set_bone_global_pose_o:
Sets the global pose transform, pose, for the bone at bone_idx. amount
is the interpolation strength that will be used when applying the pose,
and persistent determines if the applied pose will remain. Note: The
pose transform needs to be a global pose! To convert a world transform
from a Node3D to a global bone pose, multiply the...
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/set_bone_meta:
Sets the metadata with the given key to value for the bone at index
bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/set_bone_name: Sets the bone name, name, for the bone at bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/set_bone_parent:
Sets the bone index parent_idx as the parent of the bone at bone_idx. If
-1, then bone has no parent. Note: parent_idx must be less than
bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/set_bone_pose: Sets the pose transform, pose, for the bone at bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/set_bone_pose_position:
Sets the pose position of the bone at bone_idx to position. position is
a Vector3 describing a position local to the Skeleton3D node.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/set_bone_pose_rotation:
Sets the pose rotation of the bone at bone_idx to rotation. rotation is
a Quaternion describing a rotation in the bone's local coordinate space
with respect to the rotation of any parent bones.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/set_bone_pose_scale: Sets the pose scale of the bone at bone_idx to scale.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/set_bone_rest: Sets the rest transform for bone bone_idx.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/method/unparent_bone_and_rest:
Unparents the bone at bone_idx and sets its rest position to that of its
parent prior to being reset.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/signal/bone_enabled_changed:
Emitted when the bone at bone_idx is toggled with set_bone_enabled. Use
is_bone_enabled to check the new value.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/signal/bone_list_changed:
Emitted when the list of bones changes, such as when calling add_bone,
set_bone_parent, unparent_bone_and_rest, or clear_bones.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/signal/pose_updated:
Emitted when the pose is updated. Note: During the update process, this
signal is not fired, so modification by SkeletonModifier3D is not
detected.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/signal/rest_updated: Emitted when the rest is updated.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/signal/show_rest_only_changed: Emitted when the value of show_rest_only changes.
descriptions.Skeleton3D/signal/skeleton_updated:
Emitted when the final pose has been calculated will be applied to the
skin in the update process. This means that all SkeletonModifier3D
processing is complete. In order to detect the completion of the
processing of each SkeletonModifier3D, use
SkeletonModifier3D.modification_processed.
descriptions.SkeletonIK3D/method/get_parent_skeleton:
Returns the parent Skeleton3D node that was present when SkeletonIK
entered the scene tree. Returns null if the parent node was not a
Skeleton3D node when SkeletonIK3D entered the scene tree.
descriptions.SkeletonIK3D/method/is_running:
Returns true if SkeletonIK is applying IK effects on continues frames to
the Skeleton3D bones. Returns false if SkeletonIK is stopped or start
was used with the one_time parameter set to true.
descriptions.SkeletonIK3D/method/start:
Starts applying IK effects on each frame to the Skeleton3D bones but
will only take effect starting on the next frame. If one_time is true,
this will take effect immediately but also reset on the next frame.
descriptions.SkeletonIK3D/method/stop:
Stops applying IK effects on each frame to the Skeleton3D bones and also
calls Skeleton3D.clear_bones_global_pose_override to remove existing
overrides on all bones.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2D/method/_draw_edit:
Used for drawing editor-only modification gizmos. This function will
only be called in the Godot editor and can be overridden to draw custom
gizmos. Note: You will need to use the Skeleton2D from
SkeletonModificationStack2D.get_skeleton and it's draw functions, as the
SkeletonModification2D resource cannot draw on its own.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2D/method/_execute:
Executes the given modification. This is where the modification performs
whatever function it is designed to do.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2D/method/_setup_mod:
Called when the modification is setup. This is where the modification
performs initialization.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2D/method/clamp_angl:
Takes an angle and clamps it so it is within the passed-in min and max
range. invert will inversely clamp the angle, clamping it to the range
outside of the given bounds.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2D/method/get_editor:
Returns whether this modification will call _draw_editor_gizmo in the
Godot editor to draw modification-specific gizmos.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2D/method/get_is_set: Returns whether this modification has been successfully setup or not.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2D/method/get_modifi:
Returns the SkeletonModificationStack2D that this modification is bound
to. Through the modification stack, you can access the Skeleton2D the
modification is operating on.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2D/method/set_editor:
Sets whether this modification will call _draw_editor_gizmo in the Godot
editor to draw modification-specific gizmos.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2D/method/set_is_set:
Manually allows you to set the setup state of the modification. This
function should only rarely be used, as the SkeletonModificationStack2D
the modification is bound to should handle setting the modification up.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2DCCDIK/method/get_c: Returns the Bone2D node assigned to the CCDIK joint at joint_idx.

Returns the index of the Bone2D node assigned to the CCDIK joint at
joint_idx.

Returns whether the CCDIK joint at joint_idx uses an inverted joint
constraint. See set_ccdik_joint_constraint_angle_invert for details.
Returns the maximum angle constraint for the joint at joint_idx.
Returns the minimum angle constraint for the joint at joint_idx.

Returns whether angle constraints on the CCDIK joint at joint_idx are
enabled.

Returns whether the joint at joint_idx is set to rotate from the joint,
true, or to rotate from the tip, false. The default is to rotate from
the tip.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2DCCDIK/method/set_c: Sets the Bone2D node assigned to the CCDIK joint at joint_idx.

Sets the bone index, bone_idx, of the CCDIK joint at joint_idx. When
possible, this will also update the bone2d_node of the CCDIK joint based
on data provided by the linked skeleton.

Sets whether the CCDIK joint at joint_idx uses an inverted joint
constraint. An inverted joint constraint only constraints the CCDIK
joint to the angles outside of the inputted minimum and maximum angles.
For this reason, it is referred to as an inverted joint constraint, as
it constraints the joint to the outside of the inputted values.
Sets the maximum angle constraint for the joint at joint_idx.
Sets the minimum angle constraint for the joint at joint_idx.

Determines whether angle constraints on the CCDIK joint at joint_idx are
enabled. When true, constraints will be enabled and taken into account
when solving.

Sets whether the joint at joint_idx is set to rotate from the joint,
true, or to rotate from the tip, false.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2DFABRIK/method/get_: Returns the Bone2D node assigned to the FABRIK joint at joint_idx.

Returns the index of the Bone2D node assigned to the FABRIK joint at
joint_idx.
Returns the magnet position vector for the joint at joint_idx.

Returns whether the joint is using the target's rotation rather than
allowing FABRIK to rotate the joint. This option only applies to the
tip/final joint in the chain.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2DFABRIK/method/set_: Sets the Bone2D node assigned to the FABRIK joint at joint_idx.

Sets the bone index, bone_idx, of the FABRIK joint at joint_idx. When
possible, this will also update the bone2d_node of the FABRIK joint
based on data provided by the linked skeleton.
Sets the magnet position vector for the joint at joint_idx.

Sets whether the joint at joint_idx will use the target node's rotation
rather than letting FABRIK rotate the node. Note: This option only works
for the tip/final joint in the chain. For all other nodes, this option
will be ignored.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2DJiggle/method/get_:
Returns the collision mask used by the Jiggle modifier when collisions
are enabled.
Returns the Bone2D node assigned to the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.

Returns the index of the Bone2D node assigned to the Jiggle joint at
joint_idx.
Returns the amount of damping of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.

Returns a Vector2 representing the amount of gravity the Jiggle joint at
joint_idx is influenced by.
Returns the amount of mass of the jiggle joint at joint_idx.

Returns a boolean that indicates whether the joint at joint_idx is
overriding the default Jiggle joint data defined in the modification.
Returns the stiffness of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.

Returns a boolean that indicates whether the joint at joint_idx is using
gravity or not.

Returns whether the jiggle modifier is taking physics colliders into
account when solving.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2DJiggle/method/rese:
Resets the internal jiggle simulation state to the current bone
positions, clearing velocity, acceleration, and accumulated forces.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2DJiggle/method/set_:
Sets the collision mask that the Jiggle modifier will use when reacting
to colliders, if the Jiggle modifier is set to take colliders into
account.
Sets the Bone2D node assigned to the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.

Sets the bone index, bone_idx, of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx. When
possible, this will also update the bone2d_node of the Jiggle joint
based on data provided by the linked skeleton.
Sets the amount of damping of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.
Sets the gravity vector of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.
Sets the of mass of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.

Sets whether the Jiggle joint at joint_idx should override the default
Jiggle joint settings. Setting this to true will make the joint use its
own settings rather than the default ones attached to the modification.
Sets the of stiffness of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.
Sets whether the Jiggle joint at joint_idx should use gravity.

If true, the Jiggle modifier will take colliders into account, keeping
them from entering into these collision objects.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2DLookAt/method/get_:
Returns the amount of additional rotation that is applied after the
LookAt modification executes.

Returns whether the constraints to this modification are inverted or
not.
Returns the constraint's maximum allowed angle.
Returns the constraint's minimum allowed angle.
Returns true if the LookAt modification is using constraints.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2DLookAt/method/set_:
Sets the amount of additional rotation that is to be applied after
executing the modification. This allows for offsetting the results by
the inputted rotation amount.

When true, the modification will use an inverted joint constraint. An
inverted joint constraint only constraints the Bone2D to the angles
outside of the inputted minimum and maximum angles. For this reason, it
is referred to as an inverted joint constraint, as it constraints the
joint to the outside of the inputted values.
Sets the constraint's maximum allowed angle.
Sets the constraint's minimum allowed angle.

Sets whether this modification will use constraints or not. When true,
constraints will be applied when solving the LookAt modification.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2DPhysicalBones/meth:
Empties the list of PhysicalBone2D nodes and populates it with all
PhysicalBone2D nodes that are children of the Skeleton2D.
Returns the PhysicalBone2D node at joint_idx.

Sets the PhysicalBone2D node at joint_idx. Note: This is just the index
used for this modification, not the bone index used in the Skeleton2D.

Tell the PhysicalBone2D nodes to start simulating and interacting with
the physics world. Optionally, an array of bone names can be passed to
this function, and that will cause only PhysicalBone2D nodes with those
names to start simulating.

Tell the PhysicalBone2D nodes to stop simulating and interacting with
the physics world. Optionally, an array of bone names can be passed to
this function, and that will cause only PhysicalBone2D nodes with those
names to stop simulating.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2DStackHolder/method:
Returns the SkeletonModificationStack2D that this modification is
holding.

Sets the SkeletonModificationStack2D that this modification is holding.
This modification stack will then be executed when this modification is
executed.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2DTwoBoneIK/method/g:
Returns the Bone2D node that is being used as the first bone in the
TwoBoneIK modification.

Returns the index of the Bone2D node that is being used as the first
bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.

Returns the Bone2D node that is being used as the second bone in the
TwoBoneIK modification.

Returns the index of the Bone2D node that is being used as the second
bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.
descriptions.SkeletonModification2DTwoBoneIK/method/s:
Sets the Bone2D node that is being used as the first bone in the
TwoBoneIK modification.

Sets the index of the Bone2D node that is being used as the first bone
in the TwoBoneIK modification.

Sets the Bone2D node that is being used as the second bone in the
TwoBoneIK modification.

Sets the index of the Bone2D node that is being used as the second bone
in the TwoBoneIK modification.
descriptions.SkeletonModificationStack2D/method/add_m: Adds the passed-in SkeletonModification2D to the stack.
descriptions.SkeletonModificationStack2D/method/delet:
Deletes the SkeletonModification2D at the index position mod_idx, if it
exists.
descriptions.SkeletonModificationStack2D/method/enabl: Enables all SkeletonModification2Ds in the stack.
descriptions.SkeletonModificationStack2D/method/execu:
Executes all of the SkeletonModification2Ds in the stack that use the
same execution mode as the passed-in execution_mode, starting from index
0 to modification_count. Note: The order of the modifications can matter
depending on the modifications. For example, modifications on a spine
should operate before modifications on the arms in order to get
proper...
descriptions.SkeletonModificationStack2D/method/get_i:
Returns a boolean that indicates whether the modification stack is setup
and can execute.
descriptions.SkeletonModificationStack2D/method/get_m: Returns the SkeletonModification2D at the passed-in index, mod_idx.
descriptions.SkeletonModificationStack2D/method/get_s:
Returns the Skeleton2D node that the SkeletonModificationStack2D is
bound to.
descriptions.SkeletonModificationStack2D/method/set_m:
Sets the modification at mod_idx to the passed-in modification,
modification.
descriptions.SkeletonModificationStack2D/method/setup:
Sets up the modification stack so it can execute. This function should
be called by Skeleton2D and shouldn't be manually called unless you know
what you are doing.
descriptions.SkeletonModifier3D/method/_process_modif:
Override this virtual method to implement a custom skeleton modifier.
You should do things like get the Skeleton3D's current pose and apply
the pose here. _process_modification must not apply influence to bone
poses because the Skeleton3D automatically applies influence to all bone
poses set by the modifier.

Override this virtual method to implement a custom skeleton modifier.
You should do things like get the Skeleton3D's current pose and apply
the pose here. _process_modification_with_delta must not apply influence
to bone poses because the Skeleton3D automatically applies influence to
all bone poses set by the modifier. delta is passed from parent...
descriptions.SkeletonModifier3D/method/_skeleton_chan: Called when the skeleton is changed.
descriptions.SkeletonModifier3D/method/_validate_bone:
Called when bone names and indices need to be validated, such as when
entering the scene tree or changing skeleton.
descriptions.SkeletonModifier3D/method/get_skeleton:
Returns the parent Skeleton3D node if it exists. Otherwise, returns
null.
descriptions.SkeletonModifier3D/signal/modification_p:
Notifies when the modification have been finished. Note: If you want to
get the modified bone pose by the modifier, you must use
Skeleton3D.get_bone_pose or Skeleton3D.get_bone_global_pose at the
moment this signal is fired.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/find_bone: Returns the bone index that matches bone_name as its name.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/get_bone_name:
Returns the name of the bone at bone_idx that will be the key name in
the BoneMap. In the retargeting process, the returned bone name is the
bone name of the target skeleton.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/get_bone_parent:
Returns the name of the bone which is the parent to the bone at
bone_idx. The result is empty if the bone has no parent.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/get_bone_tail: Returns the name of the bone which is the tail of the bone at bone_idx.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/get_group: Returns the group of the bone at bone_idx.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/get_group_name:
Returns the name of the group at group_idx that will be the drawing
group in the BoneMap editor.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/get_handle_offset:
Returns the offset of the bone at bone_idx that will be the button
position in the BoneMap editor. This is the offset with origin at the
top left corner of the square.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/get_reference_pos: Returns the reference pose transform for bone bone_idx.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/get_tail_directio: Returns the tail direction of the bone at bone_idx.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/get_texture:
Returns the texture of the group at group_idx that will be the drawing
group background image in the BoneMap editor.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/is_required:
Returns whether the bone at bone_idx is required for retargeting. This
value is used by the bone map editor. If this method returns true, and
no bone is assigned, the handle color will be red on the bone map
editor.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/set_bone_name:
Sets the name of the bone at bone_idx that will be the key name in the
BoneMap. In the retargeting process, the setting bone name is the bone
name of the target skeleton.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/set_bone_parent:
Sets the bone with name bone_parent as the parent of the bone at
bone_idx. If an empty string is passed, then the bone has no parent.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/set_bone_tail: Sets the bone with name bone_tail as the tail of the bone at bone_idx.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/set_group: Sets the group of the bone at bone_idx.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/set_group_name:
Sets the name of the group at group_idx that will be the drawing group
in the BoneMap editor.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/set_handle_offset:
Sets the offset of the bone at bone_idx that will be the button position
in the BoneMap editor. This is the offset with origin at the top left
corner of the square.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/set_reference_pos: Sets the reference pose transform for bone bone_idx.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/set_required: Sets the required status for bone bone_idx to required.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/set_tail_directio:
Sets the tail direction of the bone at bone_idx. Note: This only
specifies the method of calculation. The actual coordinates required
should be stored in an external skeleton, so the calculation itself
needs to be done externally.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/method/set_texture:
Sets the texture of the group at group_idx that will be the drawing
group background image in the BoneMap editor.
descriptions.SkeletonProfile/signal/profile_updated:
This signal is emitted when change the value in profile. This is used to
update key name in the BoneMap and to redraw the BoneMap editor. Note:
This signal is not connected directly to editor to simplify the
reference, instead it is passed on to editor through the BoneMap.
descriptions.SkinReference/method/get_skeleton:
Returns the RID owned by this SkinReference, as returned by
RenderingServer.skeleton_create.
descriptions.SkinReference/method/get_skin:
Returns the Skin connected to this SkinReference. In the case of
MeshInstance3D with no MeshInstance3D.skin assigned, this will reference
an internal default Skin owned by that MeshInstance3D. Note that a
single Skin may have more than one SkinReference in the case that it is
shared by meshes across multiple Skeleton3D nodes.
descriptions.Slider/signal/drag_ended:
Emitted when the grabber stops being dragged. If value_changed is true,
Range.value is different from the value when the dragging was started.
descriptions.Slider/signal/drag_started:
Emitted when the grabber starts being dragged. This is emitted before
the corresponding Range.value_changed signal.
descriptions.SliderJoint3D/method/get_param: Returns the value of the given parameter.
descriptions.SliderJoint3D/method/set_param: Assigns value to the given parameter.
descriptions.SocketServer/method/is_connection_availa: Returns true if a connection is available for taking.
descriptions.SocketServer/method/is_listening: Returns true if the server is currently listening for connections.
descriptions.SocketServer/method/take_socket_connecti:
If a connection is available, returns a StreamPeerSocket with the
connection.
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/add_collision_exceptio: Adds a body to the list of bodies that this body can't collide with.
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/apply_central_force:
Distributes and applies a force to all points. A force is time dependent
and meant to be applied every physics update.
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/apply_central_impulse:
Distributes and applies an impulse to all points. An impulse is
time-independent! Applying an impulse every frame would result in a
framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it should only be used when
simulating one-time impacts (use the "_force" functions otherwise).
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/apply_force:
Applies a force to a point. A force is time dependent and meant to be
applied every physics update.
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/apply_impulse:
Applies an impulse to a point. An impulse is time-independent! Applying
an impulse every frame would result in a framerate-dependent force. For
this reason, it should only be used when simulating one-time impacts
(use the "_force" functions otherwise).
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/get_collision_exceptio:
Returns an array of nodes that were added as collision exceptions for
this body.
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/get_collision_layer_va:
Returns whether or not the specified layer of the collision_layer is
enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/get_collision_mask_val:
Returns whether or not the specified layer of the collision_mask is
enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/get_physics_rid: Returns the internal RID used by the PhysicsServer3D for this body.
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/get_point_transform: Returns local translation of a vertex in the surface array.
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/is_point_pinned: Returns true if vertex is set to pinned.
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/remove_collision_excep:
Removes a body from the list of bodies that this body can't collide
with.
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/set_collision_layer_va:
Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the
collision_layer, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/set_collision_mask_val:
Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the
collision_mask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
descriptions.SoftBody3D/method/set_point_pinned:
Sets the pinned state of a surface vertex. When set to true, the
optional attachment_path can define a Node3D the pinned vertex will be
attached to.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/add:
Place an unused instance ID in the first legal position in row-major
order. The footprint is unrotated. Returns OK on commit, ERR_CANT_CREATE
if there is no fit, ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS for a duplicate ID,
ERR_UNCONFIGURED on a fresh unconfigured grid, or ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER
for an empty ID or nonpositive footprint.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/apply_placement_:
Compares current placements with expected values and atomically applies
the changes across grids. Each row is a dictionary containing inventory,
id, before, and after. Use placement dictionaries from get_placement or
an empty dictionary for absence. A stale expected placement returns
ERR_BUSY. If any row fails validation, every grid keeps its previous
state.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/check_move:
Returns OK if the item can move to origin with the requested rotation.
The item's current cells are treated as free.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/check_placement:
Returns OK if the footprint fits within the grid at origin and every
cell it covers is free.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/check_transfer:
Returns OK if the item can transfer to destination. The destination
needs room for the footprint and an unused instance ID. A transfer to
this grid uses check_move.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/configure:
Sets the grid dimensions. Both dimensions must be positive and the grid
can hold up to 1,048,576 cells. Changing the dimensions of a populated
grid returns ERR_BUSY.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/export_snapshot:
Returns a version 1 snapshot with version, grid_size, and placements.
The placement dictionaries use the fields documented in get_placement.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/find_first_fit:
Returns the first valid top-left cell at or after start, scanning left
to right and top to bottom. If start is past the last possible origin on
its row, the search continues on the next row. Returns Vector2i(-1, -1)
for invalid geometry, a negative start, or no fit.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/get_grid_size: Returns the grid dimensions in cells.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/get_item_at:
Returns the instance ID at cell. A free cell or a cell outside the grid
returns an empty StringName.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/get_placement:
Returns a dictionary with id (StringName), footprint (Vector2i), origin
(Vector2i), and rotated (bool). The footprint is the size before
rotation. An unknown ID returns an empty dictionary.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/get_placement_re:
Returns a counter for this live grid. Actual changes to its placements
or dimensions advance the counter before change signals run. Compare
revisions on the same grid to detect edits. The counter is independent
of snapshots.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/get_placements:
Returns an array of placement dictionaries in the format documented in
get_placement.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/get_swap_target:
Returns the instance ID of the sole item overlapped by this in-bounds
footprint. Returns an empty StringName if the footprint covers free
cells only, overlaps multiple items, or has invalid geometry.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/import_snapshot:
Validates a snapshot from export_snapshot and replaces the current grid
on success. An invalid snapshot preserves the current grid.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/is_placement_del: Returns whether this grid emits placements_changed.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/item_at:
Return a detached typed placement snapshot of the item occupying the
zero-based cell, or null if it is empty or outside the grid.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/items:
Return a detached array of typed placement snapshots. Iteration order is
unspecified. An empty grid returns an empty array.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/remove: Removes the placement with the given instance ID, freeing its cells.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/set_placement_de:
Enables or disables placements_changed. Grid views enable this when
bound to a model. The changed signal is always emitted for mutations.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/try_move:
Moves or rotates the item if the resulting placement fits. An
unsuccessful move preserves the current placement.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/try_place:
Places a new item if its ID is unused in this grid and the footprint
fits. Pass the footprint before rotation.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/try_resize_item:
Applies a new unrotated footprint if it fits at the item's current
origin and rotation. An unsuccessful resize preserves the current
placement.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/try_swap_in:
Places the held item if its ID is unused in this grid and the in-bounds
footprint overlaps only expected_id. Returns the displaced placement in
the format documented in get_placement and emits changed once after
committing. Returns an empty dictionary on failure and preserves the
grid.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/method/try_transfer:
Moves the item to destination if the placement is valid. Commits both
grids before either emits changed. An unsuccessful transfer preserves
the source placement. A transfer to this grid uses try_move.
descriptions.SpatialInventory/signal/placements_chang:
Emitted when placement deltas are enabled. ids lists the affected
instance IDs. Configure and snapshot import request a full refresh by
setting full_refresh to true. Transfers and batch edits finish mutating
all affected grids before notifying listeners.
descriptions.SpatialInventoryEquipment/signal/changed:
Emitted after the equipment configuration or committed equipment
contents change.
descriptions.SpinBox/method/apply:
Applies the current value of this SpinBox. This is equivalent to
pressing Enter while editing the LineEdit used by the SpinBox. This will
cause LineEdit.text_submitted to be emitted and its currently contained
expression to be evaluated.
descriptions.SpinBox/method/get_line_edit:
Returns the LineEdit instance from this SpinBox. You can use it to
access properties and methods of LineEdit. Warning: This is a required
internal node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If you wish to
hide it or any of its children, use their CanvasItem.visible property.
descriptions.SplineIK3D/method/get_path_3d: Returns the node path of the Path3D which is describing the path.
descriptions.SplineIK3D/method/get_tilt_fade_in:
Returns the tilt interpolation method used between the root bone and the
start point of the Curve3D when they are apart. See also
set_tilt_fade_in.
descriptions.SplineIK3D/method/get_tilt_fade_out:
Returns the tilt interpolation method used between the end bone and the
end point of the Curve3D when they are apart. See also
set_tilt_fade_out.
descriptions.SplineIK3D/method/is_tilt_enabled: Returns if the tilt property of the Curve3D affects the bone twist.
descriptions.SplineIK3D/method/set_path_3d: Sets the node path of the Path3D which is describing the path.
descriptions.SplineIK3D/method/set_tilt_enabled: Sets if the tilt property of the Curve3D should affect the bone twist.
descriptions.SplineIK3D/method/set_tilt_fade_in:
If size is greater than 0, the tilt is interpolated between size start
bones from the start point of the Curve3D when they are apart. If size
is equal 0, the tilts between the root bone head and the start point of
the Curve3D are unified with a tilt of the start point of the Curve3D.
If size is less than 0, the tilts between the root bone and the start...
descriptions.SplineIK3D/method/set_tilt_fade_out:
If size is greater than 0, the tilt is interpolated between size end
bones from the end point of the Curve3D when they are apart. If size is
equal 0, the tilts between the end bone tail and the end point of the
Curve3D are unified with a tilt of the end point of the Curve3D. If size
is less than 0, the tilts between the end bone and the end point of
the...
descriptions.SplitContainer/method/clamp_split_offset:
Clamps the split_offsets values to ensure they are within valid ranges
and do not overlap with each other. When overlaps occur, this method
prioritizes one split offset (at index priority_index) by clamping any
overlapping split offsets to it.
descriptions.SplitContainer/method/get_drag_area_cont:
Returns the drag area Control. For example, you can move a
pre-configured button into the drag area Control so that it rides along
with the split bar. Try setting the Button anchors to center prior to
the reparent() call.

Returns an Array of the drag area Controls. These are the interactable
Control nodes between each child. For example, this can be used to add a
pre-configured button to a drag area Control so that it rides along with
the split bar. Try setting the Button anchors to center prior to the
Node.reparent call.
descriptions.SplitContainer/signal/drag_ended: Emitted when the user ends dragging.
descriptions.SplitContainer/signal/drag_started: Emitted when the user starts dragging.
descriptions.SplitContainer/signal/dragged: Emitted when any dragger is dragged by user.
descriptions.SpringArm3D/method/add_excluded_object:
Adds the PhysicsBody3D object with the given RID to the list of
PhysicsBody3D objects excluded from the collision check.
descriptions.SpringArm3D/method/clear_excluded_object:
Clears the list of PhysicsBody3D objects excluded from the collision
check.
descriptions.SpringArm3D/method/get_hit_length: Returns the spring arm's current length.
descriptions.SpringArm3D/method/remove_excluded_objec:
Removes the given RID from the list of PhysicsBody3D objects excluded
from the collision check.
descriptions.SpringBoneCollision3D/method/get_skeleto: Get parent Skeleton3D node of the parent SpringBoneSimulator3D if found.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/are_all_chi:
Returns true if all child SpringBoneCollision3Ds are contained in the
collision list at index in the settings.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/clear_colli:
Clears all collisions from the collision list at index in the settings
when are_all_child_collisions_enabled is false.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/clear_exclu:
Clears all exclude collisions from the collision list at index in the
settings when are_all_child_collisions_enabled is true.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_center_: Returns the center bone index of the bone chain.
Returns the center bone name of the bone chain.
Returns what the center originates from in the bone chain.
Returns the center node path of the bone chain.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_collisi:
Returns the collision count of the bone chain's collision list when
are_all_child_collisions_enabled is false.

Returns the node path of the SpringBoneCollision3D at collision in the
bone chain's collision list when are_all_child_collisions_enabled is
false.
