descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_drag: Returns the drag force damping curve of the bone chain.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_drag_da: Returns the drag force damping curve of the bone chain.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_end_bon: Returns the end bone index of the bone chain.

Returns the tail direction of the end bone of the bone chain when
is_end_bone_extended is true.

Returns the end bone tail length of the bone chain when
is_end_bone_extended is true.
Returns the end bone name of the bone chain.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_exclude:
Returns the exclude collision count of the bone chain's exclude
collision list when are_all_child_collisions_enabled is true.

Returns the node path of the SpringBoneCollision3D at collision in the
bone chain's exclude collision list when
are_all_child_collisions_enabled is true.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_gravity: Returns the gravity amount of the bone chain.
Returns the gravity amount damping curve of the bone chain.
Returns the gravity direction of the bone chain.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_joint_b: Returns the bone index at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
Returns the bone name at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_joint_c: Returns the joint count of the bone chain's joint list.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_joint_d: Returns the drag force at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_joint_g: Returns the gravity amount at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
Returns the gravity direction at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_joint_r: Returns the radius at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
Returns the rotation axis at joint in the bone chain's joint list.

Returns the rotation axis vector for the specified joint in the bone
chain. This vector represents the axis around which the joint can
rotate. It is determined based on the rotation axis set for the joint.
If get_joint_rotation_axis is SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_ALL, this
method returns Vector3(0, 0, 0).
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_joint_s: Returns the stiffness force at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_radius: Returns the joint radius of the bone chain.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_radius_: Returns the joint radius damping curve of the bone chain.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_root_bo: Returns the root bone index of the bone chain.
Returns the root bone name of the bone chain.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_rotatio: Returns the rotation axis of the bone chain.

Returns the rotation axis vector of the bone chain. This vector
represents the axis around which the bone chain can rotate. It is
determined based on the rotation axis set for the bone chain. If
get_rotation_axis is SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_ALL, this method
returns Vector3(0, 0, 0).
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/get_stiffne: Returns the stiffness force of the bone chain.
Returns the stiffness force damping curve of the bone chain.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/is_config_i: Returns true if the config can be edited individually for each joint.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/is_end_bone: Returns true if the end bone is extended to have a tail.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/reset:
Resets a simulating state with respect to the current bone pose. It is
useful to prevent the simulation result getting violent. For example,
calling this immediately after a call to AnimationPlayer.play without a
fading, or within the previous SkeletonModifier3D.modification_processed
signal if it's condition changes significantly.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_center_: Sets the center bone index of the bone chain.
Sets the center bone name of the bone chain.

Sets what the center originates from in the bone chain. Bone movement is
calculated based on the difference in relative distance between center
and bone in the previous and next frames. For example, if the parent
Skeleton3D is used as the center, the bones are considered to have not
moved if the Skeleton3D moves in the world. In this case, only a
change...
Sets the center node path of the bone chain.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_collisi:
Sets the number of collisions in the collision list at index in the
settings when are_all_child_collisions_enabled is false.

Sets the node path of the SpringBoneCollision3D at collision in the bone
chain's collision list when are_all_child_collisions_enabled is false.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_drag:
Sets the drag force of the bone chain. The greater the value, the more
suppressed the wiggling. The value is scaled by set_drag_damping_curve
and cached in each joint setting in the joint list.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_drag_da: Sets the drag force damping curve of the bone chain.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_enable_:
If enabled is true, all child SpringBoneCollision3Ds are colliding and
set_exclude_collision_path is enabled as an exclusion list at index in
the settings. If enabled is false, you need to manually register all
valid collisions with set_collision_path.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_end_bon: Sets the end bone index of the bone chain.

Sets the end bone tail direction of the bone chain when
is_end_bone_extended is true.

Sets the end bone tail length of the bone chain when
is_end_bone_extended is true.

Sets the end bone name of the bone chain. Note: End bone must be the
root bone or a child of the root bone. If they are the same, the tail
must be extended by set_extend_end_bone to jiggle the bone.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_exclude:
Sets the number of exclude collisions in the exclude collision list at
index in the settings when are_all_child_collisions_enabled is true.

Sets the node path of the SpringBoneCollision3D at collision in the bone
chain's exclude collision list when are_all_child_collisions_enabled is
true.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_extend_:
If enabled is true, the end bone is extended to have a tail. The
extended tail config is allocated to the last element in the joint list.
In other words, if you set enabled to false, the config of the last
element in the joint list has no effect in the simulated result.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_gravity:
Sets the gravity amount of the bone chain. This value is not an
acceleration, but a constant velocity of movement in
set_gravity_direction. If gravity is not 0, the modified pose will not
return to the original pose since it is always affected by gravity. The
value is scaled by set_gravity_damping_curve and cached in each joint
setting in the joint list.
Sets the gravity amount damping curve of the bone chain.

Sets the gravity direction of the bone chain. This value is internally
normalized and then multiplied by set_gravity. The value is cached in
each joint setting in the joint list.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_individ:
If enabled is true, the config can be edited individually for each
joint.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_joint_d:
Sets the drag force at joint in the bone chain's joint list when
is_config_individual is true.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_joint_g:
Sets the gravity amount at joint in the bone chain's joint list when
is_config_individual is true.

Sets the gravity direction at joint in the bone chain's joint list when
is_config_individual is true.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_joint_r:
Sets the joint radius at joint in the bone chain's joint list when
is_config_individual is true.

Sets the rotation axis at joint in the bone chain's joint list when
is_config_individual is true. The axes are based on the reference pose's
space, if axis is SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_CUSTOM, you can
specify any axis. In here, the reference pose is the bone pose
immediately before the simulation. Note: The rotation axis and the
forward vector...

Sets the rotation axis vector for the specified joint in the bone chain.
This vector is normalized by an internal process and represents the axis
around which the bone chain can rotate. If the vector length is 0, it is
considered synonymous with SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_ALL.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_joint_s:
Sets the stiffness force at joint in the bone chain's joint list when
is_config_individual is true.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_radius:
Sets the joint radius of the bone chain. It is used to move and slide
with the SpringBoneCollision3D in the collision list. The value is
scaled by set_radius_damping_curve and cached in each joint setting in
the joint list.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_radius_: Sets the joint radius damping curve of the bone chain.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_root_bo: Sets the root bone index of the bone chain.
Sets the root bone name of the bone chain.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_rotatio:
Sets the rotation axis of the bone chain. If set to a specific axis, it
acts like a hinge joint. The value is cached in each joint setting in
the joint list. The axes are based on the reference pose's space, if
axis is SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_CUSTOM, you can specify any
axis. In here, the reference pose is the bone pose immediately before
the...

Sets the rotation axis vector of the bone chain. The value is cached in
each joint setting in the joint list. This vector is normalized by an
internal process and represents the axis around which the bone chain can
rotate. If the vector length is 0, it is considered synonymous with
SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_ALL.
descriptions.SpringBoneSimulator3D/method/set_stiffne:
Sets the stiffness force of the bone chain. The greater the value, the
faster it recovers to its initial pose. If stiffness is 0, the modified
pose will not return to the original pose. The value is scaled by
set_stiffness_damping_curve and cached in each joint setting in the
joint list.
Sets the stiffness force damping curve of the bone chain.
descriptions.Sprite2D/method/get_rect:
Returns a Rect2 representing the Sprite2D's boundary in local
coordinates. Example: Detect if the Sprite2D was clicked:
descriptions.Sprite2D/method/is_pixel_opaque:
Returns true if the pixel at the given position is opaque, false
otherwise. Also returns false if the given position is out of bounds or
this sprite's texture is null. pos is in local coordinates.
descriptions.SpriteBase3D/method/generate_triangle_me:
Returns a TriangleMesh with the sprite's vertices following its current
configuration (such as its axis and pixel_size).
descriptions.SpriteBase3D/method/get_draw_flag: Returns the value of the specified flag.
descriptions.SpriteBase3D/method/get_item_rect: Returns the rectangle representing this sprite.
descriptions.SpriteBase3D/method/set_draw_flag: If true, the specified flag will be enabled.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/add_animation: Adds a new anim animation to the library.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/add_frame:
Adds a frame to the anim animation. If at_position is -1, the frame will
be added to the end of the animation. duration specifies the relative
duration, see get_frame_duration for details.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/clear: Removes all frames from the anim animation.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/clear_all: Removes all animations. An empty default animation will be created.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/duplicate_animation:
Duplicates the animation anim_from to a new animation named anim_to.
Fails if anim_to already exists, or if anim_from does not exist.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/get_animation_loop:
Returns true if get_animation_loop_mode(anim) == LOOP_LINEAR. Otherwise,
returns false.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/get_animation_loop_m: Returns the loop mode for the anim animation.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/get_animation_names:
Returns an array containing the names associated to each animation.
Values are placed in alphabetical order.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/get_animation_speed: Returns the speed in frames per second for the anim animation.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/get_frame_count: Returns the number of frames for the anim animation.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/get_frame_duration:
Returns a relative duration of the frame idx in the anim animation
(defaults to 1.0). For example, a frame with a duration of 2.0 is
displayed twice as long as a frame with a duration of 1.0. You can
calculate the absolute duration (in seconds) of a frame using the
following formula:
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/get_frame_texture: Returns the texture of the frame idx in the anim animation.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/has_animation: Returns true if the anim animation exists.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/remove_frame: Removes the anim animation's frame idx.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/rename_animation: Changes the anim animation's name to newname.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/set_animation_loop:
If loop is false equivalent to set_animation_loop_mode(LOOP_NONE). If
loop is true equivalent to set_animation_loop_mode(LOOP_LINEAR).
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/set_animation_loop_m: Sets the loop_mode for the anim animation.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/set_animation_speed: Sets the speed for the anim animation in frames per second.
descriptions.SpriteFrames/method/set_frame:
Sets the texture and the duration of the frame idx in the anim
animation. duration specifies the relative duration, see
get_frame_duration for details.
descriptions.StatusIndicator/method/get_rect:
Returns the status indicator rectangle in screen coordinates. If this
status indicator is not visible, returns an empty Rect2.
descriptions.StatusIndicator/signal/pressed: Emitted when the status indicator is pressed.
descriptions.SteamAchievement/method/get_api_name: Returns the app's published achievement identifier.
descriptions.SteamAchievement/method/get_description:
Returns the localized description copied from Steam, or an empty string
if unavailable.
descriptions.SteamAchievement/method/get_display_name:
Returns the localized name copied from Steam, or api_name as a string if
unavailable.
descriptions.SteamAchievement/method/get_unlocked_at_:
Returns the unlock time in Unix seconds, or zero when no timestamp is
available.
descriptions.SteamAchievement/method/is_hidden: Returns whether Steam marks the achievement as hidden.
descriptions.SteamAchievement/method/is_unlocked:
Returns whether the signed-in player had unlocked this achievement at
the time of the snapshot.
descriptions.SteamAchievements/method/unlock:
Validates the published achievement API name, sets its cached state, and
asks Steam to store the change. Success means Steam accepted the storage
request. SteamStats.stats_stored reports Steam's later app-wide storage
result. The submission result retains how many cache changes were
applied even when Steam rejects the storage request. An expired scope...
descriptions.SteamAnalogInput/method/get_mode:
Returns Steam's source mode for this sample. Inactive actions return
MODE_NONE.
descriptions.SteamAnalogInput/method/get_value:
Returns Steam's horizontal and vertical values in units appropriate for
the source mode. Inactive actions return Vector2.ZERO.
descriptions.SteamAnalogInput/method/is_active:
Returns whether Steam reports that the action is available in the active
set.
descriptions.SteamAnalogInputResult/method/get_value:
Returns the current analog state, or null when the action could not be
read.
descriptions.SteamAppOwnership/method/get_acquired_at: Acquisition time text from Steam, or an empty string when unavailable.
descriptions.SteamAppOwnership/method/get_app_id: AppID requested by the trusted ownership check.
descriptions.SteamAppOwnership/method/get_expires_at: Expiration time text or Steam's never sentinel. Empty when unavailable.
descriptions.SteamAppOwnership/method/get_license_own:
Full decimal SteamID64 of the owner, or an empty string when
unavailable.
descriptions.SteamAppOwnership/method/get_owns_app: Whether Steam reports an active license for the requested app.
descriptions.SteamAppOwnership/method/get_site_licens: Whether Steam reports a PC Café license.
descriptions.SteamAppOwnership/method/get_user_cancel: Whether Steam reports that the user cancelled the license.
descriptions.SteamAppOwnershipResult/method/get_value:
License snapshot on a successful lookup, including when the account has
no active license. Null when the request failed.
descriptions.SteamApps/method/available_languages:
Returns the app's configured Steam language codes in Steam's order, or
an empty array when unavailable.
descriptions.SteamApps/method/beta_branch:
Returns the selected named beta branch. An empty string indicates the
default branch or unavailable data.
descriptions.SteamApps/method/build_id:
Returns Steam's build ID for the current app. Returns 0 when Steam has
no build ID for this process, including launches outside a Steam
download or an inactive client scope.
descriptions.SteamApps/method/current_language:
Returns the Steam language code selected for this game, or an empty
string when unavailable. For the Steam client interface language, use
SteamUtils.ui_language.
descriptions.SteamApps/method/dlc:
Returns a detached typed catalog for the current app with at most 256
entries in Steam's order. Steam may limit which entries it reports. Use
known DLC AppIDs for required content. The SteamDlcInfo.available flag
describes visibility on the Steam store.
descriptions.SteamApps/method/download_progress:
Reads a progress snapshot for the optional DLC identified by dlc_app_id.
When Steam reports no active download, the query succeeds with an
inactive SteamDlcProgress. Returns an error for an invalid AppID,
unavailable interface, or byte counts beyond the signed integer range.
descriptions.SteamApps/method/install_dlc:
Issues an installation request for an optional DLC AppID associated with
this game. Steam's local subscription check must report ownership. OK
confirms that the request was issued. Use download_progress,
is_dlc_installed, or dlc_installed to observe installation.
descriptions.SteamApps/method/is_available:
Returns whether the active client exposes the Steam Apps interface on
the main thread.
descriptions.SteamApps/method/is_dlc_installed:
Returns whether the signed-in account owns and has installed the DLC
identified by app_id. Returns false for invalid or unavailable queries.
descriptions.SteamApps/method/is_subscribed_to_app:
Returns whether the signed-in account has a Steam subscription to the
app identified by app_id. The AppID must be positive. Returns false when
the query is invalid or unavailable.
descriptions.SteamApps/method/notification_session_id:
Returns the nonzero decimal session ID Steam supplied when opening a
Game Notification. Returns an empty string when absent, invalid, or
unavailable. Ask the game's backend to authorize the selected session
for the authenticated player before loading it.
descriptions.SteamApps/method/owns_dlc:
Returns Steam's local subscription state for the supplied DLC AppID. Use
it as an ownership hint in the UI. Use is_dlc_installed to check whether
the local content is installed.
descriptions.SteamApps/method/uninstall_dlc:
Issues a removal request for the selected optional DLC. Call after the
player confirms removal. OK confirms that the request was issued. Use
is_dlc_installed to check the resulting state.
descriptions.SteamApps/signal/dlc_installed:
Emitted when Steam reports installation of the specified DLC AppID to
the active client scope. Refresh the local content catalog before
presenting the DLC as playable.
descriptions.SteamApps/signal/notification_session_re:
Emitted when Steam supplies a valid Game Notification session ID while
the game is running. Validate session membership before resuming it.
descriptions.SteamAuth/method/ownership_ticket:
Await a SteamOwnershipTicketResult containing an encrypted app ticket
for the backend's 1-to-1024-byte challenge. Steam allows one pending
request across client scopes and enforces its own rate limit.
descriptions.SteamAuth/method/web_ticket:
Await a SteamWebTicketResult for the named service. Use a nonempty
audience of at most 255 UTF-8 bytes without ASCII control characters.
The backend must verify the same audience and AppID.
descriptions.SteamAuthOperation/signal/ownership_tick: Emitted when an encrypted app ticket request settles.
descriptions.SteamAuthOperation/signal/web_ticket_com: Emitted when a Web API ticket request settles.
descriptions.SteamBrowser/method/allow_origins:
Build a policy with up to sixteen additional exact origins. An origin
contains the scheme, ASCII hostname, and optional port. An optional
trailing slash is accepted. For controlled local fixtures, explicitly
include a numeric loopback HTTP origin. Policy validation occurs when
opening the request.
descriptions.SteamBrowser/method/open:
Await a SteamBrowserPageResult after creating a browser and requesting
initial HTTPS navigation. The URL must be absolute with an ASCII
authority, no credentials, and percent-encoded non-ASCII URL text. It is
limited to 2048 bytes. Use SteamBrowserPage.page_finished and
SteamBrowserPage.frame_updated to confirm page content. The browser
dimensions may...
descriptions.SteamBrowserPage/method/close:
Release this browser handle. Repeated calls have no effect. Ending the
original Steam client scope also closes the page.
descriptions.SteamBrowserPage/method/navigate:
Submit navigation to an absolute URL covered by this page's original
origin policy. Return ERR_UNAUTHORIZED and emit navigation_blocked for a
rejected URL. Steam callbacks check later requests and the final
document. An unexpected document closes the browser before displaying
its frame.
descriptions.SteamBrowserPage/method/resize:
Request a new width and height in browser pixels. Both sides must be in
the range 1 to 4096 with at most 4194304 total pixels. The texture
updates after Steam provides a frame at the new size.
descriptions.SteamBrowserPage/method/send_input:
Forward supported keyboard, mouse motion, button and vertical wheel
input. Convert pointer coordinates to browser-local pixels first.
Out-of-bounds input returns ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER, except release of a
previously pressed button. Return ERR_UNAUTHORIZED until the game gives
this page input focus.
descriptions.SteamBrowserPage/method/set_focused:
Enable forwarding while the game UI owns focus. Passing false stops new
forwarded events and releases keys and buttons held by the page.
descriptions.SteamBrowserPage/method/texture:
Return the page's owned texture, which becomes displayable on the first
frame_updated. Returns null after the page or its client scope closes.
descriptions.SteamBrowserPage/signal/frame_updated:
Emitted after the page texture receives the newest accepted browser
frame for this Godot process frame.
descriptions.SteamBrowserPage/signal/navigation_block:
Emitted when a direct request, native navigation, redirect, or attempted
new window is rejected. The URL may be empty if Steam supplied an
invalid URL.
descriptions.SteamBrowserPage/signal/page_finished:
Emitted after Steam reports that an allowed page finished loading. A
frame is observed separately.
descriptions.SteamBrowserRequest/method/open:
Await a SteamBrowserPageResult after submitting creation and initial
navigation under this policy. HTTPS permits its initial origin. HTTP is
available only for an explicitly included numeric loopback origin at the
same port.
descriptions.SteamBytesOperation/method/cancel:
Ends local observation and completes it with ERR_SKIP. Steam drains the
submitted call and holds any file reservation until then. Returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST when observation has already ended.
descriptions.SteamBytesOperation/method/is_finished: Returns whether the operation has a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamBytesOperation/method/result:
Returns the same terminal result as completed, or null while observation
is pending.
descriptions.SteamBytesOperation/method/wait:
Use await operation.wait() to receive a SteamBytesResult before or after
observation ends.
descriptions.SteamBytesOperation/signal/completed:
Emitted once after a pending action settles, including after
cancellation or client shutdown. result already returns this result
during the signal.
descriptions.SteamBytesResult/method/get_value:
Returns the completed action's bytes. An empty array can also be a
successful zero-byte result. Check SteamResult.ok for the outcome.
descriptions.SteamCheatEvidence/method/get_match_id: Returns the game-owned match reference for review.
descriptions.SteamCheatEvidence/method/get_reason_cod: Returns the positive game-defined reason code sent as Steam app data.
descriptions.SteamCheatEvidence/method/get_reporter_s:
Returns the authenticated reporter's SteamID64, or empty for server
evidence.
descriptions.SteamCheatEvidence/method/get_source:
Returns whether a player or the authoritative game server submitted the
evidence.
descriptions.SteamCheatEvidence/method/player:
Returns evidence for the match_id and positive reason_code submitted by
reporter. Report submission checks that the identity belongs to this
publisher.
descriptions.SteamCheatEvidence/method/server:
Returns authoritative server evidence for match_id and positive
reason_code. The game policy verifies the server and match context
before approving the report.
descriptions.SteamCheatReport/method/get_app_id: Returns the publisher AppID that scoped the report.
descriptions.SteamCheatReport/method/get_match_id:
Returns the game-owned match reference when available from local
submission.
descriptions.SteamCheatReport/method/get_reason_code: Returns the game-defined report reason code, or zero when unavailable.
descriptions.SteamCheatReport/method/get_report_id: Returns valve's report ID in unsigned decimal form.
descriptions.SteamCheatReport/method/get_reported_at_:
Returns the Valve report timestamp in Unix seconds, or zero when
unavailable.
descriptions.SteamCheatReportPage/method/get_next_rep:
Returns the exclusive continuation cursor, or empty when no additional
row is known.
descriptions.SteamCheatReportPage/method/get_reports: Returns the detached reports for this page.
descriptions.SteamCheatReportPageResult/method/get_va: Returns the detached report page, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamCheatReportResult/method/get_value: Returns the acknowledged Steam report, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/apps:
Returns the active scope's app and DLC metadata service, or null before
startup or after stop.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/auth:
Returns the authentication and ownership ticket service for the active
client scope, or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/boot:
Creates a client as a child of owner and attempts to start it. Call on
the main thread with a live owner inside the scene tree. Pass 0 to use
the Steam launch AppID. If attachment succeeds, the returned node
retains any initialization failure. Check is_ready and
get_initialization_error. Returns null if attachment fails.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/browser:
Returns the Steam HTML Surface service for the active client scope, or
null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/cloud:
Returns the active scope's Steam Cloud file service, or null when the
client scope is inactive.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/device:
Returns the device, virtual keyboard, and VR status service for the
active client scope, or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/diagnostics:
Returns the active scope's Steam SDK warning capture service, or null
before startup or after stop. Call SteamDiagnostics.start to enable
capture.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/friends:
Returns the active scope's Steam Friends service for local Rich
Presence, or null when the client scope is inactive.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/get_app_id: Returns the active Steam AppID, or 0 when the client scope is inactive.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/get_initialization_er:
Returns the stored startup diagnostic, including the Steam SDK's reason
when available. A successful start clears the diagnostic.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/get_local_steam_id:
Returns the signed-in account's SteamID64 as a decimal string. Returns
an empty string when the client scope is inactive.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/http:
Returns the active scope's Steam HTTP service, or null when the client
scope is inactive.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/input:
Returns the Steam Input controller service for the active client scope,
or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/inventory:
Returns the Steam Inventory service for this client scope. Returns null
while the scope is inactive.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/is_online:
Returns whether the active local Steam client has a live connection to
Valve. Check is_ready for local SDK access, which may be available in
Offline Mode.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/is_ready:
Returns whether this client has a started Steam scope. Check the
relevant service for capability availability.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/leaderboards:
Returns the active scope's Steam leaderboard service, or null when the
client scope is inactive.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/lobbies:
Return the current scope's lobby discovery and standalone social
service, or null before startup or after stop.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/messages:
Returns the Steam message service for this client scope. Standalone
peers require explicit authorization. Returns null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/music:
Returns the Steam music player service for the active client scope, or
null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/networking:
Returns the Steam relay and connection-path diagnostics for the active
client scope, or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/overlay:
Returns the active scope's Steam overlay service when the capability is
available. Returns null when the scope is inactive or overlay support is
unavailable. Check SteamOverlay.is_ready before presenting actions that
require a usable overlay.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/parties:
Returns this client's scoped Steam Parties service, or null after the
client stops.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/presence:
Returns the managed Rich Presence service for the active client scope,
or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/purchases:
Returns the active scope's purchasing facade, or null after the scope
stops. A standalone client has no purchasing backend.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/remote_play:
Returns the Remote Play session and input service for this client scope.
Returns null while the scope is inactive.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/restart_through_steam:
Optionally asks Steam to relaunch a rendered shipping game from the
player's Steam Library. Call before boot, any provider initialization,
or the overlay bootstrap. ERR_SKIP means Steam requested relaunch and
the calling game should quit promptly. OK means the current process can
continue. The check requires a non-Spacewar AppID, a Steam-enabled
build,...
descriptions.SteamClient/method/screenshots:
Returns the screenshot capture and result service for this client scope.
Returns null while the scope is inactive.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/server_browser:
Return this exact client scope's Steam dedicated server browser, or null
when its client is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/sockets:
Returns the standalone Steam Sockets service for the active client
scope, or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/start:
Starts this attached client on the main thread. An expected AppID of 0
uses the Steam launch AppID. Starting an active client again with its
current AppID succeeds. A conflicting AppID returns ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE.
Inspect get_initialization_error for Steam initialization details.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/stats:
Returns the active scope's local Steam stats and achievements service,
or null when the client scope is inactive.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/stop:
Ends this client scope, invalidates its services, and releases its lease
on the shared Steam runtime. Call on the main thread. Other active
scopes keep their own leases.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/timeline:
Returns the active scope's Steam Game Recording timeline service, or
null when the client scope is inactive.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/utils:
Returns the active scope's Steam utility service, or null when the
client scope is inactive.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/video:
Returns the Steam video and broadcast service for the active client
scope, or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/voice:
Returns the active scope's opt-in voice capture and decode service, or
null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamClient/method/workshop:
Returns the Steam Workshop service for this client scope. Returns null
while the scope is inactive.
descriptions.SteamClient/signal/runtime_lost:
Emitted after a fatal local Steam IPC failure invalidates this client
scope. A standalone owner can defer start to acquire a fresh scope after
all failure observers finish. A temporary loss of network connectivity
keeps the local scope active.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/begin_write_batch:
Opens an app-wide Steam Cloud hint for a related group of Remote Storage
writes, deletes, or direct disk writes in Steam Auto-Cloud paths. Keep
SteamCloudWriteBatchResult.value alive and await each submitted
asynchronous write before closing it. ERR_BUSY indicates that a batch is
already open. Each write keeps its own result and Steam controls...
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/delete_file:
Deletes the named file from local Steam Remote Storage. Steam propagates
the deletion through its sync lifecycle. Returns ERR_BUSY if a submitted
transfer still reserves the name, or ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND if the file is
absent.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/download_shared:
Use await cloud.download_shared(handle) to receive a
SteamSharedCloudFileResult from a shared file belonging to the active
Steam AppID. handle is a canonical unsigned decimal UGC handle, such as
one returned by share. max_bytes limits bytes copied into the result and
must be between 1 and MAX_FILE_BYTES. Steam may download the content to
its own cache...
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/download_shared_file:
Starts a bounded download with the same validation as download_shared
and returns its retained operation. The handle remains reserved until
Steam reports completion and the local Steam cache entry is closed.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/file_info:
Returns local metadata for the named file. An absent file reports
ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/files:
Returns one page of local file metadata in Steam's current enumeration
order. offset is a nonnegative zero-based index. limit must be between 1
and MAX_PAGE_FILES. An offset at or beyond the last file returns an
empty successful page. The file list can change between requests.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/is_available:
Returns whether the active client exposes Steam Remote Storage on the
main thread.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/is_enabled_for_account:
Returns the signed-in account's Steam Cloud sync preference. Returns
false when the query is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/is_enabled_for_app:
Returns the Steam Cloud sync preference for the active AppID. Returns
false when the query is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/quota:
Returns total capacity and available bytes for the signed-in account's
active app storage.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/read:
Use await cloud.read(name) to receive a SteamBytesResult. Inspect
SteamResult.ok before reading SteamBytesResult.value. Use read_file to
retain an operation for cancellation.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/read_file:
Starts a whole-file read and returns its operation. An existing empty
file completes successfully with zero bytes. A missing file completes
with ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/share:
Use await cloud.share(name) to receive a SteamStringResult containing
the opaque UGC handle as a canonical unsigned decimal string. Use this
with bytes intended to be shared, such as a leaderboard replay. A
published handle can remain usable after local file deletion. Use
share_file to retain an operation for cancellation.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/share_file:
Submits a share of an existing local file up to MAX_FILE_BYTES bytes and
reserves its filename until Steam settles the request. Returns the
retained typed share operation. An absent local file reports
ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND. Steam can still publish the file after the caller
cancels observation.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/write:
Use await cloud.write(name, bytes) to receive a SteamResult for local
Steam write completion. Use write_file to retain an operation for
cancellation.
descriptions.SteamCloud/method/write_file:
Submits a whole-file write and returns its operation. bytes must contain
between 1 byte and MAX_FILE_BYTES bytes. The service copies the
submitted bytes and holds the file name until Steam settles the
transfer.
descriptions.SteamCloud/signal/local_files_changed:
Emitted after Steam applies local file changes for an app with dynamic
Cloud sync enabled. changes is a read-only array of detached
SteamCloudChange snapshots. truncated is true when some changes could
not be included. Refresh affected save data when receiving a truncated
batch.
descriptions.SteamCloudChange/method/get_change_type: Returns the kind of local change already applied by Steam.
descriptions.SteamCloudChange/method/get_name_or_path: Returns the logical Remote Storage name or absolute local path.
descriptions.SteamCloudChange/method/get_path_type: Returns how to interpret the path reported by Steam.
descriptions.SteamCloudFile/method/get_modified_at_un: Returns the last modification timestamp in Unix seconds.
descriptions.SteamCloudFile/method/get_size_bytes: Returns the file size in bytes.
descriptions.SteamCloudFile/method/is_persisted: Returns Steam's Cloud persistence flag for the file.
descriptions.SteamCloudFileResult/method/get_value: Returns the detached metadata on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamCloudFilesResult/method/get_total_c:
Returns the total number of files Steam reported before copying the
page. Returns zero on failure.
descriptions.SteamCloudFilesResult/method/get_value:
Returns a read-only array of detached file snapshots from the page.
Returns an empty array on failure.
descriptions.SteamCloudQuota/method/get_available_byt: Returns the available capacity in bytes.
descriptions.SteamCloudQuota/method/get_total_bytes: Returns the total capacity in bytes.
descriptions.SteamCloudQuotaResult/method/get_value: Returns the quota on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamCloudShareOperation/method/cancel:
Ends local observation and completes it with ERR_SKIP. Steam can still
finish publishing the shared file. Returns ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST when
observation has already ended.
descriptions.SteamCloudShareOperation/method/is_finis: Returns whether the operation has a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamCloudShareOperation/method/result:
Returns the same terminal result as completed, or null while observation
is pending.
descriptions.SteamCloudShareOperation/method/wait:
Use await operation.wait() to receive a SteamStringResult before or
after observation ends. A successful result contains the opaque UGC
handle as a canonical unsigned decimal string.
descriptions.SteamCloudShareOperation/signal/complete:
Emitted once after a pending share settles, including after cancellation
or client shutdown. result already returns this result during the
signal.
descriptions.SteamCloudWriteBatch/method/close:
Ends this exact hint on the client thread. Returns OK for a closed
handle. Returns ERR_BUSY when called from another thread while open, or
ERR_UNAVAILABLE if Steam could not acknowledge closure.
descriptions.SteamCloudWriteBatch/method/is_open: Returns whether this handle still owns its Steam Cloud write-batch hint.
descriptions.SteamCloudWriteBatchResult/method/get_va: Returns the batch handle on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamCommerceBackend/method/_begin:
Create or resume the persisted order for this checkout ID and
authenticated account. On success, echo the checkout ID in the typed
response.
descriptions.SteamCommerceBackend/method/_catalog:
Fetch the current player's server-priced offers and call
SteamCommerceRequest.complete_catalog.
descriptions.SteamCommerceBackend/method/_observe_aut:
Use Steam's authorization hint to ask the game backend to query the
known order. Return the verified backend state. The hint alone does not
grant an entitlement.
descriptions.SteamCommerceBackend/method/_order:
Refresh the current authenticated player's exact order from the game
backend.
descriptions.SteamCommerceRequest/method/complete_cat:
Completes this exact catalog request on the main thread. Repeated or
retired completions return an error.
descriptions.SteamCommerceRequest/method/complete_ord:
Completes this exact order request on the main thread. Confirm the order
through the game backend before responding. Repeated or retired
completions return an error.
descriptions.SteamCommerceRequest/signal/catalog_comp: Emitted once when the catalog request settles.
descriptions.SteamCommerceRequest/signal/order_comple: Emitted once when the order request settles.
descriptions.SteamConfig/method/is_valid:
Returns true for an unsigned 32-bit AppID and a valid test group when
the configured AppID is 480. Other AppIDs require an empty test group.
descriptions.SteamConfig/method/public_games:
Returns an independent copy of this profile with public game discovery
enabled. An existing attachment keeps its original settings.
descriptions.SteamConfig/method/spacewar:
Creates an invitation-only development profile for AppID 480. Supply the
same 1 to 64 character group on both peers. Groups allow ASCII letters,
digits, underscores, and hyphens. A group separates discovery and join
for games sharing the development AppID. The process must already launch
in the Spacewar context.
descriptions.SteamConnectionPath/method/get_packet_lo: Returns Steam's estimated in-order delivery deficit.
descriptions.SteamConnectionPath/method/get_ping_ms: Returns the latency measurement in milliseconds.
descriptions.SteamConnectionPathResult/method/get_val: Returns the detached path when the result succeeded.
descriptions.SteamController/method/activate_layer:
Asks Steam to apply the named name layer to the current set. Returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST if the published name is unknown,
ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER if it is empty or exceeds 128 UTF-8 bytes, or
ERR_UNAVAILABLE when this view or native capability is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamController/method/analog:
Reads action in the current Steam Input frame. Inactive input returns an
inactive zero vector. Unknown actions return ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST. An
empty or oversized action name returns ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER. A retired
view or unavailable Steam interface returns ERR_UNAVAILABLE.
descriptions.SteamController/method/deactivate_layer:
Asks Steam to remove the named name layer from the current set. Returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST if the published name is unknown,
ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER if it is empty or exceeds 128 UTF-8 bytes, or
ERR_UNAVAILABLE when this view or native capability is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamController/method/digital:
Reads action in the current Steam Input frame. An inactive action
reports active = false. Unknown actions return ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST. An
empty or oversized action name returns ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER. A retired
view or unavailable Steam interface returns ERR_UNAVAILABLE.
descriptions.SteamController/method/glyph:
Returns a PNG texture at size for the first effective Steam binding
origin of action. An unbound action, unavailable glyph, or retired view
returns ERR_UNAVAILABLE. An invalid size or action name returns
ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER.
descriptions.SteamController/method/glyphs:
Returns the textures at size for the effective Steam binding origins of
action in origin order. The highest active layer that supplies origins
takes precedence over the base set. An unbound action, unavailable
glyph, or retired view returns ERR_UNAVAILABLE. An invalid size or
action name returns ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER.
descriptions.SteamController/method/is_connected:
Returns whether this view still identifies the same live connection in
its owning lease.
descriptions.SteamController/method/open_binding_pane:
Requests Steam's binding configuration panel for this controller. OK
acknowledges the request. Returns ERR_UNAVAILABLE if Steam declines or
the controller is disconnected.
descriptions.SteamController/method/type:
Returns Steam's controller family. Returns TYPE_UNKNOWN if the view is
unavailable or the reported value is unrecognized.
descriptions.SteamController/method/use_action_set:
Asks Steam to select the name action set from the manifest. Returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST if the published name is unknown,
ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER if it is empty or exceeds 128 UTF-8 bytes, or
ERR_UNAVAILABLE when this view or native capability is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamController/method/vibrate:
Submits normalized low and high motor amplitudes from 0 to 1. Pass zero
for both to clear the request. OK acknowledges the SDK submission. A
disconnected controller or missing vibration capability returns
ERR_UNAVAILABLE. Nonfinite or out-of-range values return
ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER.
descriptions.SteamDedicatedServer/method/get_initiali:
Read the safe diagnostic captured during native setup. An empty string
means setup started without an immediate error.
descriptions.SteamDedicatedServer/method/inventory_ve:
Return the verifier for the exact dedicated attachment. It validates
Steam inventory proofs only for the current transport-certified and
admitted identity. After teardown it reports unavailable.
descriptions.SteamDedicatedServer/method/stats:
Resolve Steam progression for the currently admitted remote connection
with peer_id. Returns null for the local authority, unknown or retired
peers, a Game outside its dedicated Steam session, or calls off the
scene thread. The returned service is bound to this exact authenticated
admission.
descriptions.SteamDedicatedServer/method/status:
Read a detached readiness, advertisement, world and authenticated player
count snapshot. A retired attachment returns idle status.
descriptions.SteamDedicatedServer/signal/status_chang:
Emitted on the scene thread when one public status field changes,
including on retirement.
descriptions.SteamDevice/method/dismiss_keyboard:
Request dismissal of this scope's current Steam keyboard. OK means the
request was accepted. The keyboard remains reserved until Steam reports
it closed. Returns ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST when there is no keyboard and
ERR_BUSY when another scope owns it or a prior owner is closing.
descriptions.SteamDevice/method/enter_text:
Open the modal Steam keyboard in the active rendered window. Await a
SteamTextEntryResult. The optional prompt is limited to 1024 UTF-8 bytes
and max_chars to 1 through 4096 Unicode characters. Initial text must
fit the requested length. Hidden mode masks characters during entry. A
user dismissal succeeds with an empty, unsubmitted entry. Return an...
descriptions.SteamDevice/method/hardware:
Returns the hardware family Steam reports for this game, or
HARDWARE_UNKNOWN if the query is unavailable or the reported value is
unrecognized.
descriptions.SteamDevice/method/is_available:
Returns whether this exact client start can query Steam Utils on the
main thread. Some individual queries depend on additional SDK exports.
descriptions.SteamDevice/method/is_headset_streaming_:
Returns whether Steam reports that the headset view is streaming over
Steam Remote Play. Returns false if the query is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamDevice/method/is_proton:
Returns whether Steam reports that the game process is running under
Proton. Returns false if the query is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamDevice/method/is_running_in_vr:
Returns whether Steam itself reports running in VR mode. Returns false
if the query is unavailable. Query the OpenXR interface for the game's
own XR session state.
descriptions.SteamDevice/method/is_steam_deck: Returns whether hardware identifies a Steam Deck.
descriptions.SteamDevice/method/open_vr_dashboard:
Asks Steam to open its VR dashboard. OK acknowledges the SDK request.
Returns ERR_UNAVAILABLE when Steam is outside VR mode or the scope or
dashboard capability is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamDevice/method/recommended_preset:
Returns Steam's recommended starting configuration for this game and
hardware. PRESET_NONE means Steam has no suggestion. PRESET_UNKNOWN
means the query is unavailable or the value is unrecognized.
descriptions.SteamDevice/method/show_keyboard_for:
Open Steam's floating keyboard beside a visible, focused, editable
LineEdit or TextEdit in the main game window. The field's bounds are
transformed to client pixels. Steam sends OS key events to the focused
control. Crimson requests dismissal if the field loses focus, becomes
hidden or read-only, or leaves the tree. The field keeps its normal
Godot text...
descriptions.SteamDevice/signal/keyboard_dismissed:
Emitted when Steam confirms that the floating keyboard owned by this
live scope closed. Await enter_text for the separate modal result.
descriptions.SteamDiagnosticBatch/method/get_dropped_:
Returns the number of additional callbacks discarded after the queue
reached capacity, since capture started or since the previous drain.
descriptions.SteamDiagnosticBatch/method/get_messages:
Returns the read-only array of up to 32 messages in capture order. An
empty snapshot returns an empty typed array.
descriptions.SteamDiagnosticMessage/method/get_severi:
Returns the Steam SDK severity number. Steam uses 0 for an informational
message and 1 for a warning.
descriptions.SteamDiagnosticMessage/method/get_text:
Returns the fixed framework description for the severity. Future SDK
severity codes use a generic diagnostic description.
descriptions.SteamDiagnostics/method/drain:
Takes the current messages in capture order and resets the queue and
overflow count. Returns an empty snapshot for an inactive scope, a
caller without ownership, or a call from outside the main thread.
descriptions.SteamDiagnostics/method/start:
Claims the process-wide warning hook. Returns OK for a new capture or if
this service already owns it. Returns ERR_BUSY when another scope owns
it or a caller invokes this method outside the main thread. Returns
ERR_UNAVAILABLE when the scope or SDK hook is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamDiagnostics/method/stop:
Releases this service's hook and discards pending diagnostics on the
main thread. Repeated calls and calls by other scopes leave the hook
state as it is.
descriptions.SteamDigitalInput/method/is_active:
Returns whether Steam reports that the action is available in the active
set.
descriptions.SteamDigitalInput/method/is_pressed: Returns whether this active action is currently pressed.
descriptions.SteamDigitalInputResult/method/get_value:
Returns the current digital state, or null when the action could not be
read.
descriptions.SteamDlcInfo/method/get_app_id: Returns the Steam DLC AppID for this record.
descriptions.SteamDlcInfo/method/get_display_name: Returns the display name copied from Steam.
descriptions.SteamDlcInfo/method/is_available: Returns Steam's store visibility flag for this DLC.
descriptions.SteamDlcListResult/method/get_value: Returns a detached typed array containing this result's catalog records.
descriptions.SteamDlcProgress/method/get_downloaded_b: Returns Steam's downloaded byte count, or zero when inactive.
descriptions.SteamDlcProgress/method/get_total_bytes:
Returns Steam's total download size in bytes, or zero when inactive or
unknown.
descriptions.SteamDlcProgress/method/is_active: Returns whether Steam reported an active optional DLC download.
descriptions.SteamDlcProgressResult/method/get_value: Returns the detached progress snapshot on success, or null on error.
descriptions.SteamFloatResult/method/get_value:
Returns the cached float on success or 0.0 on failure. Check
SteamResult.ok to distinguish the outcomes.
descriptions.SteamFriend/method/get_display_name:
Returns the cached Steam persona name, or an empty string if
unavailable.
descriptions.SteamFriend/method/get_steam_id: Returns the full SteamID64 as a decimal string.
descriptions.SteamFriend/method/is_online: Returns whether Steam presented the friend as online at snapshot time.
descriptions.SteamFriends/method/clear_rich_presence:
Clears one Rich Presence key and preserves the account's other keys.
Returns @GlobalScope.OK when Steam accepts the update. The Game provider
reserves the connect key for its join route.
descriptions.SteamFriends/method/is_available:
Returns whether the active client exposes the Steam Friends interface on
the main thread.
descriptions.SteamFriends/method/list:
Returns the current cached immediate friends as a read-only typed
collection. A successful result can contain an empty array. An inactive
or unavailable Steam client returns @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE.
descriptions.SteamFriends/method/rich_presence:
Returns the signed-in account's cached value for key, or an empty string
when the key is absent or the query is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamFriends/method/set_rich_presence:
Sets one Rich Presence key to value. Both must be nonempty UTF-8 strings
within Steam's byte limits. Returns @GlobalScope.OK when Steam accepts
the update. Setting a managed key explicitly removes it from
SteamPresence ownership. Use clear_rich_presence to remove a key. The
Game provider reserves connect.
descriptions.SteamFriendsResult/method/get_value: Returns the detached typed friend collection.
descriptions.SteamGameNotifications/method/create:
Creates an app-owned session from verified participants. Reuse the same
immutable operation key to replay an accepted, committed response.
descriptions.SteamGameNotifications/method/details: Requests one exact session owned by this app in the trusted store.
descriptions.SteamGameNotifications/method/remove:
Removes an owned session and its notifications through a durable
operation. A repeated committed key returns the original acknowledgment.
descriptions.SteamGameNotifications/method/request_op:
Requests Steam registration once per verified account and authoritative
backend launch ID. Reuse launch_id across authentication refreshes
within a launch and issue a fresh ID on the next game launch. Use 1 to
128 ASCII letters, digits, hyphens, underscores, periods, or colons. A
missing ID returns ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER. A claimed launch returns...
descriptions.SteamGameNotifications/method/sessions_f:
Reads up to 128 sessions returned for a user verified by this exact
publisher and app.
descriptions.SteamGameNotifications/method/update:
Replaces the full participant state of an owned session. Supply all
users who should remain in the session and a stable operation key. The
creation context remains as it was.
descriptions.SteamHttp/method/is_available:
Return true when this client scope has a usable Steam HTTP interface on
the main thread.
descriptions.SteamHttpOptions/method/accept_json:
Return a branch with the request's Accept header set to
application/json.
descriptions.SteamHttpOptions/method/delete:
Send DELETE using the selected options. Returns a
SteamHttpResponseResult after await.
descriptions.SteamHttpOptions/method/fetch:
Send an absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL using GET. Returns a
SteamHttpResponseResult after await.
descriptions.SteamHttpOptions/method/head:
Send HEAD and return status and captured headers with an empty body.
Returns a SteamHttpResponseResult after await.
descriptions.SteamHttpOptions/method/options:
Send OPTIONS using the selected options. Returns a
SteamHttpResponseResult after await.
descriptions.SteamHttpOptions/method/patch:
Send the supplied dictionary as a JSON PATCH body. Returns a
SteamHttpResponseResult after await.
descriptions.SteamHttpOptions/method/post:
Send the supplied dictionary as a JSON POST body. Returns a
SteamHttpResponseResult after await.
descriptions.SteamHttpOptions/method/put:
Send the supplied dictionary as a JSON PUT body. Returns a
SteamHttpResponseResult after await.
descriptions.SteamHttpOptions/method/request:
Create an unsent request draft with the selected options. The default
method is GET.
descriptions.SteamHttpOptions/method/with_header:
Return a branch with a request header. Header names are
case-insensitive, and a new value replaces the same header on that
branch. Steam manages framing and connection headers.
descriptions.SteamHttpOptions/method/with_max_respons:
Return a branch with a response body limit from 1 byte to 4 MiB. The
default is 1 MiB. Larger bodies return a limit error and expose no
partial response.
descriptions.SteamHttpOptions/method/with_response_he:
Return a branch that replaces the selected response header names. Select
up to 16 additional names. Matching ignores case, and Content-Type is
captured when present. A selected field larger than 2,048 bytes returns
a limit error.
descriptions.SteamHttpOptions/method/with_timeout:
Return a branch with an absolute deadline from 100 to 120,000
milliseconds. The default is 15,000 milliseconds.
descriptions.SteamHttpRequest/method/accept_json:
Return a branch with the request's Accept header set to
application/json.
descriptions.SteamHttpRequest/method/send:
Submit this draft on its original Steam client scope. Invalid drafts and
stopped scopes return already-settled failures.
descriptions.SteamHttpRequest/method/with_body:
Return a branch that owns raw bytes and their media type for POST, PUT,
or PATCH. The body limit is 1 MiB. This media type supplies the
request's Content-Type header.
descriptions.SteamHttpRequest/method/with_header:
Return a branch with a request header. Header names are
case-insensitive, and a new value replaces the same header on that
branch. Steam manages framing and connection headers.
descriptions.SteamHttpRequest/method/with_max_respons:
Return a branch with a response body limit from 1 byte to 4 MiB. The
default is 1 MiB. Larger bodies return a limit error and expose no
partial response.
descriptions.SteamHttpRequest/method/with_response_he:
Return a branch that replaces the selected response header names. Select
up to 16 additional names. Matching ignores case, and Content-Type is
captured when present. A selected field larger than 2,048 bytes returns
a limit error.
descriptions.SteamHttpRequest/method/with_timeout:
Return a branch with an absolute deadline from 100 to 120,000
milliseconds. The default is 15,000 milliseconds.
descriptions.SteamHttpResponse/method/get_body: Return the bounded response bytes. HEAD responses have an empty body.
descriptions.SteamHttpResponse/method/get_status: Return the final HTTP status code.
descriptions.SteamHttpResponse/method/header:
Return a captured response header by case-insensitive name. An absent,
empty, or unselected field returns an empty string.
descriptions.SteamHttpResponse/method/is_successful: Return true when the HTTP status is in the 2xx range.
descriptions.SteamHttpResponse/method/json:
Parse the body as UTF-8 JSON and return its separate decoding result.
Check the parsing outcome independently of the response status.
descriptions.SteamHttpResponseOperation/method/cancel:
Cancel the local request on the main thread. A successful cancellation
settles the operation with ERR_SKIP. Return ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST if the
request is no longer pending.
descriptions.SteamHttpResponseOperation/method/is_fin: Return whether the operation has settled.
descriptions.SteamHttpResponseOperation/method/result: Return the terminal result, or null while pending.
descriptions.SteamHttpResponseOperation/method/wait:
Return the completion signal while pending or the stored
SteamHttpResponseResult after settlement. Awaiting again returns the
same result.
descriptions.SteamHttpResponseOperation/signal/comple:
Emitted once after the native request and its callback routing are
retired. The result carries the transport outcome and any complete HTTP
response.
descriptions.SteamHttpResponseResult/method/get_value: Return the complete HTTP response, or null if the request failed.
descriptions.SteamIdentity/method/get_app_id: Steamworks AppID used to verify the ticket.
descriptions.SteamIdentity/method/get_license_owner_s:
Full decimal license owner SteamID64 when Valve supplies it. Empty when
omitted.
descriptions.SteamIdentity/method/get_steam_id: Full canonical decimal SteamID64 authenticated by Valve.
descriptions.SteamIdentityResult/method/get_value: Identity minted by the publisher on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamInput/method/controllers:
Returns a read-only snapshot of the connected controller views owned by
this lease. Before start and after stop, returns an empty array.
descriptions.SteamInput/method/start:
Starts Steam Input. Leave manifest_path empty to use Steam's app
configuration or join the existing manifest. To override, pass an
absolute path to a loose file Steam can read. A different explicit path
while the lease is active returns ERR_BUSY. A missing file returns
ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND. Steam's parse rejection returns ERR_PARSE_ERROR. An
invalid path...
descriptions.SteamInput/method/stop:
Releases this lease and invalidates the views already returned by
controllers. The last active lease shuts down Steam Input. Stopping
again is safe.
descriptions.SteamInput/signal/bindings_changed:
Emitted when Steam reloads the configuration for a connected controller.
Refresh cached HUD prompts.
descriptions.SteamInput/signal/controller_connected:
Emitted after a new controller view appears in controllers. A reconnect
may produce a new view for the same hardware.
descriptions.SteamInput/signal/controller_disconnecte:
Emitted after a controller view is removed and invalidated. Use the
supplied view to clear the local player assignment.
descriptions.SteamIntResult/method/get_value:
Returns the cached integer on success or zero on failure. Check
SteamResult.ok to distinguish the outcomes.
descriptions.SteamInventory/method/claim_playtime_dro:
Evaluates the published playtime generator generator_id. A successful
evaluation can grant no items. Returns SteamInventoryChangeResult.
Refresh inventory before retrying after a timeout.
descriptions.SteamInventory/method/claim_promotion:
Asks Steam to apply the published promotion definition_id if the
signed-in player is eligible. Returns SteamInventoryChangeResult.
Refresh inventory before retrying after a timeout.
descriptions.SteamInventory/method/claim_promotions:
Asks Steam to apply all eligible configured promotions. A successful
result can contain no grants. Returns SteamInventoryChangeResult.
Refresh inventory before retrying after a timeout.
descriptions.SteamInventory/method/consume:
Permanently consumes quantity units from instance_id. Use a confirmation
step in the game UI before submitting this action. Returns
SteamInventoryChangeResult. Refresh inventory before retrying after a
timeout.
descriptions.SteamInventory/method/craft:
Atomically exchanges the distinct owned ingredients for one unit of
output_definition_id when a published Steam recipe matches. Steam
validates the recipe and quantities before changing either side. Returns
SteamInventoryChangeResult. Refresh inventory before retrying after a
timeout.
descriptions.SteamInventory/method/definition:
Loads the catalog as needed and returns SteamItemDefinitionResult for
the published definition_id. A valid ID absent from the catalog returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST.
descriptions.SteamInventory/method/definitions:
Loads the app's published catalog on demand and returns
SteamItemDefinitionsResult. Requests in the same scope share an
in-flight load. A successful catalog may be empty.
descriptions.SteamInventory/method/items:
Returns SteamInventorySnapshotResult for the signed-in player's full
inventory. Call when a view needs refresh. Steam can rate-limit full
reads and return cached results. Inspect the snapshot's freshness before
making decisions that require current inventory.
descriptions.SteamInventory/method/items_by_id:
Returns SteamInventorySnapshotResult for the available owned instances
in instance_ids. Steam may omit instances that are no longer present.
Supply one to 256 distinct unsigned decimal IDs.
descriptions.SteamInventory/method/merge:
Moves quantity units from from_instance_id into the distinct
into_instance_id stack. Steam enforces the matching definition and trade
restrictions. Returns SteamInventoryChangeResult. Refresh inventory
before retrying after a timeout.
descriptions.SteamInventory/method/proof:
Returns SteamBytesResult with a signed Steam result containing exactly
the available owned selection. Supply one to 256 distinct unsigned
decimal instance_ids. A missing selected instance returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST. Proof bytes are limited to 1 MiB. Send them only to
the authority that needs to verify this selection.
descriptions.SteamInventory/method/split:
Moves quantity units from instance_id into a new instance of the same
definition. The result carries the changed or removed source and the new
stack. Returns SteamInventoryChangeResult. Refresh inventory before
retrying after a timeout.
descriptions.SteamInventory/signal/definitions_change:
Emitted after Steam announces a catalog update. An open catalog can call
definitions again to read the new revision.
descriptions.SteamInventory/signal/items_changed:
Emitted after this scope accepts a newer full inventory response to
items. The snapshot is detached and read-only. Mutations return their
own changes.
descriptions.SteamInventoryChange/method/get_changed: Returns the read-only array of existing item rows updated by Steam.
descriptions.SteamInventoryChange/method/get_granted: Returns the read-only array of item rows Steam granted or created.
descriptions.SteamInventoryChange/method/get_removed_: Returns the decimal instance IDs Steam reports as removed.
descriptions.SteamInventoryChangeOperation/method/is_: Returns whether this request has reached a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamInventoryChangeOperation/method/res: Returns the terminal result, or null while the request is pending.
descriptions.SteamInventoryChangeOperation/method/wai:
Returns the typed terminal result immediately if available, or the
completion signal to await.
descriptions.SteamInventoryChangeOperation/signal/com:
Emitted once after the operation settles and releases its native result
handle.
descriptions.SteamInventoryChangeResult/method/get_va: Returns the accepted inventory change, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamInventorySnapshot/method/get_freshn: Returns the SDK evidence available about the age of this view.
descriptions.SteamInventorySnapshot/method/get_items: Returns the read-only array of present item instances.
descriptions.SteamInventorySnapshot/method/get_observ:
Returns steam's result timestamp in Unix seconds, or zero if
unavailable.
descriptions.SteamInventorySnapshotOperation/method/i: Returns whether this request has reached a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamInventorySnapshotOperation/method/r: Returns the terminal result, or null while the request is pending.
descriptions.SteamInventorySnapshotOperation/method/w:
Returns the typed terminal result immediately if available, or the
completion signal to await.
descriptions.SteamInventorySnapshotOperation/signal/c:
Emitted once after the operation settles and releases its native result
handle.
descriptions.SteamInventorySnapshotResult/method/get_: Returns the detached inventory snapshot, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamInventoryVerifier/method/verify:
Awaits a SteamInventorySnapshotResult after validating the proof of up
to 1 MiB against the currently admitted expected_steam_id in canonical
decimal form. A successful snapshot contains up to 256 selected items at
the signed timestamp and uses
SteamInventorySnapshot.FRESHNESS_VERIFIED_PROOF. Invalid arguments
return ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER. An unavailable...
descriptions.SteamInvite/method/get_from_steam_id: Return the inviter's decimal SteamID64 when Steam provided it.
descriptions.SteamInvite/method/get_listing: Return the locator accepted by GameRuntime.join_listing.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinition/method/get_definitio: Returns the published numeric item definition ID.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinition/method/get_display_n: Returns steam's localized display name for this item.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinition/method/get_propertie: Returns the typed read-only dictionary of published properties.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinition/method/get_type: Returns the item type configured in the Steam definition.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinitionOperation/method/is_f: Returns whether this request has reached a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinitionOperation/method/resu: Returns the terminal result, or null while the request is pending.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinitionOperation/method/wait:
Returns the typed terminal result immediately if available, or the
completion signal to await.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinitionOperation/signal/comp:
Emitted once after the operation settles and releases its native result
handle.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinitionResult/method/get_val: Returns the requested definition, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinitionsOperation/method/is_: Returns whether this request has reached a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinitionsOperation/method/res: Returns the terminal result, or null while the request is pending.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinitionsOperation/method/wai:
Returns the typed terminal result immediately if available, or the
completion signal to await.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinitionsOperation/signal/com:
Emitted once after the operation settles and releases its native result
handle.
descriptions.SteamItemDefinitionsResult/method/get_va: Returns the typed catalog, empty on error.
descriptions.SteamItemInstance/method/get_definition_: Returns the published definition associated with this instance.
descriptions.SteamItemInstance/method/get_flags: Returns the Steam item status and action confirmation bits.
descriptions.SteamItemInstance/method/get_instance_id: Returns the opaque instance ID in unsigned decimal form.
descriptions.SteamItemInstance/method/get_quantity: Returns the current stack quantity reported by Steam.
descriptions.SteamItemQuantity/method/get_instance_id: Returns the opaque instance ID in unsigned decimal form.
descriptions.SteamItemQuantity/method/get_quantity: Returns the requested positive exchange quantity.
descriptions.SteamItemQuantity/method/make:
Returns a pair containing instance_id and quantity. SteamInventory.craft
validates both fields before submitting an exchange.
descriptions.SteamJsonResult/method/get_value: Return the decoded JSON value. A successful result can contain null.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboard/method/around_user:
Fetches a range around the signed-in user's score. before and after are
nonnegative counts and the requested page, including the center, is at
most 100 entries. Results use the same page format as entries.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboard/method/attach_ugc:
Attaches an existing Steam Remote Storage shared-file handle to the
signed-in user's score. Pass the handle as a decimal string. Await the
operation to receive a SteamResult. An overlapping score write or
attachment returns @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboard/method/entries:
Fetches a page starting at the one-based global first_rank. count must
be between 1 and 100. Await the operation to receive a
SteamLeaderboardPageResult containing a SteamLeaderboardPage on success.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboard/method/friends:
Fetches up to limit entries from Steam's friends view for the signed-in
account. The limit is between 1 and 100. Results use the same page
format as entries.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboard/method/is_available:
Returns whether this handle still belongs to an active client scope with
leaderboard access.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboard/method/metadata:
Returns the detached SteamLeaderboardInfo when the read succeeds. The
result reports @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE after the board scope stops.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboard/method/upload:
Uploads the signed-in user's signed 32-bit score with up to 64 optional
signed 32-bit details. Steam keeps the best score by default. Set
force_update to replace it. Await a SteamScoreUploadResult for the typed
score receipt. An overlapping write returns @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardEntry/method/get_details:
Game-defined details copied from the score entry, with at most 64 signed
32-bit integers. Editing a returned packed array leaves the entry
unchanged.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardEntry/method/get_rank: One-based position on the global board.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardEntry/method/get_score:
Raw signed 32-bit score widened to a Godot integer. Interpret it using
the board's configured units.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardEntry/method/get_steam_i: Full decimal SteamID64 of the player who owns this score.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardEntry/method/get_ugc_han:
Decimal shared-file handle for a replay attachment. An empty string
means there is no attachment.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardInfo/method/get_display: Board score display format configured in Steamworks.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardInfo/method/get_entry_co: Total number of entries reported by Steam for the board.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardInfo/method/get_sort: Board sort direction configured in Steamworks.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardInfoResult/method/get_va: Detached metadata snapshot on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardOperation/method/cancel:
Ends local observation with @GlobalScope.ERR_SKIP. Returns
@GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST when already settled.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardOperation/method/is_fini: Returns whether the operation has settled.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardOperation/method/result: Returns the typed terminal result, or null while pending.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardOperation/method/wait:
Use await to receive a SteamLeaderboardResult. A settled operation
returns the same result immediately.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardOperation/signal/complet: Emitted once after the operation settles with its typed result.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardPage/method/get_entries:
Read-only typed collection of the returned rows, up to the requested
limit. It remains readable after the Steam client stops.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardPage/method/get_total_co:
Number of rows in Steam's response before the requested limit is
applied. Use SteamLeaderboard.metadata for the board's total entry
count.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardPageOperation/method/can:
Ends local observation of the current stage. Returns @GlobalScope.OK
when the cancellation was applied. The operation settles with
@GlobalScope.ERR_SKIP. Steam can still finish an already submitted
download.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardPageOperation/method/is_: Returns whether this operation has a terminal outcome.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardPageOperation/method/res:
Returns the same typed terminal result delivered by completed, or null
while pending.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardPageOperation/method/wai:
Use await to get a SteamLeaderboardPageResult. A settled operation
returns its result immediately.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardPageOperation/signal/com:
Emitted once with the typed terminal outcome after the operation has
settled.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardPageResult/method/get_va:
Detached page on success, or null on failure. A successful query may
return a page with no rows.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardQuery/method/around_me:
Returns a branch centered on the signed-in player's score. The
nonnegative counts before and after the center plus the center row must
total at most 100.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardQuery/method/fetch:
Looks up the existing board and fetches the selected page. Use await to
receive a SteamLeaderboardPageResult. Immediate errors return the same
result type.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardQuery/method/fetch_opera:
Starts the same query as fetch and returns a retained operation for
cancellation, completion, or typed result inspection.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardQuery/method/friends:
Returns a branch that reads the signed-in player's friends view with a
display cap from 1 to 100 rows.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardQuery/method/global_rank:
Returns a branch that reads count global ranks from the one-based
first_rank. The count must be between 1 and 100.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardQuery/method/users:
Returns a branch for 1 to 100 distinct individual SteamID64 values in
decimal. Only players with scores appear in the page. Steam accepts one
selected-user download at a time across the shared runtime. An
overlapping download returns @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardResult/method/get_value:
Resolved board on success, or null on failure. The board belongs to the
exact Steam client scope that requested it.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardSubmission/method/get_re:
Outcome of attaching the requested replay. Check this even when the
result reports an attachment failure.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardSubmission/method/get_su: Returns the signed score sent in the acknowledged submission.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardSubmission/method/get_up:
Returns the native client upload receipt. A publisher submission can
acknowledge the score without a native rank or change receipt, in which
case this returns null.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardSubmissionOperation/sign: Emitted once when score submission and its optional replay stage settle.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboardSubmissionResult/method/:
Receipt for an accepted score, including when the replay fails. Returns
null if Steam never reported an accepted upload.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboards/method/find_or_create:
Looks up a board by its Steam API name, or creates it using sort and
display. An existing board keeps its configured settings. On success,
the typed result contains the board.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboards/method/friends:
Looks up the existing board and fetches up to count rows from the
signed-in account's friends view. The count must be between 1 and 100.
Use await to receive a SteamLeaderboardPageResult.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboards/method/is_available:
Returns whether the active scope exposes Steam leaderboards on the main
thread.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboards/method/query:
Returns a branchable read for the existing Steam board named board_name.
Defaults to the first ten global ranks. Use SteamLeaderboardQuery.fetch
or SteamLeaderboardQuery.fetch_operation to start the read.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboards/method/submit_score:
Submits the signed 32-bit score to an existing board using keep-best.
Use await to receive a SteamLeaderboardSubmissionResult. To supply
details or a replay, start with with_details or with_replay.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboards/method/top:
Looks up board_name and fetches the first count global ranks. The count
must be between 1 and 100. Use await to receive a
SteamLeaderboardPageResult. See query for other rank ranges and
cancellable queries.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboards/method/with_details:
