Starts score options with these game-defined details. A submission
accepts at most 64 signed 32-bit integers.
descriptions.SteamLeaderboards/method/with_replay:
Starts score options with a requested replay attachment. Pass a nonzero
decimal Steam Remote Storage handle belonging to the active app.
descriptions.SteamListing/method/get_app_id: Return the Steam AppID under which the listing was observed.
descriptions.SteamListing/method/get_capacity: Return the observed lobby member limit, or zero without a limit.
descriptions.SteamListing/method/get_namespace: Return the game namespace expected by this listing.
descriptions.SteamListing/method/get_ping_ms:
Return the measured server latency in milliseconds, or minus one when
unavailable.
descriptions.SteamListing/method/get_players: Return the observed lobby member count, or zero without a count.
descriptions.SteamListing/method/get_server_steam_id:
Return the Steam server identity when present. Lobby locators return an
empty string.
descriptions.SteamListing/method/get_world_id: Return the advertised world identifier when available.
descriptions.SteamListing/method/is_social:
Return true when Steam metadata identified a standalone social lobby. A
thin invite locator may need to join Steam membership before the
selected flow can verify its type.
descriptions.SteamListingResult/method/get_value: Return the detached listing when the lookup succeeded.
descriptions.SteamListingsOperation/method/cancel:
Cancel local observation. The search lane remains occupied until the
Steam callback drains or reaches its deadline.
descriptions.SteamListingsOperation/method/is_finishe: Return whether the operation has settled.
descriptions.SteamListingsOperation/method/result: Return the terminal result, or null while pending.
descriptions.SteamListingsOperation/method/wait: Await the same typed result before or after settlement.
descriptions.SteamListingsOperation/signal/completed: Emitted once after settling the observer.
descriptions.SteamListingsResult/method/get_value: Copy the list of immutable snapshots returned by the search.
descriptions.SteamLobbies/method/create:
Create a standalone social lobby. Null options use the private default.
An existing membership or pending native acquisition in this account
returns ERR_BUSY. A Game scope returns ERR_UNAUTHORIZED.
descriptions.SteamLobbies/method/current: Return this scope's current exact lobby, or null when it has none.
descriptions.SteamLobbies/method/friend_lobby:
Read a Steam friend's matching-AppID lobby locator when available. The
game verifies its live namespace and owner on join.
descriptions.SteamLobbies/method/is_available: Return whether this exact attachment can query Steam lobbies.
descriptions.SteamLobbies/method/join:
Enter a standalone lobby and recheck its live social protocol,
namespace, and Steam owner. A known Game listing is rejected locally. A
Game scope cannot submit standalone membership.
descriptions.SteamLobbies/method/query:
Build a detached gameplay lobby query. The namespace defaults to the
configured Game namespace or crimson for standalone clients. A
standalone query can opt into social lobbies with
SteamLobbyQuery.social.
descriptions.SteamLobbies/signal/invite_received:
Emitted by a standalone scope after the user accepts a Steam lobby
invite. The listing is a candidate and must be explicitly joined.
descriptions.SteamLobby/method/edit:
Return an empty edit for this membership. Call SteamLobbyEdit.submit to
check live ownership and write.
descriptions.SteamLobby/method/invite:
Submit one Steam lobby invitation from its current owner to a selected
decimal individual SteamID64. A malformed ID or the local account
returns ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER. OK acknowledges submission.
descriptions.SteamLobby/method/leave:
Leave this standalone membership, releasing its account reservation
before closed. A Game-owned membership returns ERR_UNAUTHORIZED.
descriptions.SteamLobby/method/listing:
Return a detached listing using current presentation and counts while
active. After closing, return the initial snapshot.
descriptions.SteamLobby/method/members:
Copy up to 65 current Steam lobby members. An unavailable membership
returns an empty array.
descriptions.SteamLobby/method/open_invite_dialog:
Request the Steam invite picker for the current owner's lobby. Return
ERR_BUSY while the overlay is still unavailable and OK when submitted.
descriptions.SteamLobby/method/send_chat:
Submit nonempty UTF-8 text of up to 1024 bytes with no ASCII controls,
at most once per 250 milliseconds. OK acknowledges submission. Use
chat_received to observe delivery.
descriptions.SteamLobby/method/set_joinable:
Set whether Steam can accept new members into this standalone lobby. The
current Steam owner can call this. Game-owned lobbies and guests return
ERR_UNAUTHORIZED.
descriptions.SteamLobby/method/tag:
Read the bounded value of one nonreserved application key. Return an
empty string when unavailable or absent.
descriptions.SteamLobby/signal/chat_received:
Emitted for bounded text from a current Steam lobby member, including
the local sender. A scope observes at most 20 messages per second.
descriptions.SteamLobby/signal/closed:
Emitted once after this view stops serving live actions. Explicit leave
uses OK, scope teardown uses ERR_SKIP, and Steam-reported loss uses
ERR_CONNECTION_ERROR.
descriptions.SteamLobby/signal/members_changed:
Emitted with a current bounded snapshot after a Steam member event for
this lobby.
descriptions.SteamLobbyEdit/method/named:
Return a branch staging a display name of up to 127 UTF-8 bytes. An
empty name clears the current name.
descriptions.SteamLobbyEdit/method/submit:
Recheck Steam's current owner and submit up to 16 distinct staged keys.
OK means each write was accepted. Steam may accept earlier keys before a
later write fails. Invalid or empty edits return ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER,
closed membership returns ERR_UNAVAILABLE, and guests receive
ERR_UNAUTHORIZED.
descriptions.SteamLobbyEdit/method/tag:
Return a branch staging a key of 1 to 32 ASCII letters, numbers,
underscores or hyphens and a value up to 255 UTF-8 bytes. Keys starting
with crimson_, including case variants, are reserved. An empty value
clears the tag.
descriptions.SteamLobbyMember/method/get_display_name:
The locally available Steam persona name, or an empty string if
unavailable.
descriptions.SteamLobbyMember/method/get_is_owner: Whether this member was Steam's owner at snapshot time.
descriptions.SteamLobbyOperation/method/cancel:
Settle the pending observation with ERR_SKIP. An acquired membership is
cleaned up once the pending native Steam call completes. An already
settled operation returns ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST.
descriptions.SteamLobbyOperation/method/is_finished: Return whether this operation has a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamLobbyOperation/method/result: Return the terminal result, or null while pending.
descriptions.SteamLobbyOperation/method/wait:
Await completed or return its existing SteamLobbyResult if already
finished.
descriptions.SteamLobbyOperation/signal/completed:
Emitted once when the lobby is available or the observation fails, is
cancelled, or reaches its 30-second deadline.
descriptions.SteamLobbyOptions/method/configure:
Start with an invite-only lobby in crimson with four seats, including
the local creator.
descriptions.SteamLobbyOptions/method/for_players: Return a branch with 1 to 65 member seats, including the creator.
descriptions.SteamLobbyOptions/method/in_namespace:
Return a branch with a matchmaking namespace of 1 to 64 ASCII letters,
numbers, underscores or hyphens.
descriptions.SteamLobbyOptions/method/with_visibility:
Return a branch with the selected Steam lobby visibility. Unrecognized
values make the branch invalid at creation.
descriptions.SteamLobbyQuery/method/fetch: Start the search and await its typed result directly.
descriptions.SteamLobbyQuery/method/fetch_operation:
Start the same search and retain an operation for cancellation or
repeated reads. An overlapping SDK search returns busy.
descriptions.SteamLobbyQuery/method/limit: Return a branch capped at one to 50 results. The default is 20.
descriptions.SteamLobbyQuery/method/on_map:
Return a branch for the supplied world identifier. Steam discovery
accepts up to 128 characters and 512 UTF-8 bytes without control
characters.
descriptions.SteamLobbyQuery/method/social:
Return a branch searching standalone social lobbies. Use a standalone
SteamLobbies scope. Gameplay map filters do not apply to social
searches.
descriptions.SteamLobbyQuery/method/with_room_for:
Return a branch requiring one to 64 available lobby seats. The default
is one.
descriptions.SteamLobbyQuery/method/within:
Return a branch with the selected Steam region preference. The default
is nearby.
descriptions.SteamLobbyResult/method/get_value: Return the established lobby on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamLocalizedText/method/create:
Creates immutable text with a Steam localization token and detached
substitutions. Use a leading #, up to 128 UTF-8 token bytes, and up to 8
substitutions. The service checks these bounds before submission.
descriptions.SteamLocalizedText/method/get_token: Return the localization token, including its leading #.
descriptions.SteamMessagePeer/method/close:
Retires this exact local authorization and closes its framework-owned
native channel. Native channels owned by other SDK consumers are
preserved.
descriptions.SteamMessagePeer/method/send:
Queues one packet of 1 to 4096 bytes on an allowed app channel. Defaults
to reliable ordered delivery. OK confirms local queue acceptance.
Pending binding proof can queue up to eight reliable frames and 16 KiB.
A remote binding change drops queued packets from the previous binding.
Unreliable sends return ERR_BUSY until the exact binding is proven.
An...
descriptions.SteamMessagePeer/signal/closed:
Emitted once when local authorization is withdrawn, its Game generation
retires, its pending proof expires, or an exact send reports a
connection failure.
descriptions.SteamMessagePeer/signal/received:
Emitted after copying and releasing the exact SDK packet. The app
channel, identity, current scope, sequence, and size have been checked.
descriptions.SteamMessages/method/authorize:
Authorizes one distinct remote individual SteamID64 in a standalone
scope. Supply one to 16 distinct names of up to 32 ASCII characters.
Names begin with a letter or digit and may also contain period, hyphen,
or underscore. This grants local routing permission only. Game scopes
require for_peer.
descriptions.SteamMessages/method/for_peer:
Authorizes the Game's current Steam-verified participant using its
configured channels. A guest resolves its authority. An authority
resolves its admitted world-ready peers. The binding expires when the
participant or current epoch retires.
descriptions.SteamModerationAuthorization/method/appr:
Returns an approval bound to this exact request. Use the reviewed
player_id for a suspension or ban. An empty player ID keeps the
request's explicit target. A sanction or removal requires a durable
audit_id. Returns null for a missing request.
descriptions.SteamModerationAuthorization/method/get_:
Returns the trusted backend's durable audit reference for a reviewed
action.

Returns the policy's resolved target SteamID64 when the action addresses
a player.
descriptions.SteamModerationPolicy/method/_authorize:
Return null to deny request. For a reviewed write, check moderator
authorization and resolve the reviewed player for the configured app.
Persist the exact action and reserve an audit reference before returning
SteamModerationAuthorization.approve.
descriptions.SteamModerationPolicy/method/_record_out:
Durably record the publisher-observed terminal error and receipt in the
matching audit record. Return true after persistence succeeds. A missing
or failed write returns ERR_DATABASE_CANT_WRITE from the moderation
action and preserves its receipt for reconciliation. This hook runs
before the caller resumes.
descriptions.SteamModerationReceipt/method/get_acknow: Returns whether a recognized Steam reply acknowledged the action.
descriptions.SteamModerationReceipt/method/get_action: Returns the exact reviewed action recorded by the policy.
descriptions.SteamModerationReceipt/method/get_app_id: Returns the trusted AppID that scoped this action.
descriptions.SteamModerationReceipt/method/get_audit_: Returns the game-owned audit reference reserved before dispatch.
descriptions.SteamModerationReceipt/method/get_durati: Returns the suspension duration in seconds, or zero otherwise.
descriptions.SteamModerationReceipt/method/get_player: Returns the target SteamID64 resolved by the policy.
descriptions.SteamModerationReceipt/method/get_report: Returns the reviewed Valve report ID, or empty for removal.
descriptions.SteamModerationReceiptResult/method/get_:
Returns the approved action's audit receipt, including when its remote
outcome is unresolved. Null when authorization was not granted.
descriptions.SteamModerationRequest/method/get_action: Returns the exact moderation action the trusted caller wants to perform.
descriptions.SteamModerationRequest/method/get_after_: Returns the exclusive decimal report cursor for a read.
descriptions.SteamModerationRequest/method/get_durati: Returns the requested suspension duration, in seconds.
descriptions.SteamModerationRequest/method/get_enviro: Returns the trusted publisher environment selection.
descriptions.SteamModerationRequest/method/get_eviden: Returns the report evidence, or null for other actions.
descriptions.SteamModerationRequest/method/get_from_u: Returns the inclusive UTC report-window start in Unix seconds.
descriptions.SteamModerationRequest/method/get_player: Returns the requested target SteamID64 when known.
descriptions.SteamModerationRequest/method/get_reason: Returns the requested sanction or removal reason supplied to the policy.
descriptions.SteamModerationRequest/method/get_report: Returns the reviewed Valve report ID for a suspension or permanent ban.
descriptions.SteamModerationRequest/method/get_to_uni: Returns the inclusive UTC report-window end in Unix seconds.
descriptions.SteamMusic/method/next: Requests the next track in the current Steam queue.
descriptions.SteamMusic/method/pause: Requests a pause of the current Steam queue.
descriptions.SteamMusic/method/play: Requests resume or playback of the current Steam queue.
descriptions.SteamMusic/method/previous: Requests the previous track in the current Steam queue.
descriptions.SteamMusic/method/set_volume: Requests the normalized volume level from 0 through 1.
descriptions.SteamMusic/method/status: Reads the player's enabled state, playback state, and volume.
descriptions.SteamMusic/signal/playback_changed:
Emitted after Steam reports a playback change. Read the new state with
status.
descriptions.SteamMusic/signal/volume_changed: Emitted with the normalized volume reported by Steam.
descriptions.SteamNetworking/method/peer_path:
Samples the exact current remote Steam-verified Game peer. Returns
ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER for an invalid ID, ERR_UNAVAILABLE without a live
Game sampler, or ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST when the peer has no matching
admitted live socket.
descriptions.SteamNetworking/method/relay_status:
Returns Steam's latest relay readiness. An inactive or unsupported scope
returns an unknown snapshot.
descriptions.SteamNetworking/method/warm_relay:
Starts Steam relay preparation. OK means preparation was requested.
Observe relay_status_changed or query relay_status for readiness.
descriptions.SteamNetworking/signal/relay_status_chan:
Emitted when Steam reports a relay availability update. The argument is
a detached snapshot.
descriptions.SteamNotificationBoolOperation/method/ca:
Settles local observation with ERR_SKIP. An already submitted request
can still reach Steam and commit its durable receipt. Returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST if observation has ended.
descriptions.SteamNotificationBoolOperation/method/is: Returns whether this observation has a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamNotificationBoolOperation/method/re: Returns the terminal result, or null while pending.
descriptions.SteamNotificationBoolOperation/method/wa:
Use await operation.wait() to receive a SteamBoolResult before or after
settlement.
descriptions.SteamNotificationBoolOperation/signal/co: Emitted once with the same terminal result available from result.
descriptions.SteamNotificationClaim/method/create:
Creates a store decision. A committed decision includes the original
provider session ID.
descriptions.SteamNotificationClaim/method/get_sessio: Returns the stored provider session ID for a committed operation.
descriptions.SteamNotificationParticipant/method/get_: Return the localized message when available.
Return the participant's confirmed asynchronous state.
Return the provider's unsigned decimal participant SteamID64.
descriptions.SteamNotificationSession/method/get_cont: Return the known creation context, or an empty string when unavailable.
descriptions.SteamNotificationSession/method/get_sess: Return the exact provider session ID as an unsigned decimal string.
descriptions.SteamNotificationSession/method/get_titl: Return the confirmed localized session title.
descriptions.SteamNotificationSession/method/get_user: Return the detached read-only participant snapshots.
descriptions.SteamNotificationSessionOperation/method:
Settles local observation with ERR_SKIP. An already submitted request
can still reach Steam and commit its durable receipt. Returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST if observation has ended.
Returns whether this observation has a terminal result.
Returns the terminal result, or null while pending.

Use await operation.wait() to receive a SteamNotificationSessionResult
before or after settlement.
descriptions.SteamNotificationSessionOperation/signal: Emitted once with the same terminal result available from result.
descriptions.SteamNotificationSessionResult/method/ge:
The typed receipt on success. If Steam accepted a write and the durable
store could not commit it, the known receipt can still be available for
trusted reconciliation.
descriptions.SteamNotificationSessionSpec/method/crea:
Creates an immutable complete session spec. context is a canonical
unsigned decimal string used at creation. Supply a localized title and 1
to 16 distinct verified participants.
descriptions.SteamNotificationSessionSpec/method/get_: Return the backend context as an unsigned decimal string.
Return the full read-only participant state.
descriptions.SteamNotificationSessionsOperation/metho:
Settles local observation with ERR_SKIP. An already submitted request
can still reach Steam and commit its durable receipt. Returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST if observation has ended.
Returns whether this observation has a terminal result.
Returns the terminal result, or null while pending.

Use await operation.wait() to receive a SteamNotificationSessionsResult
before or after settlement.
descriptions.SteamNotificationSessionsOperation/signa: Emitted once with the same terminal result available from result.
descriptions.SteamNotificationSessionsResult/method/g:
A read-only array of detached sessions. An unsuccessful query yields an
empty array.
descriptions.SteamNotificationStore/method/_claim:
Atomically compare the app-scoped key and fingerprint, replay completed
receipts, and claim a new write only when authorized. Update and remove
claims also reserve the exact owned target against competing keys until
settlement. An unresolved sent operation remains reserved for trusted
reconciliation.
descriptions.SteamNotificationStore/method/_claim_lau:
Atomically reserve notification registration for the exact verified app,
account, and authoritative launch ID across backend workers. Return OK
only for a new durable claim, ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE when it is already
claimed, or an error if authorization or storage fails. Keep the claim
after dispatch even when Steam does not confirm the response.
descriptions.SteamNotificationStore/method/_commit:
Atomically commit the exact claim and its provider ID. Record ownership
on create, preserve it on update, and retire it on remove. Release the
target reservation in the same transaction.
descriptions.SteamNotificationStore/method/_owns_sess:
Returns whether the trusted backend currently owns this provider session
for the configured app.
descriptions.SteamNotificationStore/method/_release_u:
Atomically releases the exact claim and its target reservation when
Crimson reports that transport scheduling failed.

Release the exact launch claim when Crimson confirms no Steam request
was scheduled. Return true only after releasing the claim durably.
descriptions.SteamNotificationUserState/method/create:
Creates one recipient's state for a session mutation. Pass the identity
minted by the same trusted publisher for this recipient.
descriptions.SteamNotificationUserState/method/get_me: Return the recipient's localized status message.
descriptions.SteamNotificationUserState/method/get_st: Return the desired asynchronous session state.
descriptions.SteamOperation/method/cancel:
Ends local observation and completes it with ERR_SKIP. Steam can still
finish the submitted action. Returns ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST when observation
has already ended.
descriptions.SteamOperation/method/is_finished: Returns whether the operation has a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamOperation/method/result:
Returns the same terminal result as completed, or null while observation
is pending.
descriptions.SteamOperation/method/wait:
Use await operation.wait() to receive a SteamResult before or after
observation ends.
descriptions.SteamOperation/signal/completed:
Emitted once after a pending action settles, including after
cancellation or client shutdown. result already returns this result
during the signal.
descriptions.SteamOverlay/method/is_active:
Returns the latest activation state observed for the running AppID. The
initial state is false until the current Steam runtime receives an
activation event. A detached facade returns false.
descriptions.SteamOverlay/method/is_ready:
Returns true when the running Steam client reports that the overlay is
loaded and accessible. It may remain false during graphics startup, with
the overlay disabled, or in a headless process.
descriptions.SteamOverlay/method/open_achievements: Requests the current game's Steam Achievements pane.
descriptions.SteamOverlay/method/open_profile:
Requests the Steam Community profile of an individual account identified
by its decimal SteamID64.
descriptions.SteamOverlay/method/open_store:
Requests the Steam Store page in browse mode. Zero selects the running
AppID. A positive unsigned 32-bit AppID selects another product.
descriptions.SteamOverlay/method/open_trade:
Requests the Steam Trading pane for the supplied partner's decimal
SteamID64. Call it after the game's authorized backend has started an
existing Steam trading session with that individual account.
descriptions.SteamOverlay/method/open_web:
Requests a page in Steam's overlay browser. Supply an absolute HTTP or
HTTPS URL without embedded credentials and at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes.
descriptions.SteamOverlay/signal/activation_changed:
Emitted when Steam reports that the overlay gained or lost focus.
Applies to both a Steam hotkey and an in-game request. is_active already
reflects the new state when the signal is delivered.
descriptions.SteamOwnership/method/get_checked_dlc_id: Returns the exact DLC AppIDs checked during verification.
descriptions.SteamOwnership/method/get_identity:
Returns the publisher-scoped Steam identity verified by the encrypted
ticket and backend challenge.
descriptions.SteamOwnership/method/get_issued_at_unix: Returns the verified ticket issue time in Unix seconds.
descriptions.SteamOwnership/method/get_owned_dlc_ids: Returns the requested DLC AppIDs whose ownership the ticket proves.
descriptions.SteamOwnership/method/owns_app: Returns whether this receipt proves ownership of its base app.
descriptions.SteamOwnership/method/owns_dlc:
Returns true when the ticket confirms ownership of the requested DLC
AppID.
descriptions.SteamOwnershipChallengeStore/method/_con:
Atomically matches the exact backend-issued challenge and AppID,
verifies the record is unexpired and unused, checks its request and
expected-account bindings, and retires it before returning true.
steam_id is the verified ticket account. Times use Unix seconds. Return
false when any check fails. Keep challenge bytes and account identifiers
out of logs.
descriptions.SteamOwnershipResult/method/get_value: Returns the verified ownership receipt on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamOwnershipTicket/method/bytes:
Returns the opaque encrypted ticket for the trusted backend. Keep it out
of saves, replays, and logs. Issuance and backend validation are
separate actions.
descriptions.SteamParties/method/beacons:
Reads visible beacons with compatible bounded Game lobby metadata.
Snapshots remain readable after the SDK changes its visible list.
descriptions.SteamParties/method/locations:
Reads up to 128 eligible Steam Chat locations as typed snapshots. Empty
eligible lists are valid.
descriptions.SteamParties/method/publish:
Await a SteamPartyBeaconResult. The listing must be this Game scope's
live owned non-private Steam lobby. Choose a currently eligible location
and one to 64 unreserved seats within authority capacity. A process can
publish one beacon at a time.
descriptions.SteamParties/method/reserve:
Await a SteamListingResult. Steam reserves a seat and returns an
owner-bound locator for GameRuntime.join_listing. Game admission still
verifies the live lobby owner and rules. An abandoned reservation
expires on the host.
descriptions.SteamParties/signal/beacons_changed:
Emitted when Steam says the visible beacons or eligible locations
changed. Read a fresh snapshot when handling it.
descriptions.SteamPartyBeacon/method/cancel:
Returns the exact pending reservation to Steam. A guest already in
flight still follows the ordinary Game admission rules.
descriptions.SteamPartyBeacon/method/change_open_slot:
Requests a new count of zero to 64 unreserved seats. The count cannot
exceed current authority capacity after outstanding reservations. Await
the operation to observe Steam's response.
descriptions.SteamPartyBeacon/method/close:
Withdraws the exact beacon and retires its reservations and local slot
observer.
descriptions.SteamPartyBeacon/method/complete:
Acknowledges the exact reserved account after the authority confirms
that it reached the current world. The Game also performs this
acknowledgment automatically.
descriptions.SteamPartyBeacon/signal/closed:
Emitted after the beacon is retired and local reservation state is
cleared.
descriptions.SteamPartyBeacon/signal/reservation_rece:
Emitted for an exact Steam reservation on this live beacon. The
authority returns abandoned seats after its deadline.
descriptions.SteamPartySlotsOperation/method/cancel:
Settles local observation with ERR_SKIP. Steam may still apply the
submitted update.
descriptions.SteamPartySlotsOperation/method/is_finis: Returns whether this observer reached a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamPartySlotsOperation/method/result: Returns the terminal result or null while pending.
descriptions.SteamPartySlotsOperation/method/wait: Returns the completed typed result, or the signal to await it.
descriptions.SteamPartySlotsOperation/signal/complete: Emitted once with this operation's terminal result.
descriptions.SteamPeer/method/get_remote_steam_id:
Return the current transport-certified Steam ID bound to this exact
physical peer. Return zero before its secure handshake or after it
leaves.
descriptions.SteamPresence/method/clear:
Clears the keys still owned by this scope. A non-owning scope can call
this without changing another scope's status. Explicit Friends overrides
and unrelated presence keys are preserved. Stopping the owning scope
also attempts to clear its keys.
descriptions.SteamPresence/method/is_available:
Returns whether the active main-thread Steam scope supports local status
writes and cache reads.
descriptions.SteamPresence/method/show:
Publishes a Steamworks localization token beginning with # and its
optional replacements. To group players, provide both a nonempty
party_id and a positive party_size. Use the defaults for no grouping.
Replacement keys must fit Steam's byte and key limits and must avoid
connect, status, and names beginning with steam_. Returns
@GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY when...
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/configure: Build detached settings with a private lobby and the Steam launch AppID.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/dedicated:
Return a branch that creates a separate SteamGameServer pipe for
GameRuntime.start_dedicated_online. The game remains playerless and does
not acquire a signed-in Steam client. Null settings return null.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/for_app:
Return a branch with this expected AppID. Zero uses the Steam launch
AppID, and invalid IDs return null.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/friends_only: Return a branch that publishes a lobby joinable by friends and invitees.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/get_initialization_:
Return the unique attachment's startup diagnostic or the diagnostic for
an ambiguous Resource.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/get_lobby_visibilit: Return the configured Steam lobby visibility.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/get_local_steam_id:
Return the signed-in SteamID64 for the uniquely identified attachment,
or an empty string.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/get_prefer_relay_ro:
Returns whether the next Steam listen attachment will prefer Valve
relays.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/get_virtual_port: Return the configured Steam P2P virtual port.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/invisible_lobby:
Return a branch whose lobby appears in Steam search and is hidden from
friends visibility.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/invite_player:
Send an invitation from the uniquely attached game's current lobby. Use
GameInvites.send for an exact game attachment.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/is_ready:
Return whether this Resource identifies one attached game with usable
Steam. Use SteamServices.for_game when the Resource is shared.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/on_virtual_port:
Return a branch with a Steam virtual port from 0 to 65535. An invalid
port returns null.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/open_invite_overlay:
Request the invite picker for the uniquely attached game's current
lobby. Use GameInvites.open_overlay for an exact game attachment.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/prefer_relay:
Returns a branch that prefers Valve relay routes over direct ICE for
incoming Steam listen connections. It adds a 500 millisecond ICE route
selection penalty while preserving direct fallback. Dedicated routes are
unaffected. Observe the actual chosen path with
SteamNetworking.peer_path.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/private: Return a branch that publishes an invite-only lobby.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/public_lobbies: Return a branch whose compatible lobby appears in Steam search.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/set_app_id: Set the expected AppID before attaching the game.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/set_lobby_namespace: Set the shared lobby namespace before attaching the game.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/set_lobby_visibilit: Set the lobby visibility captured when the game attaches.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/set_prefer_relay_ro: Sets the route preference for the next Steam listen attachment.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/set_virtual_port: Set the Steam P2P virtual port before attaching the game.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/with_commerce_backe:
Returns a new provider configuration with the selected game-owned
commerce adapter. The adapter must use the game's authenticated
purchasing backend. Pass null for a provider without commerce.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/with_lobby_namespac:
Return a branch with 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or
hyphens. An invalid namespace returns null.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/with_message_channe:
Returns an independent provider branch allowing the specified app
message channels for verified, world-ready Steam Game peers. Supply at
most 16 distinct channel names of up to 32 ASCII characters, or an empty
list to disable Game Messages. Invalid names return null.
descriptions.SteamProvider/method/with_relay_coordina:
Return a branch with the trusted hosted relay coordinator. The server
uses registration and withdrawal. The signed-in guest uses fresh
authorization. Null clears the adapter for a future Game.
descriptions.SteamProvider/signal/invite_received:
Emitted when Steam asks the running client to join a lobby. Submit the
listing to GameRuntime.join_online after the user accepts it in your
game.
descriptions.SteamPublisher/method/auth:
Returns the trusted authentication and ownership service, or null if the
scope has closed.
descriptions.SteamPublisher/method/boot:
Validates and snapshots settings and the attached trusted host. Resolves
the credential on the first request.
descriptions.SteamPublisher/method/close:
Invalidates the issuer and its services. Pending local observations
settle on the next host tick.
descriptions.SteamPublisher/method/game_notifications:
Returns the scoped game notification service, or null if the scope has
closed. Durable mutations require an injected
SteamPublisherSettings.notification_store.
descriptions.SteamPublisher/method/inventory:
Returns the trusted Steam Inventory service for this app, or null if the
scope has closed.
descriptions.SteamPublisher/method/is_ready:
Returns whether the publisher still belongs to its original attached
host generation.
descriptions.SteamPublisher/method/leaderboards:
Returns the trusted leaderboard service, or null if the scope has
closed.
descriptions.SteamPublisher/method/moderation:
Returns the scoped publisher moderation service, or null if the scope
has closed. Actions require an injected
SteamPublisherSettings.moderation_policy.
descriptions.SteamPublisher/method/purchases:
Returns the scoped trusted Steam Wallet service, or null if the scope
has closed. Actions require an injected
SteamPublisherSettings.purchase_store.
descriptions.SteamPublisherAuth/method/owns_app:
Checks Steam's current license for an identity minted by this exact
publisher. Use await to receive SteamAppOwnershipResult. A negative
license is a successful query with SteamAppOwnership.owns_app false.
descriptions.SteamPublisherAuth/method/verify:
Sends the configured AppID, exact audience, and hex-encoded ticket to
Valve. Use await to receive SteamIdentityResult. Only an accepted ticket
with a valid individual SteamID issues an identity.
descriptions.SteamPublisherAuth/method/verify_ownersh:
Verifies an encrypted app ticket locally against the configured AppID,
exact expected_challenge, and optional DLC AppIDs. Checks the fresh
ticket and consumes the one-time challenge through the trusted store
before issuing an identity. Returns a typed error for invalid tickets,
replay, or unavailable configuration.
descriptions.SteamPublisherCompletion/signal/complete:
Emitted once with the action's concrete result after its native request
has retired.
descriptions.SteamPublisherHost/method/_fixture_trans:
Returns true in publisher test builds. This fixture method is omitted
from production builds.
descriptions.SteamPublisherHost/method/_resolve_encry:
Returns the exact private Steam app-ticket decryption key bytes for
reference, or an empty array if unavailable. Resolve this key only
inside the trusted backend.
descriptions.SteamPublisherHost/method/_resolve_secre:
Returns the secret for the configured reference or an empty string when
unavailable. Keep returned data inside the trusted host.
descriptions.SteamPublisherHost/method/_test_decrypte:
Returns synthetic decrypted ticket claims for encrypted ownership
fixtures. This override is available only in the publisher test build.
descriptions.SteamPublisherHost/method/_test_response:
Returns synthetic status, body bytes, and optional ticks in a publisher
test build. The hook receives whether a key was resolved and never
receives the key value.
descriptions.SteamPublisherInventory/method/consume:
Awaits a SteamInventoryChangeResult for the permanent consumption of a
positive unsigned 32-bit quantity from player's instance_id. Supply the
same nonzero unsigned decimal request_id for a retry of the same
authorized operation. A recognized confirmation includes exactly one
changed or removed row for the requested stack.
descriptions.SteamPublisherInventory/method/grant:
Awaits a SteamInventoryChangeResult for a game-authorized award to
player. Supply 1 to 256 published definition_ids and a nonzero unsigned
decimal request_id. The result contains the actual item rows Steam
reports after bundle and generator expansion. Repeat the same request ID
and definitions for a retry of this award.
descriptions.SteamPublisherInventory/method/items:
Awaits a SteamInventorySnapshotResult for the configured app and
verified player. The typed rows are detached and read-only. The
publisher endpoint supplies no snapshot freshness evidence.
descriptions.SteamPublisherInventory/method/start_tra:
Awaits a SteamTradeSessionResult for a Steam trade request in an
eligible Economy app. Verify the distinct player and partner in the same
publisher and confirm their consent in the game before calling. A
recognized Steam acknowledgment identifies both accounts. The
participants confirm any transfer through Steam.
descriptions.SteamPublisherLeaderboards/method/submit:
Submits a signed 32-bit score using KeepBest for a verified player and a
positive Valve board ID. Accepts up to 256 raw details bytes. Use await
to receive SteamLeaderboardSubmissionResult. Success acknowledges the
HTTP submission. The publisher endpoint does not document rank or change
fields, so the result carries the submitted score and no...
descriptions.SteamPublisherModeration/method/ban:
Requests a permanent game ban for the policy-resolved player associated
with report_id. Supply the reviewed reason. Returns
SteamModerationReceiptResult. The exact game policy must authorize the
request and reserve the audit record before Steam receives it. An
expired or closed observation can leave the remote outcome unresolved.
descriptions.SteamPublisherModeration/method/remove_b:
Requests removal of the game ban for player_id on the configured AppID.
The reason stays in the trusted audit record. Returns
SteamModerationReceiptResult. The exact game policy must authorize the
request and reserve the audit record before Steam receives it. An
expired or closed observation can leave the remote outcome unresolved.
descriptions.SteamPublisherModeration/method/report:
Submits evidence about player_id after policy approval. The player ID is
an individual SteamID64 in decimal form. A player reporter must be
verified by the same publisher. Returns SteamCheatReportResult with the
full unsigned Valve report ID.
descriptions.SteamPublisherModeration/method/reports:
Lists reports from from_unix to to_unix, in UTC Unix seconds, with a
maximum span of seven days. Use the exclusive decimal after_report_id
cursor from the previous page or "0" for the first page. Returns
SteamCheatReportPageResult.
descriptions.SteamPublisherModeration/method/suspend:
Requests a suspension for the policy-resolved player associated with
report_id. seconds must be from 1 through 31535999. Valve treats
durations under one year as suspensions hidden from the player's public
profile. Supply the reviewed reason. Returns
SteamModerationReceiptResult. An invalid duration returns
ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER before invoking the...
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseLine/method/create:
Returns a validated priced line, or null for an empty or oversized SKU
or description, out-of-range item ID or quantity, or nonpositive total.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseLine/method/get_de: Trusted localized Steam checkout text, up to 128 characters.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseLine/method/get_it: Positive unsigned 32-bit Steam item ID configured by the game.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseLine/method/get_qu: Positive count of units, up to 32767.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseLine/method/get_sk: Game catalog SKU, up to 96 characters.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseLine/method/get_to: Total for the whole line in the original quote's Steam currency units.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseOrder/method/creat:
Returns a new RESERVED order at revision zero, or null for an invalid
configuration, duplicate SKU or item ID, empty or oversized cart, or
total overflow.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseOrder/method/get_a: Positive Steamworks AppID for the original order.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseOrder/method/get_c:
Stable account-scoped retry ID encoded as 32 lowercase hexadecimal
characters.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseOrder/method/get_e: Steam endpoint environment selected for the original order.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseOrder/method/get_l: Lowercase ISO 639-1 language code used in the checkout.
Read-only list of up to 32 unique priced lines.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseOrder/method/get_o: Canonical positive decimal order ID assigned by the publisher.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseOrder/method/get_r:
Exact Steam item IDs whose entitlements have been reversed for this
order.
Optimistic concurrency revision. The reservation begins at zero.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseOrder/method/get_s: Canonical decimal SteamID64 of the authenticated buyer.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseOrder/method/get_t: Basis used when verifying a receipt's line amount. Defaults to NET.

Checked sum of the quoted line totals, in the original currency's Steam
units.
Valve's canonical decimal transaction ID, empty before it is known.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseOrder/method/get_v:
Latest accepted Steam UTC timestamp in Unix seconds, or zero before an
observation.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseOrder/method/with_:
Returns a copy of the quote with the supplied durable state. Returns
null for an invalid revision, phase, transaction ID, timestamp, or
reversed item set. This constructs a storage snapshot and does not
request a payment or grant an entitlement.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchaseOrderResult/method:
Constructs a durable lookup result. Use ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST only when
storage confirms absence. An OK result with a null value becomes
ERR_INVALID_DATA.
Exact persisted order, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchases/method/begin:
Await a SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult. Requires a SteamIdentity verified by
the same publisher. Atomically prices and reserves the cart under
checkout_id, then starts Steam authorization. An uncertain previous
initialization is queried without automatically repeating the write.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchases/method/buyer_inf:
Await a SteamPurchaseBuyerInfoResult with the Steam Wallet country,
currency, optional region, and reported account status for player. The
identity must come from this exact publisher. Uses the configured live
or sandbox environment. Read this before quoting a localized price. The
game keeps ownership of its catalog, pricing, and eligibility policy.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchases/method/finalize:
Await a SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult. Requires an exact Steam query to
verify approval before claiming and capturing the charge. Durable
fulfillment follows a verified success. An uncertain earlier
finalization remains in reconciliation and is never blindly repeated.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchases/method/query:
Await a SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult for a known order. Verifies exact
Steam payer, transaction, currency and line amounts and persists
applicable state changes. An unknown order or invalid receipt returns a
typed error.
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchases/method/reconcile:
Await a SteamPurchaseReconciliationResult for one bounded settlement
page from the inclusive Unix UTC cursor. max_results must be from 1 to
1000 and defaults to 1000. A reply larger than 4 MiB fails validation.
Applies known receipts and exact item reversals in order. A failing
event leaves the original cursor available for replay. A full page whose
last...
descriptions.SteamPublisherPurchases/method/refund:
Await a SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult. Queries and requests a full refund
only for a known fulfilled order and an explicit store policy approval.
Reversal requires a confirmed receipt and durable update. Partial
Steam-originated reversals are handled by reconcile.
descriptions.SteamPublisherResult/method/get_value:
Initialized publisher on success, or null when its configuration was
rejected.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/get_app_id:
Positive Steamworks AppID verified by the backend and used for publisher
writes.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/get_encryp:
Optional reference for the separate private encrypted app-ticket
decryption key. Required for local encrypted ownership verification.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/get_enviro:
Vendor environment for features with a separate sandbox. The default is
LIVE.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/get_host:
Attached trusted scene-tree node that resolves credential references and
owns requests.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/get_modera:
Trusted app policy for authorizing and auditing reports and sanctions.
The default null leaves moderation unavailable.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/get_notifi:
Durable app-owned store for exact notification operations and session
ownership. The default null leaves notification mutations unavailable.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/get_owners:
Returns the configured one-time ownership challenge store, or null if
absent.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/get_publis:
Name of a publisher credential in the host's secret store, such as a
vault identifier. Required for Steam partner Web API calls.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/get_purcha:
Trusted backend adapter for atomic pricing, order persistence, refund
policy, and entitlement changes. The default null leaves Steam Wallet
actions unavailable.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/set_app_id:
Positive Steamworks AppID verified by the backend and used for publisher
writes.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/set_encryp:
Optional reference for the separate private encrypted app-ticket
decryption key. Required for local encrypted ownership verification.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/set_enviro:
Vendor environment for features with a separate sandbox. The default is
LIVE.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/set_host:
Attached trusted scene-tree node that resolves credential references and
owns requests.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/set_modera:
Trusted app policy for authorizing and auditing reports and sanctions.
The default null leaves moderation unavailable.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/set_notifi:
Durable app-owned store for exact notification operations and session
ownership. The default null leaves notification mutations unavailable.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/set_owners:
Injects the durable game store that atomically consumes one-time
ownership challenges. The default null leaves encrypted ownership
verification unavailable.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/set_publis:
Name of a publisher credential in the host's secret store, such as a
vault identifier. Required for Steam partner Web API calls.
descriptions.SteamPublisherSettings/method/set_purcha:
Trusted backend adapter for atomic pricing, order persistence, refund
policy, and entitlement changes. The default null leaves Steam Wallet
actions unavailable.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseBuyerInfo/method/get_accoun:
Returns the Steam purchasing status, or UNKNOWN if Valve omitted it or
returned a new value.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseBuyerInfo/method/get_countr: Returns the two-letter uppercase ISO 3166-1 country code.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseBuyerInfo/method/get_curren: Returns the three-letter uppercase ISO 4217 Steam Wallet currency code.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseBuyerInfo/method/get_region: Returns the state or region Steam supplied, or an empty string.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseBuyerInfoResult/method/get_: Returns the detached buyer metadata on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseCart/method/lines: Returns a read-only copy of the typed SKU selections.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseCart/method/with_checkout_i:
Returns the same selection with a previously assigned 32-character
lowercase hexadecimal retry ID. Returns null if the ID is invalid.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseCart/method/with_item:
Returns an independent branch with the quantity for this SKU replaced. A
SKU uses 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes, or underscores. A cart
holds up to 32 SKUs. Quantities range from 1 through 1000. Invalid
selections return null.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseCatalog/method/create:
Creates a catalog from up to 256 valid offers with unique SKU IDs.
Returns null for invalid data.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseCatalogResult/method/create:
Creates a result for the game adapter. A successful result requires a
typed catalog.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseItem/method/create:
Creates an offer from the authenticated backend's pricing. Amount must
be positive in Steam's units for the three-letter uppercase currency
code. Invalid offers return null.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseOutcome/method/create:
Creates the typed receipt from verified backend state. Provide a
canonical nonzero 64-bit decimal order ID, a valid currency code, and a
positive total in Steam's units. Invalid data returns null.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult/method/create:
Creates a typed response for the commerce adapter. Echo the original
checkout ID on a successful begin response. Error results can carry the
same ID for retry.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseReconciliation/method/get_n:
Unix UTC seconds to use for the next page, or the original cursor on an
empty or failed page.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseReconciliation/method/get_p:
Number of known order observations successfully applied or already
recorded.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseReconciliationResult/method:
Detached summary when a report was received, or null if the request
could not start.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseStore/method/_authorize_ref:
Return true only when the current trusted operator or workflow may
refund this exact fulfilled order. The default denies. A backend must
enforce its own administrative authentication and refund policy.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseStore/method/_compare_and_c:
Return true only when the stored immutable quote and expected revision
matched and the new revision and corresponding entitlement change or
outbox message were committed atomically. Return false without changing
durable state on a conflict or failure.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseStore/method/_load_order:
Returns the stored order for the exact namespace and ID. Return an
explicit storage error when durability cannot be established.
descriptions.SteamPurchaseStore/method/_reserve_check:
Atomically looks up or reserves the authenticated player's checkout. The
game chooses order ID, currency, prices and item mappings. Return the
same immutable quote for a replay and null if the selection is rejected.
descriptions.SteamPurchases/method/catalog: Await a SteamPurchaseCatalogResult for the signed-in player's offers.
descriptions.SteamPurchases/method/checkout:
Await a SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult for this cart. A pending receipt can
be refreshed later by order ID. A failed local observation retains the
checkout ID.
descriptions.SteamPurchases/method/order:
Await a SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult for the authenticated player's exact
previously created order.
descriptions.SteamPurchases/signal/order_changed:
Emitted when the authenticated game backend first reports or changes an
order state.
descriptions.SteamRelayCoordinator/method/_authorize_:
Authenticate the client independently, authorize only the selected live
registration, and sign a fresh Steam relay ticket on the backend.
Complete the exact request with SteamRelayRequest.authorize or
SteamRelayRequest.fail. Keep signing credentials off client and
game-server builds.
descriptions.SteamRelayCoordinator/method/_register_s:
Submit the Steam-signed login only to the authenticated backend. The
backend checks app, namespace, profile, virtual port and registration
before acknowledging the exact request with SteamRelayRequest.registered
or SteamRelayRequest.fail.
descriptions.SteamRelayCoordinator/method/_withdraw_s:
Idempotently retire only this exact generation-scoped hosted locator,
including a late registration that finished after the Game left.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/authorize:
Return a fresh signed Steam relay ticket of 1 to 4096 bytes for this
exact client, AppID, authority, virtual port and registration. Crimson
verifies the SDK-parsed fields and cache selection before opening any
peer.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/fail:
Settle the pending request without a registration or authorization. A
settled or unconfigured request returns ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/get_app_id: The Steam AppID selected and validated by the native SDK.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/get_kind: Return the native hosted step, registration or authorization.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/get_listing_id:
The exact generation-scoped hosted locator. The coordinator must use
this same value to register and withdraw.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/get_local_steam:
The signed-in client's candidate SteamID64. The coordinator
independently authenticates the caller before using this value. Empty
during registration.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/get_login_blob:
Copy the Steam-signed server login blob on the scene thread before
dispatching backend work. Send it only to the authenticated coordinator
backend. Empty off the scene thread, during client authorization, or
after settlement.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/get_namespace: The matching game's namespace, bound to the selected hosted locator.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/get_profile: The operator-defined hosted relay deployment profile.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/get_registratio:
The generation nonce as a decimal unsigned 64-bit string. The backend
signs this value into the relay ticket's crimson_registration fixed64
extra field.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/get_server_stea: The expected certified Steam GameServer identity as a decimal SteamID64.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/get_virtual_por: The exact Steam hosted virtual port, from zero through 65535.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/get_world_id:
The authority's mounted world during registration. Empty during client
authorization.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/is_cancelled: Return true once the owning Game abandoned this exact request.
descriptions.SteamRelayRequest/method/registered:
Acknowledge registration of the exact signed server login. If the Game
cancelled, the request withdraws that same registration. ERR_UNAVAILABLE
means the backend must compensate itself.
descriptions.SteamRelayStatus/method/is_measuring: Returns whether Steam is measuring or waiting to measure relay latency.
descriptions.SteamRemotePlay/method/is_available:
Return whether this live scope has the Steam Remote Play interface and
stream callback routing. The Steam app must enable Together features for
invites and separate input.
descriptions.SteamRemotePlay/method/open_together_ove:
Request Steam's Remote Play Together overlay. Return OK if Steam
accepts, ERR_BUSY if its overlay is still unavailable for display, or
ERR_UNAVAILABLE if the feature or live scope is unavailable. Use the
session signals to observe actual streams.
descriptions.SteamRemotePlay/method/poll_input:
Return a read-only batch of newly available keyboard and mouse samples.
The owner that enabled separate input can consume up to the requested
limit, capped at 256. A nonpositive limit or unavailable scope yields an
empty batch. Unknown SDK events are skipped.
descriptions.SteamRemotePlay/method/send_invite:
Submit a Together invitation to an individual friend's decimal
SteamID64. A malformed or local ID returns ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER. Return
FAILED when Steam declines the invitation. Successful submission does
not indicate that the guest connected.
descriptions.SteamRemotePlay/method/sessions:
Return a read-only snapshot of currently connected Remote Play streams.
An empty list is valid when nobody is connected. Use is_available to
distinguish unavailable observation.
descriptions.SteamRemotePlay/method/set_separate_inpu:
Enable separate Together keyboard and mouse input for this scope, or
restore Steam's merged input. Return ERR_BUSY while another scope owns
the process input mode. Stopping the owner also restores merged input.
descriptions.SteamRemotePlay/signal/session_connected:
Emitted when Steam reports a connected stream. Use its session ID to
assign or restore a local seat.
descriptions.SteamRemotePlay/signal/session_disconnec:
Emitted when Steam reports a disconnected stream. Release that seat and
clear any held input.
descriptions.SteamResult/method/get_error:
Returns the terminal Godot error. OK means the action succeeded under
its documented completion contract.
descriptions.SteamResult/method/get_message:
Returns the action's diagnostic. A failed action that supplies no
specific detail returns the Godot error description. A successful action
can leave this empty.
descriptions.SteamResult/method/is_ok: Returns true when error is OK.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/apps:
Read app metadata through this attachment's active Steam client. Returns
null when this generation has ended.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/auth:
Returns the authentication and ownership ticket service for this exact
Game attachment, or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/browser:
Returns the Steam HTML Surface service for this exact Game attachment,
or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/cloud:
Resolve Steam Cloud for this attachment. Returns null when this
generation has ended.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/device:
Returns the device, virtual keyboard, and VR status service for this
exact Game attachment, or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/diagnostics:
Resolve the warning capture service for this attachment. Returns null
when this generation has ended.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/friends:
Use this attachment's active friends service. Returns null when this
generation has ended.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/get_app_id: Return the confirmed active Steam AppID, or zero when unavailable.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/get_initialization_err:
Return the diagnostic captured by this game's provider. Successful
attachments return an empty string.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/get_local_steam_id:
Return the local signed-in SteamID64, or an empty string when
unavailable.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/http:
Issue HTTP requests on this attachment's client scope. Returns null when
this generation has ended.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/input:
Returns the Steam Input controller service for this exact Game
attachment, or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/inventory:
Returns the Steam Inventory service for this exact Game attachment.
Returns null after the attachment ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/is_ready: Return whether this attachment has a live Steam client and provider.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/leaderboards:
Resolve the leaderboard service for this attachment. Returns null when
this generation has ended.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/lobbies:
Resolve this exact attachment's lobby discovery service. Retained
services expire on tree exit.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/messages:
Returns this attachment's Steam message service for admitted peers and
configured channels. Returns null after the attachment ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/music:
Returns the Steam music player service for this exact Game attachment,
or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/networking:
Returns the Steam relay and connection-path diagnostics for this exact
Game attachment, or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/overlay:
Use this attachment's overlay actions and state when Steam provides
them. Returns null when this generation has ended.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/parties:
Returns this attachment's Steam Parties service, or null after the scope
ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/presence:
Returns the managed Rich Presence service for this exact Game
attachment, or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/purchases:
Returns the purchase facade for this exact Game attachment, or null
after it ends. Bind a backend through
SteamProvider.with_commerce_backend.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/remote_play:
Returns the Remote Play session and input service for this exact Game
attachment. Returns null after the attachment ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/screenshots:
Returns the screenshot capture and result service for this exact Game
attachment. Returns null after the attachment ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/server_browser:
Return this exact client scope's Steam dedicated server browser, or null
when its client is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/sockets:
Returns the standalone Steam Sockets service for this exact Game
attachment, or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/stats:
Read or manage this attachment's Steam stats and achievements. Returns
null when this generation has ended.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/timeline:
Resolve Steam Game Recording events for this attachment. Returns null
when this generation has ended.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/utils:
Read client and hardware state through this attachment. Returns null
when this generation has ended.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/video:
Returns the Steam video and broadcast service for this exact Game
attachment, or null after the scope ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/voice:
Returns Steam voice capture and decoding for this exact Game attachment,
or null after the attachment ends.
descriptions.SteamScope/method/workshop:
Returns the Steam Workshop service for this exact Game attachment.
Returns null after the attachment ends.
descriptions.SteamScoreOptions/method/submit_score:
Submits the signed 32-bit score to an existing board using keep-best. If
Steam reports that the score became the entry, attaches the requested
replay. Use await to receive a SteamLeaderboardSubmissionResult. The
accepted receipt remains available if attachment fails.
descriptions.SteamScoreOptions/method/with_details:
Returns a branch that sends these details with the score. The submission
accepts at most 64 signed 32-bit integers.
descriptions.SteamScoreOptions/method/with_replay:
Returns a branch requesting attachment of the provided Steam Remote
Storage shared-file handle. Pass a nonzero decimal handle belonging to
this app.
descriptions.SteamScoreUpload/method/get_changed:
Whether the submission became the current leaderboard score. Keep-best
can accept the submission while retaining the old score.
descriptions.SteamScoreUpload/method/get_previous_ran:
The player's rank before submission. Zero means the player had no
previous entry.
descriptions.SteamScoreUpload/method/get_rank: The player's global rank after Steam evaluated the submission.
descriptions.SteamScoreUpload/method/get_score: The signed 32-bit score submitted to Steam.
descriptions.SteamScoreUploadOperation/method/cancel:
Ends local observation with @GlobalScope.ERR_SKIP. Returns
@GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST when already settled.
descriptions.SteamScoreUploadOperation/method/is_fini: Returns whether the operation has settled.
descriptions.SteamScoreUploadOperation/method/result: Returns the typed terminal result, or null while pending.
descriptions.SteamScoreUploadOperation/method/wait:
Use await to receive a SteamScoreUploadResult. A settled operation
returns the same result immediately.
descriptions.SteamScoreUploadOperation/signal/complet: Emitted once after the operation settles with its typed result.
descriptions.SteamScoreUploadResult/method/get_value: Accepted score receipt on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamScreenshotOperation/method/cancel:
Stop local observation and skip its pending annotations. Settle the
result with ERR_SKIP. Return ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST when already settled.
descriptions.SteamScreenshotOperation/method/is_finis:
Return whether the callback, local deadline, cancellation, or scope stop
settled the result.
descriptions.SteamScreenshotOperation/method/result: Return the stored outcome, or null while observation is pending.
descriptions.SteamScreenshotOperation/method/wait:
Return the completion signal while pending, or the same terminal result
on every call after settlement.
descriptions.SteamScreenshotOperation/signal/complete:
Emitted once with the terminal save observation after the handle has
been removed from the scope's pending operations.
descriptions.SteamScreenshotRequest/method/at:
Return a copy with the optional location label. Pass empty text to omit
it. Steam accepts at most 255 UTF-8 bytes without embedded NUL
characters.
descriptions.SteamScreenshotRequest/method/send:
Submit the draft once and return a retained operation. The scope
validates all input before writing, waits up to 15 seconds for the exact
save confirmation, and then applies requested metadata. A timeout does
not cancel the Steam write.
descriptions.SteamScreenshotRequest/method/submit:
Submit the draft once. Await this call for a SteamScreenshotResult,
including immediate validation or availability failures.
descriptions.SteamScreenshotRequest/method/tag:
Return a copy with an individual decimal SteamID64 tag. Submission
rejects a malformed ID or more than 32 user tag requests. Duplicate IDs
are submitted once.
descriptions.SteamScreenshotRequest/method/tag_item:
Return a copy with a nonzero decimal Workshop published-file ID.
Submission rejects a malformed ID or more than 32 item tag requests.
Duplicate IDs are submitted once.
descriptions.SteamScreenshots/method/capture:
Ask Steam to capture the current rendered frame. Return OK when the
request was issued. Observe screenshot_ready after a successful save.
Return ERR_BUSY while the overlay is unavailable for capture or another
integration has hooked screenshots.
descriptions.SteamScreenshots/method/from_image:
Snapshot a nonempty, uncompressed image as RGB8 without mipmaps. Each
side is limited to 8192 pixels and the total to 16777216 pixels. Invalid
input is reported when submitting the draft. Later edits to the original
image do not affect the draft.
descriptions.SteamScreenshots/method/is_available:
Return whether this scope has Steam's screenshot interface and
ready-event routing. Capture has the additional overlay requirement.
descriptions.SteamScreenshots/signal/screenshot_ready:
Emitted for a successful Steam save, including the normal screenshot
hotkey. Only the scope that submitted an annotated image reports its
annotation status. Use the draft's result for exact correlation.
descriptions.SteamServer/method/advertise_on:
Return a branch with the selected advertisement policy. LAN-only Steam
advertisement is unavailable in the current SDK. Only INTERNET
explicitly enables Steam discovery.
descriptions.SteamServer/method/bind_to:
Return a branch bound to a literal IPv4 interface. An asterisk uses
every local IPv4 interface.
descriptions.SteamServer/method/configure:
Configure the server name and two distinct UDP ports. The display name
allows up to 63 UTF-8 bytes. Gameplay accepts ports 1 to 65535. Query
ports 1 to 65534 are available. The default binds all IPv4 interfaces
and starts in authenticated, unlisted direct mode.
descriptions.SteamServer/method/get_game_description: Returns the title's browser game description.
descriptions.SteamServer/method/get_install_dir: Returns the title's Steam install folder name, without the parent path.
descriptions.SteamServer/method/get_product_version:
Returns the version sent to Steam's GameServer initialization and
master-server checks.
descriptions.SteamServer/method/is_valid:
Returns whether all detached settings passed validation. An invalid
branch cannot start a Steam dedicated Game.
descriptions.SteamServer/method/secure:
Return a branch retaining the default requirement for certified Steam
identities and valid Steam authentication tickets.
descriptions.SteamServer/method/via_sdr:
Return a branch selecting a hosted Steam Datagram Relay deployment with
a profile name of up to 32 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or
hyphens. An empty profile selects direct transport. A hosted profile
requires Valve-provisioned server settings and a trusted game
coordinator.
descriptions.SteamServer/method/with_login:
Return a branch reading a server login token from an operator-owned
environment key. Use up to 64 uppercase ASCII letters, digits or
underscores. An empty key uses Steam's anonymous game server logon.
descriptions.SteamServer/method/with_product_metadata:
Returns a branch with the game's configured Steam master-server version,
game description, and install folder name. Version and description are
limited to 63 UTF-8 bytes. The folder name is limited to 31 UTF-8 bytes
and must be one folder component. All values are nonempty and exclude
controls. Invalid settings prevent dedicated startup. Defaults are...
descriptions.SteamServerBrowser/method/inspect:
Refresh one selected server using its native Steam query port. The
response must match the selected AppID, namespace, server identity and
address. Timeout accepts 100 to 15000 milliseconds.
descriptions.SteamServerBrowser/method/is_available:
Return whether the owning Steam client start supports the server
browser.
descriptions.SteamServerBrowser/method/query:
Return detached options for Steam Internet or LAN discovery. Omit the
namespace to use the owning game's namespace or crimson on a standalone
client. A Game scope cannot override its namespace.
descriptions.SteamServerDetails/method/get_listing:
Current Steam observation of the selected server and address. Gameplay
still verifies the connection certificate.
descriptions.SteamServerDetails/method/get_ping_ms: Measured ping in milliseconds, or -1 for an empty snapshot.
descriptions.SteamServerDetails/method/get_tags: Bounded tags copied from Steam server metadata.
descriptions.SteamServerDetailsOperation/method/cance:
Cancel the native query before settling the observer with ERR_SKIP. A
settled query returns ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST.
descriptions.SteamServerDetailsOperation/method/is_fi: Return whether this query has a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamServerDetailsOperation/method/resul: Return the terminal result, or null while pending.
descriptions.SteamServerDetailsOperation/method/wait: Await completed or read the existing typed result.
descriptions.SteamServerDetailsOperation/signal/compl:
Emitted once after the native query has completed, failed, expired or
been cancelled.
descriptions.SteamServerDetailsResult/method/get_valu: Refreshed server details on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamServerPlayerStats/method/achievemen:
Read whether name is unlocked in the loaded cache. A locked achievement
is a successful false result. A missing definition returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST, and an unloaded cache returns ERR_UNCONFIGURED.
descriptions.SteamServerPlayerStats/method/edit:
Create a new draft to set stats or achievements in this player's cache
and submit them to Steam. Editing the draft has no immediate effect.
descriptions.SteamServerPlayerStats/method/is_availab:
Return whether the dedicated interface is available and this exact
admission remains active.
descriptions.SteamServerPlayerStats/method/is_loaded:
Return whether Steam successfully loaded the cache for this admission.
Returns false before the first successful load and after Steam evicts
the cache.
descriptions.SteamServerPlayerStats/method/load:
Load stats and achievements for this admission, without changing any
stats. An already loaded cache returns success immediately. Steam can
refuse the request for an account or app without eligible stats. If
another operation on the account is pending, this returns ERR_BUSY.
descriptions.SteamServerPlayerStats/method/stat_float:
Read the finite single-precision value of the published stat name from
the loaded cache. A missing definition or wrong type returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST. An unloaded cache returns ERR_UNCONFIGURED.
descriptions.SteamServerPlayerStats/method/stat_int:
Read the signed 32-bit value of the published stat name from the loaded
cache. A missing definition or wrong type returns ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST. An
unloaded cache returns ERR_UNCONFIGURED.
descriptions.SteamServerPlayerStats/method/store:
Store previously accepted cache changes without repeating the setters.
Use this after a partially applied batch or a drained failed store if
the game intends to persist those accepted changes. An unloaded cache
returns ERR_UNCONFIGURED. An undrained call returns ERR_BUSY. A loaded
cache without pending changes returns success without issuing a Steam
call.
descriptions.SteamServerQuery/method/fetch:
Run the search and await its typed SteamListingsResult. The deadline
accepts 100 to 15000 milliseconds. Eligible rows already copied by the
deadline are returned when available.
descriptions.SteamServerQuery/method/fetch_operation:
Run the same bounded search with an explicit cancellable operation. A
scope permits one active search.
descriptions.SteamServerQuery/method/limit: Return a branch with a 1 to 50 result cap. The default is 50.
descriptions.SteamServerQuery/method/on_map:
Return a branch matching the exact world tag. The default accepts every
compatible world.
descriptions.SteamServerQuery/method/under_latency:
Return a branch capping latency at 1 to 60000 milliseconds. The default
applies no additional latency cutoff.
descriptions.SteamServerQuery/method/with_room_for:
Return a branch requiring 1 to 64 free seats. The default requires one
seat.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsEdit/method/clear_achiev:
Stage clearing the published server-writable achievement name. Submit
only for a deliberate reset.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsEdit/method/set_float:
Stage an absolute finite value representable as a Steam single-precision
float for name.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsEdit/method/set_int:
Stage an absolute signed 32-bit value for the published integer stat
name.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsEdit/method/submit:
Submit this exact draft once and return its retained observation.
Repeated calls return the same operation, including after failure or
cancellation. A successful edit receipt confirms Steam's native
StoreUserStats response. An invalid draft settles with
ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER before issuing Steam work. Use a new draft for a
different game action.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsEdit/method/unlock: Stage an unlock for the published server-writable achievement name.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsEdit/method/update_avera:
Stage a finite accumulated count over a finite, positive elapsed
duration in seconds for the published AVGRATE stat name.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsOperation/method/cancel:
Settle a pending observer with ERR_SKIP and stop any edit still waiting
on a load. A store already issued to Steam can still persist. Returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST once the observer is settled.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsOperation/method/is_fini: Report whether the observation has a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsOperation/method/result: Return the settled result, or null while pending.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsOperation/method/wait:
Return the terminal SteamServerStatsResult or a signal to await for that
result.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsOperation/signal/complet: Emitted once the terminal result is stored on this operation.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsResult/method/get_applie:
Return the number of setters accepted into the native cache for this
action.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsResult/method/get_failed:
Return the zero-based index of a rejected edit, or -1 when no individual
edit failed.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsResult/method/get_steam_:
Return the exact observed Steam EResult, or 0 when there is no matched
native result.
descriptions.SteamServerStatsResult/method/was_store_: Return whether Steam assigned a native call handle to the store.
descriptions.SteamServerStatus/method/get_authenticat: Number of remote peers verified and admitted by the active Game Session.
descriptions.SteamServerStatus/method/get_world_id: Stable published world identifier, or empty when no world is published.
descriptions.SteamServerStatus/method/is_advertisemen:
True when this world enabled local Steam browser advertisement. Confirm
external discoverability by querying from a Steam client.
descriptions.SteamServerStatus/method/is_ready: True when the exact playerless Game is running with admission open.
descriptions.SteamServerStatus/method/is_secure:
True when the dedicated SDK is logged in, reports Steam secure mode, and
has a current transport certificate.
descriptions.SteamServices/method/current: Return Steam for the selected or sole active GameRuntime.
descriptions.SteamServices/method/for_game:
Return the exact game's Steam scope. A failed setup exposes its
diagnostic. Closed games and games without Steam return null.
descriptions.SteamServices/method/server_for:
Return the exact Steam dedicated attachment, including an unavailable
attachment with a diagnostic. Return null for a client or non-Steam
provider.
descriptions.SteamSessionTransport/method/get_host_en:
Return the typed route for the current authenticated authority when the
listener and Steam identity are available.
descriptions.SteamSessionTransport/method/get_host_re:
Return the active authority's remote seat limit, or zero without a live
listener.
descriptions.SteamSessionTransport/method/get_remote_:
Return the certified Steam identity for the exact ready physical Godot
peer, or zero when it is unavailable. Gameplay admission also validates
its Session identity.
descriptions.SteamSessionTransport/method/open_client:
Connect on the configured signed-in Steam pipe. The adapter accepts its
versioned Steam P2P, dedicated direct, or coordinator-authorized hosted
endpoint and checks the remote identity against the expected
certificate.
descriptions.SteamSessionTransport/method/open_server:
Open a listener on the configured Steam virtual port or dedicated
gameplay port. The bound peer count is 1 to 64. Listen Steam accepts the
wildcard bind. A dedicated adapter accepts its configured IPv4 address
or the wildcard selection of its configured interface.
descriptions.SteamSessionTransport/method/route:
Construct a versioned P2P endpoint for a valid individual SteamID64 and
virtual port from 0 to 65535. Return null when unavailable or invalid.
Dedicated locators are resolved by the Steam game provider instead.
descriptions.SteamSharedCloudFile/method/get_bytes: Returns the detached bytes copied from the Steam download.
descriptions.SteamSharedCloudFile/method/get_handle: Returns the requested UGC handle as a canonical unsigned decimal string.
descriptions.SteamSharedCloudFile/method/get_name: Returns the validated logical filename reported by Steam.
descriptions.SteamSharedCloudFile/method/get_owner_st:
Returns the owner SteamID64 as an unsigned decimal string, or an empty
string when Steam supplies no owner.
