descriptions.SteamSharedCloudFileOperation/method/can:
Ends local observation and completes it with ERR_SKIP. Steam finishes
the native download and closes any resulting cache entry. Returns
ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST when observation has already ended.
descriptions.SteamSharedCloudFileOperation/method/is_: Returns whether the operation has a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamSharedCloudFileOperation/method/res:
Returns the same terminal result as completed, or null while observation
is pending.
descriptions.SteamSharedCloudFileOperation/method/wai:
Use await operation.wait() to receive a SteamSharedCloudFileResult
before or after observation ends.
descriptions.SteamSharedCloudFileOperation/signal/com:
Emitted once after a pending download settles, including after
cancellation or client shutdown. result already returns this result
during the signal.
descriptions.SteamSharedCloudFileResult/method/get_va: Returns the downloaded file on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnectOperation/method/cance:
Cancels the exact pending handshake and settles it with ERR_SKIP. A
completed operation has no pending handshake to cancel.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnectOperation/method/is_fi: Returns whether the operation has reached a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnectOperation/method/resul: Returns the terminal typed result, or null while pending.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnectOperation/method/wait:
Use var result: SteamSocketConnectionResult = await operation.wait().
Returns the existing result immediately or a signal that settles with
the typed result.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnectOperation/signal/compl: Emitted once when the operation settles.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnection/method/close: Closes this exact socket, including a pending incoming handshake.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnection/method/get_steam_i: Returns the certified account of the live peer.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnection/method/is_connecte:
Returns whether the exact live connection passed Steam identity and
encryption checks.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnection/method/path:
Returns metrics from the current live socket or null without a verified
path.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnection/method/send:
Queues one message from 1 byte to 32 KiB after authentication. Both
directions allow up to 128 frames and 256 KiB per second. ERR_BUSY
reports SDK backpressure or an exhausted outbound budget.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnection/signal/closed:
Emitted after the socket has been retired. OK indicates a local close,
ERR_SKIP indicates scope retirement, and other values report a transport
or policy failure.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnection/signal/connected:
Emitted once an accepted incoming connection is encrypted and has a
certified account.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnection/signal/received:
Emitted with a copied packet from the live authenticated socket.
Reliable receive overload closes the connection. Unreliable overload can
drop packets.
descriptions.SteamSocketConnectionResult/method/get_v: Returns the issued handle when the result succeeded.
descriptions.SteamSocketEndpoint/method/direct:
Returns a numeric IPv4 or IPv6 route with a physical UDP port from 1 to
65535. Returns null for invalid input. Wildcard addresses are for
listeners.
descriptions.SteamSocketEndpoint/method/expect_peer:
Branches a direct route with a pinned certified individual or game
server identity. Returns null for an invalid account or P2P route. Apply
the returned route to SteamSockets.connect_to.
descriptions.SteamSocketEndpoint/method/get_address: Returns the specified address or an empty string for P2P.
descriptions.SteamSocketEndpoint/method/get_port: Returns the configured physical or virtual port.
descriptions.SteamSocketEndpoint/method/get_steam_id: Returns the P2P identity or optional direct identity pin.
descriptions.SteamSocketEndpoint/method/p2p:
Returns a route to a canonical decimal SteamID64 for an individual Steam
account. Use your own ID for a listener and the remote account for a
connection. The virtual port is from 0 to 65535. Returns null for
invalid input.
descriptions.SteamSocketListener/method/accept:
Accepts the exact live offer on its original listener. Successful
acceptance issues a handle that can be closed immediately. Wait for
SteamSocketConnection.connected before using its authenticated identity
or sending.
descriptions.SteamSocketListener/method/close:
Closes this listener and retires its pending offers and accepted
connections.
descriptions.SteamSocketListener/method/reject: Rejects and retires the exact pending offer.
descriptions.SteamSocketListener/signal/connection_re:
Emitted for a new pending offer. Handle it within its monotonic
deadline.
descriptions.SteamSocketListenerResult/method/get_val: Returns the issued listener when the result succeeded.
descriptions.SteamSocketOffer/method/get_expires_at_m: Returns the expiry in Godot monotonic milliseconds.
descriptions.SteamSocketOffer/method/get_steam_id: Returns the initial claimed account, if available.
descriptions.SteamSockets/method/connect_to:
Starts one authenticated outgoing handshake. Specify a timeout from 1000
to 30000 milliseconds. For direct routes requiring a specific Steam
account, pass the endpoint returned by SteamSocketEndpoint.expect_peer.
descriptions.SteamSockets/method/listen:
Listens on a direct endpoint or a P2P endpoint addressed to the current
Steam user. Set remote_limit from 1 to 64 to cap pending and accepted
connections together. A direct listener cannot have an outgoing peer
pin.
descriptions.SteamStats/method/achievement:
Returns a detached snapshot of the named achievement, or null if the
name or cache cannot be read.
descriptions.SteamStats/method/achievements:
Returns a typed array of readable achievement snapshots. Returns an
empty array if the Steam stats cache is unavailable or there are no
entries.
descriptions.SteamStats/method/clear_achievement:
Clears an unlock in the signed-in player's local cache. Use on
controlled test data or as part of a game reset. Call store to request
persistence.
descriptions.SteamStats/method/edit: Returns an empty draft. This call has no effect on the Steam cache.
descriptions.SteamStats/method/is_available:
Returns whether the active client scope exposes the Steam User Stats
interface on the main thread.
descriptions.SteamStats/method/set_stat_float:
Sets an absolute finite float in the local cache within Steam's
single-precision range. Call store to request persistence.
descriptions.SteamStats/method/set_stat_int:
Sets an absolute signed 32-bit integer in the local cache. Call store to
request persistence.
descriptions.SteamStats/method/show_progress:
Requests a Steam overlay progress popup for a locked achievement. The
current count must be positive and below the maximum, which fits an
unsigned 32-bit integer. The popup leaves the cached unlock state
unchanged.
descriptions.SteamStats/method/stat_float:
Reads a cached float or average-rate stat. Check SteamResult.ok before
using its value. The result reports an invalid name, an unavailable
interface, or a missing stat of the requested type.
descriptions.SteamStats/method/stat_int:
Reads a cached signed 32-bit stat. Check SteamResult.ok before using its
value. The result reports an invalid name, an unavailable interface, or
a missing stat of the requested type.
descriptions.SteamStats/method/store:
Requests persistence of changed stats and achievements. @GlobalScope.OK
means Steam accepted the local request. Use stats_stored to observe the
app-wide backend response.
descriptions.SteamStats/method/unlock_achievement:
Marks the named achievement unlocked in the signed-in player's local
cache. Call store to request persistence and the unlock notification.
descriptions.SteamStats/method/update_average_rate:
Updates an average-rate stat in the local cache. The accumulated count
must be finite within Steam's float range and the duration must be
finite and positive. Call store to request persistence.
descriptions.SteamStats/signal/achievement_stored:
Emitted when Steam reports an achievement unlock or a progress popup for
the active app. Both progress counts are zero for a complete unlock.
descriptions.SteamStats/signal/stats_stored:
Emitted with Steam's native result for a store or achievement progress
event. This is an app-wide event shared by matching Steam scopes.
descriptions.SteamStatsEdit/method/set_float:
Returns a branch that sets the published float stat to an absolute
value. The value must be finite and fit Steam's single-precision range.
descriptions.SteamStatsEdit/method/set_int:
Returns a branch that sets the published integer stat to an absolute
value in the signed 32-bit range.
descriptions.SteamStatsEdit/method/submit:
Validates the draft before applying any edits. If a Steam setter rejects
an edit after preflight, earlier accepted edits remain in the local
cache. Once every edit succeeds, submits one persistence request. The
result includes edit counts for every outcome. Observe
SteamStats.stats_stored for the app-wide backend response.
descriptions.SteamStatsEdit/method/unlock:
Returns a branch that unlocks the published achievement when the draft
is submitted.
descriptions.SteamStatsEdit/method/update_average_rat:
Returns a branch that adds a finite accumulated count over a finite
positive duration in seconds. Steam checks whether the named stat
accepts average-rate updates when the draft is applied.
descriptions.SteamStatsSubmission/method/get_applied: Returns how many edits Steam accepted into its local cache.
descriptions.SteamStatsSubmission/method/get_failed_a:
Returns the zero-based index of the rejected edit or -1 when there is no
individual failure.
descriptions.SteamStatsSubmissionResult/method/get_va: Returns the edit counters, including on failure.
descriptions.SteamTextureResult/method/get_value: Returns the loaded texture, or null if the operation failed.
descriptions.SteamTexturesResult/method/get_value:
Returns the read-only textures in Steam's reported origin order, empty
if the operation failed.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/add_phase_tag:
Adds a tag to the current phase owned by this facade. An empty group
leaves the tag out of group filtering. Priority ranges from 0 through
1000.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/clear_tooltip:
Clears the process timeline tooltip at the given relative time in
seconds.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/end_phase: Closes the active game phase if this facade owns it.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/end_range: Ends an open range owned by this service at a relative time in seconds.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/is_available: Returns whether the active main-thread scope can use Steam Timeline.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/mark:
Adds an instantaneous marker. A null options object selects the default
icon, priority, clip policy, and start time.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/mark_range: Marks a fixed duration greater than zero and at most 600 seconds.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/open_in_overlay:
Requests the overlay view of an event owned by this facade. Returns
ERR_BUSY if the overlay is disabled or still starting.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/open_phase_in_overl:
Requests that an enabled Steam overlay open the phase associated with
this game ID.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/phase_recording:
Await to receive a SteamTimelinePhaseResult for the exact stable phase
ID.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/recording_exists:
Await to receive a SteamBoolResult with whether Steam has video for the
completed event.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/recording_operation:
Starts the same lookup as recording_exists and returns a retained,
cancellable operation.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/remove_event:
Removes a completed event or discards an open range owned by this
service. Invalidates the handle.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/set_game_mode: Sets the activity mode for the process timeline.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/set_phase_attribute:
Replaces an attribute on the current phase owned by this facade. Group
and value are nonempty. Priority ranges from 0 through 1000.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/set_tooltip:
Sets a nonempty localized tooltip of up to 1024 UTF-8 bytes at a
relative time in seconds.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/start_phase:
Starts the process phase using a stable, nonempty game ID of up to 63
UTF-8 bytes with no ASCII control characters. An already-open phase
returns ERR_BUSY.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/start_range:
Starts an open range. End it with end_range or discard it with
remove_event.
descriptions.SteamTimeline/method/update_range:
Replaces the display details of an open range owned by this service.
Null presentation selects the default details.
descriptions.SteamTimelineEvent/method/is_open:
Returns whether the handle identifies a valid range awaiting its end
time.
descriptions.SteamTimelineEvent/method/is_valid:
Returns whether the handle still belongs to an active scope and its
event has not been removed.
descriptions.SteamTimelineOperation/method/cancel: Ends this local observation and settles it with ERR_SKIP.
descriptions.SteamTimelineOperation/method/is_finishe: Returns true once the lookup reaches a terminal result.
descriptions.SteamTimelineOperation/method/result: Returns the settled result or null while the lookup is pending.
descriptions.SteamTimelineOperation/method/wait:
Returns the settled result immediately or a signal that resolves to a
SteamBoolResult.
descriptions.SteamTimelineOperation/signal/completed: Emitted once with the settled recording lookup result.
descriptions.SteamTimelinePhaseOperation/signal/compl:
Emitted when Steam answers, the lookup expires, or the client scope
closes.
descriptions.SteamTradeSession/method/get_partner_id: Returns the verified partner's SteamID64 as a decimal string.
descriptions.SteamTradeSession/method/get_player_id: Returns the verified first player's SteamID64 as a decimal string.
descriptions.SteamTradeSession/method/is_acknowledged: Returns whether Steam acknowledged the request to start a trade.
descriptions.SteamTradeSessionResult/method/get_value: Returns the acknowledged trade request, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamUtils/method/hardware_default_confi:
Returns Steam's suggested starting preset for this game and device. Use
it when choosing initial settings and let players retain their own
settings. Returns CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE when Steam cannot supply the query.
descriptions.SteamUtils/method/hardware_type:
Returns the Steam-reported hardware type. Returns HARDWARE_UNAVAILABLE
when Steam cannot supply the query.
descriptions.SteamUtils/method/is_available:
Returns whether the active client exposes the Steam Utils interface on
the main thread.
descriptions.SteamUtils/method/is_overlay_ready:
Returns whether the Steam overlay is available to this process now.
Check again before requesting an overlay action after startup.
descriptions.SteamUtils/method/is_running_in_vr:
Returns whether Steam reports that the Steam client is running in VR
mode. Returns false when the query is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamUtils/method/is_running_under_proto:
Returns whether Steam reports that the game process is running under
Proton. Returns false when the query is unavailable.
descriptions.SteamUtils/method/ui_language:
Returns the Steam client's interface language code, or an empty string
when unavailable. For the selected game language, use
SteamApps.current_language.
descriptions.SteamVideo/method/broadcast_status:
Reads whether Steam is uploading a broadcast and how many viewers are
watching.
descriptions.SteamVideo/method/projection_settings:
Await a SteamStringResult with the 360-degree projection settings for
the specified video AppID. Concurrent lookups of the same AppID share a
single Steam request.
descriptions.SteamVideo/method/stream_url:
Await a SteamStringResult with the Steam-issued stream URL for an
entitled video AppID. Treat this URL as temporary and keep it out of
logs.
descriptions.SteamVideo/signal/broadcast_started: Emitted when Steam reports a local broadcast upload started.
descriptions.SteamVideo/signal/broadcast_stopped:
Emitted with the SDK broadcast upload result code when the local upload
stops.
descriptions.SteamVideoOperation/signal/completed: Emitted with the stream URL or projection settings result.
descriptions.SteamVoice/method/capture:
Returns the scope's microphone controls without starting capture. A new
unattached service has no capture handle. A retained handle returns
ERR_UNAVAILABLE after its scope stops.
descriptions.SteamVoice/method/decode:
Decodes one complete Steam voice frame of 1 to 8192 bytes. Zero chooses
Steam's recommended rate, or pass a rate from 11025 to 48000 Hz. The
result contains up to 131072 bytes of signed 16-bit mono PCM.
Unavailable codecs and invalid input return a typed error.
descriptions.SteamVoiceCapture/method/read_frame:
Polls one opaque compressed frame of up to 8192 bytes. Call once per
process frame during capture. An empty poll, exhausted tail, or detached
owner returns ERR_UNAVAILABLE.
descriptions.SteamVoiceCapture/method/start:
Requests capture for this scope. Call after the player opts in and
explicitly starts push-to-talk. Another owner or native tail cleanup
returns ERR_BUSY. Repeating an active start from the same owner is
harmless.
descriptions.SteamVoiceCapture/method/stop:
Requests native stop. The exact owner may read final frames for up to
300 milliseconds. Scope teardown discards those frames immediately. A
detached or inactive owner returns ERR_UNAVAILABLE.
descriptions.SteamWebTicket/method/bytes:
Returns the opaque bytes while the issuing scope and ticket are active.
Transfer them only to the trusted verifier. Keep them out of save data,
replays, and logs.
descriptions.SteamWebTicket/method/close:
Cancels this ticket and clears its stored bytes. Call on the main thread
after the backend no longer needs the ticket. Repeated calls are safe.
descriptions.SteamWorkshop/method/item:
Creates a reference to one item. Pass the canonical unsigned decimal
published file ID. SteamWorkshopItemRef.fetch validates the ID before
using Steam.
descriptions.SteamWorkshop/method/legal_agreement_sta:
Use await workshop.legal_agreement_status() for a
SteamWorkshopLegalAgreementStatusResult for the exact active app. Check
SteamWorkshopLegalAgreementStatus.needs_action and offer
show_legal_agreement as an explicit player action when needed.
descriptions.SteamWorkshop/method/new_item:
Creates a branchable draft for a new item. The draft remains local until
SteamWorkshopPublishRequest.submit. New items default to private
visibility.
descriptions.SteamWorkshop/method/query:
Creates a fresh query starting at the first page. Use the query methods
to branch filters before calling SteamWorkshopQuery.fetch.
descriptions.SteamWorkshop/method/show_legal_agreemen:
Asks Steam to open the active app's Workshop legal agreement in its
overlay. Call this in response to a player or author action. OK
acknowledges the request. Query legal_agreement_status after the user
closes the overlay to read the current decision.
descriptions.SteamWorkshop/method/subscriptions:
Copies up to limit Workshop subscriptions for the signed-in user and
current app in Steam's subscription order. Set include_locally_disabled
to include subscriptions disabled in the Steam client. The limit ranges
from 1 to MAX_SUBSCRIPTIONS. Use a returned decimal ID with item to
inspect or install that item.
descriptions.SteamWorkshop/signal/install_changed:
Emitted for Steam's matching same-app installation or update event.
published_id identifies the item. Passive events provide a null install.
Call SteamWorkshopItemRef.installed to inspect its current directory
when needed.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopInstall/method/get_director: Return the absolute directory Steam reports for this item.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopInstall/method/get_publishe: Return the canonical unsigned decimal published file ID.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopInstall/method/get_size_byt: Return the installed content size in bytes.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopInstallResult/method/get_va: Returns the detached snapshot on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopItem/method/get_author_stea:
The Workshop author's unsigned decimal SteamID64. An empty string
indicates that Steam supplied no author.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopItem/method/get_description: The description copied from Steam while the query was live.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopItem/method/get_published_i: The exact published file ID as a canonical unsigned decimal string.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopItem/method/get_title: The Workshop title reported by Steam.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopItemRef/method/edit:
Creates a branchable draft that edits this existing item. Unset fields
keep their current values. Submission verifies that the item belongs to
the active app.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopItemRef/method/fetch:
Use await item.fetch() to receive a SteamWorkshopItemResult for this
exact item in the active app. An unavailable or removed item can report
ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopItemRef/method/install:
Use await item.install() to receive a SteamWorkshopInstallResult. A
same-app item with a current local directory resolves immediately after
identity verification. Otherwise this waits for Steam's matching
download. high_priority tells Steam to prioritize the transfer ahead of
other downloads. An unsubscribed item may be cached temporarily. Inspect
and...
descriptions.SteamWorkshopItemRef/method/installed:
Returns a current local content directory after this client verifies the
item through a Workshop query or a matching install event. An unknown,
pending, legacy, or out-of-date install returns null. Steam can record
this inspection in the signed-in player's used items.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopItemRef/method/subscribe:
Use await item.subscribe() to receive the
SteamWorkshopSubscriptionResult for an explicit subscription to this
app's item. The result confirms the subscription. Use install to wait
for a current local directory.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopItemRef/method/unsubscribe:
Use await item.unsubscribe() to receive the
SteamWorkshopSubscriptionResult for removing the subscription. Steam may
remove the installed files after the game closes.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopItemRef/method/vote:
Use await item.vote(up) to receive the SteamWorkshopVoteResult after
Steam acknowledges this app item's upvote or downvote for the signed-in
account.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopItemResult/method/get_value: Returns Workshop item metadata on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopLegalAgreementStatus/method: Returns the signed agreement's Unix timestamp when available.
Returns the AppID Steam confirmed for this status.
Reports whether the user needs to accept the latest agreement.
Returns the version of the signed agreement when applicable.
Reports whether Steam says the user accepted the reported version.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopLegalAgreementStatusResult/: Returns the detached snapshot on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopPage/method/get_items:
Read-only, detached item snapshots in Steam's result order. A page
contains up to 50 items.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopPage/method/get_next_cursor: The opaque cursor for the next page. An empty cursor marks the end.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopPageResult/method/get_value: Returns Workshop page data on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopPublication/method/get_need:
Return whether Steam requires the author to accept its Workshop
agreement.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopPublication/method/get_publ: Return the canonical unsigned decimal published file ID.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopPublicationResult/method/ge:
Returns the publication identity when Steam reports one. Inspect
SteamResult.ok for completion and retain the ID for a retry through
SteamWorkshopItemRef.edit.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopPublishRequest/method/descr:
Returns a branch with a replacement item description. An empty
description clears this field. Supports up to 7,999 UTF-8 bytes.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopPublishRequest/method/named: Returns a branch with a replacement title of 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopPublishRequest/method/submi:
Use await request.submit() to receive a SteamWorkshopPublicationResult.
Steam uploads the chosen content and preview. Keep those paths available
while Steam may still complete a submitted update. change_notes supports
up to 7,999 UTF-8 bytes. If Steam has already created an item, an
interrupted upload can return its published ID even when
SteamResult.ok...
descriptions.SteamWorkshopPublishRequest/method/tagge:
Returns a branch that includes this tag in the replacement set. Supply
up to 16 distinct tags using printable characters other than commas. A
tag supports up to 255 UTF-8 bytes, and Steam also bounds the combined
set. Leaving tags unset on an edit preserves the existing set.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopPublishRequest/method/visib:
Returns a branch with the selected Steam Workshop audience. Leaving
visibility unset keeps a new item private and preserves an existing
item's audience.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopPublishRequest/method/with_:
Returns a branch that uploads the selected content directory. Use an
existing absolute local directory or a Godot path that resolves to one.
Steam uploads the directory's contents.

Returns a branch with a replacement local preview image. The file must
contain at least 16 bytes and be smaller than 1 MiB. Steam uses the
active app's Cloud settings to store the preview.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopQuery/method/after:
Returns a branch using the exact SteamWorkshopPage.next_cursor from the
same filters and sort. An empty cursor starts from the first page.
cursor supports up to 255 UTF-8 bytes.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopQuery/method/fetch:
Use await query.fetch() to receive a SteamWorkshopPageResult. Requests
up to 50 items for the active app. A stopped client settles pending
observation with ERR_SKIP.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopQuery/method/search:
Returns a branch that matches text in item titles or descriptions and
starts at the first page. An empty string clears the text filter. text
supports up to 255 UTF-8 bytes.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopQuery/method/sort_by:
Returns a branch with explicit sorting and starts at the first page.
Browsing defaults to RATING, and a text search defaults to RELEVANCE.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopQuery/method/tagged:
Returns a branch requiring the additional tag and starts at the first
page. A branch supports up to 16 tags, each between 1 and 255 UTF-8
bytes.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopSubscription/method/get_pub: Return the canonical unsigned decimal published file ID.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopSubscriptionResult/method/g: Returns the detached snapshot on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopSubscriptions/method/get_pu: Returns decimal published file IDs in Steam's subscription order.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopSubscriptions/method/get_to:
Returns the maximum subscription count observed while copying the
snapshot.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopSubscriptions/method/is_tru: Reports whether more subscriptions were observed than could be copied.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopSubscriptionsResult/method/: Returns the detached snapshot on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopVote/method/get_published_i: Return the canonical unsigned decimal published file ID.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopVote/method/is_up: Return whether Steam confirmed an upvote.
descriptions.SteamWorkshopVoteResult/method/get_value: Returns the detached snapshot on success, or null on failure.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/achievements:
Returns the single-achievement action facade for this attachment. Its
unlock action submits storage and carries the original startup error
when no stats service was attached.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/apps:
Returns the app and DLC information for this exact attachment, or null
when unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/auth:
Returns the authentication and ownership ticket service for this exact
attachment, or null when unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/boot:
Attaches the internal Steam client beneath a live scene-tree owner on
the main thread. With null settings, accepts the launch AppID. The
returned facade retains the attachment outcome, including a missing
runtime, invalid settings, or unsupported build.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/boot_result:
Returns the original startup result. Use is_ready when a view needs to
observe current availability.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/browser:
Returns the Steam browser service for this exact attachment, or null
when unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/cloud:
Returns the cloud file service for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/device:
Returns the device service for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/diagnostics:
Returns the diagnostic controls for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/friends:
Returns the friends and social data for this exact attachment, or null
when unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/get_app_id:
Returns the AppID verified by Steam for this attachment, or zero if
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/get_local_steam_id:
Returns the signed-in SteamID64 as a decimal string, or an empty string
if unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/http:
Returns the HTTP client for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/input:
Returns the Steam Input service for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/inventory:
Returns the Steam Inventory service for this exact attachment, or null
when unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/is_online:
Returns whether the exact attached client currently has a live
connection to Steam. Offline Mode can still expose cached features when
is_ready is true.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/is_ready:
Returns whether this attachment still owns a live Steam client
generation.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/leaderboards:
Returns the leaderboard service for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/lobbies:
Returns the lobby service for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/messages:
Returns the Steam Messages service for this exact attachment, or null
when unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/music:
Returns the music service for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/networking:
Returns the route diagnostics for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/open_achievements:
Requests the Achievements pane using the attached Steam overlay. Success
means the request was submitted. A busy result means the overlay is
still loading, disabled, or inaccessible from this thread. A failed
startup or detached scope returns its diagnostic. Observe the overlay to
confirm display.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/overlay:
Returns the overlay controls and activation signals for this exact
attachment, or null when unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/parties:
Returns the Steam Parties service for this exact attachment, or null
when unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/presence:
Returns the rich presence service for this exact attachment, or null
when unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/purchases:
Returns the purchase service for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/remote_play:
Returns the Remote Play service for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/restart_through_steam_:
Opt into Valve's relaunch check before starting any Steam runtime.
Supply a shipping AppID. @GlobalScope.ERR_SKIP means the process should
quit while Steam starts the installed copy. The shared Spacewar AppID is
rejected.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/screenshots:
Returns the screenshot service for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/server_browser:
Returns the dedicated server browser for this exact attachment, or null
when unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/sockets:
Returns the standalone Steam Sockets service for this exact attachment,
or null when unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/stats:
Returns the stats and achievement editing for this exact attachment, or
null when unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/timeline:
Returns the timeline event service for this exact attachment, or null
when unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/utils:
Returns the Steam utilities for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/video:
Returns the video service for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/voice:
Returns the voice service for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/method/workshop:
Returns the Workshop service for this exact attachment, or null when
unavailable.
descriptions.Steamworks/signal/runtime_lost:
Emitted after an IPC failure retires the exact native client generation
and invalidates its retained services. To recover a standalone scope,
defer a fresh boot until the callback returns.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_16: Gets a signed 16-bit value from the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_32: Gets a signed 32-bit value from the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_64: Gets a signed 64-bit value from the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_8: Gets a signed byte from the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_available_bytes: Returns the number of bytes this StreamPeer has available.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_data:
Returns a chunk data with the received bytes, as an Array containing two
elements: an Error constant and a PackedByteArray. bytes is the number
of bytes to be received. If not enough bytes are available, the function
will block until the desired amount is received.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_double: Gets a double-precision float from the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_float: Gets a single-precision float from the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_half: Gets a half-precision float from the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_partial_data:
Returns a chunk data with the received bytes, as an Array containing two
elements: an Error constant and a PackedByteArray. bytes is the number
of bytes to be received. If not enough bytes are available, the function
will return how many were actually received.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_string:
Gets an ASCII string with byte-length bytes from the stream. If bytes is
negative (default) the length will be read from the stream using the
reverse process of put_string.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_u16: Gets an unsigned 16-bit value from the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_u32: Gets an unsigned 32-bit value from the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_u64: Gets an unsigned 64-bit value from the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_u8: Gets an unsigned byte from the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_utf8_string:
Gets a UTF-8 string with byte-length bytes from the stream (this decodes
the string sent as UTF-8). If bytes is negative (default) the length
will be read from the stream using the reverse process of
put_utf8_string.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/get_var:
Gets a Variant from the stream. If allow_objects is true, decoding
objects is allowed. Internally, this uses the same decoding mechanism as
the @GlobalScope.bytes_to_var method. Warning: Deserialized objects can
contain code which gets executed. Do not use this option if the
serialized object comes from untrusted sources to avoid potential
security...
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_16: Puts a signed 16-bit value into the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_32: Puts a signed 32-bit value into the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_64: Puts a signed 64-bit value into the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_8: Puts a signed byte into the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_data:
Sends a chunk of data through the connection, blocking if necessary
until the data is done sending. This function returns an Error code.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_double: Puts a double-precision float into the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_float: Puts a single-precision float into the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_half: Puts a half-precision float into the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_partial_data:
Sends a chunk of data through the connection. If all the data could not
be sent at once, only part of it will. This function returns two values,
an Error code and an integer, describing how much data was actually
sent.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_string:
Puts a zero-terminated ASCII string into the stream prepended by a
32-bit unsigned integer representing its size. Note: To put an ASCII
string without prepending its size, you can use put_data:
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_u16: Puts an unsigned 16-bit value into the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_u32: Puts an unsigned 32-bit value into the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_u64: Puts an unsigned 64-bit value into the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_u8: Puts an unsigned byte into the stream.
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_utf8_string:
Puts a zero-terminated UTF-8 string into the stream prepended by a 32
bits unsigned integer representing its size. Note: To put a UTF-8 string
without prepending its size, you can use put_data:
descriptions.StreamPeer/method/put_var:
Puts a Variant into the stream. If full_objects is true encoding objects
is allowed (and can potentially include code). Internally, this uses the
same encoding mechanism as the @GlobalScope.var_to_bytes method.
descriptions.StreamPeerBuffer/method/clear: Clears the data_array and resets the cursor.
descriptions.StreamPeerBuffer/method/duplicate: Returns a new StreamPeerBuffer with the same data_array content.
descriptions.StreamPeerBuffer/method/resize: Resizes the data_array. This doesn't update the cursor.
descriptions.StreamPeerBuffer/method/seek:
Moves the cursor to the specified position. position must be a valid
index of data_array.
descriptions.StreamPeerGZIP/method/clear: Clears this stream, resetting the internal state.
descriptions.StreamPeerGZIP/method/finish:
Finalizes the stream, compressing any buffered chunk left. You must call
it only when you are compressing.
descriptions.StreamPeerGZIP/method/start_compression:
Start the stream in compression mode with the given buffer_size, if
use_deflate is true uses deflate instead of GZIP.
descriptions.StreamPeerGZIP/method/start_decompressio:
Start the stream in decompression mode with the given buffer_size, if
use_deflate is true uses deflate instead of GZIP.
descriptions.StreamPeerSocket/method/get_status: Returns the status of the connection.
descriptions.StreamPeerSocket/method/poll: Polls the socket, updating its state. See get_status.
descriptions.StreamPeerTCP/method/bind:
Opens the TCP socket, and binds it to the specified local address. This
method is generally not needed, and only used to force the subsequent
call to connect_to_host to use the specified host and port as source
address. This can be desired in some NAT punchthrough techniques, or
when forcing the source network interface.
descriptions.StreamPeerTCP/method/connect_to_host:
Connects to the specified host:port pair. A hostname will be resolved if
valid. Returns OK on success.
descriptions.StreamPeerTCP/method/get_connected_host: Returns the IP of this peer.
descriptions.StreamPeerTCP/method/get_connected_port: Returns the port of this peer.
descriptions.StreamPeerTCP/method/get_local_port: Returns the local port to which this peer is bound.
descriptions.StreamPeerTCP/method/set_no_delay:
If enabled is true, packets will be sent immediately. If enabled is
false (the default), packet transfers will be delayed and combined using
Nagle's algorithm. Note: It's recommended to leave this disabled for
applications that send large packets or need to transfer a lot of data,
as enabling this can decrease the total available bandwidth.
descriptions.StreamPeerTLS/method/accept_stream:
Accepts a peer connection as a server using the given server_options.
See TLSOptions.server.
descriptions.StreamPeerTLS/method/connect_to_stream:
Connects to a peer using an underlying StreamPeer stream and verifying
the remote certificate is correctly signed for the given common_name.
You can pass the optional client_options parameter to customize the
trusted certification authorities, or disable the common name
verification. See TLSOptions.client and TLSOptions.client_unsafe.
descriptions.StreamPeerTLS/method/get_status: Returns the status of the connection.
descriptions.StreamPeerTLS/method/get_stream:
Returns the underlying StreamPeer connection, used in accept_stream or
connect_to_stream.
descriptions.StreamPeerTLS/method/poll:
Poll the connection to check for incoming bytes. Call this right before
StreamPeer.get_available_bytes for it to work properly.
descriptions.StreamPeerUDS/method/bind:
Opens the UDS socket, and binds it to the specified socket path. This
method is generally not needed, and only used to force the subsequent
call to connect_to_host to use the specified path as the source address.
descriptions.StreamPeerUDS/method/connect_to_host:
Connects to the specified UNIX Domain Socket path. Returns OK on
success.
descriptions.StreamPeerUDS/method/get_connected_path: Returns the socket path of this peer.
descriptions.String/method/begins_with:
Returns true if the string begins with the given text. See also
ends_with.
descriptions.String/method/bigrams:
Returns an array containing the bigrams (pairs of consecutive
characters) of this string.
descriptions.String/method/bin_to_int:
Converts the string representing a binary number into an int. The string
may optionally be prefixed with "0b", and an additional - prefix for
negative numbers.
descriptions.String/method/c_escape:
Returns a copy of the string with special characters escaped using the C
language standard.
descriptions.String/method/c_unescape:
Returns a copy of the string with escaped characters replaced by their
meanings. Supported escape sequences are \', \", \\, \a, \b, \f, \n, \r,
\t, \v. Note: Unlike the GDScript parser, this method doesn't support
the \uXXXX escape sequence.
descriptions.String/method/capitalize:
Returns a copy of the string with changed appearance. Replaces
underscores (_) and hyphens (-) with spaces, adds spaces before
uppercase letters in the middle of a word, converts all letters to
lowercase, then converts the first one and each one following a space to
uppercase.
descriptions.String/method/casecmp_to:
Performs a case-sensitive comparison to another string. Returns -1 if
less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than" and "greater
than" are determined by the Unicode code points of each string, which
roughly matches the alphabetical order. If the character comparison
reaches the end of one string, but the other string contains more
characters,...
descriptions.String/method/chr:
Returns a single Unicode character from the integer code. You may use
unicodelookup.com or unicode.org as points of reference.
descriptions.String/method/contains:
Returns true if the string contains what. In GDScript, this corresponds
to the in operator.
descriptions.String/method/containsn:
Returns true if the string contains what, ignoring case. If you need to
know where what is within the string, use findn. See also contains.
descriptions.String/method/count:
Returns the number of occurrences of the substring what between from and
to positions. If to is 0, the search continues until the end of the
string.
descriptions.String/method/countn:
Returns the number of occurrences of the substring what between from and
to positions, ignoring case. If to is 0, the search continues until the
end of the string.
descriptions.String/method/dedent:
Returns a copy of the string with indentation (leading tabs and spaces)
removed. See also indent to add indentation.
descriptions.String/method/ends_with:
Returns true if the string ends with the given text. See also
begins_with.
descriptions.String/method/erase:
Returns a string with chars characters erased starting from position. If
chars goes beyond the string's length given the specified position,
fewer characters will be erased from the returned string. Returns an
empty string if either position or chars is negative. Returns the
original string unmodified if chars is 0.
descriptions.String/method/filecasecmp_to:
Like naturalcasecmp_to but prioritizes strings that begin with periods
(.) and underscores (_) before any other character. Useful when sorting
folders or file names. To get a bool result from a string comparison,
use the == operator instead. See also filenocasecmp_to,
naturalcasecmp_to, and casecmp_to.
descriptions.String/method/filenocasecmp_to:
Like naturalnocasecmp_to but prioritizes strings that begin with periods
(.) and underscores (_) before any other character. Useful when sorting
folders or file names. To get a bool result from a string comparison,
use the == operator instead. See also filecasecmp_to,
naturalnocasecmp_to, and nocasecmp_to.
descriptions.String/method/findn:
Returns the index of the first case-insensitive occurrence of what in
this string, or -1 if there are none. The starting search index can be
specified with from, continuing to the end of the string.
descriptions.String/method/format:
Formats the string by replacing all occurrences of placeholder with the
elements of values. values can be a Dictionary, an Array, or an Object.
Any underscores in placeholder will be replaced with the corresponding
keys in advance. Array elements use their index as keys.
descriptions.String/method/get_base_dir: If the string is a valid file path, returns the base directory name.
descriptions.String/method/get_basename:
If the string is a valid file path, returns the full file path, without
the extension.
descriptions.String/method/get_extension:
If the string is a valid file name or path, returns the file extension
without the leading period (.). Otherwise, returns an empty string.
descriptions.String/method/get_file:
If the string is a valid file path, returns the file name, including the
extension.
descriptions.String/method/get_slice:
Splits the string using a delimiter and returns the substring at index
slice. Returns the original string if delimiter does not occur in the
string. Returns an empty string if the slice does not exist. This is
faster than split, if you only need one or two substrings.
descriptions.String/method/get_slice_count:
Returns the total number of slices when the string is split with the
given delimiter (see split). Use get_slice to extract a specific slice.
descriptions.String/method/get_slicec:
Splits the string using a Unicode character with code delimiter and
returns the substring at index slice. Returns an empty string if the
slice does not exist. This is faster than split, if you only need one or
two substrings. This is a Unicode version of get_slice.
descriptions.String/method/hash:
Returns the 32-bit hash value representing the string's contents. Note:
Strings with equal hash values are not guaranteed to be the same, as a
result of hash collisions. On the contrary, strings with different hash
values are guaranteed to be different.
descriptions.String/method/hex_decode: Decodes a hexadecimal string as a PackedByteArray.
descriptions.String/method/hex_to_int:
Converts the string representing a hexadecimal number into an int. The
string may be optionally prefixed with "0x", and an additional - prefix
for negative numbers.
descriptions.String/method/humanize_size:
Converts size which represents a number of bytes into a human-readable
form. The result is in IEC prefix format, which may end in either "B",
"KiB", "MiB", "GiB", "TiB", "PiB", or "EiB".
descriptions.String/method/indent:
Indents every line of the string with the given prefix. Empty lines are
not indented. See also dedent to remove indentation. For example, the
string can be indented with two tabulations using "\t\t", or four spaces
using " ".
descriptions.String/method/insert: Inserts what at the given position in the string.
descriptions.String/method/is_absolute_path:
Returns true if the string is a path to a file or directory, and its
starting point is explicitly defined. This method is the opposite of
is_relative_path. This includes all paths starting with "res://",
"user://", "C:\", "/", etc.
descriptions.String/method/is_empty: Returns true if the string's length is 0 (""). See also length.
descriptions.String/method/is_relative_path:
Returns true if the string is a path, and its starting point is
dependent on context. The path could begin from the current directory,
or the current Node (if the string is derived from a NodePath), and may
sometimes be prefixed with "./". This method is the opposite of
is_absolute_path.
descriptions.String/method/is_subsequence_of:
Returns true if all characters of this string can be found in text in
their original order. This is not the same as contains.
descriptions.String/method/is_subsequence_ofn:
Returns true if all characters of this string can be found in text in
their original order, ignoring case. This is not the same as containsn.
descriptions.String/method/is_valid_ascii_identifier:
Returns true if this string is a valid ASCII identifier. A valid ASCII
identifier may contain only letters, digits, and underscores (_), and
the first character may not be a digit.
descriptions.String/method/is_valid_filename:
Returns true if this string is a valid file name. A valid file name
cannot be empty, begin or end with space characters, or contain
characters that are not allowed (: / \ ? * " | % < >).
descriptions.String/method/is_valid_float:
Returns true if this string represents a valid floating-point number. A
valid float may contain only digits, one decimal point (.), and the
exponent letter (e). It may also be prefixed with a positive (+) or
negative (-) sign. Any valid integer is also a valid float (see
is_valid_int). See also to_float.
descriptions.String/method/is_valid_hex_number:
Returns true if this string is a valid hexadecimal number. A valid
hexadecimal number only contains digits or letters A to F (either
uppercase or lowercase), and may be prefixed with a positive (+) or
negative (-) sign. If with_prefix is true, the hexadecimal number needs
to prefixed by "0x" to be considered valid.
descriptions.String/method/is_valid_html_color:
Returns true if this string is a valid color in hexadecimal HTML
notation. The string must be a hexadecimal value (see
is_valid_hex_number) of either 3, 4, 6 or 8 digits, and may be prefixed
by a hash sign (#). Other HTML notations for colors, such as names or
hsl(), are not considered valid. See also Color.html.
descriptions.String/method/is_valid_identifier:
Returns true if this string is a valid identifier. A valid identifier
may contain only letters, digits and underscores (_), and the first
character may not be a digit.
descriptions.String/method/is_valid_int:
Returns true if this string represents a valid integer. A valid integer
only contains digits, and may be prefixed with a positive (+) or
negative (-) sign. See also to_int.
descriptions.String/method/is_valid_ip_address:
Returns true if this string represents a well-formatted IPv4 or IPv6
address. This method considers reserved IP addresses such as "0.0.0.0"
and "ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff" as valid.
descriptions.String/method/is_valid_unicode_identifie:
Returns true if this string is a valid Unicode identifier. A valid
Unicode identifier must begin with a Unicode character of class
XID_Start or "_", and may contain Unicode characters of class
XID_Continue in the other positions.
descriptions.String/method/join:
Returns the concatenation of parts' elements, with each element
separated by the string calling this method. This method is the opposite
of split.
descriptions.String/method/json_escape:
Returns a copy of the string with special characters escaped using the
JSON standard. Because it closely matches the C standard, it is possible
to use c_unescape to unescape the string, if necessary.
descriptions.String/method/left:
Returns the first length characters from the beginning of the string. If
length is negative, strips the last length characters from the string's
end.
descriptions.String/method/length:
Returns the number of characters in the string. Empty strings ("")
always return 0. See also is_empty.
descriptions.String/method/lpad:
Formats the string to be at least min_length long by adding characters
to the left of the string, if necessary. See also rpad.
descriptions.String/method/lstrip:
Removes a set of characters defined in chars from the string's
beginning. See also rstrip. Note: chars is not a prefix. Use trim_prefix
to remove a single prefix, rather than a set of characters.
descriptions.String/method/match:
Does a simple expression match (also called "glob" or "globbing"), where
* matches zero or more arbitrary characters and ? matches any single
character except a period (.). An empty string or empty expression
always evaluates to false.
descriptions.String/method/matchn:
Does a simple case-insensitive expression match, where * matches zero or
more arbitrary characters and ? matches any single character except a
period (.). An empty string or empty expression always evaluates to
false.
descriptions.String/method/md5_buffer: Returns the MD5 hash of the string as a PackedByteArray.
descriptions.String/method/md5_text: Returns the MD5 hash of the string as another String.
descriptions.String/method/naturalcasecmp_to:
Performs a case-sensitive, natural order comparison to another string.
Returns -1 if less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than"
or "greater than" are determined by the Unicode code points of each
string, which roughly matches the alphabetical order. When used for
sorting, natural order comparison orders sequences of numbers by the
combined...
descriptions.String/method/naturalnocasecmp_to:
Performs a case-insensitive, natural order comparison to another string.
Returns -1 if less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than"
or "greater than" are determined by the Unicode code points of each
string, which roughly matches the alphabetical order. Internally,
lowercase characters are converted to uppercase for the comparison. When
used...
descriptions.String/method/nocasecmp_to:
Performs a case-insensitive comparison to another string. Returns -1 if
less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than" or "greater
than" are determined by the Unicode code points of each string, which
roughly matches the alphabetical order. Internally, lowercase characters
are converted to uppercase for the comparison. If the character...
descriptions.String/method/num:
Converts a float to a string representation of a decimal number, with
the number of decimal places specified in decimals. If decimals is -1 as
by default, the string representation may only have up to 14 significant
digits, with digits before the decimal point having priority over digits
after. Trailing zeros are not included in the string. The last...
descriptions.String/method/num_int64:
Converts the given number to a string representation, with the given
base. By default, base is set to decimal (10). Other common bases in
programming include binary (2), octal (8), hexadecimal (16). If
capitalize_hex is true, digits higher than 9 are represented in
uppercase.
descriptions.String/method/num_scientific:
Converts the given number to a string representation, in scientific
notation.
descriptions.String/method/num_uint64:
Converts the given unsigned int to a string representation, with the
given base. By default, base is set to decimal (10). Other common bases
in programming include binary (2), octal (8), hexadecimal (16). If
capitalize_hex is true, digits higher than 9 are represented in
uppercase.
descriptions.String/method/pad_decimals:
Formats the string representing a number to have an exact number of
digits after the decimal point.
descriptions.String/method/pad_zeros:
Formats the string representing a number to have an exact number of
digits before the decimal point.
descriptions.String/method/path_join:
Concatenates path at the end of the string as a subpath, adding / if
necessary. Example: "this/is".path_join("path") == "this/is/path".
descriptions.String/method/remove_char:
Removes all occurrences of the Unicode character with code what. Faster
version of replace when the key is only one character long and the
replacement is "".
descriptions.String/method/remove_chars:
Removes all occurrences of the characters in chars. See also
remove_char.
descriptions.String/method/repeat:
Repeats this string a number of times. count needs to be greater than 0.
Otherwise, returns an empty string.
descriptions.String/method/replace:
Replaces all occurrences of what inside the string with the given
forwhat.
descriptions.String/method/replace_char:
Replaces all occurrences of the Unicode character with code key with the
Unicode character with code with. Faster version of replace when the key
is only one character long. To get a single character use
"X".unicode_at(0) (note that some strings, like compound letters and
emoji, can be composed of multiple unicode codepoints, and will not work
with this...
descriptions.String/method/replace_chars:
Replaces any occurrence of the characters in keys with the Unicode
character with code with. See also replace_char.
descriptions.String/method/replacen:
Replaces all case-insensitive occurrences of what inside the string with
the given forwhat.
descriptions.String/method/reverse:
Returns the copy of this string in reverse order. This operation works
on unicode codepoints, rather than sequences of codepoints, and may
break things like compound letters or emojis.
descriptions.String/method/rfind:
Returns the index of the last occurrence of what in this string, or -1
if there are none. The search's start can be specified with from,
continuing to the beginning of the string. This method is the reverse of
find. Note: A negative value of from is converted to a starting index by
counting back from the last possible index with enough space to find...
descriptions.String/method/rfindn:
Returns the index of the last case-insensitive occurrence of what in
this string, or -1 if there are none. The starting search index can be
specified with from, continuing to the beginning of the string. This
method is the reverse of findn.
descriptions.String/method/right:
Returns the last length characters from the end of the string. If length
is negative, strips the first length characters from the string's
beginning.
descriptions.String/method/rpad:
Formats the string to be at least min_length long, by adding characters
to the right of the string, if necessary. See also lpad.
descriptions.String/method/rsplit:
Splits the string using a delimiter and returns an array of the
substrings, starting from the end of the string. The splits in the
returned array appear in the same order as the original string. If
delimiter is an empty string, each substring will be a single character.
If allow_empty is false, empty strings between adjacent delimiters are
excluded from...
descriptions.String/method/rstrip:
Removes a set of characters defined in chars from the string's end. See
also lstrip. Note: chars is not a suffix. Use trim_suffix to remove a
single suffix, rather than a set of characters.
descriptions.String/method/sha1_buffer: Returns the SHA-1 hash of the string as a PackedByteArray.
descriptions.String/method/sha1_text: Returns the SHA-1 hash of the string as another String.
descriptions.String/method/sha256_buffer: Returns the SHA-256 hash of the string as a PackedByteArray.
descriptions.String/method/sha256_text: Returns the SHA-256 hash of the string as another String.
descriptions.String/method/similarity:
Returns the similarity index (Sørensen-Dice coefficient) of this string
compared to another. A result of 1.0 means totally similar, while 0.0
means totally dissimilar.
descriptions.String/method/simplify_path:
If the string is a valid file path, converts the string into a canonical
path. This is the shortest possible path, without "./", and all the
unnecessary ".." and "/".
descriptions.String/method/split:
Splits the string using a delimiter and returns an array of the
substrings. If delimiter is an empty string, each substring will be a
single character. This method is the opposite of join. If allow_empty is
false, empty strings between adjacent delimiters are excluded from the
array. If maxsplit is greater than 0, the number of splits may not
exceed...
descriptions.String/method/split_floats:
Splits the string into floats by using a delimiter and returns a
PackedFloat64Array. If allow_empty is false, empty or invalid float
conversions between adjacent delimiters are excluded.
descriptions.String/method/strip_edges:
Strips all non-printable characters from the beginning and the end of
the string. These include spaces, tabulations (\t), and newlines (\n
\r). If left is false, ignores the string's beginning. Likewise, if
right is false, ignores the string's end.
descriptions.String/method/strip_escapes:
Strips all escape characters from the string. These include all
non-printable control characters of the first page of the ASCII table
(values from 0 to 31), such as tabulation (\t) and newline (\n, \r)
characters, but not spaces.
descriptions.String/method/substr:
Returns part of the string from the position from with length len. If
len is -1 (as by default), returns the rest of the string starting from
the given position.
descriptions.String/method/to_ascii_buffer:
Converts the string to an ASCII/Latin-1 encoded PackedByteArray. This
method is slightly faster than to_utf8_buffer, but replaces all
unsupported characters with spaces. This is the inverse of
PackedByteArray.get_string_from_ascii.
descriptions.String/method/to_camel_case: Returns the string converted to camelCase.
descriptions.String/method/to_float:
Converts the string representing a decimal number into a float. This
method stops on the first non-number character, except the first decimal
point (.) and the exponent letter (e). See also is_valid_float.
descriptions.String/method/to_int:
Converts the string representing an integer number into an int. This
method removes any non-number character and stops at the first decimal
point (.). See also is_valid_int.
descriptions.String/method/to_kebab_case:
Returns the string converted to kebab-case. Note: Numbers followed by a
single letter are not separated in the conversion to keep some words
(such as "2D") together.
descriptions.String/method/to_lower: Returns the string converted to lowercase.
descriptions.String/method/to_multibyte_char_buffer:
Converts the string to system multibyte code page encoded
PackedByteArray. If conversion fails, empty array is returned. The
values permitted for encoding are system dependent. If encoding is empty
string, system default encoding is used. - For Windows, see Code Page
Identifiers .NET names. - For macOS and Linux/BSD, see libiconv library
documentation...
descriptions.String/method/to_pascal_case: Returns the string converted to PascalCase.
descriptions.String/method/to_snake_case:
Returns the string converted to snake_case. Note: Numbers followed by a
single letter are not separated in the conversion to keep some words
(such as "2D") together.
descriptions.String/method/to_upper: Returns the string converted to UPPERCASE.
descriptions.String/method/to_utf16_buffer:
Converts the string to a UTF-16 encoded PackedByteArray. This is the
inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf16.
descriptions.String/method/to_utf32_buffer:
Converts the string to a UTF-32 encoded PackedByteArray. This is the
inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf32.
descriptions.String/method/to_utf8_buffer:
Converts the string to a UTF-8 encoded PackedByteArray. This method is
slightly slower than to_ascii_buffer, but supports all UTF-8 characters.
For most cases, prefer using this method. This is the inverse of
PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf8.
descriptions.String/method/to_wchar_buffer:
Converts the string to a wide character (wchar_t, UTF-16 on Windows,
UTF-32 on other platforms) encoded PackedByteArray. This is the inverse
of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_wchar.
descriptions.String/method/trim_prefix:
Removes the given prefix from the start of the string, or returns the
string unchanged.
descriptions.String/method/trim_suffix:
Removes the given suffix from the end of the string, or returns the
string unchanged.
descriptions.String/method/unicode_at:
Returns the character code at position at. See also chr, @GDScript.char,
and @GDScript.ord.
descriptions.String/method/uri_decode:
Decodes the string from its URL-encoded format. This method is meant to
properly decode the parameters in a URL when receiving an HTTP request.
See also uri_encode.
descriptions.String/method/uri_encode:
Encodes the string to URL-friendly format. This method is meant to
properly encode the parameters in a URL when sending an HTTP request.
See also uri_decode.
descriptions.String/method/uri_file_decode:
Decodes the file path from its URL-encoded format. Unlike uri_decode
this method leaves + as is.
descriptions.String/method/validate_filename:
Returns a copy of the string with all characters that are not allowed in
is_valid_filename replaced with underscores.
descriptions.String/method/validate_node_name:
Returns a copy of the string with all characters that are not allowed in
Node.name (. : @ / " %) replaced with underscores.
descriptions.String/method/xml_escape:
Returns a copy of the string with special characters escaped using the
XML standard. If escape_quotes is true, the single quote (') and double
quote (") characters are also escaped.
descriptions.String/method/xml_unescape:
Returns a copy of the string with escaped characters replaced by their
meanings according to the XML standard.
descriptions.StringName/method/begins_with:
Returns true if the string begins with the given text. See also
ends_with.
descriptions.StringName/method/bigrams:
Returns an array containing the bigrams (pairs of consecutive
characters) of this string.
descriptions.StringName/method/bin_to_int:
Converts the string representing a binary number into an int. The string
may optionally be prefixed with "0b", and an additional - prefix for
negative numbers.
descriptions.StringName/method/c_escape:
Returns a copy of the string with special characters escaped using the C
language standard.
descriptions.StringName/method/c_unescape:
Returns a copy of the string with escaped characters replaced by their
meanings. Supported escape sequences are \', \", \\, \a, \b, \f, \n, \r,
\t, \v. Note: Unlike the GDScript parser, this method doesn't support
the \uXXXX escape sequence.
descriptions.StringName/method/capitalize:
Changes the appearance of the string: replaces underscores (_) with
spaces, adds spaces before uppercase letters in the middle of a word,
converts all letters to lowercase, then converts the first one and each
one following a space to uppercase.
descriptions.StringName/method/casecmp_to:
Performs a case-sensitive comparison to another string. Returns -1 if
less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than" and "greater
than" are determined by the Unicode code points of each string, which
roughly matches the alphabetical order. With different string lengths,
returns 1 if this string is longer than the to string, or -1 if
shorter....
descriptions.StringName/method/contains:
Returns true if the string contains what. In GDScript, this corresponds
to the in operator.
descriptions.StringName/method/containsn:
Returns true if the string contains what, ignoring case. If you need to
know where what is within the string, use findn. See also contains.
descriptions.StringName/method/count:
Returns the number of occurrences of the substring what between from and
to positions. If to is 0, the search continues until the end of the
string.
descriptions.StringName/method/countn:
Returns the number of occurrences of the substring what between from and
to positions, ignoring case. If to is 0, the search continues until the
end of the string.
descriptions.StringName/method/dedent:
Returns a copy of the string with indentation (leading tabs and spaces)
removed. See also indent to add indentation.
descriptions.StringName/method/ends_with:
Returns true if the string ends with the given text. See also
begins_with.
descriptions.StringName/method/erase:
Returns a string with chars characters erased starting from position. If
chars goes beyond the string's length given the specified position,
fewer characters will be erased from the returned string. Returns an
empty string if either position or chars is negative. Returns the
original string unmodified if chars is 0.
descriptions.StringName/method/filecasecmp_to:
Like naturalcasecmp_to but prioritizes strings that begin with periods
(.) and underscores (_) before any other character. Useful when sorting
folders or file names. To get a bool result from a string comparison,
use the == operator instead. See also filenocasecmp_to,
naturalcasecmp_to, and casecmp_to.
descriptions.StringName/method/filenocasecmp_to:
Like naturalnocasecmp_to but prioritizes strings that begin with periods
(.) and underscores (_) before any other character. Useful when sorting
folders or file names. To get a bool result from a string comparison,
use the == operator instead. See also filecasecmp_to,
naturalnocasecmp_to, and nocasecmp_to.
descriptions.StringName/method/findn:
Returns the index of the first case-insensitive occurrence of what in
this string, or -1 if there are none. The starting search index can be
specified with from, continuing to the end of the string.
descriptions.StringName/method/format:
Formats the string by replacing all occurrences of placeholder with the
elements of values. values can be a Dictionary, an Array, or an Object.
Any underscores in placeholder will be replaced with the corresponding
keys in advance. Array elements use their index as keys.
descriptions.StringName/method/get_base_dir: If the string is a valid file path, returns the base directory name.
descriptions.StringName/method/get_basename:
If the string is a valid file path, returns the full file path, without
the extension.
descriptions.StringName/method/get_extension:
If the string is a valid file name or path, returns the file extension
without the leading period (.). Otherwise, returns an empty string.
descriptions.StringName/method/get_file:
If the string is a valid file path, returns the file name, including the
extension.
descriptions.StringName/method/get_slice:
Splits the string using a delimiter and returns the substring at index
slice. Returns the original string if delimiter does not occur in the
string. Returns an empty string if the slice does not exist. This is
faster than split, if you only need one substring.
descriptions.StringName/method/get_slice_count:
Returns the total number of slices when the string is split with the
given delimiter (see split).
descriptions.StringName/method/get_slicec:
Splits the string using a Unicode character with code delimiter and
returns the substring at index slice. Returns an empty string if the
slice does not exist. This is faster than split, if you only need one
substring.
descriptions.StringName/method/hash:
Returns the 32-bit hash value representing the string's contents. Note:
Strings with equal hash values are not guaranteed to be the same, as a
result of hash collisions. On the contrary, strings with different hash
values are guaranteed to be different.
descriptions.StringName/method/hex_decode: Decodes a hexadecimal string as a PackedByteArray.
descriptions.StringName/method/hex_to_int:
Converts the string representing a hexadecimal number into an int. The
string may be optionally prefixed with "0x", and an additional - prefix
for negative numbers.
descriptions.StringName/method/indent:
Indents every line of the string with the given prefix. Empty lines are
not indented. See also dedent to remove indentation. For example, the
string can be indented with two tabulations using "\t\t", or four spaces
using " ".
descriptions.StringName/method/insert: Inserts what at the given position in the string.
descriptions.StringName/method/is_absolute_path:
Returns true if the string is a path to a file or directory, and its
starting point is explicitly defined. This method is the opposite of
is_relative_path. This includes all paths starting with "res://",
"user://", "C:\", "/", etc.
descriptions.StringName/method/is_empty: Returns true if the string's length is 0 (""). See also length.
descriptions.StringName/method/is_relative_path:
Returns true if the string is a path, and its starting point is
dependent on context. The path could begin from the current directory,
or the current Node (if the string is derived from a NodePath), and may
sometimes be prefixed with "./". This method is the opposite of
is_absolute_path.
descriptions.StringName/method/is_subsequence_of:
Returns true if all characters of this string can be found in text in
their original order. This is not the same as contains.
descriptions.StringName/method/is_subsequence_ofn:
Returns true if all characters of this string can be found in text in
their original order, ignoring case. This is not the same as containsn.
descriptions.StringName/method/is_valid_ascii_identif:
Returns true if this string is a valid ASCII identifier. A valid ASCII
identifier may contain only letters, digits, and underscores (_), and
the first character may not be a digit.
descriptions.StringName/method/is_valid_filename:
Returns true if this string is a valid file name. A valid file name
cannot be empty, begin or end with space characters, or contain
characters that are not allowed (: / \ ? * " | % < >).
descriptions.StringName/method/is_valid_float:
Returns true if this string represents a valid floating-point number. A
valid float may contain only digits, one decimal point (.), and the
exponent letter (e). It may also be prefixed with a positive (+) or
negative (-) sign. Any valid integer is also a valid float (see
is_valid_int). See also to_float.
descriptions.StringName/method/is_valid_hex_number:
Returns true if this string is a valid hexadecimal number. A valid
hexadecimal number only contains digits or letters A to F (either
uppercase or lowercase), and may be prefixed with a positive (+) or
negative (-) sign. If with_prefix is true, the hexadecimal number needs
to prefixed by "0x" to be considered valid.
descriptions.StringName/method/is_valid_html_color:
Returns true if this string is a valid color in hexadecimal HTML
notation. The string must be a hexadecimal value (see
is_valid_hex_number) of either 3, 4, 6 or 8 digits, and may be prefixed
by a hash sign (#). Other HTML notations for colors, such as names or
hsl(), are not considered valid. See also Color.html.
descriptions.StringName/method/is_valid_identifier:
Returns true if this string is a valid identifier. A valid identifier
may contain only letters, digits and underscores (_), and the first
character may not be a digit.
descriptions.StringName/method/is_valid_int:
Returns true if this string represents a valid integer. A valid integer
only contains digits, and may be prefixed with a positive (+) or
negative (-) sign. See also to_int.
descriptions.StringName/method/is_valid_ip_address:
Returns true if this string represents a well-formatted IPv4 or IPv6
address. This method considers reserved IP addresses such as "0.0.0.0"
and "ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff" as valid.
descriptions.StringName/method/is_valid_unicode_ident:
Returns true if this string is a valid Unicode identifier. A valid
Unicode identifier must begin with a Unicode character of class
XID_Start or "_", and may contain Unicode characters of class
XID_Continue in the other positions.
descriptions.StringName/method/join:
Returns the concatenation of parts' elements, with each element
separated by the string calling this method. This method is the opposite
of split.
descriptions.StringName/method/json_escape:
Returns a copy of the string with special characters escaped using the
JSON standard. Because it closely matches the C standard, it is possible
to use c_unescape to unescape the string, if necessary.
descriptions.StringName/method/left:
Returns the first length characters from the beginning of the string. If
length is negative, strips the last length characters from the string's
end.
descriptions.StringName/method/length:
Returns the number of characters in the string. Empty strings ("")
always return 0. See also is_empty.
descriptions.StringName/method/lpad:
Formats the string to be at least min_length long by adding characters
to the left of the string, if necessary. See also rpad.
descriptions.StringName/method/lstrip:
Removes a set of characters defined in chars from the string's
beginning. See also rstrip. Note: chars is not a prefix. Use trim_prefix
to remove a single prefix, rather than a set of characters.
descriptions.StringName/method/match:
Does a simple expression match (also called "glob" or "globbing"), where
* matches zero or more arbitrary characters and ? matches any single
character except a period (.). An empty string or empty expression
always evaluates to false.
descriptions.StringName/method/matchn:
Does a simple case-insensitive expression match, where * matches zero or
more arbitrary characters and ? matches any single character except a
period (.). An empty string or empty expression always evaluates to
false.
descriptions.StringName/method/md5_buffer: Returns the MD5 hash of the string as a PackedByteArray.
descriptions.StringName/method/md5_text: Returns the MD5 hash of the string as another String.

Performs a case-insensitive, natural order comparison to another string.
Returns -1 if less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than"
or "greater than" are determined by the Unicode code points of each
string, which roughly matches the alphabetical order. Internally,
lowercase characters are converted to uppercase for the comparison. When
used...

Performs a case-insensitive comparison to another string. Returns -1 if
