than" are determined by the Unicode code points of each string, which
roughly matches the alphabetical order. Internally, lowercase characters
are converted to uppercase for the comparison. With different string...
descriptions.StringName/method/pad_decimals:
Formats the string representing a number to have an exact number of
digits after the decimal point.
descriptions.StringName/method/pad_zeros:
Formats the string representing a number to have an exact number of
digits before the decimal point.
descriptions.StringName/method/path_join:
Concatenates path at the end of the string as a subpath, adding / if
necessary. Example: "this/is".path_join("path") == "this/is/path".
descriptions.StringName/method/remove_char:
Removes all occurrences of the Unicode character with code what. Faster
version of replace when the key is only one character long and the
replacement is "".
descriptions.StringName/method/remove_chars:
Removes all occurrences of the characters in chars. See also
remove_char.
descriptions.StringName/method/repeat:
Repeats this string a number of times. count needs to be greater than 0.
Otherwise, returns an empty string.
descriptions.StringName/method/replace:
Replaces all occurrences of what inside the string with the given
forwhat.
descriptions.StringName/method/replace_char:
Replaces all occurrences of the Unicode character with code key with the

Replaces all case-insensitive occurrences of what inside the string with

Returns the copy of this string in reverse order. This operation works

descriptions.StringName/method/rfind:
Returns the index of the last occurrence of what in this string, or -1

continuing to the beginning of the string. This method is the reverse of
find. Note: A negative value of from is converted to a starting index by
counting back from the last possible index with enough space to find...
descriptions.StringName/method/rfindn:
Returns the index of the last case-insensitive occurrence of what in

descriptions.StringName/method/right:
Returns the last length characters from the end of the string. If length
is negative, strips the first length characters from the string's
beginning.
descriptions.StringName/method/rpad:
Formats the string to be at least min_length long, by adding characters
to the right of the string, if necessary. See also lpad.
descriptions.StringName/method/rsplit:
Splits the string using a delimiter and returns an array of the
substrings, starting from the end of the string. The splits in the
returned array appear in the same order as the original string. If
delimiter is an empty string, each substring will be a single character.
If allow_empty is false, empty strings between adjacent delimiters are
excluded from...
descriptions.StringName/method/rstrip:
Removes a set of characters defined in chars from the string's end. See
also lstrip. Note: chars is not a suffix. Use trim_suffix to remove a
single suffix, rather than a set of characters.
descriptions.StringName/method/sha1_buffer: Returns the SHA-1 hash of the string as a PackedByteArray.
descriptions.StringName/method/sha1_text: Returns the SHA-1 hash of the string as another String.
descriptions.StringName/method/sha256_buffer: Returns the SHA-256 hash of the string as a PackedByteArray.
descriptions.StringName/method/sha256_text: Returns the SHA-256 hash of the string as another String.
descriptions.StringName/method/similarity:
Returns the similarity index (Sørensen-Dice coefficient) of this string
compared to another. A result of 1.0 means totally similar, while 0.0
means totally dissimilar.
descriptions.StringName/method/simplify_path:
If the string is a valid file path, converts the string into a canonical
path. This is the shortest possible path, without "./", and all the
unnecessary ".." and "/".
descriptions.StringName/method/split:
Splits the string using a delimiter and returns an array of the
substrings. If delimiter is an empty string, each substring will be a
single character. This method is the opposite of join. If allow_empty is
false, empty strings between adjacent delimiters are excluded from the
array. If maxsplit is greater than 0, the number of splits may not
exceed...
descriptions.StringName/method/split_floats:
Splits the string into floats by using a delimiter and returns a
PackedFloat64Array. If allow_empty is false, empty or invalid float
conversions between adjacent delimiters are excluded.
descriptions.StringName/method/strip_edges:
Strips all non-printable characters from the beginning and the end of
the string. These include spaces, tabulations (\t), and newlines (\n
\r). If left is false, ignores the string's beginning. Likewise, if
right is false, ignores the string's end.
descriptions.StringName/method/strip_escapes:
Strips all escape characters from the string. These include all
non-printable control characters of the first page of the ASCII table
(values from 0 to 31), such as tabulation (\t) and newline (\n, \r)
characters, but not spaces.
descriptions.StringName/method/substr:
Returns part of the string from the position from with length len. If
len is -1 (as by default), returns the rest of the string starting from
the given position.
descriptions.StringName/method/to_ascii_buffer:
Converts the string to an ASCII/Latin-1 encoded PackedByteArray. This
method is slightly faster than to_utf8_buffer, but replaces all
unsupported characters with spaces. This is the inverse of
PackedByteArray.get_string_from_ascii.
descriptions.StringName/method/to_camel_case: Returns the string converted to camelCase.
descriptions.StringName/method/to_float:
Converts the string representing a decimal number into a float. This
method stops on the first non-number character, except the first decimal
point (.) and the exponent letter (e). See also is_valid_float.
descriptions.StringName/method/to_int:
Converts the string representing an integer number into an int. This
method removes any non-number character and stops at the first decimal
point (.). See also is_valid_int.
descriptions.StringName/method/to_kebab_case:
Returns the string converted to kebab-case. Note: Numbers followed by a
single letter are not separated in the conversion to keep some words
(such as "2D") together.
descriptions.StringName/method/to_lower: Returns the string converted to lowercase.
descriptions.StringName/method/to_multibyte_char_buff:
Converts the string to system multibyte code page encoded
PackedByteArray. If conversion fails, empty array is returned. The
values permitted for encoding are system dependent. If encoding is empty
string, system default encoding is used. - For Windows, see Code Page
Identifiers .NET names. - For macOS and Linux/BSD, see libiconv library
documentation...
descriptions.StringName/method/to_pascal_case: Returns the string converted to PascalCase.
descriptions.StringName/method/to_snake_case:
Returns the string converted to snake_case. Note: Numbers followed by a
single letter are not separated in the conversion to keep some words
(such as "2D") together.
descriptions.StringName/method/to_upper: Returns the string converted to UPPERCASE.
descriptions.StringName/method/to_utf16_buffer:
Converts the string to a UTF-16 encoded PackedByteArray. This is the
inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf16.
descriptions.StringName/method/to_utf32_buffer:
Converts the string to a UTF-32 encoded PackedByteArray. This is the
inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf32.
descriptions.StringName/method/to_utf8_buffer:
Converts the string to a UTF-8 encoded PackedByteArray. This method is
slightly slower than to_ascii_buffer, but supports all UTF-8 characters.
For most cases, prefer using this method. This is the inverse of
PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf8.
descriptions.StringName/method/to_wchar_buffer:
Converts the string to a wide character (wchar_t, UTF-16 on Windows,
UTF-32 on other platforms) encoded PackedByteArray. This is the inverse
of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_wchar.
descriptions.StringName/method/trim_prefix:
Removes the given prefix from the start of the string, or returns the
string unchanged.
descriptions.StringName/method/trim_suffix:
Removes the given suffix from the end of the string, or returns the
string unchanged.
descriptions.StringName/method/unicode_at:
Returns the character code at position at. See also String.chr,
@GDScript.char, and @GDScript.ord.
descriptions.StringName/method/uri_decode:
Decodes the string from its URL-encoded format. This method is meant to
properly decode the parameters in a URL when receiving an HTTP request.
See also uri_encode.
descriptions.StringName/method/uri_encode:
Encodes the string to URL-friendly format. This method is meant to
properly encode the parameters in a URL when sending an HTTP request.
See also uri_decode.
descriptions.StringName/method/uri_file_decode:
Decodes the file path from its URL-encoded format. Unlike uri_decode
this method leaves + as is.
descriptions.StringName/method/validate_filename:
Returns a copy of the string with all characters that are not allowed in
is_valid_filename replaced with underscores.
descriptions.StringName/method/validate_node_name:
Returns a copy of the string with all characters that are not allowed in
Node.name (. : @ / " %) replaced with underscores.
descriptions.StringName/method/xml_escape:
Returns a copy of the string with special characters escaped using the
XML standard. If escape_quotes is true, the single quote (') and double
quote (") characters are also escaped.
descriptions.StringName/method/xml_unescape:
Returns a copy of the string with escaped characters replaced by their
meanings according to the XML standard.
descriptions.StyleBox/method/_get_minimum_size:
Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns a custom minimum
size that the stylebox must respect when drawing. By default
get_minimum_size only takes content margins into account. This method
can be overridden to add another size restriction. A combination of the
default behavior and the output of this method will be used, to account
for both...
descriptions.StyleBox/method/draw:
Draws this stylebox using a canvas item identified by the given RID. The
RID value can either be the result of CanvasItem.get_canvas_item called
on an existing CanvasItem-derived node, or directly from creating a
canvas item in the RenderingServer with
RenderingServer.canvas_item_create.
descriptions.StyleBox/method/get_content_margin: Returns the default margin of the specified Side.
descriptions.StyleBox/method/get_current_item_drawn:
Returns the CanvasItem that handles its CanvasItem.NOTIFICATION_DRAW or
CanvasItem._draw callback at this moment.
descriptions.StyleBox/method/get_margin:
Returns the content margin offset for the specified Side. Positive
values reduce size inwards, unlike Control's margin values.
descriptions.StyleBox/method/get_minimum_size: Returns the minimum size that this stylebox can be shrunk to.
descriptions.StyleBox/method/get_offset:
Returns the "offset" of a stylebox. This helper function returns a value
equivalent to Vector2(style.get_margin(MARGIN_LEFT),
style.get_margin(MARGIN_TOP)).
descriptions.StyleBox/method/set_content_margin: Sets the default value of the specified Side to offset pixels.
descriptions.StyleBox/method/set_content_margin_all: Sets the default margin to offset pixels for all sides.
descriptions.StyleBox/method/test_mask: Test a position in a rectangle, return whether it passes the mask test.
descriptions.StyleBoxFlat/method/get_border_width: Returns the specified Side's border width.
descriptions.StyleBoxFlat/method/get_border_width_min: Returns the smallest border width out of all four borders.
descriptions.StyleBoxFlat/method/get_expand_margin: Returns the size of the specified Side's expand margin.
descriptions.StyleBoxFlat/method/set_border_width: Sets the specified Side's border width to width pixels.
descriptions.StyleBoxFlat/method/set_border_width_all: Sets the border width to width pixels for all sides.
descriptions.StyleBoxFlat/method/set_corner_radius: Sets the corner radius to radius pixels for the given corner.
descriptions.StyleBoxFlat/method/set_corner_radius_al: Sets the corner radius to radius pixels for all corners.
descriptions.StyleBoxFlat/method/set_expand_margin: Sets the expand margin to size pixels for the specified Side.
descriptions.StyleBoxFlat/method/set_expand_margin_al: Sets the expand margin to size pixels for all sides.
descriptions.StyleBoxTexture/method/get_expand_margin: Returns the expand margin size of the specified Side.
descriptions.StyleBoxTexture/method/get_texture_margi: Returns the margin size of the specified Side.
descriptions.StyleBoxTexture/method/set_expand_margin: Sets the expand margin to size pixels for the specified Side.
Sets the expand margin to size pixels for all sides.
descriptions.StyleBoxTexture/method/set_texture_margi: Sets the margin to size pixels for the specified Side.
Sets the margin to size pixels for all sides.
descriptions.SubViewportContainer/method/_propagate_i:
Virtual method to be implemented by the user. If it returns true, the
event is propagated to SubViewport children. Propagation doesn't happen
if it returns false. If the function is not implemented, all events are
propagated to SubViewports.
descriptions.SubtweenTweener/method/set_delay:
Sets the time in seconds after which the SubtweenTweener will start
running the subtween. By default there's no delay.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/add_index:
Adds a vertex to index array if you are using indexed vertices. Does not
need to be called before adding vertices.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/add_triangle_fan:
Inserts a triangle fan made of array data into Mesh being constructed.
Requires the primitive type be set to Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/add_vertex:
Specifies the position of current vertex. Should be called after
specifying other vertex properties (e.g. Color, UV).
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/append_from:
Append vertices from a given Mesh surface onto the current vertex array
with specified Transform3D.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/begin:
Called before adding any vertices. Takes the primitive type as an
argument (e.g. Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES).
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/clear: Clear all information passed into the surface tool so far.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/commit:
Returns a constructed ArrayMesh from current information passed in. If
an existing ArrayMesh is passed in as an argument, will add an extra
surface to the existing ArrayMesh. The flags argument can be the bitwise
OR of Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_USE_DYNAMIC_UPDATE,
Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_USE_8_BONE_WEIGHTS, or
Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_USES_EMPTY_VERTEX_ARRAY.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/commit_to_arrays:
Commits the data to the same format used by
ArrayMesh.add_surface_from_arrays, ImporterMesh.add_surface, and
create_from_arrays. This way you can further process the mesh data using
the ArrayMesh or ImporterMesh APIs.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/create_from: Creates a vertex array from an existing Mesh.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/create_from_arrays:
Creates this SurfaceTool from existing vertex arrays such as returned by
commit_to_arrays, Mesh.surface_get_arrays,
Mesh.surface_get_blend_shape_arrays, ImporterMesh.get_surface_arrays,
and ImporterMesh.get_surface_blend_shape_arrays. primitive_type controls
the type of mesh data, defaulting to Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/create_from_blend_sha:
Creates a vertex array from the specified blend shape of an existing
Mesh. This can be used to extract a specific pose from a blend shape.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/deindex: Removes the index array by expanding the vertex array.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/generate_lod:
Generates an LOD for a given nd_threshold in linear units (square root
of quadric error metric), using at most target_index_count indices.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/generate_normals:
Generates normals from vertices so you do not have to do it manually. If
flip is true, the resulting normals will be inverted. generate_normals
should be called after generating geometry and before committing the
mesh using commit or commit_to_arrays. For correct display of
normal-mapped surfaces, you will also have to generate tangents using...
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/generate_tangents:
Generates a tangent vector for each vertex. Requires that each vertex
already has UVs and normals set (see generate_normals).
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/get_aabb: Returns the axis-aligned bounding box of the vertex positions.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/get_custom_format:
Returns the format for custom channel_index (currently up to 4). Returns
CUSTOM_MAX if this custom channel is unused.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/get_primitive_type: Returns the type of mesh geometry, such as Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/get_skin_weight_count:
By default, returns SKIN_4_WEIGHTS to indicate only 4 bone influences
per vertex are used. Returns SKIN_8_WEIGHTS if up to 8 influences are
used. Note: This function returns an enum, not the exact number of
weights.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/index:
Shrinks the vertex array by creating an index array. This can improve
performance by avoiding vertex reuse.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/optimize_indices_for_:
Optimizes triangle sorting for performance. Requires that
get_primitive_type is Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/set_bones:
Specifies an array of bones to use for the next vertex. bones must
contain 4 integers.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/set_color:
Specifies a Color to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to
have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first
vertex, this information may not be used at all. Note: The material must
have BaseMaterial3D.vertex_color_use_as_albedo enabled for the vertex
color to be visible.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/set_custom:
Sets the custom value on this vertex for channel_index.
set_custom_format must be called first for this channel_index. Formats
which are not RGBA will ignore other color channels.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/set_custom_format:
Sets the color format for this custom channel_index. Use CUSTOM_MAX to
disable. Must be invoked after begin and should be set before commit or
commit_to_arrays.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/set_material: Sets Material to be used by the Mesh you are constructing.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/set_normal:
Specifies a normal to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to
have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first
vertex, this information may not be used at all.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/set_skin_weight_count:
Set to SKIN_8_WEIGHTS to indicate that up to 8 bone influences per
vertex may be used. By default, only 4 bone influences are used
(SKIN_4_WEIGHTS). Note: This function takes an enum, not the exact
number of weights.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/set_smooth_group:
Specifies the smooth group to use for the next vertex. If this is never
called, all vertices will have the default smooth group of 0 and will be
smoothed with adjacent vertices of the same group. To produce a mesh
with flat normals, set the smooth group to -1. Note: This function
actually takes a uint32_t, so C# users should use uint32.MaxValue
instead...
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/set_tangent:
Specifies a tangent to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to
have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first
vertex, this information may not be used at all. Note: Even though
tangent is a Plane, it does not directly represent the tangent plane.
Its Plane.x, Plane.y, and Plane.z represent the tangent vector and
Plane.d...
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/set_uv:
Specifies a set of UV coordinates to use for the next vertex. If every
vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for
the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/set_uv2:
Specifies an optional second set of UV coordinates to use for the next
vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail
to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at
all.
descriptions.SurfaceTool/method/set_weights:
Specifies weight values to use for the next vertex. weights must contain
4 values. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you
fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used
at all.
descriptions.SyntaxHighlighter/method/_clear_highligh: Virtual method which can be overridden to clear any local caches.
descriptions.SyntaxHighlighter/method/_get_line_synta:
Virtual method which can be overridden to return syntax highlighting
data. See get_line_syntax_highlighting for more details.
descriptions.SyntaxHighlighter/method/_update_cache: Virtual method which can be overridden to update any local caches.
descriptions.SyntaxHighlighter/method/clear_highlight:
Clears all cached syntax highlighting data. Then calls overridable
method _clear_highlighting_cache.
descriptions.SyntaxHighlighter/method/get_line_syntax:
Returns the syntax highlighting data for the line at index line. If the
line is not cached, calls _get_line_syntax_highlighting first to
calculate the data. Each entry is a column number containing a nested
Dictionary. The column number denotes the start of a region, the region
will end if another region is found, or at the end of the line. The
nested...
descriptions.SyntaxHighlighter/method/update_cache:
Clears then updates the SyntaxHighlighter caches. Override _update_cache
for a callback. Note: This is called automatically when the associated
TextEdit node, updates its own cache.
descriptions.TCPServer/method/get_local_port: Returns the local port this server is listening to.
descriptions.TCPServer/method/listen:
Listen on the port binding to bind_address. If bind_address is set as
"*" (default), the server will listen on all available addresses (both
IPv4 and IPv6). If bind_address is set as "0.0.0.0" (for IPv4) or "::"
(for IPv6), the server will listen on all available addresses matching
that IP type. If bind_address is set to any valid address (e.g....
descriptions.TCPServer/method/take_connection:
If a connection is available, returns a StreamPeerTCP with the
connection.
descriptions.TLSOptions/method/client:
Creates a TLS client configuration which validates certificates and
their common names (fully qualified domain names). You can specify a
custom trusted_chain of certification authorities (the default CA list
will be used if null), and optionally provide a common_name_override if
you expect the certificate to have a common name other than the server
FQDN....
descriptions.TLSOptions/method/client_unsafe:
Creates an unsafe TLS client configuration where certificate validation
is optional. You can optionally provide a valid trusted_chain, but the
common name of the certificates will never be checked. Using this
configuration for purposes other than testing is not recommended. Note:
On the Web platform, TLS verification is always enforced against the
CA...
descriptions.TLSOptions/method/get_common_name_overri:
Returns the common name (domain name) override specified when creating
with TLSOptions.client.
descriptions.TLSOptions/method/get_own_certificate:
Returns the X509Certificate specified when creating with
TLSOptions.server.
descriptions.TLSOptions/method/get_private_key: Returns the CryptoKey specified when creating with TLSOptions.server.
descriptions.TLSOptions/method/get_trusted_ca_chain:
Returns the CA X509Certificate chain specified when creating with
TLSOptions.client or TLSOptions.client_unsafe.
descriptions.TLSOptions/method/is_server: Returns true if created with TLSOptions.server, false otherwise.
descriptions.TLSOptions/method/is_unsafe_client: Returns true if created with TLSOptions.client_unsafe, false otherwise.
descriptions.TLSOptions/method/server:
Creates a TLS server configuration using the provided key and
certificate. Note: The certificate should include the full certificate
chain up to the signing CA (certificates file can be concatenated using
a general purpose text editor).
descriptions.TabBar/method/ensure_tab_visible: Moves the scroll view to make the tab visible.
descriptions.TabBar/method/get_offset_buttons_visible:
Returns true if the offset buttons (the ones that appear when there's
not enough space for all tabs) are visible.
descriptions.TabBar/method/get_previous_tab: Returns the previously active tab index.
descriptions.TabBar/method/get_tab_button_icon:
Returns the icon for the right button of the tab at index tab_idx or
null if the right button has no icon.
descriptions.TabBar/method/get_tab_icon:
Returns the icon for the tab at index tab_idx or null if the tab has no
icon.
descriptions.TabBar/method/get_tab_icon_max_width:
Returns the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index
tab_idx.
descriptions.TabBar/method/get_tab_idx_at_point:
Returns the index of the tab at local coordinates point. Returns -1 if
the point is outside the control boundaries or if there's no tab at the
queried position.
descriptions.TabBar/method/get_tab_metadata:
Returns the metadata value set to the tab at index tab_idx using
set_tab_metadata. If no metadata was previously set, returns null by
default.
descriptions.TabBar/method/get_tab_offset: Returns the number of hidden tabs offsetted to the left.
descriptions.TabBar/method/get_tab_rect: Returns tab Rect2 with local position and size.
descriptions.TabBar/method/get_tab_text_direction: Returns tab title text base writing direction.
descriptions.TabBar/method/get_tab_title: Returns the title of the tab at index tab_idx.
descriptions.TabBar/method/get_tab_tooltip: Returns the tooltip text of the tab at index tab_idx.
descriptions.TabBar/method/is_tab_disabled: Returns true if the tab at index tab_idx is disabled.
descriptions.TabBar/method/is_tab_hidden: Returns true if the tab at index tab_idx is hidden.
descriptions.TabBar/method/move_tab: Moves a tab from from to to.
descriptions.TabBar/method/remove_tab: Removes the tab at index tab_idx.
descriptions.TabBar/method/select_next_available:
Selects the first available tab with greater index than the currently
selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.
descriptions.TabBar/method/select_previous_available:
Selects the first available tab with lower index than the currently
selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.
descriptions.TabBar/method/set_tab_button_icon:
Sets an icon for the button of the tab at index tab_idx (located to the
right, before the close button), making it visible and clickable (See
tab_button_pressed). Giving it a null value will hide the button.
descriptions.TabBar/method/set_tab_disabled:
If disabled is true, disables the tab at index tab_idx, making it
non-interactable.
descriptions.TabBar/method/set_tab_hidden:
If hidden is true, hides the tab at index tab_idx, making it disappear
from the tab area.
descriptions.TabBar/method/set_tab_icon: Sets an icon for the tab at index tab_idx.
descriptions.TabBar/method/set_tab_icon_max_width:
Sets the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index tab_idx.
This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon and on top
of icon_max_width. The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio.
descriptions.TabBar/method/set_tab_language:
Sets the language code of the title for the tab at index tab_idx to
language. This is used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If
language is empty, the current locale is used.
descriptions.TabBar/method/set_tab_metadata:
Sets the metadata value for the tab at index tab_idx, which can be
retrieved later using get_tab_metadata.
descriptions.TabBar/method/set_tab_text_direction: Sets tab title base writing direction.
descriptions.TabBar/method/set_tab_title: Sets a title for the tab at index tab_idx.
descriptions.TabBar/method/set_tab_tooltip:
Sets a tooltip for tab at index tab_idx. Note: By default, if the
tooltip is empty and the tab text is truncated (not all characters fit
into the tab), the title will be displayed as a tooltip. To hide the
tooltip, assign " " as the tooltip text.
descriptions.TabBar/signal/active_tab_rearranged:
Emitted when the active tab is rearranged via mouse drag. See
drag_to_rearrange_enabled.
descriptions.TabBar/signal/tab_button_pressed: Emitted when a tab's right button is pressed. See set_tab_button_icon.
descriptions.TabBar/signal/tab_changed: Emitted when switching to another tab.
descriptions.TabBar/signal/tab_clicked: Emitted when a tab is clicked, even if it is the current tab.
descriptions.TabBar/signal/tab_close_pressed:
Emitted when a tab's close button is pressed or, if
close_with_middle_mouse is true, when middle-clicking on a tab. Note:
Tabs are not removed automatically; this behavior needs to be coded
manually. For example:
descriptions.TabBar/signal/tab_hovered: Emitted when a tab is hovered by the mouse.
descriptions.TabBar/signal/tab_rmb_clicked: Emitted when a tab is right-clicked.
descriptions.TabBar/signal/tab_selected:
Emitted when a tab is selected via click, directional input, or script,
even if it is the current tab.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/get_current_tab_cont: Returns the child Control node located at the active tab index.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/get_popup:
Returns the Popup node instance if one has been set already with
set_popup. Warning: This is a required internal node, removing and
freeing it may cause a crash. If you wish to hide it or any of its
children, use their Window.visible property.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/get_previous_tab: Returns the previously active tab index.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/get_tab_bar:
Returns the TabBar contained in this container. Warning: This is a
required internal node, removing and freeing it or editing its tabs may
cause a crash. If you wish to edit the tabs, use the methods provided in
TabContainer.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/get_tab_button_icon: Returns the button icon from the tab at index tab_idx.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/get_tab_control: Returns the Control node from the tab at index tab_idx.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/get_tab_icon:
Returns the Texture2D for the tab at index tab_idx or null if the tab
has no Texture2D.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/get_tab_icon_max_wid:
Returns the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index
tab_idx.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/get_tab_idx_at_point:
Returns the index of the tab at local coordinates point. Returns -1 if
the point is outside the control boundaries or if there's no tab at the
queried position.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/get_tab_idx_from_con:
Returns the index of the tab tied to the given control. The control must
be a child of the TabContainer.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/get_tab_metadata:
Returns the metadata value set to the tab at index tab_idx using
set_tab_metadata. If no metadata was previously set, returns null by
default.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/get_tab_title:
Returns the title of the tab at index tab_idx. Tab titles default to the
name of the indexed child node, but this can be overridden with
set_tab_title.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/get_tab_tooltip: Returns the tooltip text of the tab at index tab_idx.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/is_tab_disabled: Returns true if the tab at index tab_idx is disabled.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/is_tab_hidden: Returns true if the tab at index tab_idx is hidden.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/select_next_availabl:
Selects the first available tab with greater index than the currently
selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/select_previous_avai:
Selects the first available tab with lower index than the currently
selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/set_popup:
If set on a Popup node instance, a popup menu icon appears in the
top-right corner of the TabContainer (setting it to null will make it go
away). Clicking it will expand the Popup node.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/set_tab_button_icon: Sets the button icon from the tab at index tab_idx.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/set_tab_disabled:
If disabled is true, disables the tab at index tab_idx, making it
non-interactable.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/set_tab_hidden:
If hidden is true, hides the tab at index tab_idx, making it disappear
from the tab area.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/set_tab_icon: Sets an icon for the tab at index tab_idx.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/set_tab_icon_max_wid:
Sets the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index tab_idx.
This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon and on top
of icon_max_width. The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/set_tab_metadata:
Sets the metadata value for the tab at index tab_idx, which can be
retrieved later using get_tab_metadata.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/set_tab_title:
Sets a custom title for the tab at index tab_idx (tab titles default to
the name of the indexed child node). Set it back to the child's name to
make the tab default to it again.
descriptions.TabContainer/method/set_tab_tooltip:
Sets a custom tooltip text for tab at index tab_idx. Note: By default,
if the tooltip is empty and the tab text is truncated (not all
characters fit into the tab), the title will be displayed as a tooltip.
To hide the tooltip, assign " " as the tooltip text.
descriptions.TabContainer/signal/active_tab_rearrange:
Emitted when the active tab is rearranged via mouse drag. See
drag_to_rearrange_enabled.
descriptions.TabContainer/signal/pre_popup_pressed:
Emitted when the TabContainer's Popup button is clicked. See set_popup
for details.
descriptions.TabContainer/signal/tab_button_pressed: Emitted when the user clicks on the button icon on this tab.
descriptions.TabContainer/signal/tab_changed: Emitted when switching to another tab.
descriptions.TabContainer/signal/tab_clicked: Emitted when a tab is clicked, even if it is the current tab.
descriptions.TabContainer/signal/tab_hovered: Emitted when a tab is hovered by the mouse.
descriptions.TabContainer/signal/tab_selected:
Emitted when a tab is selected via click, directional input, or script,
even if it is the current tab.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/_backspace:
Override this method to define what happens when the user presses the
backspace key.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/_copy:
Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a
copy operation.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/_cut:
Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a cut
operation.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/_handle_unicode_input:
Override this method to define what happens when the user types in the
provided key unicode_char.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/_paste:
Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a
paste operation.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/_paste_primary_clipboard:
Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a
paste operation with middle mouse button. Note: This method is only
implemented on Linux.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/add_caret:
Adds a new caret at the given location. Returns the index of the new
caret, or -1 if the location is invalid.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/add_caret_at_carets:
Adds an additional caret above or below every caret. If below is true
the new caret will be added below and above otherwise.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/add_gutter:
Register a new gutter to this TextEdit. Use at to have a specific gutter
order. A value of -1 appends the gutter to the right.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/add_selection_for_next_o:
Adds a selection and a caret for the next occurrence of the current
selection. If there is no active selection, selects word under caret.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/adjust_viewport_to_caret: Adjust the viewport so the caret is visible.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/apply_ime:
Applies text from the Input Method Editor (IME) to each caret and closes
the IME if it is open.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/backspace:
Called when the user presses the backspace key. Can be overridden with
_backspace.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/begin_complex_operation:
Starts a multipart edit. All edits will be treated as one action until
end_complex_operation is called.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/begin_multicaret_edit:
Starts an edit for multiple carets. The edit must be ended with
end_multicaret_edit. Multicaret edits can be used to edit text at
multiple carets and delay merging the carets until the end, so the caret
indexes aren't affected immediately. begin_multicaret_edit and
end_multicaret_edit can be nested, and the merge will happen at the last
end_multicaret_edit.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/cancel_ime:
Closes the Input Method Editor (IME) if it is open. Any text in the IME
will be lost.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/center_viewport_to_caret:
Centers the viewport on the line the editing caret is at. This also
resets the scroll_horizontal value to 0.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/clear: Performs a full reset of TextEdit, including undo history.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/collapse_carets:
Collapse all carets in the given range to the from_line and from_column
position. inclusive applies to both ends. If is_in_mulitcaret_edit is
true, carets that are collapsed will be true for
multicaret_edit_ignore_caret. merge_overlapping_carets will be called if
any carets were collapsed.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/copy: Copies the current text selection. Can be overridden with _copy.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/cut: Cut's the current selection. Can be overridden with _cut.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/end_action: Marks the end of steps in the current action started with start_action.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/end_complex_operation:
Ends a multipart edit, started with begin_complex_operation. If called
outside a complex operation, the current operation is pushed onto the
undo/redo stack.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/end_multicaret_edit:
Ends an edit for multiple carets, that was started with
begin_multicaret_edit. If this was the last end_multicaret_edit and
merge_overlapping_carets was called, carets will be merged.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_caret_column: Returns the column the editing caret is at.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_caret_count: Returns the number of carets in this TextEdit.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_caret_draw_pos: Returns the caret pixel draw position.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_caret_index_edit_ord:
Returns a list of caret indexes in their edit order, this done from
bottom to top. Edit order refers to the way actions such as
insert_text_at_caret are applied.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_caret_line: Returns the line the editing caret is on.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_caret_wrap_index: Returns the wrap index the editing caret is on.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_first_non_whitespace:
Returns the first column containing a non-whitespace character on the
given line. If there is only whitespace, returns the number of
characters.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_gutter_count: Returns the number of gutters registered.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_gutter_name: Returns the name of the gutter at the given index.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_gutter_type:
Returns the type of the gutter at the given index. Gutters can contain
icons, text, or custom visuals.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_gutter_width: Returns the width of the gutter at the given index.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_h_scroll_bar: Returns the HScrollBar used by TextEdit.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_indent_level:
Returns the indent level of the given line. This is the number of spaces
and tabs at the beginning of the line, with the tabs taking the tab size
into account (see get_tab_size).
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_last_full_visible_li:
Returns the last visible line. Use get_last_full_visible_line_wrap_index
for the wrap index.
Returns the last visible wrap index of the last visible line.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_last_unhidden_line: Returns the last unhidden line in the entire TextEdit.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line: Returns the text of a specific line.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_background_colo:
Returns the custom background color of the given line. If no color is
set, returns Color(0, 0, 0, 0).
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_column_at_pos:
Returns the line and column at the given position. In the returned
vector, x is the column and y is the line. If clamp_line is false and
position is below the last line, Vector2i(-1, -1) is returned. If
clamp_column is false and position is outside the column range of the
line, Vector2i(-1, -1) is returned.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_count: Returns the number of lines in the text.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_gutter_icon:
Returns the icon currently in gutter at line. This only works when the
gutter type is GUTTER_TYPE_ICON (see set_gutter_type).
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_gutter_item_col: Returns the color currently in gutter at line.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_gutter_metadata: Returns the metadata currently in gutter at line.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_gutter_text:
Returns the text currently in gutter at line. This only works when the
gutter type is GUTTER_TYPE_STRING (see set_gutter_type).
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_height:
Returns the maximum value of the line height among all lines. Note: The
return value is influenced by line_spacing and font_size. And it will
not be less than 1.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_ranges_from_car:
Returns an Array of line ranges where x is the first line and y is the
last line. All lines within these ranges will have a caret on them or be
part of a selection. Each line will only be part of one line range, even
if it has multiple carets on it. If a selection's end column
(get_selection_to_column) is at column 0, that line will not be
included. If a...
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_width: Returns the width in pixels of the wrap_index on line.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_with_ime:
Returns line text as it is currently displayed, including IME
composition string.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_wrap_count: Returns the number of times the given line is wrapped.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_wrap_index_at_c:
Returns the wrap index of the given column on the given line. This
ranges from 0 to get_line_wrap_count.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_line_wrapped_text: Returns an array of Strings representing each wrapped index.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_local_mouse_pos: Returns the local mouse position adjusted for the text direction.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_menu:
Returns the PopupMenu of this TextEdit. By default, this menu is
displayed when right-clicking on the TextEdit. You can add custom menu
items or remove standard ones. Make sure your IDs don't conflict with
the standard ones (see MenuItems). For example:
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_minimap_line_at_pos: Returns the equivalent minimap line at position.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_minimap_visible_line: Returns the number of lines that may be drawn on the minimap.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_next_composite_chara:
Returns the correct column at the end of a composite character like ❤️‍🩹
(mending heart; Unicode: U+2764 U+FE0F U+200D U+1FA79) which is
comprised of more than one Unicode code point, if the caret is at the
start of the composite character. Also returns the correct column with
the caret at mid grapheme and for non-composite characters. Note: To
check at...
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_next_visible_line_in:
Similar to get_next_visible_line_offset_from, but takes into account the
line wrap indexes. In the returned vector, x is the line, y is the wrap
index.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_next_visible_line_of:
Returns the count to the next visible line from line to line +
visible_amount. Can also count backwards. For example if a TextEdit has
5 lines with lines 2 and 3 hidden, calling this with line = 1,
visible_amount = 1 would return 3.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_pos_at_line_column:
Returns the local position for the given line and column. If x or y of
the returned vector equal -1, the position is outside of the viewable
area of the control. Note: The Y position corresponds to the bottom side
of the line. Use get_rect_at_line_column to get the top side position.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_previous_composite_c:
Returns the correct column at the start of a composite character like
❤️‍🩹 (mending heart; Unicode: U+2764 U+FE0F U+200D U+1FA79) which is
comprised of more than one Unicode code point, if the caret is at the
end of the composite character. Also returns the correct column with the
caret at mid grapheme and for non-composite characters. Note: To check
at...
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_rect_at_line_column:
Returns the local position and size for the grapheme at the given line
and column. If x or y position of the returned rect equal -1, the
position is outside of the viewable area of the control. Note: The Y
position of the returned rect corresponds to the top side of the line,
unlike get_pos_at_line_column which returns the bottom side.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_saved_version: Returns the last tagged saved version from tag_saved_version.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_scroll_pos_for_line: Returns the scroll position for wrap_index of line.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_selected_text:
Returns the text inside the selection of a caret, or all the carets if
caret_index is its default value -1.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_selection_at_line_co:
Returns the caret index of the selection at the given line and column,
or -1 if there is none. If include_edges is false, the position must be
inside the selection and not at either end. If only_selections is false,
carets without a selection will also be considered.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_selection_column: Returns the original start column of the selection.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_selection_from_colum:
Returns the selection begin column. Returns the caret column if there is
no selection.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_selection_from_line:
Returns the selection begin line. Returns the caret line if there is no
selection.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_selection_line: Returns the original start line of the selection.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_selection_origin_col:
Returns the origin column of the selection. This is the opposite end
from the caret.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_selection_origin_lin:
Returns the origin line of the selection. This is the opposite end from
the caret.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_selection_to_column:
Returns the selection end column. Returns the caret column if there is
no selection.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_selection_to_line:
Returns the selection end line. Returns the caret line if there is no
selection.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_sorted_carets:
Returns the carets sorted by selection beginning from lowest line and
column to highest (from top to bottom of text). If
include_ignored_carets is false, carets from
multicaret_edit_ignore_caret will be ignored.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_total_gutter_width: Returns the total width of all gutters and internal padding.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_total_visible_line_c:
Returns the total number of lines in the text. This includes wrapped
lines and excludes folded lines. If wrap_mode is set to
LINE_WRAPPING_NONE and no lines are folded (see CodeEdit.is_line_folded)
then this is equivalent to get_line_count. See
get_visible_line_count_in_range for a limited range of lines.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_v_scroll_bar: Returns the VScrollBar of the TextEdit.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_version:
Returns the current version of the TextEdit. The version is a count of
recorded operations by the undo/redo history.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_visible_line_count:
Returns the number of lines that can visually fit, rounded down, based
on this control's height.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_visible_line_count_i:
Returns the total number of lines between from_line and to_line
(inclusive) in the text. This includes wrapped lines and excludes folded
lines. If the range covers all lines it is equivalent to
get_total_visible_line_count.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/get_word_under_caret: Returns a String text with the word under the caret's location.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/has_ime_text: Returns true if the user has text in the Input Method Editor (IME).
descriptions.TextEdit/method/has_redo: Returns true if a "redo" action is available.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/has_selection: Returns true if the user has selected text.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/has_undo: Returns true if an "undo" action is available.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/insert_line_at: Inserts a new line with text at line.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/insert_text:
Inserts the text at line and column. If before_selection_begin is true,
carets and selections that begin at line and column will moved to the
end of the inserted text, along with all carets after it. If
before_selection_end is true, selections that end at line and column
will be extended to the end of the inserted text. These parameters can
be used to...
descriptions.TextEdit/method/insert_text_at_caret: Insert the specified text at the caret position.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/is_caret_after_selection:
Returns true if the caret of the selection is after the selection
origin. This can be used to determine the direction of the selection.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/is_caret_visible:
Returns true if the caret is visible, false otherwise. A caret will be
considered hidden if it is outside the scrollable area when scrolling is
enabled. Note: is_caret_visible does not account for a caret being
off-screen if it is still within the scrollable area. It will return
true even if the caret is off-screen as long as it meets TextEdit's
own...
descriptions.TextEdit/method/is_dragging_cursor:
Returns true if the user is dragging their mouse for scrolling,
selecting, or text dragging.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/is_gutter_clickable:
Returns true if the gutter at the given index is clickable. See
set_gutter_clickable.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/is_gutter_drawn:
Returns true if the gutter at the given index is currently drawn. See
set_gutter_draw.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/is_gutter_overwritable:
Returns true if the gutter at the given index is overwritable. See
set_gutter_overwritable.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/is_in_mulitcaret_edit:
Returns true if a begin_multicaret_edit has been called and
end_multicaret_edit has not yet been called.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/is_line_gutter_clickable:
Returns true if the gutter at the given index on the given line is
clickable. See set_line_gutter_clickable.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/is_line_in_viewport:
Returns true if the given line is within the scope of the scrollable
area of the viewport.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/is_line_wrapped: Returns if the given line is wrapped.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/is_menu_visible:
Returns true if the menu is visible. Use this instead of
get_menu().visible to improve performance (so the creation of the menu
is avoided). See get_menu.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/is_mouse_over_selection:
Returns true if the mouse is over a selection. If edges is true, the
edges are considered part of the selection.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/is_overtype_mode_enabled: Returns true if overtype mode is enabled. See set_overtype_mode_enabled.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/menu_option: Executes a given action as defined in the MenuItems enum.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/merge_gutters:
Merge the gutters from from_line into to_line. Only overwritable gutters
will be copied. See set_gutter_overwritable.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/merge_overlapping_carets:
Merges any overlapping carets. Will favor the newest caret, or the caret
with a selection. If is_in_mulitcaret_edit is true, the merge will be
queued to happen at the end of the multicaret edit. See
begin_multicaret_edit and end_multicaret_edit. Note: This is not called
when a caret changes position but after certain actions, so it is
possible to get...
descriptions.TextEdit/method/multicaret_edit_ignore_c:
Returns true if the given caret_index should be ignored as part of a
multicaret edit. See begin_multicaret_edit and end_multicaret_edit.
Carets that should be ignored are ones that were part of removed text
and will likely be merged at the end of the edit, or carets that were
added during the edit. It is recommended to continue within a loop
iterating on...
descriptions.TextEdit/method/paste: Paste at the current location. Can be overridden with _paste.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/remove_caret:
Removes the given caret index. Note: This can result in adjustment of
all other caret indices.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/remove_gutter: Removes the gutter at the given index.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/remove_line_at:
Removes the line of text at line. Carets on this line will attempt to
match their previous visual x position. If move_carets_down is true
carets will move to the next line down, otherwise carets will move up.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/remove_text: Removes text between the given positions.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/search:
Perform a search inside the text. Search flags can be specified in the
SearchFlags enum. In the returned vector, x is the column, y is the
line. If no results are found, both are equal to -1.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/select:
Selects text from origin_line and origin_column to caret_line and
caret_column for the given caret_index. This moves the selection origin
and the caret. If the positions are the same, the selection will be
deselected. If selecting_enabled is false, no selection will occur.
Note: If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any overlap.
See...
descriptions.TextEdit/method/select_all:
Select all the text. If selecting_enabled is false, no selection will
occur.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/select_word_under_caret: Selects the word under the caret.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_caret_column:
Moves the caret to the specified column index. If adjust_viewport is
true, the viewport will center at the caret position after the move
occurs. Note: If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any
overlap. See merge_overlapping_carets.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_caret_line:
Moves the caret to the specified line index. The caret column will be
moved to the same visual position it was at the last time
set_caret_column was called, or clamped to the end of the line. If
adjust_viewport is true, the viewport will center at the caret position
after the move occurs. If can_be_hidden is true, the specified line can
be hidden. If...
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_gutter_clickable:
If true, the mouse cursor will change to a pointing hand
(Control.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND) when hovering over the gutter at the
given index. See is_gutter_clickable and set_line_gutter_clickable.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_gutter_custom_draw:
Set a custom draw callback for the gutter at the given index.
draw_callback must take the following arguments: A line index int, a
gutter index int, and an area Rect2. This callback only works when the
gutter type is GUTTER_TYPE_CUSTOM (see set_gutter_type).
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_gutter_draw:
If true, the gutter at the given index is drawn. The gutter type
(set_gutter_type) determines how it is drawn. See is_gutter_drawn.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_gutter_name: Sets the name of the gutter at the given index.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_gutter_overwritable:
If true, the line data of the gutter at the given index can be
overridden when using merge_gutters. See is_gutter_overwritable.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_gutter_type:
Sets the type of gutter at the given index. Gutters can contain icons,
text, or custom visuals.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_gutter_width: Set the width of the gutter at the given index.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_line:
Sets the text for a specific line. Carets on the line will attempt to
keep their visual x position.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_line_as_center_visib: Positions the wrap_index of line at the center of the viewport.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_line_as_first_visibl: Positions the wrap_index of line at the top of the viewport.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_line_as_last_visible: Positions the wrap_index of line at the bottom of the viewport.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_line_background_colo:
Sets the custom background color of the given line. If transparent, this
color is applied on top of the default background color (See
background_color). If set to Color(0, 0, 0, 0), no additional color is
applied.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_line_gutter_clickabl:
If clickable is true, makes the gutter on the given line clickable. This
is like set_gutter_clickable, but for a single line. If
is_gutter_clickable is true, this will not have any effect. See
is_line_gutter_clickable and gutter_clicked.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_line_gutter_icon:
Sets the icon for gutter on line to icon. This only works when the
gutter type is GUTTER_TYPE_ICON (see set_gutter_type).
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_line_gutter_item_col: Sets the color for gutter on line to color.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_line_gutter_metadata: Sets the metadata for gutter on line to metadata.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_line_gutter_text:
Sets the text for gutter on line to text. This only works when the
gutter type is GUTTER_TYPE_STRING (see set_gutter_type).
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_overtype_mode_enable:
If true, enables overtype mode. In this mode, typing overrides existing
text instead of inserting text. The
ProjectSettings.input/ui_text_toggle_insert_mode action toggles overtype
mode. See is_overtype_mode_enabled.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_search_flags:
Sets the search flags. This is used with set_search_text to highlight
occurrences of the searched text. Search flags can be specified from the
SearchFlags enum.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_search_text: Sets the search text. See set_search_flags.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_selection_origin_col:
Sets the selection origin column to the column for the given
caret_index. If the selection origin is moved to the caret position, the
selection will deselect.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_selection_origin_lin:
Sets the selection origin line to the line for the given caret_index. If
the selection origin is moved to the caret position, the selection will
deselect. If can_be_hidden is false, The line will be set to the nearest
unhidden line below or above. If wrap_index is -1, the selection origin
column will be clamped to the line's length. If wrap_index is...
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_tab_size: Sets the tab size for the TextEdit to use.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/set_tooltip_request_func:
Provide custom tooltip text. The callback method must take the following
args: hovered_word: String.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/skip_selection_for_next_:
Moves a selection and a caret for the next occurrence of the current
selection. If there is no active selection, moves to the next occurrence
of the word under caret.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/start_action:
Starts an action, will end the current action if action is different. An
action will also end after a call to end_action, after
ProjectSettings.gui/timers/text_edit_idle_detect_sec is triggered or a
new undoable step outside the start_action and end_action calls.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/swap_lines: Swaps the two lines. Carets will be swapped with the lines.
descriptions.TextEdit/method/tag_saved_version: Tag the current version as saved.
descriptions.TextEdit/signal/caret_changed: Emitted when any caret changes position.
descriptions.TextEdit/signal/gutter_added: Emitted when a gutter is added.
descriptions.TextEdit/signal/gutter_clicked: Emitted when a gutter is clicked.
descriptions.TextEdit/signal/gutter_removed: Emitted when a gutter is removed.
descriptions.TextEdit/signal/lines_edited_from:
Emitted immediately when the text changes. When text is added from_line
will be less than to_line. On a remove to_line will be less than
from_line.
descriptions.TextEdit/signal/text_set: Emitted when clear is called or text is set.
descriptions.TextLine/method/add_object:
Adds inline object to the text buffer, key must be unique. In the text,
object is represented as length object replacement characters.
descriptions.TextLine/method/add_string: Adds text span and font to draw it.
descriptions.TextLine/method/clear: Clears text line (removes text and inline objects).
descriptions.TextLine/method/draw:
Draw text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos
specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is
greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise
viewport oversampling settings are used.
descriptions.TextLine/method/draw_outline:
Draw text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos
specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is
greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise
viewport oversampling settings are used.
descriptions.TextLine/method/get_inferred_direction: Returns the text writing direction inferred by the BiDi algorithm.
descriptions.TextLine/method/get_line_ascent:
Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for
horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).
descriptions.TextLine/method/get_line_descent:
Returns the text descent (number of pixels below the baseline for
horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).
descriptions.TextLine/method/get_line_underline_posit: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
descriptions.TextLine/method/get_line_width:
Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the
text.
descriptions.TextLine/method/get_object_rect: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.
descriptions.TextLine/method/get_size: Returns size of the bounding box of the text.
descriptions.TextLine/method/has_object: Returns true if an object with key is embedded in this line.
descriptions.TextLine/method/hit_test:
Returns caret character offset at the specified pixel offset at the
baseline. This function always returns a valid position.
descriptions.TextLine/method/resize_object: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.
descriptions.TextLine/method/set_bidi_override:
Overrides BiDi for the structured text. Override ranges should cover
full source text without overlaps. BiDi algorithm will be used on each
range separately.
descriptions.TextLine/method/tab_align: Aligns text to the given tab-stops.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/add_object:
Adds inline object to the text buffer, key must be unique. In the text,
object is represented as length object replacement characters.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/add_string: Adds text span and font to draw it.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/clear: Clears text paragraph (removes text and inline objects).
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/draw:
Draw all lines of the text and drop cap into a canvas item at a given
position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding
box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font
oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/draw_dropcap:
Draw drop cap into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos
specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is
greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise
viewport oversampling settings are used.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/draw_dropcap_outlin:
Draw drop cap outline into a canvas item at a given position, with
color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If
oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling
factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/draw_line:
Draw single line of text into a canvas item at a given position, with
color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If
oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling
factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/draw_line_outline:
Draw outline of the single line of text into a canvas item at a given
position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding
box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font
oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/draw_outline:
Draw outlines of all lines of the text and drop cap into a canvas item
at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of
the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as
font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are
used.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_dropcap_lines: Returns number of lines used by dropcap.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_dropcap_rid: Returns drop cap text buffer RID.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_dropcap_size: Returns drop cap bounding box size.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_inferred_direct: Returns the text writing direction inferred by the BiDi algorithm.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_line_ascent:
Returns the text line ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for
horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_line_count: Returns number of lines in the paragraph.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_line_descent:
Returns the text line descent (number of pixels below the baseline for
horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_line_object_rec: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_line_objects: Returns array of inline objects in the line.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_line_range: Returns character range of the line.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_line_size:
Returns size of the bounding box of the line of text. Returned size is
rounded up.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_line_underline_: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_line_width:
Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the
line of text.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_non_wrapped_siz:
Returns the size of the bounding box of the paragraph, without line
breaks.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_range: Returns the character range of the paragraph.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_rid: Returns TextServer full string buffer RID.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/get_size: Returns the size of the bounding box of the paragraph.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/has_object:
Returns true if an object with key is embedded in this shaped text
buffer.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/hit_test:
Returns caret character offset at the specified coordinates. This
function always returns a valid position.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/resize_object: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/set_bidi_override:
Overrides BiDi for the structured text. Override ranges should cover
full source text without overlaps. BiDi algorithm will be used on each
range separately.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/set_dropcap:
Sets drop cap, overrides previously set drop cap. Drop cap (dropped
capital) is a decorative element at the beginning of a paragraph that is
larger than the rest of the text.
descriptions.TextParagraph/method/tab_align: Aligns paragraph to the given tab-stops.
descriptions.TextServer/method/create_font:
Creates a new, empty font cache entry resource. To free the resulting
resource, use the free_rid method.
descriptions.TextServer/method/create_font_linked_var:
Creates a new variation existing font which is reusing the same glyph
cache and font data. To free the resulting resource, use the free_rid
method.
descriptions.TextServer/method/create_shaped_text:
Creates a new buffer for complex text layout, with the given direction
and orientation. To free the resulting buffer, use free_rid method.
Note: Direction is ignored if server does not support
FEATURE_BIDI_LAYOUT feature (supported by TextServerAdvanced). Note:
Orientation is ignored if server does not support
FEATURE_VERTICAL_LAYOUT feature (supported...
descriptions.TextServer/method/draw_hex_code_box:
Draws box displaying character hexadecimal code. Used for replacing
missing characters.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_clear_glyphs:
Removes all rendered glyph information from the cache entry. Note: This
function will not remove textures associated with the glyphs, use
font_remove_texture to remove them manually.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_clear_size_cache: Removes all font sizes from the cache entry.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_clear_system_fall: Frees all automatically loaded system fonts.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_clear_textures:
Removes all textures from font cache entry. Note: This function will not
remove glyphs associated with the texture, use font_remove_glyph to
remove them manually.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_draw_glyph:
Draws single glyph into a canvas item at the position, using font_rid at
the size size. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font
oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
Note: Glyph index is specific to the font, use glyphs indices returned
by shaped_text_get_glyphs or font_get_glyph_index. Note: If there...
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_draw_glyph_outlin:
Draws single glyph outline of size outline_size into a canvas item at
the position, using font_rid at the size size. If oversampling is
greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise
viewport oversampling settings are used. Note: Glyph index is specific
to the font, use glyphs indices returned by shaped_text_get_glyphs or...
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_ascent: Returns the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_baseline_offs: Returns extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_char_from_gly:
Returns character code associated with glyph_index, or 0 if glyph_index
is invalid. See font_get_glyph_index.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_descent: Returns the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_disable_embed: Returns whether the font's embedded bitmap loading is disabled.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_face_count: Returns number of faces in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_face_index: Returns an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_generate_mipm: Returns true if font texture mipmap generation is enabled.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_global_oversa: This method does nothing and always returns 1.0.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_glyph_advance:
Returns glyph advance (offset of the next glyph). Note: Advance for
glyphs outlines is the same as the base glyph advance and is not saved.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_glyph_contour:
Returns outline contours of the glyph as a Dictionary with the following
contents: points - PackedVector3Array, containing outline points. x and
y are point coordinates. z is the type of the point, using the
ContourPointTag values. contours - PackedInt32Array, containing indices
the end points of each contour. orientation - bool, contour orientation.
If...
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_glyph_index:
Returns the glyph index of a char, optionally modified by the
variation_selector. See font_get_char_from_glyph_index.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_glyph_list: Returns list of rendered glyphs in the cache entry.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_glyph_offset: Returns glyph offset from the baseline.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_glyph_texture: Returns index of the cache texture containing the glyph.

Returns resource ID of the cache texture containing the glyph. Note: If
there are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger
the texture cache update.

Returns size of the cache texture containing the glyph. Note: If there
are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger the
texture cache update.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_glyph_uv_rect: Returns rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_hinting: Returns the font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_keep_rounding:
Returns glyph position rounding behavior. If set to true, when aligning
glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to
ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if
subpixel positioning is enabled.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_kerning: Returns kerning for the pair of glyphs.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_kerning_list: Returns list of the kerning overrides.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_language_supp: Returns true if support override is enabled for the language.
Returns list of language support overrides.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_msdf_pixel_ra:
Returns the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and
maximum representable signed distance.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_msdf_size: Returns source font size used to generate MSDF textures.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_opentype_feat: Returns font OpenType feature set override.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_ot_name_strin:
Returns Dictionary with OpenType font name strings (localized font
names, version, description, license information, sample text, etc.).
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_oversampling:
Returns oversampling factor override. If set to a positive value,
overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in.
See Viewport.oversampling. This value doesn't override the oversampling
parameter of draw_* methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_palette_color:
Returns the array in the predefined color palette at index. Palette
contains all colors used to render font glyphs. Each palette has the
same number of colors. Colors can be overridden using
font_set_palette_custom_colors.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_palette_count:
Returns the number of predefined color palettes. Palette contains all
colors used to render font glyphs. Each palette has the same number of
colors.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_palette_custo: Returns array of custom colors to override predefined palette.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_palette_name:
Returns the name of the predefined color palette at index. Palette
contains all colors used to render font glyphs. Each palette has the
same number of colors.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_scale: Returns scaling factor of the color bitmap font.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_script_suppor: Returns true if support override is enabled for the script.
Returns list of script support overrides.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_size_cache_in:
Returns font cache information, each entry contains the following
fields: Vector2i size_px - font size in pixels, float
viewport_oversampling - viewport oversampling factor, int glyphs -
number of rendered glyphs, int textures - number of used textures, int
textures_size - size of texture data in bytes.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_size_cache_li:
Returns list of the font sizes in the cache. Each size is Vector2i with
font size and outline size.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_spacing:
Returns the spacing for spacing in pixels (not relative to the font
size).
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_stretch:
Returns font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage
value between 50% and 200%.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_subpixel_posi: Returns font subpixel glyph positioning mode.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_supported_cha: Returns a string containing all the characters available in the font.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_supported_gly: Returns an array containing all glyph indices in the font.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_texture_count: Returns number of textures used by font cache entry.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_texture_image: Returns font cache texture image data.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_texture_offse: Returns array containing glyph packing data.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_transform: Returns 2D transform applied to the font outlines.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_underline_pos: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_underline_thi: Returns thickness of the underline in pixels.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_variation_coo:
Returns variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry. See
font_supported_variation_list for more info.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_get_weight:
Returns weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range,
normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_has_char: Returns true if a Unicode char is available in the font.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_is_allow_system_f: Returns true if system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_is_force_autohint:
Returns true if auto-hinting is supported and preferred over font
built-in hinting. Used by dynamic fonts only.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_is_language_suppo:
Returns true if the font supports the given language (as a ISO 639
code).
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_is_modulate_color:
Returns true if color modulation is applied when drawing the font's
colored glyphs.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_is_multichannel_s:
Returns true if glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single
multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font
vector data.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_is_script_support:
Returns true if the font supports the given script (as a ISO 15924
code).
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_remove_glyph:
Removes specified rendered glyph information from the cache entry. Note:
This function will not remove textures associated with the glyphs, use
font_remove_texture to remove them manually.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_remove_kerning: Removes kerning override for the pair of glyphs.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_remove_size_cache: Removes specified font size from the cache entry.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_remove_texture:
Removes specified texture from the cache entry. Note: This function will
not remove glyphs associated with the texture, remove them manually,
using font_remove_glyph.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_render_glyph: Renders specified glyph to the font cache texture.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_render_range: Renders the range of characters to the font cache texture.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_allow_system_: If set to true, system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.
