descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_ascent: Sets the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_baseline_offs: Sets extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_data: Sets font source data, e.g contents of the dynamic font source file.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_descent: Sets the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_disable_embed:
If set to true, embedded font bitmap loading is disabled (bitmap-only
and color fonts ignore this property).
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_embolden:
Sets font embolden strength. If strength is not equal to zero, emboldens
the font outlines. Negative values reduce the outline thickness.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_face_index: Sets an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_fixed_size:
Sets bitmap font fixed size. If set to value greater than zero, same
cache entry will be used for all font sizes.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_fixed_size_sc:
Sets bitmap font scaling mode. This property is used only if fixed_size
is greater than zero.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_force_autohin: If set to true auto-hinting is preferred over font built-in hinting.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_generate_mipm: If set to true font texture mipmap generation is enabled.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_glyph_advance:
Sets glyph advance (offset of the next glyph). Note: Advance for glyphs
outlines is the same as the base glyph advance and is not saved.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_glyph_offset: Sets glyph offset from the baseline.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_glyph_texture: Sets index of the cache texture containing the glyph.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_glyph_uv_rect: Sets rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_hinting: Sets font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_keep_rounding:
Sets glyph position rounding behavior. If set to true, when aligning
glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to
ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if
subpixel positioning is enabled.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_kerning: Sets kerning for the pair of glyphs.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_modulate_colo:
If set to true, color modulation is applied when drawing colored glyphs,
otherwise it's applied to the monochrome glyphs only.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_msdf_pixel_ra:
Sets the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and
maximum representable signed distance.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_msdf_size: Sets source font size used to generate MSDF textures.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_multichannel_:
If set to true, glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single
multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font
vector data. MSDF rendering allows displaying the font at any scaling
factor without blurriness, and without incurring a CPU cost when the
font size changes (since the font no longer needs to be rasterized on
the CPU). As a...
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_opentype_feat: Sets font OpenType feature set override.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_oversampling:
If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the
viewport this font is used in. See Viewport.oversampling. This value
doesn't override the oversampling parameter of draw_* methods. Used by
dynamic fonts only.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_palette_custo:
Sets array of custom colors to override predefined palette. Set to empty
array to reset overrides. Use Color(0, 0, 0, 0), to keep predefined
palette color at specific position.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_scale: Sets scaling factor of the color bitmap font.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_spacing:
Sets the spacing for spacing to value in pixels (not relative to the
font size).
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_stretch:
Sets font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value
between 50% and 200%. Note: This value is used for font matching only
and will not affect font rendering. Use font_set_face_index,
font_set_variation_coordinates, or font_set_transform instead.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_style:
Sets the font style flags. Note: This value is used for font matching
only and will not affect font rendering. Use font_set_face_index,
font_set_variation_coordinates, font_set_embolden, or font_set_transform
instead.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_subpixel_posi: Sets font subpixel glyph positioning mode.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_texture_image: Sets font cache texture image data.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_texture_offse: Sets array containing glyph packing data.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_transform:
Sets 2D transform, applied to the font outlines, can be used for
slanting, flipping, and rotating glyphs. For example, to simulate italic
typeface by slanting, apply the following transform Transform2D(1.0,
slant, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0).
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_underline_pos: Sets pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_underline_thi: Sets thickness of the underline in pixels.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_variation_coo:
Sets variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry. See
font_supported_variation_list for more info.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_set_weight:
Sets weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range,
normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700. Note: This value is
used for font matching only and will not affect font rendering. Use
font_set_face_index, font_set_variation_coordinates, or
font_set_embolden instead.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_supported_feature: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType features.
descriptions.TextServer/method/font_supported_variati: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType variation coordinates.
descriptions.TextServer/method/format_number:
Converts a number from Western Arabic (0..9) to the numeral system used
in the given language. If language is an empty string, the active locale
will be used.
descriptions.TextServer/method/free_rid: Frees an object created by this TextServer.
descriptions.TextServer/method/get_features: Returns text server features, see Feature.
descriptions.TextServer/method/get_hex_code_box_size:
Returns size of the replacement character (box with character
hexadecimal code that is drawn in place of invalid characters).
descriptions.TextServer/method/get_name: Returns the name of the server interface.
descriptions.TextServer/method/get_support_data:
Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and
dictionaries).
descriptions.TextServer/method/get_support_data_filen:
Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and
dictionaries) filename.
descriptions.TextServer/method/get_support_data_info:
Returns TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries)
description.
descriptions.TextServer/method/has: Returns true if rid is valid resource owned by this text server.
descriptions.TextServer/method/has_feature: Returns true if the server supports a feature.
descriptions.TextServer/method/is_confusable:
Returns index of the first string in dict which is visually confusable
with the string, or -1 if none is found. Note: This method doesn't
detect invisible characters, for spoof detection use it in combination
with spoof_check. Note: Always returns -1 if the server does not support
the FEATURE_UNICODE_SECURITY feature.
descriptions.TextServer/method/is_locale_right_to_lef: Returns true if locale is right-to-left.
descriptions.TextServer/method/is_locale_using_suppor:
Returns true if the locale requires text server support data for
line/word breaking.
descriptions.TextServer/method/is_valid_identifier:
Returns true if string is a valid identifier. If the text server
supports the FEATURE_UNICODE_IDENTIFIERS feature, a valid identifier
must: - Conform to normalization form C. - Begin with a Unicode
character of class XID_Start or "_". - May contain Unicode characters of
class XID_Continue in the other positions. - Use UAX #31 recommended
scripts only...
descriptions.TextServer/method/is_valid_letter:
Returns true if the given code point is a valid letter, i.e. it belongs
to the Unicode category "L".
descriptions.TextServer/method/load_support_data:
Loads optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and
dictionaries). Note: This function should be called before any other
TextServer functions used, otherwise it won't have any effect.
descriptions.TextServer/method/name_to_tag:
Converts the given readable name of a feature, variation, script, or
language to an OpenType tag.
descriptions.TextServer/method/parse_number:
Converts number from the numeral system used in the given language to
Western Arabic (0..9). If language is an empty string, the active locale
will be used.
descriptions.TextServer/method/parse_structured_text: Default implementation of the BiDi algorithm override function.
descriptions.TextServer/method/percent_sign:
Returns the percent sign used in the given language. If language is an
empty string, the active locale will be used.
descriptions.TextServer/method/save_support_data:
Saves optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and
dictionaries) to the file. Note: This function is used by during project
export, to include TextServer database.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_get_run_count: Returns the number of uniform text runs in the buffer.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_get_run_directi: Returns the direction of the index text run (in visual order).
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_get_run_font_ri: Returns the font RID of the index text run (in visual order).
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_get_run_font_si: Returns the font size of the index text run (in visual order).
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_get_run_glyph_r: Returns the glyph range of the index text run (in visual order).
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_get_run_languag: Returns the language of the index text run (in visual order).
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_get_run_object: Returns the embedded object of the index text run (in visual order).
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_get_run_range: Returns the source text range of the index text run (in visual order).
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_get_run_text: Returns the source text of the index text run (in visual order).
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_get_span_count:
Returns number of text spans added using shaped_text_add_string or
shaped_text_add_object.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_get_span_object: Returns the text span embedded object key.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_get_span_text: Returns the text span source text.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_get_text:
Returns the text buffer source text, including object replacement
characters.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_set_span_update:
Changes text span font, font size, and OpenType features, without
changing the text.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_add_object:
Adds inline object to the text buffer, key must be unique. In the text,
object is represented as length object replacement characters.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_add_string: Adds text span and font to draw it to the text buffer.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_clear: Clears text buffer (removes text and inline objects).
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_closest_ch: Returns composite character position closest to the pos.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_draw:
Draw shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos
specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or
topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If oversampling is
greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise
viewport oversampling settings are used. clip_l and clip_r are
offsets...
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_draw_outli:
Draw the outline of the shaped text into a canvas item at a given
position, with color. pos specifies the leftmost point of the baseline
(for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical
layout). If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font
oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
clip_l and...
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_fit_to_wid: Adjusts text width to fit to specified width, returns new text width.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_ascent:
Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for
horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical). Note:
Overall ascent can be higher than font ascent, if some glyphs are
displaced from the baseline.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_carets:
Returns shapes of the carets corresponding to the character offset
position in the text. Returned caret shape is 1 pixel wide rectangle.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_charac: Returns array of the composite character boundaries.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_custom: Returns ellipsis character used for text clipping.

Returns custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If
set to empty string, server defaults are used.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_descen:
Returns the text descent (number of pixels below the baseline for
horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical). Note:
Overall descent can be higher than font descent, if some glyphs are
displaced from the baseline.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_domina: Returns dominant direction of in the range of text.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_ellips: Returns number of glyphs in the ellipsis.
Returns array of the glyphs in the ellipsis.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_glyph_: Returns number of glyphs in the buffer.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_glyphs: Returns an array of glyphs in the visual order.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_graphe:
Returns composite character's bounds as offsets from the start of the
line.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_inferr: Returns direction of the text, inferred by the BiDi algorithm.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_line_b: Breaks text to the lines and returns character ranges for each line.

Breaks text to the lines and columns. Returns character ranges for each
segment.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_object: Returns the glyph index of the inline object.
Returns the character range of the inline object.
Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_parent: Returns the parent buffer from which the substring originates.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_preser: Returns true if text buffer is configured to display control characters.

Returns true if text buffer is configured to display hexadecimal codes
in place of invalid characters. Note: If set to false, nothing is
displayed in place of invalid characters.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_range: Returns substring buffer character range in the parent buffer.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_select: Returns selection rectangles for the specified character range.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_spacin: Returns extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_trim_p: Returns the position of the overrun trim.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_underl: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_width:
Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the
text.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_get_word_b:
Breaks text into words and returns array of character ranges. Use
grapheme_flags to set what characters are used for breaking.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_has_object:
Returns true if an object with key is embedded in this shaped text
buffer.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_has_visibl: Returns true if text buffer contains any visible characters.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_hit_test_g:
Returns grapheme index at the specified pixel offset at the baseline, or
-1 if none is found.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_hit_test_p:
Returns caret character offset at the specified pixel offset at the
baseline. This function always returns a valid position.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_is_ready: Returns true if buffer is successfully shaped.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_next_chara: Returns composite character end position closest to the pos.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_next_graph: Returns grapheme end position closest to the pos.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_overrun_tr: Trims text if it exceeds the given width.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_prev_chara: Returns composite character start position closest to the pos.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_prev_graph: Returns grapheme start position closest to the pos.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_resize_obj: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_set_bidi_o:
Overrides BiDi for the structured text. Override ranges should cover
full source text without overlaps. BiDi algorithm will be used on each
range separately.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_set_custom: Sets ellipsis character used for text clipping.

Sets custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set
to empty string, server defaults are used.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_set_direct:
Sets desired text direction. If set to DIRECTION_AUTO, direction will be
detected based on the buffer contents and current locale. Note:
Direction is ignored if server does not support FEATURE_BIDI_LAYOUT
feature (supported by TextServerAdvanced).
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_set_orient:
Sets desired text orientation. Note: Orientation is ignored if server
does not support FEATURE_VERTICAL_LAYOUT feature (supported by
TextServerAdvanced).
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_set_preser: If set to true text buffer will display control characters.

If set to true text buffer will display invalid characters as
hexadecimal codes, otherwise nothing is displayed.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_set_spacin: Sets extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_shape:
Shapes buffer if it's not shaped. Returns true if the string is shaped
successfully. Note: It is not necessary to call this function manually,
buffer will be shaped automatically as soon as any of its output data is
requested.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_sort_logic: Returns text glyphs in the logical order.
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_substr:
Returns text buffer for the substring of the text in the shaped text
buffer (including inline objects).
descriptions.TextServer/method/shaped_text_tab_align: Aligns shaped text to the given tab-stops.
descriptions.TextServer/method/spoof_check:
Returns true if string is likely to be an attempt at confusing the
reader. Note: Always returns false if the server does not support the
FEATURE_UNICODE_SECURITY feature.
descriptions.TextServer/method/string_get_character_b: Returns array of the composite character boundaries.
descriptions.TextServer/method/string_get_word_breaks:
Returns an array of the word break boundaries. Elements in the returned
array are the offsets of the start and end of words. Therefore the
length of the array is always even. When chars_per_line is greater than
zero, line break boundaries are returned instead.
descriptions.TextServer/method/string_to_lower:
Returns the string converted to lowercase. Note: Casing is locale
dependent and context sensitive if server support
FEATURE_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE_CASE_CONVERSION feature (supported by
TextServerAdvanced). Note: The result may be longer or shorter than the
original.
descriptions.TextServer/method/string_to_title:
Returns the string converted to Title Case. Note: Casing is locale
dependent and context sensitive if server support
FEATURE_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE_CASE_CONVERSION feature (supported by
TextServerAdvanced). Note: The result may be longer or shorter than the
original.
descriptions.TextServer/method/string_to_upper:
Returns the string converted to UPPERCASE. Note: Casing is locale
dependent and context sensitive if server support
FEATURE_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE_CASE_CONVERSION feature (supported by
TextServerAdvanced). Note: The result may be longer or shorter than the
original.
descriptions.TextServer/method/strip_diacritics:
Strips diacritics from the string. Note: The result may be longer or
shorter than the original.
descriptions.TextServer/method/tag_to_name:
Converts the given OpenType tag to the readable name of a feature,
variation, script, or language.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_cleanup: This method is called before text server is unregistered.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_create_font: Creates a new, empty font cache entry resource.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_create_font_:
Optional, implement if font supports extra spacing or baseline offset.
Creates a new variation existing font which is reusing the same glyph
cache and font data.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_create_shape:
Creates a new buffer for complex text layout, with the given direction
and orientation.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_draw_hex_cod: Draws box displaying character hexadecimal code.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_clear_g: Removes all rendered glyph information from the cache entry.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_clear_s: Removes all font sizes from the cache entry.
Frees all automatically loaded system fonts.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_clear_t: Removes all textures from font cache entry.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_draw_gl:
Draws single glyph into a canvas item at the position, using font_rid at
the size size. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font
oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

Draws single glyph outline of size outline_size into a canvas item at
the position, using font_rid at the size size. If oversampling is
greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise
viewport oversampling settings are used.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_asc: Returns the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_bas: Returns extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_cha:
Returns character code associated with glyph_index, or 0 if glyph_index
is invalid.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_des: Returns the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_dis: Returns whether the font's embedded bitmap loading is disabled.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_fac: Returns number of faces in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
Returns an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_gen: Returns true if font texture mipmap generation is enabled.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_glo:
Returns the font oversampling factor, shared by all fonts in the
TextServer.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_gly: Returns glyph advance (offset of the next glyph).
Returns outline contours of the glyph.

Returns the glyph index of a char, optionally modified by the
variation_selector.

Returns size of the cache texture containing the glyph.
Returns rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_hin: Returns the font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_kee:
Returns glyph position rounding behavior. If set to true, when aligning
glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to
ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if
subpixel positioning is enabled.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_ker: Returns kerning for the pair of glyphs.
Returns list of the kerning overrides.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_lan: Returns true if support override is enabled for the language.
Returns list of language support overrides.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_msd:
Returns the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and
maximum representable signed distance.
Returns source font size used to generate MSDF textures.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_ope: Returns font OpenType feature set override.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_ot_:
Returns Dictionary with OpenType font name strings (localized font
names, version, description, license information, sample text, etc.).
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_ove:
Returns oversampling factor override. If set to a positive value,
overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in.
See Viewport.oversampling. This value doesn't override the oversampling
parameter of draw_* methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_pal:
Returns the array in the predefined color palette at index. Palette
contains all colors used to render font glyphs. Each palette has the
same number of colors. Colors can be overridden using
_font_set_palette_custom_colors.

Returns the number of predefined color palettes. Palette contains all
colors used to render font glyphs. Each palette has the same number of
colors.

Returns the name of the predefined color palette at index. Palette
contains all colors used to render font glyphs. Each palette has the
same number of colors.

descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_scr: Returns true if support override is enabled for the script.
Returns list of script support overrides.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_siz:
Returns font cache information, each entry contains the following
fields: Vector2i size_px - font size in pixels, float
viewport_oversampling - viewport oversampling factor, int glyphs -
number of rendered glyphs, int textures - number of used textures, int
textures_size - size of texture data in bytes.

Returns list of the font sizes in the cache. Each size is Vector2i with
font size and outline size.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_spa:
Returns the spacing for spacing in pixels (not relative to the font
size).
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_str:
Returns font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage
value between 50% and 200%.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_sub: Returns font subpixel glyph positioning mode.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_sup: Returns a string containing all the characters available in the font.
Returns an array containing all glyph indices in the font.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_tex: Returns number of textures used by font cache entry.
Returns font cache texture image data.
Returns array containing glyph packing data.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_tra: Returns 2D transform applied to the font outlines.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_und: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
Returns thickness of the underline in pixels.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_var: Returns variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_get_wei:
Returns weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range,
normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_has_cha: Returns true if a Unicode char is available in the font.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_is_allo: Returns true if system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_is_forc:
Returns true if auto-hinting is supported and preferred over font
built-in hinting.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_is_lang:
Returns true if the font supports the given language (as a ISO 639
code).
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_is_modu:
Returns true if color modulation is applied when drawing the font's
colored glyphs.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_is_mult:
Returns true if glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single
multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font
vector data.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_is_scri:
Returns true if the font supports the given script (as a ISO 15924
code).
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_remove_: Removes specified rendered glyph information from the cache entry.

descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_render_: Renders specified glyph to the font cache texture.

descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_all: If set to true, system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_asc: Sets the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).

source file.

Sets font embolden strength. If strength is not equal to zero, emboldens
the font outlines. Negative values reduce the outline thickness.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_fac: Sets an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_fix:
Sets bitmap font fixed size. If set to value greater than zero, same
cache entry will be used for all font sizes.

Sets bitmap font scaling mode. This property is used only if fixed_size
is greater than zero.

glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to
ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if
subpixel positioning is enabled.

If set to true, color modulation is applied when drawing colored glyphs,
otherwise it's applied to the monochrome glyphs only.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_msd:
Sets the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and
maximum representable signed distance.
Sets source font size used to generate MSDF textures.

If set to true, glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single
multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font
vector data. MSDF rendering allows displaying the font at any scaling
factor without blurriness, and without incurring a CPU cost when the
font size changes (since the font no longer needs to be rasterized on

descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_ope: Sets font OpenType feature set override.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_ove:
If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the
viewport this font is used in. See Viewport.oversampling. This value
doesn't override the oversampling parameter of draw_* methods. Used by
dynamic fonts only.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_pal:
Sets array of custom colors to override predefined palette. Set to empty
array to reset overrides. Use Color(0, 0, 0, 0), to keep predefined
palette color at specific position.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_sca: Sets scaling factor of the color bitmap font.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_spa:
Sets the spacing for spacing to value in pixels (not relative to the
font size).
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_str:
Sets font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value
between 50% and 200%.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_sub: Sets font subpixel glyph positioning mode.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_tex: Sets font cache texture image data.
Sets array containing glyph packing data.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_tra:
Sets 2D transform, applied to the font outlines, can be used for
slanting, flipping, and rotating glyphs.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_und: Sets pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
Sets thickness of the underline in pixels.

descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_set_wei:
Sets weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range,
normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_font_support: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType features.
Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType variation coordinates.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_format_numbe:
Converts a number from Western Arabic (0..9) to the numeral system used
in the given language. If language is an empty string, the active locale
will be used.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_free_rid: Frees an object created by this TextServer.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_get_features: Returns text server features, see TextServer.Feature.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_get_hex_code:
Returns size of the replacement character (box with character
hexadecimal code that is drawn in place of invalid characters).
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_get_name: Returns the name of the server interface.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_get_support_:
Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and
dictionaries).

Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and
dictionaries) filename.

description.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_has: Returns true if rid is valid resource owned by this text server.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_has_feature: Returns true if the server supports a feature.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_is_confusabl:
Returns index of the first string in dict which is visually confusable
with the string, or -1 if none is found.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_is_locale_ri: Returns true if locale is right-to-left.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_is_locale_us:
Returns true if the locale requires text server support data for
line/word breaking.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_is_valid_ide: Returns true if string is a valid identifier.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_load_support:

dictionaries).
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_name_to_tag:

language to an OpenType tag.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_parse_number:
Converts number from the numeral system used in the given language to
Western Arabic (0..9). If language is an empty string, the active locale
will be used.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_parse_struct: Default implementation of the BiDi algorithm override function.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_percent_sign: Returns percent sign used in the given language.
descriptions.TextServerExtension/method/_reference_ov:

Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for
