Sets the number of subdivisions to use in the specified quadrant. A
higher number of subdivisions allows you to have more shadows in the
scene at once, but reduces the quality of the shadows. A good practice
is to have quadrants with a varying number of subdivisions and to have
as few subdivisions as possible.
descriptions.Viewport/method/update_mouse_cursor_stat:
Force instantly updating the display based on the current mouse cursor
position. This includes updating the mouse cursor shape and sending
necessary Control.mouse_entered, CollisionObject2D.mouse_entered,
CollisionObject3D.mouse_entered and Window.mouse_entered signals and
their respective mouse_exited counterparts.
descriptions.Viewport/method/warp_mouse:
Moves the mouse pointer to the specified position in this Viewport using
the coordinate system of this Viewport. Note: warp_mouse is only
supported on Windows, macOS and Linux. It has no effect on Android, iOS
and Web.
descriptions.Viewport/signal/gui_focus_changed:
Emitted when a Control node grabs keyboard focus. Note: A Control node
losing focus doesn't cause this signal to be emitted.
descriptions.Viewport/signal/size_changed:
Emitted when the size of the viewport is changed, whether by resizing of
window, or some other means.
descriptions.VirtualJoystick/signal/flick_canceled: Emitted when the tip enters the deadzone after being outside of it.
descriptions.VirtualJoystick/signal/flicked:
Emitted when the tip moved outside the deadzone and the joystick is
released. The input_vector contains the last input direction and
strength before release. Its length is between 0.0 and 1.0.
descriptions.VirtualJoystick/signal/pressed: Emitted when the joystick is pressed.
descriptions.VirtualJoystick/signal/released:
Emitted when the joystick is released. The input_vector is the final
input direction and strength, with a length between 0.0 and 1.0.
descriptions.VirtualJoystick/signal/tapped: Emitted when the joystick is released without moving the tip.
descriptions.VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D/method/is_on_s:
If true, the bounding rectangle is on the screen. Note: It takes one
frame for the VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D's visibility to be determined
once added to the scene tree, so this method will always return false
right after it is instantiated, before the draw pass.
descriptions.VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D/signal/screen_: Emitted when the VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D enters the screen.
Emitted when the VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D exits the screen.
descriptions.VisibleOnScreenNotifier3D/method/is_on_s:
Returns true if the bounding box is on the screen. Note: It takes one
frame for the VisibleOnScreenNotifier3D's visibility to be assessed once
added to the scene tree, so this method will always return false right
after it is instantiated.
descriptions.VisibleOnScreenNotifier3D/signal/screen_: Emitted when the VisibleOnScreenNotifier3D enters the screen.
Emitted when the VisibleOnScreenNotifier3D exits the screen.
descriptions.VisualInstance3D/method/get_aabb:
Returns the AABB (also known as the bounding box) for this
VisualInstance3D.
descriptions.VisualInstance3D/method/get_base:
Returns the RID of the resource associated with this VisualInstance3D.
For example, if the Node is a MeshInstance3D, this will return the RID
of the associated Mesh.
descriptions.VisualInstance3D/method/get_instance:
Returns the RID of this instance. This RID is the same as the RID
returned by RenderingServer.instance_create. This RID is needed if you
want to call RenderingServer functions directly on this
VisualInstance3D.
descriptions.VisualInstance3D/method/get_layer_mask_v:
Returns whether or not the specified layer of the layers is enabled,
given a layer_number between 1 and 20.
descriptions.VisualInstance3D/method/set_base:
Sets the resource that is instantiated by this VisualInstance3D, which
changes how the engine handles the VisualInstance3D under the hood.
Equivalent to RenderingServer.instance_set_base.
descriptions.VisualInstance3D/method/set_layer_mask_v:
Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the layers,
given a layer_number between 1 and 20.
descriptions.VisualScript/method/get_graph:
Returns a copy of the authored graph data for editor and tool
integration. A new script has a version 1 graph with empty nodes and
connections arrays.
descriptions.VisualScript/method/get_graph_base:
Returns the name of the native Godot class that the graph script
extends. A new script defaults to Node.
descriptions.VisualScript/method/set_graph:
Replaces the authored graph data with a copy of graph. Supply the graph
format version, node records, and connections between their ports.
Include any authored declarations such as variables or functions. The
editor can hold incomplete drafts. The runtime reports graph errors
through Godot's output.
descriptions.VisualScript/method/set_graph_base:
Sets the name of the native Godot node class that the graph script
extends. Attach the script to that class or a class derived from it.
Godot's Attach Script dialog sets this value from the selected base.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/add_node: Adds the specified node to the shader.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/add_varying: Adds a new varying value node to the shader.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/attach_node_to_frame: Attaches the given node to the given frame.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/can_connect_nodes: Returns true if the specified nodes and ports can be connected together.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/connect_nodes: Connects the specified nodes and ports.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/connect_nodes_forced:
Connects the specified nodes and ports, even if they can't be connected.
Such connection is invalid and will not function properly.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/detach_node_from_fra: Detaches the given node from the frame it is attached to.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/disconnect_nodes: Connects the specified nodes and ports.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/get_node: Returns the shader node instance with specified type and id.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/get_node_connections: Returns the list of connected nodes with the specified type.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/get_node_list: Returns the list of all nodes in the shader with the specified type.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/get_node_position: Returns the position of the specified node within the shader graph.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/get_valid_node_id: Returns next valid node ID that can be added to the shader graph.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/has_varying: Returns true if the shader has a varying with the given name.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/is_node_connection: Returns true if the specified node and port connection exist.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/remove_node: Removes the specified node from the shader.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/remove_varying:
Removes a varying value node with the given name. Prints an error if a
node with this name is not found.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/replace_node: Replaces the specified node with a node of new class type.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/set_mode: Sets the mode of this shader.
descriptions.VisualShader/method/set_node_position: Sets the position of the specified node.
descriptions.VisualShaderNode/method/clear_default_in: Clears the default input ports value.
descriptions.VisualShaderNode/method/get_default_inpu:
Returns the input port which should be connected by default when this
node is created as a result of dragging a connection from an existing
node to the empty space on the graph.

Returns an Array containing default values for all of the input ports of
the node in the form [index0, value0, index1, value1, ...].
descriptions.VisualShaderNode/method/get_input_port_d: Returns the default value of the input port.
descriptions.VisualShaderNode/method/remove_input_por: Removes the default value of the input port.
descriptions.VisualShaderNode/method/set_default_inpu:
Sets the default input ports values using an Array of the form [index0,
value0, index1, value1, ...]. For example: [0, Vector3(0, 0, 0), 1,
Vector3(0, 0, 0)].
descriptions.VisualShaderNode/method/set_input_port_d: Sets the default value for the selected input port.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/_get_categ:
Override this method to define the path to the associated custom node in
the Visual Shader Editor's members dialog. The path may look like
"MyGame/MyFunctions/Noise". Defining this method is optional. If not
overridden, the node will be filed under the "Addons" category.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/_get_code:
Override this method to define the actual shader code of the associated
custom node. The shader code should be returned as a string, which can
have multiple lines (the """ multiline string construct can be used for
convenience). The input_vars and output_vars arrays contain the string
names of the various input and output variables, as defined by...
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/_get_defau:
Override this method to define the input port which should be connected
by default when this node is created as a result of dragging a
connection from an existing node to the empty space on the graph.
Defining this method is optional. If not overridden, the connection will
be created to the first valid port.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/_get_descr:
Override this method to define the description of the associated custom
node in the Visual Shader Editor's members dialog. Defining this method
is optional.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/_get_func_:
Override this method to add a shader code to the beginning of each
shader function (once). The shader code should be returned as a string,
which can have multiple lines (the """ multiline string construct can be
used for convenience). If there are multiple custom nodes of different
types which use this feature the order of each insertion is
undefined....
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/_get_globa:
Override this method to add shader code on top of the global shader, to
define your own standard library of reusable methods, varyings,
constants, uniforms, etc. The shader code should be returned as a
string, which can have multiple lines (the """ multiline string
construct can be used for convenience). Be careful with this
functionality as it can cause...
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/_get_input:
Override this method to define the number of input ports of the
associated custom node. Defining this method is required. If not
overridden, the node has no input ports.

Override this method to define the default value for the specified input
port. Prefer use this over
VisualShaderNode.set_input_port_default_value. Defining this method is
required. If not overridden, the node has no default values for their
input ports.

Override this method to define the names of input ports of the
associated custom node. The names are used both for the input slots in
the editor and as identifiers in the shader code, and are passed in the
input_vars array in _get_code. Defining this method is optional, but
recommended. If not overridden, input ports are named as "in" +
str(port).

Override this method to define the returned type of each input port of
the associated custom node. Defining this method is optional, but
recommended. If not overridden, input ports will return the
VisualShaderNode.PORT_TYPE_SCALAR type.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/_get_name:
Override this method to define the name of the associated custom node in
the Visual Shader Editor's members dialog and graph. Defining this
method is optional, but recommended. If not overridden, the node will be
named as "Unnamed".
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/_get_outpu:
Override this method to define the number of output ports of the
associated custom node. Defining this method is required. If not
overridden, the node has no output ports.

Override this method to define the names of output ports of the
associated custom node. The names are used both for the output slots in
the editor and as identifiers in the shader code, and are passed in the
output_vars array in _get_code. Defining this method is optional, but
recommended. If not overridden, output ports are named as "out" +
str(port).

Override this method to define the returned type of each output port of
the associated custom node. Defining this method is optional, but
recommended. If not overridden, output ports will return the
VisualShaderNode.PORT_TYPE_SCALAR type.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/_get_prope:
Override this method to define the number of the properties. Defining
this method is optional.

Override this method to define the default index of the property of the
associated custom node. Defining this method is optional.

Override this method to define the names of the property of the
associated custom node. Defining this method is optional.

Override this method to define the options inside the drop-down list
property of the associated custom node. Defining this method is
optional.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/_get_retur:
Override this method to define the return icon of the associated custom
node in the Visual Shader Editor's members dialog. Defining this method
is optional. If not overridden, no return icon is shown.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/_is_availa:
Override this method to prevent the node to be visible in the member
dialog for the certain mode and/or type. Defining this method is
optional. If not overridden, it's true.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/_is_highen:
Override this method to enable the high-end mark in the Visual Shader
Editor's members dialog. This should return true for nodes that only
work when using the Forward+ and Mobile renderers. Defining this method
is optional. If not overridden, it's false, which indicates this node
works with all renderers (including Compatibility).
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeCustom/method/get_option:
Returns the selected index of the drop-down list option within a graph.
You may use this function to define the specific behavior in the
_get_code or _get_global_code.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeFrame/method/add_attache:
Adds a node to the list of nodes attached to the frame. Should not be
called directly, use the VisualShader.attach_node_to_frame method
instead.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeFrame/method/remove_atta:
Removes a node from the list of nodes attached to the frame. Should not
be called directly, use the VisualShader.detach_node_from_frame method
instead.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeGroupBase/method/add_inp:
Adds an input port with the specified type (see
VisualShaderNode.PortType) and name.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeGroupBase/method/add_out:
Adds an output port with the specified type (see
VisualShaderNode.PortType) and name.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeGroupBase/method/clear_i: Removes all previously specified input ports.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeGroupBase/method/clear_o: Removes all previously specified output ports.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeGroupBase/method/get_fre: Returns a free input port ID which can be used in add_input_port.
Returns a free output port ID which can be used in add_output_port.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeGroupBase/method/get_inp:
Returns the number of input ports in use. Alternative for
get_free_input_port_id.

Returns a String description of the input ports as a colon-separated
list using the format id,type,name; (see add_input_port).
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeGroupBase/method/get_out:
Returns the number of output ports in use. Alternative for
get_free_output_port_id.

Returns a String description of the output ports as a colon-separated
list using the format id,type,name; (see add_output_port).
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeGroupBase/method/has_inp: Returns true if the specified input port exists.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeGroupBase/method/has_out: Returns true if the specified output port exists.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeGroupBase/method/is_vali:
Returns true if the specified port name does not override an existed
port name and is valid within the shader.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeGroupBase/method/set_inp: Sets the specified input port's type (see VisualShaderNode.PortType).

Defines all input ports using a String formatted as a colon-separated
list: id,type,name; (see add_input_port).
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeGroupBase/method/set_out: Sets the specified output port's type (see VisualShaderNode.PortType).

Defines all output ports using a String formatted as a colon-separated
list: id,type,name; (see add_output_port).
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeInput/method/get_input_r:
Returns a translated name of the current constant in the Godot Shader
Language. E.g. "ALBEDO" if the input_name equal to "albedo".
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeInput/signal/input_type_: Emitted when input is changed via input_name.
descriptions.VisualShaderNodeReroute/method/get_port_: Returns the port type of the reroute node.
descriptions.VoxelGI/method/bake:
Bakes the effect from all GeometryInstance3Ds marked with
GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_STATIC and Light3Ds marked with either
Light3D.BAKE_STATIC or Light3D.BAKE_DYNAMIC. If create_visual_debug is
true, after baking the light, this will generate a MultiMesh that has a
cube representing each solid cell with each cube colored to the cell's
albedo color. This...
descriptions.VoxelGIData/method/allocate:
Initializes this VoxelGIData with the specified data. octree_cells must
be a multiple of 32. octree_cells must be double the size of data_cells.
The allocated data can be retrieved later using the various getter
methods.
descriptions.VoxelGIData/method/get_bounds:
Returns the bounds of the baked voxel data as an AABB, which should
match VoxelGI.size after being baked (which only contains the size as a
Vector3). Note: If the size was modified without baking the VoxelGI
data, then the value of get_bounds and VoxelGI.size will not match.
descriptions.VoxelGIData/method/get_data_cells: Returns the baked cell data for this VoxelGIData.
descriptions.VoxelGIData/method/get_level_counts: Returns the baked level counts for this VoxelGIData.
descriptions.VoxelGIData/method/get_octree_cells: Returns the baked octree cell data for this VoxelGIData.
descriptions.VoxelGIData/method/get_octree_size:
Returns the baked octree size for this VoxelGIData, which corresponds to
the number of subdivisions per axis. This can be viewed in the editor by
hovering the Bake VoxelGI button at the top of the 3D editor viewport
when a VoxelGI node is selected and looking at the Subdivisions field in
the tooltip.
descriptions.VoxelGIData/method/get_to_cell_xform: Returns the baked cell transform for this VoxelGIData.
descriptions.WeakRef/method/get_ref:
Returns the Object this weakref is referring to. Returns null if that
object no longer exists.
descriptions.WebRTCDataChannel/method/close: Closes this data channel, notifying the other peer.
descriptions.WebRTCDataChannel/method/get_buffered_am:
Returns the number of bytes currently queued to be sent over this
channel.
descriptions.WebRTCDataChannel/method/get_id:
Returns the ID assigned to this channel during creation (or
auto-assigned during negotiation). If the channel is not negotiated
out-of-band the ID will only be available after the connection is
established (will return 65535 until then).
descriptions.WebRTCDataChannel/method/get_label: Returns the label assigned to this channel during creation.
descriptions.WebRTCDataChannel/method/get_max_packet_:
Returns the maxPacketLifeTime value assigned to this channel during
creation. Will be 65535 if not specified.
descriptions.WebRTCDataChannel/method/get_max_retrans:
Returns the maxRetransmits value assigned to this channel during
creation. Will be 65535 if not specified.
descriptions.WebRTCDataChannel/method/get_protocol:
Returns the sub-protocol assigned to this channel during creation. An
empty string if not specified.
descriptions.WebRTCDataChannel/method/get_ready_state: Returns the current state of this channel.
descriptions.WebRTCDataChannel/method/is_negotiated: Returns true if this channel was created with out-of-band configuration.
descriptions.WebRTCDataChannel/method/is_ordered:
Returns true if this channel was created with ordering enabled
(default).
descriptions.WebRTCDataChannel/method/poll: Reserved, but not used for now.
descriptions.WebRTCDataChannel/method/was_string_pack:
Returns true if the last received packet was transferred as text. See
write_mode.
descriptions.WebRTCMultiplayerPeer/method/add_peer:
Add a new peer to the mesh with the given peer_id. The
WebRTCPeerConnection must be in state WebRTCPeerConnection.STATE_NEW.
Three channels will be created for reliable, unreliable, and ordered
transport. The value of unreliable_lifetime will be passed to the
"maxPacketLifetime" option when creating unreliable and ordered channels
(see...
descriptions.WebRTCMultiplayerPeer/method/create_clie:
Initialize the multiplayer peer as a client with the given peer_id (must
be between 2 and 2147483647). In this mode, you should only call
add_peer once and with peer_id of 1. This mode enables
MultiplayerPeer.is_server_relay_supported, allowing the upper
MultiplayerAPI layer to perform peer exchange and packet relaying. You
can optionally specify a...
descriptions.WebRTCMultiplayerPeer/method/create_mesh:
Initialize the multiplayer peer as a mesh (i.e. all peers connect to
each other) with the given peer_id (must be between 1 and 2147483647).
descriptions.WebRTCMultiplayerPeer/method/create_serv:
Initialize the multiplayer peer as a server (with unique ID of 1). This
mode enables MultiplayerPeer.is_server_relay_supported, allowing the
upper MultiplayerAPI layer to perform peer exchange and packet relaying.
You can optionally specify a channels_config array of
MultiplayerPeer.TransferMode which will be used to create extra channels
(WebRTC only...
descriptions.WebRTCMultiplayerPeer/method/get_peer:
Returns a dictionary representation of the peer with given peer_id with
three keys. "connection" containing the WebRTCPeerConnection to this
peer, "channels" an array of three WebRTCDataChannel, and "connected" a
boolean representing if the peer connection is currently connected (all
three channels are open).
descriptions.WebRTCMultiplayerPeer/method/get_peers:
Returns a dictionary which keys are the peer ids and values the peer
representation as in get_peer.
descriptions.WebRTCMultiplayerPeer/method/has_peer:
Returns true if the given peer_id is in the peers map (it might not be
connected though).
descriptions.WebRTCMultiplayerPeer/method/remove_peer:
Remove the peer with given peer_id from the mesh. If the peer was
connected, and MultiplayerPeer.peer_connected was emitted for it, then
MultiplayerPeer.peer_disconnected will be emitted.
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/method/add_ice_cand:
Add an ice candidate generated by a remote peer (and received over the
signaling server). See ice_candidate_created.
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/method/close:
Close the peer connection and all data channels associated with it.
Note: You cannot reuse this object for a new connection unless you call
initialize.
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/method/create_data_:
Returns a new WebRTCDataChannel (or null on failure) with given label
and optionally configured via the options dictionary. This method can
only be called when the connection is in state STATE_NEW. There are two
ways to create a working data channel: either call create_data_channel
on only one of the peer and listen to data_channel_received on the
other,...
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/method/create_offer:
Creates a new SDP offer to start a WebRTC connection with a remote peer.
At least one WebRTCDataChannel must have been created before calling
this method. If this functions returns OK, session_description_created
will be called when the session is ready to be sent.
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/method/get_gatherin:
Returns the ICE GatheringState of the connection. This lets you detect,
for example, when collection of ICE candidates has finished.
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/method/get_signalin:
Returns the signaling state on the local end of the connection while
connecting or reconnecting to another peer.
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/method/initialize:
Re-initialize this peer connection, closing any previously active
connection, and going back to state STATE_NEW. A dictionary of
configuration options can be passed to configure the peer connection.
Valid configuration options are:
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/method/poll:
Call this method frequently (e.g. in Node._process or
Node._physics_process) to properly receive signals.
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/method/set_default_:
Sets the extension_class as the default WebRTCPeerConnectionExtension
returned when creating a new WebRTCPeerConnection.
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/method/set_local_de:
Sets the SDP description of the local peer. This should be called in
response to session_description_created. After calling this function the
peer will start emitting ice_candidate_created (unless an Error
different from OK is returned).
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/method/set_remote_d:
Sets the SDP description of the remote peer. This should be called with
the values generated by a remote peer and received over the signaling
server. If type is "offer" the peer will emit
session_description_created with the appropriate answer. If type is
"answer" the peer will start emitting ice_candidate_created.
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/signal/data_channel:
Emitted when a new in-band channel is received, i.e. when the channel
was created with negotiated: false (default). The object will be an
instance of WebRTCDataChannel. You must keep a reference of it or it
will be closed automatically. See create_data_channel.
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/signal/ice_candidat:
Emitted when a new ICE candidate has been created. The three parameters
are meant to be passed to the remote peer over the signaling server.
descriptions.WebRTCPeerConnection/signal/session_desc:
Emitted after a successful call to create_offer or
set_remote_description (when it generates an answer). The parameters are
meant to be passed to set_local_description on this object, and sent to
the remote peer over the signaling server.
descriptions.WebSocketMultiplayerPeer/method/create_c:
Starts a new multiplayer client connecting to the given url. TLS
certificates will be verified against the hostname when connecting using
the wss:// protocol. You can pass the optional tls_client_options
parameter to customize the trusted certification authorities, or disable
the common name verification. See TLSOptions.client and...
descriptions.WebSocketMultiplayerPeer/method/create_s:
Starts a new multiplayer server listening on the given port. You can
optionally specify a bind_address, and provide valid tls_server_options
to use TLS. See TLSOptions.server.
descriptions.WebSocketMultiplayerPeer/method/get_peer: Returns the WebSocketPeer associated to the given peer_id.
Returns the IP address of the given peer.
Returns the remote port of the given peer.
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/accept_stream:
Accepts a peer connection performing the HTTP handshake as a WebSocket
server. The stream must be a valid TCP stream retrieved via
TCPServer.take_connection, or a TLS stream accepted via
StreamPeerTLS.accept_stream. Note: Not supported in Web exports due to
browsers' restrictions.
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/close:
Closes this WebSocket connection. code is the status code for the
closure (see RFC 6455 section 7.4 for a list of valid status codes). If
code is negative, the connection will be closed immediately without
notifying the remote peer. reason is the human-readable reason for
closing the connection. It can be any UTF-8 string that's smaller than
123 bytes....
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/connect_to_url:
Connects to the given URL. TLS certificates will be verified against the
hostname when connecting using the wss:// protocol. You can pass the
optional tls_client_options parameter to customize the trusted
certification authorities, or disable the common name verification. See
TLSOptions.client and TLSOptions.client_unsafe. Note: This method is...
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/get_close_code:
Returns the received WebSocket close frame status code, or -1 when the
connection was not cleanly closed. Only call this method when
get_ready_state returns STATE_CLOSED.
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/get_close_reason:
Returns the received WebSocket close frame status reason string. Only
call this method when get_ready_state returns STATE_CLOSED.
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/get_connected_host:
Returns the IP address of the connected peer. Note: Not available in the
Web export.
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/get_connected_port:
Returns the remote port of the connected peer. Note: Not available in
the Web export.
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/get_current_outboun:
Returns the current amount of data in the outbound websocket buffer.
Note: Web exports use WebSocket.bufferedAmount, while other platforms
use an internal buffer.
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/get_ready_state: Returns the ready state of the connection.
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/get_requested_url:
Returns the URL requested by this peer. The URL is derived from the url
passed to connect_to_url or from the HTTP headers when acting as server
(i.e. when using accept_stream).
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/get_selected_protoc:
Returns the selected WebSocket sub-protocol for this connection or an
empty string if the sub-protocol has not been selected yet.
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/poll:
Updates the connection state and receive incoming packets. Call this
function regularly to keep it in a clean state.
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/send:
Sends the given message using the desired write_mode. When sending a
String, prefer using send_text.
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/send_text:
Sends the given message using WebSocket text mode. Prefer this method
over PacketPeer.put_packet when interacting with third-party text-based
API (e.g. when using JSON formatted messages).
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/set_no_delay:
Disable Nagle's algorithm on the underlying TCP socket (default). See
StreamPeerTCP.set_no_delay for more information. Note: Not available in
the Web export.
descriptions.WebSocketPeer/method/was_string_packet:
Returns true if the last received packet was sent as a text payload. See
WriteMode.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/method/get_available_disp:
Returns display refresh rates supported by the current HMD. Only
returned if this feature is supported by the web browser and after the
interface has been initialized.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/method/get_display_refres:
Returns the display refresh rate for the current HMD. Not supported on
all HMDs and browsers. It may not report an accurate value until after
using set_display_refresh_rate.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/method/get_input_source_t:
Returns the target ray mode for the given input_source_id. This can help
interpret the input coming from that input source. See
XRInputSource.targetRayMode for more information.

Gets an XRControllerTracker for the given input_source_id. In the
context of WebXR, an input source can be an advanced VR controller like
the Oculus Touch or Index controllers, or even a tap on the screen, a
spoken voice command or a button press on the device itself. When a
non-traditional input source is used, interpret the position and
orientation of...
descriptions.WebXRInterface/method/is_input_source_ac:
Returns true if there is an active input source with the given
input_source_id.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/method/is_session_support:
Checks if the given session_mode is supported by the user's browser.
Possible values come from WebXR's XRSessionMode, including:
"immersive-vr", "immersive-ar", and "inline". This method returns
nothing, instead it emits the session_supported signal with the result.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/method/set_display_refres:
Sets the display refresh rate for the current HMD. Not supported on all
HMDs and browsers. It won't take effect right away until after
display_refresh_rate_changed is emitted.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/signal/display_refresh_ra: Emitted after the display's refresh rate has changed.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/signal/reference_space_re:
Emitted to indicate that the reference space has been reset or
reconfigured. When (or whether) this is emitted depends on the user's
browser or device, but may include when the user has changed the
dimensions of their play space (which you may be able to access via
XRInterface.get_play_area) or pressed/held a button to recenter their
position. See...
descriptions.WebXRInterface/signal/select:
Emitted after one of the input sources has finished its "primary
action". Use get_input_source_tracker and
get_input_source_target_ray_mode to get more information about the input
source.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/signal/selectend:
Emitted when one of the input sources has finished its "primary action".
Use get_input_source_tracker and get_input_source_target_ray_mode to get
more information about the input source.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/signal/selectstart:
Emitted when one of the input source has started its "primary action".
Use get_input_source_tracker and get_input_source_target_ray_mode to get
more information about the input source.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/signal/session_ended:
Emitted when the user ends the WebXR session (which can be done using UI
from the browser or device). At this point, you should do
get_viewport().use_xr = false to instruct Godot to resume rendering to
the screen.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/signal/session_failed:
Emitted by XRInterface.initialize if the session fails to start. message
may optionally contain an error message from WebXR, or an empty string
if no message is available.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/signal/session_started:
Emitted by XRInterface.initialize if the session is successfully
started. At this point, it's safe to do get_viewport().use_xr = true to
instruct Godot to start rendering to the XR device.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/signal/session_supported:
Emitted by is_session_supported to indicate if the given session_mode is
supported or not.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/signal/squeeze:
Emitted after one of the input sources has finished its "primary squeeze
action". Use get_input_source_tracker and
get_input_source_target_ray_mode to get more information about the input
source.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/signal/squeezeend:
Emitted when one of the input sources has finished its "primary squeeze
action". Use get_input_source_tracker and
get_input_source_target_ray_mode to get more information about the input
source.
descriptions.WebXRInterface/signal/squeezestart:
Emitted when one of the input sources has started its "primary squeeze
action". Use get_input_source_tracker and
get_input_source_target_ray_mode to get more information about the input
source.
descriptions.Window/method/_get_contents_minimum_size:
Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Overrides the value
returned by get_contents_minimum_size.
descriptions.Window/method/add_theme_color_override:
Creates a local override for a theme Color with the specified name.
Local overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the
control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_color_override.
See also get_theme_color and Control.add_theme_color_override for more
details.
descriptions.Window/method/add_theme_constant_overrid:
Creates a local override for a theme constant with the specified name.
Local overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the
control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_constant_override.
See also get_theme_constant.
descriptions.Window/method/add_theme_font_override:
Creates a local override for a theme Font with the specified name. Local
overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the
control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_font_override. See
also get_theme_font.
descriptions.Window/method/add_theme_font_size_overri:
Creates a local override for a theme font size with the specified name.
Local overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the
control. An override can be removed with
remove_theme_font_size_override. See also get_theme_font_size.
descriptions.Window/method/add_theme_icon_override:
Creates a local override for a theme icon with the specified name. Local
overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the
control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_icon_override. See
also get_theme_icon.
descriptions.Window/method/add_theme_stylebox_overrid:
Creates a local override for a theme StyleBox with the specified name.
Local overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the
control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_stylebox_override.
See also get_theme_stylebox and Control.add_theme_stylebox_override for
more details.
descriptions.Window/method/begin_bulk_theme_override:
Prevents *_theme_*_override methods from emitting
NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED until end_bulk_theme_override is called.
descriptions.Window/method/can_draw: Returns whether the window is being drawn to the screen.
descriptions.Window/method/child_controls_changed: Requests an update of the Window size to fit underlying Control nodes.
descriptions.Window/method/end_bulk_theme_override: Ends a bulk theme override update. See begin_bulk_theme_override.
descriptions.Window/method/get_contents_minimum_size:
Returns the combined minimum size from the child Control nodes of the
window. Use child_controls_changed to update it when child nodes have
changed. The value returned by this method can be overridden with
_get_contents_minimum_size.
descriptions.Window/method/get_flag: Returns true if the flag is set.
descriptions.Window/method/get_layout_direction: Returns layout direction and text writing direction.
descriptions.Window/method/get_output_max_linear_valu:
Returns the maximum value for linear color components that can be
displayed in this window, regardless of SDR or HDR output. Returns 1.0
if HDR is not enabled or not supported. The
output_max_linear_value_changed signal will be emitted whenever this
value changes. This value is used by tonemapping and other Environment
effects to ensure that bright...
descriptions.Window/method/get_position_with_decorati:
Returns the window's position including its border. Note: If visible is
false, this method returns the same value as position.
descriptions.Window/method/get_size_with_decorations:
Returns the window's size including its border. Note: If visible is
false, this method returns the same value as size.
descriptions.Window/method/get_theme_color:
Returns a Color from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme
has a color item with the specified name and theme_type. See
Control.get_theme_color for more details.
descriptions.Window/method/get_theme_constant:
Returns a constant from the first matching Theme in the tree if that
Theme has a constant item with the specified name and theme_type. See
Control.get_theme_color for more details.
descriptions.Window/method/get_theme_default_base_sca:
Returns the default base scale value from the first matching Theme in
the tree if that Theme has a valid Theme.default_base_scale value. See
Control.get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Window/method/get_theme_default_font:
Returns the default font from the first matching Theme in the tree if
that Theme has a valid Theme.default_font value. See
Control.get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Window/method/get_theme_default_font_siz:
Returns the default font size value from the first matching Theme in the
tree if that Theme has a valid Theme.default_font_size value. See
Control.get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Window/method/get_theme_font:
Returns a Font from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme
has a font item with the specified name and theme_type. See
Control.get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Window/method/get_theme_font_size:
Returns a font size from the first matching Theme in the tree if that
Theme has a font size item with the specified name and theme_type. See
Control.get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Window/method/get_theme_icon:
Returns an icon from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme
has an icon item with the specified name and theme_type. See
Control.get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Window/method/get_theme_stylebox:
Returns a StyleBox from the first matching Theme in the tree if that
Theme has a stylebox item with the specified name and theme_type. See
Control.get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Window/method/get_window_id: Returns the ID of the window.
descriptions.Window/method/grab_focus: Causes the window to grab focus, allowing it to receive user input.
descriptions.Window/method/has_focus: Returns true if the window is focused.
descriptions.Window/method/has_theme_color:
Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a color
item with the specified name and theme_type. See Control.get_theme_color
for details.
descriptions.Window/method/has_theme_color_override:
Returns true if there is a local override for a theme Color with the
specified name in this Control node. See add_theme_color_override.
descriptions.Window/method/has_theme_constant:
Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a
constant item with the specified name and theme_type. See
Control.get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Window/method/has_theme_constant_overrid:
Returns true if there is a local override for a theme constant with the
specified name in this Control node. See add_theme_constant_override.
descriptions.Window/method/has_theme_font:
Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a font
item with the specified name and theme_type. See Control.get_theme_color
for details.
descriptions.Window/method/has_theme_font_override:
Returns true if there is a local override for a theme Font with the
specified name in this Control node. See add_theme_font_override.
descriptions.Window/method/has_theme_font_size:
Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a font
size item with the specified name and theme_type. See
Control.get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Window/method/has_theme_font_size_overri:
Returns true if there is a local override for a theme font size with the
specified name in this Control node. See add_theme_font_size_override.
descriptions.Window/method/has_theme_icon:
Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has an icon
item with the specified name and theme_type. See Control.get_theme_color
for details.
descriptions.Window/method/has_theme_icon_override:
Returns true if there is a local override for a theme icon with the
specified name in this Control node. See add_theme_icon_override.
descriptions.Window/method/has_theme_stylebox:
Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a
stylebox item with the specified name and theme_type. See
Control.get_theme_color for details.
descriptions.Window/method/has_theme_stylebox_overrid:
Returns true if there is a local override for a theme StyleBox with the
specified name in this Control node. See add_theme_stylebox_override.
descriptions.Window/method/hide:
Hides the window. This is not the same as minimized state. Hidden window
can't be interacted with and needs to be made visible with show.
descriptions.Window/method/is_embedded: Returns true if the window is currently embedded in another window.
descriptions.Window/method/is_layout_rtl: Returns true if the layout is right-to-left.
descriptions.Window/method/is_maximize_allowed:
Returns true if the window can be maximized (the maximize button is
enabled).
descriptions.Window/method/is_using_font_oversampling:
Returns true if font oversampling is enabled. See
set_use_font_oversampling.
descriptions.Window/method/move_to_center:
Centers the window in the current screen. If the window is embedded, it
is centered in the embedder Viewport instead.
descriptions.Window/method/move_to_foreground: Causes the window to grab focus, allowing it to receive user input.
descriptions.Window/method/popup:
Shows the Window and makes it transient (see transient). If rect is
provided, it will be set as the Window's size. Fails if called on the
main window. If
ProjectSettings.display/window/subwindows/embed_subwindows is true
(single-window mode), rect's coordinates are global and relative to the
main window's top-left corner (excluding window decorations)....
descriptions.Window/method/popup_centered:
Popups the Window at the center of the current screen, with optionally
given minimum size. If the Window is embedded, it will be centered in
the parent Viewport instead. Note: Calling it with the default value of
minsize is equivalent to calling it with size.
descriptions.Window/method/popup_centered_clamped:
Popups the Window centered inside its parent Window. fallback_ratio
determines the maximum size of the Window, in relation to its parent.
Note: Calling it with the default value of minsize is equivalent to
calling it with size.
descriptions.Window/method/popup_centered_ratio:
If Window is embedded, popups the Window centered inside its embedder
and sets its size as a ratio of embedder's size. If Window is a native
window, popups the Window centered inside the screen of its parent
Window and sets its size as a ratio of the screen size.
descriptions.Window/method/popup_exclusive:
Attempts to parent this dialog to the last exclusive window relative to
from_node, and then calls Window.popup on it. The dialog must have no
current parent, otherwise the method fails. See also
set_unparent_when_invisible and Node.get_last_exclusive_window.
descriptions.Window/method/popup_exclusive_centered:
Attempts to parent this dialog to the last exclusive window relative to
from_node, and then calls Window.popup_centered on it. The dialog must
have no current parent, otherwise the method fails. See also
set_unparent_when_invisible and Node.get_last_exclusive_window.
descriptions.Window/method/popup_exclusive_centered_c:
Attempts to parent this dialog to the last exclusive window relative to
from_node, and then calls Window.popup_centered_clamped on it. The
dialog must have no current parent, otherwise the method fails. See also
set_unparent_when_invisible and Node.get_last_exclusive_window.
descriptions.Window/method/popup_exclusive_centered_r:
Attempts to parent this dialog to the last exclusive window relative to
from_node, and then calls Window.popup_centered_ratio on it. The dialog
must have no current parent, otherwise the method fails. See also
set_unparent_when_invisible and Node.get_last_exclusive_window.
descriptions.Window/method/popup_exclusive_on_parent:
Attempts to parent this dialog to the last exclusive window relative to
from_node, and then calls Window.popup_on_parent on it. The dialog must
have no current parent, otherwise the method fails. See also
set_unparent_when_invisible and Node.get_last_exclusive_window.
descriptions.Window/method/popup_on_parent:
Popups the Window with a position shifted by parent Window's position.
If the Window is embedded, has the same effect as popup.
descriptions.Window/method/remove_theme_color_overrid:
Removes a local override for a theme Color with the specified name
previously added by add_theme_color_override or via the Inspector dock.
descriptions.Window/method/remove_theme_constant_over:
Removes a local override for a theme constant with the specified name
previously added by add_theme_constant_override or via the Inspector
dock.
descriptions.Window/method/remove_theme_font_override:
Removes a local override for a theme Font with the specified name
previously added by add_theme_font_override or via the Inspector dock.
descriptions.Window/method/remove_theme_font_size_ove:
Removes a local override for a theme font size with the specified name
previously added by add_theme_font_size_override or via the Inspector
dock.
descriptions.Window/method/remove_theme_icon_override:
Removes a local override for a theme icon with the specified name
previously added by add_theme_icon_override or via the Inspector dock.
descriptions.Window/method/remove_theme_stylebox_over:
Removes a local override for a theme StyleBox with the specified name
previously added by add_theme_stylebox_override or via the Inspector
dock.
descriptions.Window/method/request_attention:
Tells the OS that the Window needs an attention. This makes the window
stand out in some way depending on the system, e.g. it might blink on
the task bar.
descriptions.Window/method/reset_size:
Resets the size to the minimum size, which is the max of min_size and
(if wrap_controls is enabled) get_contents_minimum_size. This is
equivalent to calling set_size(Vector2i()) (or any size below the
minimum).
descriptions.Window/method/set_ime_active: If active is true, enables system's native IME (Input Method Editor).
descriptions.Window/method/set_ime_position: Moves IME to the given position.
descriptions.Window/method/set_layout_direction:
Sets layout direction and text writing direction. Right-to-left layouts
are necessary for certain languages (e.g. Arabic and Hebrew).
descriptions.Window/method/set_taskbar_progress_state:
Sets the type and state of the progress bar on the taskbar/dock icon of
the Window. See DisplayServer.ProgressState for possible values and how
each mode behaves. Note: This method is implemented only on Windows and
macOS.
descriptions.Window/method/set_taskbar_progress_value:
Creates a progress bar on the taskbar/dock icon of the Window if it does
not exist, sets the progress of the icon. value acts as a relative
percentage value, ranges from 0.0 (lowest) to 1.0 (highest). Note: This
method is implemented only on Windows and macOS.
descriptions.Window/method/set_unparent_when_invisibl:
If unparent is true, the window is automatically unparented when going
invisible. Note: Make sure to keep a reference to the node, otherwise it
will be orphaned. You also need to manually call Node.queue_free to free
the window if it's not parented.
descriptions.Window/method/set_use_font_oversampling:
Enables font oversampling. This makes fonts look better when they are
scaled up.
descriptions.Window/method/show:
Makes the Window appear. This enables interactions with the Window and
doesn't change any of its property other than visibility (unlike e.g.
popup).
descriptions.Window/method/start_drag:
Starts an interactive drag operation on the window, using the current
mouse position. Call this method when handling a mouse button being
pressed to simulate a pressed event on the window's title bar. Using
this method allows the window to participate in space switching, tiling,
and other system features.
descriptions.Window/method/start_resize:
Starts an interactive resize operation on the window, using the current
mouse position. Call this method when handling a mouse button being
pressed to simulate a pressed event on the window's edge.
descriptions.Window/signal/about_to_popup:
Emitted right after popup call, before the Window appears or does
anything.
descriptions.Window/signal/close_requested:
Emitted when the Window's close button is pressed or when popup_window
is enabled and user clicks outside the window. This signal can be used
to handle window closing, e.g. by connecting it to hide.
descriptions.Window/signal/dpi_changed:
Emitted when the Window's DPI changes as a result of OS-level changes
(e.g. moving the window from a Retina display to a lower resolution
one). Note: Only implemented on macOS and Linux (Wayland).
descriptions.Window/signal/files_dropped:
Emitted when files are dragged from the OS file manager and dropped in
the game window. The argument is a list of file paths.
descriptions.Window/signal/focus_entered: Emitted when the Window gains focus.
descriptions.Window/signal/focus_exited: Emitted when the Window loses its focus.
descriptions.Window/signal/go_back_requested:
Emitted when a go back request is sent (e.g. pressing the "Back" button
on Android), right after Node.NOTIFICATION_WM_GO_BACK_REQUEST.
descriptions.Window/signal/mouse_entered:
Emitted when the mouse cursor enters the Window's visible area, that is
not occluded behind other Controls or windows, provided its
Viewport.gui_disable_input is false and regardless if it's currently
focused or not.
descriptions.Window/signal/mouse_exited:
Emitted when the mouse cursor leaves the Window's visible area, that is
not occluded behind other Controls or windows, provided its
Viewport.gui_disable_input is false and regardless if it's currently
focused or not.
descriptions.Window/signal/nonclient_window_input:
Emitted when the mouse event is received by the custom decoration area
defined by nonclient_area, and normal input to the window is blocked
(such as when it has an exclusive child opened). event's position is in
the embedder's coordinate system.
descriptions.Window/signal/output_max_linear_value_ch:
Emitted when the output max linear value returned by
Window.get_output_max_linear_value has changed. This occurs when HDR
output is enabled or disabled and when any HDR output luminance values
of the window have changed, such as when the player adjusts their screen
brightness setting or moves the window to a different screen.
output_max_linear_value is...
descriptions.Window/signal/theme_changed: Emitted when the NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED notification is sent.
descriptions.Window/signal/title_changed: Emitted when window title bar text is changed.
descriptions.Window/signal/titlebar_changed:
Emitted when window title bar decorations are changed, e.g. macOS window
enter/exit full screen mode, or extend-to-title flag is changed.
descriptions.Window/signal/visibility_changed: Emitted when Window is made visible or disappears.
descriptions.Window/signal/window_input:
Emitted when the Window is currently focused and receives any input,
passing the received event as an argument. The event's position, if
present, is in the embedder's coordinate system.
descriptions.WorkerThreadPool/method/add_group_task:
Adds action as a group task to be executed by the worker threads. The
Callable will be called a number of times based on elements, with the
first thread calling it with the value 0 as a parameter, and each
consecutive execution incrementing this value by 1 until it reaches
element - 1. The number of threads the task is distributed to is defined
by...
descriptions.WorkerThreadPool/method/add_task:
Adds action as a task to be executed by a worker thread. high_priority
determines if the task has a high priority or a low priority (default).
You can optionally provide a description to help with debugging. Returns
a task ID that can be used by other methods. Warning: Every task must be
waited for completion using wait_for_task_completion or...
descriptions.WorkerThreadPool/method/get_caller_group:
Returns the task group ID of the current thread calling this method, or
-1 if invalid or the current thread is not part of a task group.
descriptions.WorkerThreadPool/method/get_caller_task_:
Returns the task ID of the current thread calling this method, or -1 if
the task is a group task, invalid or the current thread is not part of
the thread pool (e.g. the main thread). Can be used by a task to get its
own task ID, or to determine whether the current code is running inside
the worker thread pool. Note: Group tasks have their own IDs, so...
descriptions.WorkerThreadPool/method/get_group_proces:
Returns how many times the Callable of the group task with the given ID
has already been executed by the worker threads. Note: If a thread has
started executing the Callable but is yet to finish, it won't be
counted.
descriptions.WorkerThreadPool/method/is_group_task_co:
Returns true if the group task with the given ID is completed. Note: You
should only call this method between adding the group task and awaiting
its completion.
descriptions.WorkerThreadPool/method/is_task_complete:
Returns true if the task with the given ID is completed. Note: You
should only call this method between adding the task and awaiting its
completion.
descriptions.WorkerThreadPool/method/wait_for_group_t:
Pauses the thread that calls this method until the group task with the
given ID is completed.
descriptions.WorkerThreadPool/method/wait_for_task_co:
Pauses the thread that calls this method until the task with the given
ID is completed. Returns @GlobalScope.OK if the task could be
successfully awaited. Returns @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER if a
task with the passed ID does not exist (maybe because it was already
awaited and disposed of). Returns @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY if the call is
made from...
descriptions.WorldDefinition/method/at: Make a destination with an explicit stable ID and res:// path.
descriptions.WorldDefinition/method/set_id: Set the ID for future game configurations.
descriptions.WorldDefinition/method/set_path: Set the scene locator for future configurations.
descriptions.X509Certificate/method/load: Loads a certificate from path ("*.crt" file).
descriptions.X509Certificate/method/load_from_string: Loads a certificate from the given string.
descriptions.X509Certificate/method/save: Saves a certificate to the given path (should be a "*.crt" file).
descriptions.X509Certificate/method/save_to_string:
Returns a string representation of the certificate, or an empty string
if the certificate is invalid.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/get_attribute_count:
Returns the number of attributes in the currently parsed element. Note:
If this method is used while the currently parsed node is not
NODE_ELEMENT or NODE_ELEMENT_END, this count will not be updated and
will still reflect the last element.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/get_attribute_name:
Returns the name of an attribute of the currently parsed element,
specified by the idx index.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/get_attribute_value:
Returns the value of an attribute of the currently parsed element,
specified by the idx index.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/get_current_line: Returns the current line in the parsed file, counting from 0.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/get_named_attribute_val:
Returns the value of an attribute of the currently parsed element,
specified by its name. This method will raise an error if the element
has no such attribute.

Returns the value of an attribute of the currently parsed element,
specified by its name. This method will return an empty string if the
element has no such attribute.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/get_node_data:
Returns the contents of a text node. This method will raise an error if
the current parsed node is of any other type.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/get_node_name:
Returns the name of a node. This method will raise an error if the
currently parsed node is a text node. Note: The content of a NODE_CDATA
node and the comment string of a NODE_COMMENT node are also considered
names.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/get_node_offset:
Returns the byte offset of the currently parsed node since the beginning
of the file or buffer. This is usually equivalent to the number of
characters before the read position.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/get_node_type: Returns the type of the current node. Compare with NodeType constants.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/has_attribute:
Returns true if the currently parsed element has an attribute with the
name.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/is_empty: Returns true if the currently parsed element is empty, e.g. <element />.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/open: Opens an XML file for parsing. This method returns an error code.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/open_buffer: Opens an XML raw buffer for parsing. This method returns an error code.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/read: Parses the next node in the file. This method returns an error code.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/seek:
Moves the buffer cursor to a certain offset (since the beginning) and
reads the next node there. This method returns an error code.
descriptions.XMLParser/method/skip_section:
Skips the current section. If the currently parsed node contains more
inner nodes, they will be ignored and the cursor will go to the closing
of the current element.
descriptions.XRAnchor3D/method/get_plane: Returns a plane aligned with our anchor; handy for intersection testing.
descriptions.XRAnchor3D/method/get_size:
Returns the estimated size of the plane that was detected. Say when the
anchor relates to a table in the real world, this is the estimated size
of the surface of that table.
descriptions.XRBodyTracker/method/get_joint_flags:
Returns flags about the validity of the tracking data for the given body
joint.
descriptions.XRBodyTracker/method/get_joint_transform: Returns the transform for the given body joint.
descriptions.XRBodyTracker/method/set_joint_flags:
Sets flags about the validity of the tracking data for the given body
joint.
descriptions.XRBodyTracker/method/set_joint_transform: Sets the transform for the given body joint.
descriptions.XRController3D/method/get_float:
Returns a numeric value for the input with the given name. This is used
for triggers and grip sensors. Note: The current XRInterface defines the
name for each input. In the case of OpenXR, these are the names of
actions in the current action set.
descriptions.XRController3D/method/get_input:
Returns a Variant for the input with the given name. This works for any
input type, the variant will be typed according to the actions
configuration. Note: The current XRInterface defines the name for each
input. In the case of OpenXR, these are the names of actions in the
current action set.
descriptions.XRController3D/method/get_tracker_hand: Returns the hand holding this controller, if known.
descriptions.XRController3D/method/get_vector2:
Returns a Vector2 for the input with the given name. This is used for
thumbsticks and thumbpads found on many controllers. Note: The current
XRInterface defines the name for each input. In the case of OpenXR,
these are the names of actions in the current action set.
descriptions.XRController3D/method/is_button_pressed:
Returns true if the button with the given name is pressed. Note: The
current XRInterface defines the name for each input. In the case of
OpenXR, these are the names of actions in the current action set.
descriptions.XRController3D/signal/button_pressed: Emitted when a button on this controller is pressed.
descriptions.XRController3D/signal/button_released: Emitted when a button on this controller is released.
descriptions.XRController3D/signal/input_float_change:
Emitted when a trigger or similar input on this controller changes
value.
descriptions.XRController3D/signal/input_vector2_chan: Emitted when a thumbstick or thumbpad on this controller is moved.
descriptions.XRController3D/signal/profile_changed: Emitted when the interaction profile on this controller is changed.
descriptions.XRFaceTracker/method/get_blend_shape: Returns the requested face blend shape weight.
descriptions.XRFaceTracker/method/set_blend_shape: Sets a face blend shape weight.
descriptions.XRHandTracker/method/get_hand_joint_angu: Returns the angular velocity for the given hand joint.
descriptions.XRHandTracker/method/get_hand_joint_flag:
Returns flags about the validity of the tracking data for the given hand
joint.
descriptions.XRHandTracker/method/get_hand_joint_line: Returns the linear velocity for the given hand joint.
descriptions.XRHandTracker/method/get_hand_joint_radi: Returns the radius of the given hand joint.
descriptions.XRHandTracker/method/get_hand_joint_tran: Returns the transform for the given hand joint.
descriptions.XRHandTracker/method/set_hand_joint_angu: Sets the angular velocity for the given hand joint.
descriptions.XRHandTracker/method/set_hand_joint_flag:
Sets flags about the validity of the tracking data for the given hand
joint.
descriptions.XRHandTracker/method/set_hand_joint_line: Sets the linear velocity for the given hand joint.
descriptions.XRHandTracker/method/set_hand_joint_radi: Sets the radius of the given hand joint.
descriptions.XRHandTracker/method/set_hand_joint_tran: Sets the transform for the given hand joint.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/get_camera_feed_id:
If this is an AR interface that requires displaying a camera feed as the
background, this method returns the feed ID in the CameraServer for this
interface.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/get_capabilities:
Returns a combination of Capabilities flags providing information about
the capabilities of this interface.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/get_name:
Returns the name of this interface ("OpenXR", "OpenVR", "OpenHMD",
"ARKit", etc.).
descriptions.XRInterface/method/get_play_area:
Returns an array of vectors that represent the physical play area mapped
to the virtual space around the XROrigin3D point. The points form a
convex polygon that can be used to react to or visualize the play area.
This returns an empty array if this feature is not supported or if the
information is not yet available.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/get_projection_for_vi: Returns the projection matrix for a view/eye.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/get_render_target_siz:
Returns the resolution at which we should render our intermediate
results before things like lens distortion are applied by the VR
platform.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/get_supported_environ:
Returns the an array of supported environment blend modes, see
XRInterface.EnvironmentBlendMode.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/get_system_info:
Returns a Dictionary with extra system info. Interfaces are expected to
return XRRuntimeName and XRRuntimeVersion providing info about the used
XR runtime. Additional entries may be provided specific to an interface.
Note:This information may only be available after initialize was
successfully called.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/get_tracking_status:
If supported, returns the status of our tracking. This will allow you to
provide feedback to the user whether there are issues with positional
tracking.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/get_transform_for_vie:
Returns the transform for a view/eye. view is the view/eye index.
cam_transform is the transform that maps device coordinates to scene
coordinates, typically the Node3D.global_transform of the current
XROrigin3D.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/get_view_count:
Returns the number of views that need to be rendered for this device. 1
for Monoscopic, 2 for Stereoscopic.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/initialize:
Call this to initialize this interface. The first interface that is
initialized is identified as the primary interface and it will be used
for rendering output. After initializing the interface you want to use
you then need to enable the AR/VR mode of a viewport and rendering
should commence. Note: You must enable the XR mode on the main viewport
for any...
descriptions.XRInterface/method/is_initialized: Returns true if this interface has been initialized.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/is_passthrough_enable: Returns true if passthrough is enabled.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/is_passthrough_suppor: Returns true if this interface supports passthrough.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/set_environment_blend:
Sets the active environment blend mode. mode is the environment blend
mode starting with the next frame. Note: Not all runtimes support all
environment blend modes, so it is important to check this at startup.
For example:
descriptions.XRInterface/method/set_play_area_mode:
Sets the active play area mode, will return false if the mode can't be
used with this interface. Note: Changing this after the interface has
already been initialized can be jarring for the player, so it's
recommended to recenter on the HMD with XRServer.center_on_hmd (if
switching to XRInterface.XR_PLAY_AREA_STAGE) or make the switch during a
scene change.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/start_passthrough:
Starts passthrough, will return false if passthrough couldn't be
started. Note: The viewport used for XR must have a transparent
background, otherwise passthrough may not properly render.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/supports_play_area_mo:
Call this to find out if a given play area mode is supported by this
interface.
descriptions.XRInterface/method/trigger_haptic_pulse:
Triggers a haptic pulse on a device associated with this interface.
action_name is the name of the action for this pulse. tracker_name is
optional and can be used to direct the pulse to a specific device
provided that device is bound to this haptic. frequency is the frequency
of the pulse, set to 0.0 to have the system use a default frequency.
amplitude...
descriptions.XRInterface/signal/play_area_changed:
Emitted when the play area is changed. This can be a result of the
player resetting the boundary or entering a new play area, the player
changing the play area mode, the world scale changing or the player
resetting their headset orientation.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_end_frame: Called if interface is active and queues have been submitted.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_anchor_: Return true if anchor detection is enabled for this interface.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_camera_:
Returns the camera feed ID for the CameraFeed registered with the
CameraServer that should be presented as the background on an AR capable
device (if applicable).
Returns the Transform3D that positions the XRCamera3D in the world.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_capabil: Returns the capabilities of this interface.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_color_t: Return color texture into which to render (if applicable).
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_depth_t: Return depth texture into which to render (if applicable).
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_name: Returns the name of this interface.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_play_ar:
Returns a PackedVector3Array that represents the play areas boundaries
(if applicable).
Returns the play area mode that sets up our play area.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_project:
Returns the projection matrix for the given view as a
PackedFloat64Array.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_render_:
Returns the size of our render target for this interface, this overrides
the size of the Viewport marked as the xr viewport.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_suggest:
Returns a PackedStringArray with pose names configured by this
interface. Note that user configuration can override this list.

Returns a PackedStringArray with tracker names configured by this
interface. Note that user configuration can override this list.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_system_: Returns a Dictionary with system information related to this interface.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_trackin: Returns the current status of our tracking.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_transfo: Returns a Transform3D for a given view.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_velocit: Return velocity texture into which to render (if applicable).
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_view_co:
Returns the number of views this interface requires, 1 for mono, 2 for
stereoscopic.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_get_vrs_tex: Returns the format of the texture returned by _get_vrs_texture.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_initialize: Initializes the interface, returns true on success.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_is_initiali: Returns true if this interface has been initialized.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_post_draw_v: Called after the XR Viewport draw logic has completed.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_pre_draw_vi:
Called if this is our primary XRInterfaceExtension before we start
processing a Viewport for every active XR Viewport, returns true if that
viewport should be rendered. An XR interface may return false if the
user has taken off their headset and we can pause rendering.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_pre_render:
Called if this XRInterfaceExtension is active before rendering starts.
Most XR interfaces will sync tracking at this point in time.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_process:
Called if this XRInterfaceExtension is active before our physics and
game process is called. Most XR interfaces will update its
XRPositionalTrackers at this point in time.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_set_anchor_: Enables anchor detection on this interface if supported.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_set_play_ar: Set the play area mode for this interface.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_supports_pl: Returns true if this interface supports this play area mode.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/_trigger_hap: Triggers a haptic pulse to be emitted on the specified tracker.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/add_blit:
Blits our render results to screen optionally applying lens distortion.
This can only be called while processing _commit_views.
descriptions.XRInterfaceExtension/method/get_render_t:
Returns a valid RID for a texture to which we should render the current
frame if supported by the interface.
descriptions.XRNode3D/method/get_has_tracking_data:
Returns true if the tracker has current tracking data for the pose being
tracked.
descriptions.XRNode3D/method/get_is_active:
Returns true if the tracker has been registered and the pose is being
tracked.
descriptions.XRNode3D/method/get_pose:
Returns the XRPose containing the current state of the pose being
tracked. This gives access to additional properties of this pose.
descriptions.XRNode3D/method/trigger_haptic_pulse:
Triggers a haptic pulse on a device associated with this interface.
action_name is the name of the action for this pulse. frequency is the
frequency of the pulse, set to 0.0 to have the system use a default
frequency. amplitude is the amplitude of the pulse between 0.0 and 1.0.
duration_sec is the duration of the pulse in seconds. delay_sec is a
delay in...
descriptions.XRNode3D/signal/tracking_changed:
Emitted when the tracker starts or stops receiving updated tracking data
for the pose being tracked. The tracking argument indicates whether the
tracker is getting updated tracking data.
descriptions.XRPose/method/get_adjusted_transform:
Returns the transform with world scale and our reference frame applied.
This is the transform used to position XRNode3D objects.
descriptions.XRPositionalTracker/method/get_input:
Returns an input for this tracker. It can return a boolean, float or
Vector2 value depending on whether the input is a button, trigger or
thumbstick/thumbpad.
descriptions.XRPositionalTracker/method/get_pose: Returns the current XRPose state object for the bound name pose.
descriptions.XRPositionalTracker/method/has_pose:
Returns true if the tracker is available and is currently tracking the
bound name pose.
descriptions.XRPositionalTracker/method/invalidate_po:
Marks this pose as invalid, we don't clear the last reported state but
it allows users to decide if trackers need to be hidden if we lose
tracking or just remain at their last known position.
descriptions.XRPositionalTracker/method/set_input:
Changes the value for the given input. This method is called by an
XRInterface implementation and should not be used directly.
descriptions.XRPositionalTracker/method/set_pose:
Sets the transform, linear velocity, angular velocity and tracking
confidence for the given pose. This method is called by an XRInterface
implementation and should not be used directly.
descriptions.XRPositionalTracker/signal/button_presse:
Emitted when a button on this tracker is pressed. Note that many XR
runtimes allow other inputs to be mapped to buttons.
descriptions.XRPositionalTracker/signal/button_releas: Emitted when a button on this tracker is released.
descriptions.XRPositionalTracker/signal/input_float_c: Emitted when a trigger or similar input on this tracker changes value.
descriptions.XRPositionalTracker/signal/input_vector2: Emitted when a thumbstick or thumbpad on this tracker moves.
descriptions.XRPositionalTracker/signal/pose_changed: Emitted when the state of a pose tracked by this tracker changes.
descriptions.XRPositionalTracker/signal/pose_lost_tra:
Emitted when a pose tracked by this tracker stops getting updated
tracking data.
descriptions.XRPositionalTracker/signal/profile_chang: Emitted when the profile of our tracker changes.
descriptions.XRServer/method/add_tracker: Registers a new XRTracker that tracks a physical object.
descriptions.XRServer/method/center_on_hmd:
This is an important function to understand correctly. AR and VR
platforms all handle positioning slightly differently. For platforms
that do not offer spatial tracking, our origin point (0, 0, 0) is the
location of our HMD, but you have little control over the direction the
player is facing in the real world. For platforms that do offer
spatial...
descriptions.XRServer/method/clear_reference_frame:
Clears the reference frame that was set by previous calls to
center_on_hmd.
descriptions.XRServer/method/find_interface:
Finds an interface by its name. For example, if your project uses
capabilities of an AR/VR platform, you can find the interface for that
platform by name and initialize it.
descriptions.XRServer/method/get_interface:
Returns the interface registered at the given idx index in the list of
interfaces.
descriptions.XRServer/method/get_interface_count:
Returns the number of interfaces currently registered with the AR/VR
server. If your project supports multiple AR/VR platforms, you can look
through the available interface, and either present the user with a
selection or simply try to initialize each interface and use the first
one that returns true.
descriptions.XRServer/method/get_interfaces:
Returns a list of available interfaces the ID and name of each
interface.
descriptions.XRServer/method/get_reference_frame:
Returns the reference frame transform. Mostly used internally and
exposed for GDExtension build interfaces.
descriptions.XRServer/method/get_tracker: Returns the positional tracker with the given tracker_name.
descriptions.XRServer/method/get_trackers: Returns a dictionary of trackers for tracker_types.
descriptions.XRServer/signal/interface_added: Emitted when a new interface has been added.
descriptions.XRServer/signal/interface_removed: Emitted when an interface is removed.
descriptions.XRServer/signal/reference_frame_changed: Emitted when the reference frame transform changes.
descriptions.XRServer/signal/tracker_added:
Emitted when a new tracker has been added. If you don't use a fixed
number of controllers or if you're using XRAnchor3Ds for an AR solution,
it is important to react to this signal to add the appropriate
XRController3D or XRAnchor3D nodes related to this new tracker.
descriptions.XRServer/signal/tracker_removed:
Emitted when a tracker is removed. You should remove any XRController3D
or XRAnchor3D points if applicable. This is not mandatory, the nodes
simply become inactive and will be made active again when a new tracker
becomes available (i.e. a new controller is switched on that takes the
place of the previous one).
descriptions.XRServer/signal/tracker_updated:
Emitted when an existing tracker has been updated. This can happen if
the user switches controllers.
descriptions.XRServer/signal/world_origin_changed: Emitted when the world origin transform changes.
descriptions.XRVRS/method/make_vrs_texture:
Generates the VRS texture based on a render target_size adjusted by our
VRS tile size. For each eyes focal point passed in eye_foci a layer is
created. Focal point should be in NDC. The result will be cached,
requesting a VRS texture with unchanged parameters and settings will
return the cached RID.
descriptions.ZIPPacker/method/add_directory:
Adds directory to the archive. If modified_time is set to 0, current
system time is used. Note: Directories are automatically created when
start_file is called, use this function before adding files to create
directories with custom permissions and modification time.
descriptions.ZIPPacker/method/close: Closes the underlying resources used by this instance.
descriptions.ZIPPacker/method/close_file:
Stops writing to a file within the archive. It will fail if there is no
open file.
descriptions.ZIPPacker/method/open:
Opens a zip file for writing at the given path using the specified write
mode. This must be called before everything else.
descriptions.ZIPPacker/method/start_file:
Starts writing to a file within the archive. Only one file can be
written at the same time. If modified_time is set to 0, current system
time is used. Must be called after open.
descriptions.ZIPPacker/method/write_file: Write the given data to the file. Needs to be called after start_file.
descriptions.ZIPReader/method/close: Closes the underlying resources used by this instance.
descriptions.ZIPReader/method/file_exists:
Returns true if the file exists in the loaded zip archive. Must be
called after open.
descriptions.ZIPReader/method/get_compression_level:
Returns the compression level of the file in the loaded zip archive.
Returns -1 if the file doesn't exist or any other error occurs. Must be
called after open.
descriptions.ZIPReader/method/get_files:
Returns the list of names of all files in the loaded archive. Must be
called after open.
descriptions.ZIPReader/method/open: Opens the zip archive at the given path and reads its file index.
descriptions.ZIPReader/method/read_file:
Loads the whole content of a file in the loaded zip archive into memory
and returns it. Must be called after open.
